RaceName: Aalberts IPS Pegler Valves Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Bettered low-key debut when second at Newcastle (7f, AW) in December, despite racing too freely; makes turf debut after 225-day break but the drop in trip could be a good move; big player if fully tuned up.

RaceName: Aalberts IPS Pegler Valves Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Slightly disappointing when dropped to 5f for latest run and remains unproven on ground quicker than good, but was placed twice over 6f beforehand (maiden/handicap) and can play a major role if aided by first-time blinkers.

RaceName: Aalberts IPS Pegler Valves Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Boasts the best form in this line-up, having twice finished second (once over C&D) on fast ground in the spring, but seems to have lost his way since; beaten over 18l when last of four at Ripon (6f, good) a fortnight ago and arrives here with questions to answer.

RaceName: Aalberts IPS Pegler Valves Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Well beaten on both outings, the latest here (7f, good) on seasonal/stable debut in June; drops back to 6f with hood added today.

RaceName: Bapp Group Of Companies Bapp Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Third at Beverley (7.4f, good) and justified favouritism in a five-runner novice at Ayr (7f, good to firm) four weeks later, outpaced over 2f out but rallying strongly; the fourth from that Ayr race is the only one to have run since and he won; while 1m might have made more appeal, this one clearly looks capable of better.

RaceName: Bapp Group Of Companies Bapp Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: Spg Property, Alfa Site & Graeme Curnow
Spotlight: Second at Wolverhampton (6f, AW; 66-1) in June, always front rank, was much better than his runs on good ground either side; just behind Eighth Immortal at Chester (6f) latest, with that rival going past him; late foal who's bred to stay 1m+.

RaceName: Bapp Group Of Companies Bapp Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Favourite both starts, when unable to hold off a strong finisher at Leicester (7f, good) and unable to threaten at Chester (6f, good; third at 11-10); the winner on first occasion took the Group 2 Vintage at Goodwood this week for his second win since, and the third also won next time; moving back up to 7f should help this one on nursery debut.

RaceName: Bapp Group Of Companies Bapp Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: All three races were over 7f on good ground, best on second occasion when third of seven at Sandown despite having traffic issues and stumbling; raced up with pace, but faded, when favourite there last time; goes handicapping and his earlier promise can't be forgotten.

RaceName: Bapp Group Of Companies Bapp Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Modest form on first two starts (6f, AW/good) and stiff task when well beaten on soft ground for latest; gelded since; bred to stay 1m/1m2f in time and needs a market check on this handicap debut.

RaceName: 7 Core Electrical Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Band D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 16,000gns yearling and half-sister to a 6f winner; 18-1 at Epsom (7f, good to firm) but beaten only 2l after starting slowly; should be wiser this time and have every chance.

RaceName: 7 Core Electrical Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Band D) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: G H Thompson And Michael Dods
Spotlight: No match for a subsequent winner at Redcar in May (6f, good) but that was a promising start; pressed the leader and kept on; can improve.

RaceName: 7 Core Electrical Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Band D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Eighth foal; half-sister to winners Militia (5f/6f; RPR 93), Faster Bee (7f; 76) and Shamadram (6f-1m); dam placed 1m AW 2yo (71), half-sister to winners Tactician (1m6f Listed) and Promotion (Listed-placed 1m2f); trainer having a good season with his 2yos.

RaceName: 7 Core Electrical Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Band D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beaten 2l and less in her last three starts, all over 6f; narrowly denied last time at Chepstow (good to firm) and shouldn't be far away, unless there's a useful newcomer lurking.

RaceName: 7 Core Electrical Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Band D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 13,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-sister to winners Ziggy's Triton (multiple 5f; RPR 96), Soller Bay (6f-1m1f; 68) and Mullazem (7f/1m); dam unraced half-sister to 6f 2yo winner Furas; stable had a newcomer win on debut earlier this week.

RaceName: 7 Core Electrical Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Band D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 5,000gns yearling; 13th foal; half-sister to five winners including Staxton (6f; RPR 106), Lazarus Bell (7f 2yo; 89), Classic Pursuit (prolific 5f/6f; 89) and Satin Snake (7f; 81); dam 1m4f winner (80); rare 2yo runner for the yard.

RaceName: 7 Core Electrical Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Band D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 10,000euros 2yo; second foal; dam 1m-1m4f winner (RPR 87), closely related to winners Green Storm (Group-placed 1m1f 2yo) and Bulldog Spirit (1m-1m6f); trainer has sent out ten 2yo winners on turf this season.

RaceName: 7 Core Electrical Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Band D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 5,000gns foal; seventh foal; half-sister to 7f winner One Night Thunder (RPR 93); dam 6f AW winner (91), out of 1m4f/2m winning sister to Group 2 winners Nearly Caught (1m7f) and Pale Mimosa (2m); the market should be informative.

RaceName: 7 Core Electrical Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Band D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: The form of her second places give her a chance but now 0-7 and very disappointing in her last two races, latterly tried in cheekpieces.

RaceName: 7 Core Electrical Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Band D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to 6f/7f winner Eye Of Dubai (RPR 97); dam French 7.5f-1m2f winner, half-sister to German 1m3f winner Sokol; makes sense to check the betting.

RaceName: 7 Core Electrical Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Band D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 8,000gns yearling; half-sister to 5f winner Beerwah (RPR 70); dam placed 5f-1m (102), sister to 7f winner Jalaad; stable's newcomers are usually best watched.

RaceName: 7 Core Electrical Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Band D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Low-level form thus far (over 5f) and likely to fare better when handicapping.

RaceName: Yates Drywall Ltd Handicap
Spotlight: Some return to form in his last two races and wasn't far away over 1m here last time when a stronger pace would have helped; interesting returned to further, having won over this far.

RaceName: Yates Drywall Ltd Handicap
Spotlight: Only 1-27, the win when with Ralph Beckett; had been badly out of form this season but ran better in a new tongue-tie over 1m here last time when close up behind Mariner; possibilities if as good again as he stays this far.

RaceName: Yates Drywall Ltd Handicap
Spotlight: All the better for a hood returning, winning two of his last three races; overcame some traffic issues to prevail narrowly at Windsor 12 days ago (1m2f, good to firm); 3lb higher.

RaceName: Yates Drywall Ltd Handicap
Spotlight: Won at Ripon (1m, soft) last July off a mark 12lb higher than today's but he's struggled since; others have stronger claims.

RaceName: Yates Drywall Ltd Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice over 9.4f on the AW during the winter; probably okay on turf (0-4) but last two runs were heavy defeats and she's been off since March.

RaceName: Yates Drywall Ltd Handicap
Spotlight: Has shown some fair Flat form but became disappointing for David O'Meara and has shown nothing over hurdles for current yard.

RaceName: Winners Wear Skopes Menswear Handicap
Spotlight: Bought for 50,000gns soon after winning a 6f Curragh maiden in first-time cheekpieces (eighth start); proven over 1m, let alone this far, and could be interesting on yard/handicap debut.

RaceName: Winners Wear Skopes Menswear Handicap
OwnerName: L Bond, Sheikh Aymen Al Hamandi, J Catling
Spotlight: 0-7 in Ireland with one notable effort when narrowly beaten in a 5f handicap at Naas in March (first-time blinkers); struggled in two following runs, the latest tried in a visor; changed hands for 5,500gns; likely best watched.

RaceName: Winners Wear Skopes Menswear Handicap
Spotlight: Twice runner-up before winning a 7f AW maiden in October and then gelded; finished last of the four when favourite for his handicap debut at Catterick (7f, good to firm) but he raced freely up front and didn't look at home on the track; worth another chance.

RaceName: Winners Wear Skopes Menswear Handicap
OwnerName: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd
Spotlight: 7f maiden winner in May and held his own in handicaps until a poor last run, since when he's been gelded; entitled to play a part if back to best.

RaceName: Winners Wear Skopes Menswear Handicap
Spotlight: Newmarket maiden winner for Harry Charlton last August (6f, good to firm); subsequently sold for 90,000gns; building momentum in handicaps for his new yard, last time holding every chance over C&D and going down by a length; solid prospects off 1lb lower.

RaceName: Winners Wear Skopes Menswear Handicap
Spotlight: Goodwood novice winner in May of last year; 0-9 in the meantime and progress has levelled out; ran no more than okay when third of five in a new tongue-tie last week at Lingfield (6f, good to firm); swaps cheekpieces for first-time blinkers here.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Started off well for Ruth Carr, although did appear to throw away (hung right) a winning opportunity when runner-up at Carlisle (7f, good) in May; better than bare facts - denied a clear run - when sixth of nine at Thirsk latest; fairly treated, so isn't discounted.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Dual AW winner, including from this mark at Newcastle (7f) in February; is yet to win on turf (0-13) but was beaten a nose in this last year, and was returning from a ten-week break when sixth of ten at Redcar (7f; 50-1; beaten 10l) in June; others preferred.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: 14-race maiden; forced to switch right - circumnavigated the field - when third of 11 at Ripon (6f, good; 11-4 favourite) a fortnight ago; worth another go over 7f (first since debut) as he seeks to make the breakthrough; likely player.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Overcame slow start to win in newly applied visor at Leicester (7f; from 3lb lower) on penultimate start; less productive (fourth of five) back there over 6f subsequently; cheekpieces refitted, and Christian Howarth's 3lb claim can assist.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Modest in maidens, the pick of her three starts coming on Catterick debut (7f, soft; fourth, beaten nearly 7l) last July; has been given a nine-week break since low-key Chester comeback; hood applied for handicap debut.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Made the most of a favourable draw, running down the pacesetter at Redcar (6f, good; from 4lb lower) in June; below that level at Thirsk, but this is easier, and Jake Dickson's 5lb claim is handy; stamina is untested beyond 6f.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: 1-12; placed over C&D in April, and gave it a good go from the front when third to Vega's Virtue at Ripon (1m, good) a fortnight ago; sports newly applied cheekpieces seeking that extra edge with the drop back to 7f in her favour; chance.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Sole win from 24 starts came at Brighton (7f, good; from 9lb higher) in May 2024; generally disappointing for this trainer, weakening on first start since wind surgery at Ffos Las (7.5f, good; beaten over 7l) 32 days ago; 3lb lower.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: 0-4; failed to take step forward on Ripon handicap debut (6f; seventh of nine, 28-1; always towards rear); still early days but, equally, there's little to suggest that she can play a role in the finish.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden; has plummeted in the weights since sent handicapping (down 16lb); weakened quickly when last of eight in first-time cheekpieces at Wetherby (5.5f) latest; difficult to identify many positives; headgear tweaked.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Ran well (third) on Southwell debut (5f maiden; 33-1) last April, but it's been all downhill since, beating only a single rival in two AW starts this year; cheekpieces discarded off 95-day break for turf return; monitor only.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: 0-8; no match for Act Of Violence at Ripon (6f, good; 10-1) a fortnight ago, but that was a step back in the right direction, and third-placed Get Up Everybody puts that form to the test in the first division (4:50); key player on first attempt at 7f (dam a 7f-8.4f winner).

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: 2-5 over C&D; scrambled home to justify favouritism from Operation Gimcrack (runs in first division) in this last year; placed numerous times since, including at Yarmouth (7f; 10-1) on penultimate start; slow start scuppered chance latest.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Modest since joining Nigel Tinkler (0-6) but there was merit to his Carlisle second (7f, soft) on penultimate start; that track seems to bring out the best of his abilities so, although fairly weighted, he couldn't rate as a confident pick.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: 0-7; respectable comeback at Nottingham (5f, good; fourth, beaten 3l) in May, but hasn't built on that, including in blinkers (discarded) the last twice; tough to say how he'll fare on first go at 7f; safer options elsewhere.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Five-race maiden; lost shoe when failing to figure (11 of 14) on handicap debut at Bath (1m; 25-1) seven weeks ago; 2lb lower in the right type of race, but with clear improvement required to threaten.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Finished strongly to resume winning ways over C&D (good to soft; from 2lb lower) in May; hasn't operated at the same level since, but overall strike rate (10-80) is admirable for the level; forecast ground perhaps faster than ideal.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Seven-race maiden; in rear throughout in newly applied headgear combination (discarded) over 6f here five weeks ago; eased another 3lb in the handicap since, so isn't written off yet; prudent to consult the market.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: 27-race maiden; placed in this same headgear combination at Wolverhampton and Chester (both 7f) before producing poor performance at Chester latest; opposed on the balance of probability.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Yet to win on turf (0-12); hasn't managed to beat many rivals in three starts this year, only eighth of nine at Catterick (7f; 28-1) 24 days ago; handicap mark continues to slide.

RaceName: Harrison College Handicap (Div II)
OwnerName: Dr M Voikhansky & Mrs S Voikhanskaya
Spotlight: 0-7; onto third trainer already, having previously been with Richard Hannon and Kevin/Lauren Frost; minor headway when sixth on recent stable debut at Wolverhampton (7f; 22-1); down a further 5lb in the weights.

RaceName: Grace And Dotty Handicap
Spotlight: Won the Legends Classified Stakes here (1m; 40-1) last September; knocking on the door over 7f here (23) in recent times; competitively weighted from an unchanged mark, and a danger to all if allowed uncontested lead back at 6f.

RaceName: Grace And Dotty Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner; runner-up on last two starts, beaten a nose at Carlisle (6f, good; 5-2 favourite) four weeks ago; that form looks solid, with the winner running well in a Class 4 at York subsequently; 1lb higher, but does have Alex Jary's 3lb claim to assist; key player.

RaceName: Grace And Dotty Handicap
Spotlight: No turf win since July 2023; ran respectably (fifth) on stable debut at Yarmouth (7f, good) in May and has had excuses since, including when stumbling and unseating his rider at the start at Goodwood on Wednesday; 3lb below last winning mark (AW), and with a 5lb claimer booked.

RaceName: Grace And Dotty Handicap
OwnerName: Come On Over Syndicate & A H Yates Ltd
Spotlight: Beaten a neck over C&D in June; made amends the following week before his revised mark could kick into force, making all to fend off a pair of rivals who also raced far side early on in that contest; weakened quickly when last of four at Nottingham latest; needs to bounce back.

RaceName: Grace And Dotty Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced filly who is continuing to make progress; runner-up on her last two starts, latest when a neck behind Saucy Jane on handicap debut at Thirsk (6f; good to firm; 20-1); 1lb higher in a slightly more competitive contest but can't be ruled out.

RaceName: Grace And Dotty Handicap
Spotlight: Ripon specialist (ten wins at that track); run down only by Reigning Profit and Rock Of England when attempting to win the race named in his honour there (5f) 26 days ago; no issue with this return to 6f and has been placed here previously.

RaceName: Grace And Dotty Handicap
Spotlight: 1-21; close fourth at Thirsk (6f, good; from 7lb higher) in April; has lost his way since, failing to beat many in 5f contests at Pontefract, Beverley, and Chester; questions to be answered for the time being.

RaceName: Grace And Dotty Handicap
Spotlight: Made the breakthrough, justifying favouritism at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) 17 days ago; while she has responded to the removal of the hood, this represents a step back up the ladder (Class 5) from a 4lb higher mark; her task isn't an insurmountable one, though.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Group 3 winner in France and was second in a German Group 1 last year; sold for 400,000euros since; not a bad hurdling debut at Killarney but was poor back on the Flat at Royal Ascot; however, has a solid shout back hurdling and looks the stable first-string.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: French bumper winner was second in a Grade 3 in that sphere when last seen in April 2025; a concern that he has been off for so long but still has to be respected from this yard even though he looks the second-string.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Four Flat wins and is rated 89 in that sphere; was never involved in the Connacht Hotel handicap here five days ago; best hurdle run when second at Killarney last time, a mistake at the last costing him; should be in the mix.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Placed in a point; won a Naas bumper in testing ground before third in a Grade 2 bumper at Leopardstown; not as good in an Aintree Grade 2 since on better ground; should be capable of running well on hurdle bow.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a Fairyhouse bumper on debut for Mags Mullins last November, beating the smart Moonverrin into second; has since changed hands and looks to have been targetted at this meeting so has to be feared; the market can be a guide.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Best point run came when second in February; well beaten in a Downpatrick maiden hurdle; lots to find; hood on.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Smart Flat sort has won twice and seems to stay 1m2f; a solid run in a Curragh Group 3 in April and now rated 101; has stamina to prove on hurdling debut but could be a player if jumping soundly.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Second runner for yard; beaten 12l in a Roscommon handicap hurdle last time and can't be fancied here on that form.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Beaten a long way in three maiden hurdles on soft ground in the spring; however, has respected connections and is likely to do better on this sounder surface.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Respectable midfield finishes in both maiden hurdle runs and looks one for handicaps in time.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Beaten a long way in a Punchestown maiden hurdle on debut for Tony Mullins; passed over today.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Soundly beaten in a bumper and maiden hurdle at Bellewstown so is best watched for the time being.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Five Flat wins in UK for Sir Mark Prescott up to 2m1f and rated 87; bought for 19,000gns last year; a concern that he has been off the track since but is worth a market check.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Beaten a long way at Kilbeggan on debut and passed over today.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Runner-up on second point start; showed a glimpse of ability in a Tramore bumper but needs to do much better here.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Soundly beaten in all starts in different disciplines so is one for handicaps in time.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: A 1m2f AW winner for Jane Chapple Hyam last year; beaten 29l in a Cork maiden hurdle on stable debut last month; needs plenty of improvement from that; tongue-tie on.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Two wins up to 1m4f when trained by William Haggas before being sold for 30,000gns; makes hurdling debut after an absence and could run well; the market can help.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Four of his five wins came in Britain, with three at Cartmel; posted a solid run at Ballinrobe last time and should run well again off 1lb higher.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has been in the form of her life at present, winning handicaps at Ballinrobe (2m) and Kilbeggan (2m4f); got a 10lb rise for that and back down in trip but still has to be on the shortlist.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual-purpose winner won his last hurdle race over C&D last October; ran a solid race from the front to be third to Putapoundinthejar at Bellewstown last time; 3lb better off and cheekpieces added; chance.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual-purpose winner was well beaten at Punchestown on his last hurdle run but ran a decent race on the Flat at Tramore since; needs to find more.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual-purpose winner was below form over hurdles on his last two starts for Gavin Cromwell last winter; however, would have a chance off this mark if restored to his best.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a Limerick 4yo Grade 2 in 2022 but no win since; some decent efforts in defeat earlier this year but was well beaten in a 2m4f Punchestown handicap last time; the drop in trip may help.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Killarney novice hurdle winner last October has run well at times in defeat since, notably back at that track in May; poor behind Spy at Listowel since so questions.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won this last year off a 3lb lower mark; some good hurdle runs in defeat after while also won over fences; beaten 10l by Putapoundinthejar at Bellewstown last time but is 7lb better off so a player.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Exors of the Late E Blaney
Spotlight: Dual purpose winner won for the second time over hurdles when narrowly taking a 2m4f Killarney handicap last time; needs more down in trip off 7lb higher.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual hurdle winner and was third in this race in 2023 off 6lb higher; regressive over fences last season but a decent Flat run at Killarney last time; could run well.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Seamus Perry & Brian P Larkin & Ms Bernadette Leigh
Spotlight: Won for the second time over hurdles when scoring at Punchestown in May (form franked) over this trip; raised 7lb for that and is up in grade but goes well fresh so has to be respected.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Useful Flat sort on the continent has got his act together over hurdles, winning at Downpatrick and Killarney 109 days apart; seems best fresh but if he can back that up off 9lb higher then he is a player.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual-purpose winner is at his best on testing ground; last win came on the Flat here in October 2025; well beaten on the level here three days ago.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: D O'Mahony & D McHugh & D J Kelly & G Butler
Spotlight: Yet to win on the Flat but took a Down Royal maiden hurdle in May; might have been unsuited by soft ground when poor in a Roscommon novice last time; solid fourth on the Flat here on Thursday.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won three bumpers in France but is yet to score over hurdles for this yard; best run in a valuable handicap at Leopardstown in February but was poor in a maiden since; a player if back to best.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual-purpose winner won a Listowel handicap hurdle in June but was beaten 13l by Putapoundinthejar at Bellewstown last time; has to rebound.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Better known as a chaser and won a Ballinrobe handicap in that discipline in May; ran well on the first of two Flat starts since; hasn't run over hurdles since 2022 but could go well.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden in all spheres but was running a big race in a Cork maiden hurdle before falling last time; cheekpieces are added and capable of a decent showing.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Dual-purpose sort has been soundly beaten on his last three hurdle runs and needs a return to his best.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Won over fences last time at Wexford (2m3f); dual hurdle winner and has posted some smart form in this sphere over shorter; has a chance if getting back to best hurdle form and staying this trip.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Six hurdle wins in Britain; some solid runs in defeat in quality handicaps since his last win including at Plumpton last time; needs more but shouldn't be far away either.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Five wins between hurdles and fences up to 3m; decent runs in defeat over hurdles and fences last twice so one to consider.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Some decent runs in dxefeat in bumpers; won a Listowel maiden over 2m4f and was just denied in a Bellewstown handicap over 3m since; up 3lb but improving sort can be competitive.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Is 1-12 over hurdles; well beaten back on the Flat at Royal Ascot last time; needs a return to best hurdle form but can't be ruled out.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: The last of his four hurdle wins came in this race in 2023 off 4lb higher; mostly chasing since and blinkers added; others more likely here.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Won a valuable 2m handicap here in 2023 and won over fences after; solid runs at Wexford and Bellewstown lately, with the latter run looking better after the win of Putapoundinthejar in the Galway Hurdle; can run a sound race if staying.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Point and hurdle winner has been soundly beaten over fences lately but would have a shout on his best hurdles form of last year.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Doubled his score over hurdles when winning well at Roscommon last time, beating Stede Bonnet; however, his record is still only 2-29 and a 7lb rise makes this a tougher task up in grade.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Bumper winner in 2023 built on his Clonmel maiden win when scoring at Limerick on handicap debut, both over approx' 2m4f; up 10lb but is an improving sort and should stay this trip.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Last win came in a Listed hurdle in November at Kempton over 2m5f; some good runs after but was below form at Cheltenham; a decent Flat run last time at Tramore; considered.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Came back to form in terrific style when winning the Connacht Hotel Flat Handicap over 2m on Monday here; hasn't run over hurdles since May 2025 but can be a big player with his confidence boosted.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Dual bumper winner is 2-8 over hurdles, both wins coming over about 2m; solid runs in defeat in 2m4f handicaps the last twice and should be competitive off same mark.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Has posted five wins between hurdles and fences; beat Dani Donadoni in a conditions race over 3m at Wexford last time; a 6lb rise makes this a tougher task but promising 5lb claimer helps.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Second runner for UK yard; won for the fifth time over hurdles at Uttoxeter last time, scoring by 11l over 2m4f; has to be respected even up 10lb and looks likely to stay too.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner looked set to score over 3m at Wexford before being run down by Kiltealy Park; similar effort in a Roscommon novice down to 2m since; needs more back in a handicap but considered.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Formerly smart chaser when trained by Gordon Elliott, winning in Grade 2 company and placed in Grade 1 bumpers; not a bad hurdle run last time at Worcester but this is much more competitive.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Won at Kilbeggan in June, his fifth hurdle win, but was beaten a long way there since so has to bounce back in a competitive race.

RaceName: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Promising sort last autumn, winning a maiden and second in a novice hurdle; however, he has to rebound in a major way from two pulled-up runs.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
OwnerName: For The Love Of It Syndicate
Spotlight: Off the mark at the second attempt in point-to-points at Lisronagh for Benny Walsh in April; has joined a shrewd yard that has already had a winner here this week and this daughter of Yeats needs checking in the market on Rules' debut; tongue tied.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: One of two for top yard that has won five of last six renewals; Doctor Dino filly; half-sister to winners Fleur In The Park (smart bumper and 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase), Zurekin (useful 2m1f/2m2f hurdle), Hunting Brook (2m5f/3m hurdle) and Marie Philippe (bumper); dam useful 2m1f-2m5f chase winner; preferred by Patrick Mullins.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Placed in one of two starts in point-to-points; bought for E25,000 after finishing second of four finishers at Oldcastle; percentage call is to watch on Rules' bow.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
OwnerName: Whose Round Is It Now Syndicate
Spotlight: Wide margin point-to-point winner on soft in April at Tullaherin; promising start under Rules when a 2.75l third of 14 at Wexford in May and the second from that race has won a bumper easily since; big player on that form.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Off the mark at the third attempt in point-to-points at Loughrea in May; bought for E35,000 at Tattersalls later that month; probably best watched on Rules' debut; tongue tied.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Belied odds of 66-1 to run a huge race on debut at Roscommon when she had a few of these behind; enters calculations now with improvement likely to be forthcoming.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Okay effort when fourth at Tramore on debut; didn't build on that when tailed off at Cork latest; others preferred.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Best effort yet when finishing ahead of Aodha's Arrow and Back In Favour at Roscommon on latest; should strip fitter for that run and holds an each way chance.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Harzand filly; half-sister to winners Phantom Gold (bumper/2m4f hurdle) and Parisian Fashion (2m4f hurdle); dam useful bumper and 2m/2m1f hurdle winner; makes some appeal on paper and worth checking in the market; tongue tied.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Modest enough efforts in bumpers at Leopardstown when beaten 16l into fourth and at Limerick when beaten 32l into fifth; new cheekpieces need to eke out more.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Displayed potential on debut at Limerick (2m, soft) two months ago, outpaced but keeping on for a 9.75l third of 9; should come on for that and now sports a tongue tie; not discounted for place purposes.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Old Persian filly; half-sister to winners Miami Present (useful 2m-3m1f hurdle/chase) and Florida Calling (point); dam German 7f/7.5f winner, half-sister to 1m Listed Flat and useful 2m-2m2f hurdle/chase winner Moon Over Miami; market can guide on debut.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: 25-1 and beaten 25l on debut at Tramore in May; others make more appeal.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: 40-1 but creditable effort on debut at Killarney last month, showing up well before fading in the final furlong into a 6.5l third of 15; likely to improve for that run and outside place claims.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Heavy defeats at big odds in bumpers at Roscommon and Wexford; seems safe to rule out.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Promise in all three starts; beaten similar distances when fifth on debut at Cork and again on second start at Wexford; didn't get a clear run when beaten 3.5l into fourth at Sligo on latest; can give another good account.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
OwnerName: Going For The One Syndicate/Michael McEvoy/Jimmy Whittle
Spotlight: Was bang there when falling at the last in sole point-to-point start at Lisronagh in April; bumper winners in pedigree and yard had a bumper winner at Ballinrobe last month; market can guide on Rules' debut.

RaceName: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Poet's Word mare; dam bumper/2m hurdle winner, sister to smart bumper and 2m2f-2m6f hurdle winner Glens Melody, closely related to useful 2m-3m hurdle winner Lean Araig, out of 2m Flat, bumper and useful 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase winner; lots of appeal on paper and top yard has won five of last six renewals.

RaceName: Whiriskey Refrigeration Irish EBF Maiden
OwnerName: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith
Spotlight: Brother to 6f Group 2 2yo winner Beautify; was the stable second-string on debut when runner-up in what is traditionally a strong Curragh maiden; that was 7f but looked as if he would stay this trip; looks the one to beat on that run.

RaceName: Whiriskey Refrigeration Irish EBF Maiden
Spotlight: A 75,000gns breeze-up purchase in April and from a middle-distance family; recovered from a slow start to run well on debut at Killarney over this trip; can be more competitive with that experience behind him.

RaceName: Whiriskey Refrigeration Irish EBF Maiden
Spotlight: First foal; dam twice-raced half-sister to winners Alluringly (9.4f Listed) and Toogood Tobetrue (useful 6f 2yo), from the family of Derby winners and oustanding sires Galileo and Sea The Stars; E300,000 yearling is the stable second-string on debut but is still respected.

RaceName: Whiriskey Refrigeration Irish EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Fifth foal; half-brother to winners Pinot Gris (10.3f/1m5f Flat, RPR 87; useful 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase) and Postdamerstrasse (Italian 7.5f); dam 1m4f/12.5f winner (85); E18,000 foal made E40,000 as a yearling; by a promising first-crop sire and related to winners so could run respectably.

RaceName: Bathshack Maiden
Spotlight: Glimmers of ability in three runs last season for John Kiely; caught the eye of the stewards when a never nearer sixth on final start for that stable here over 7f in October (heavy); worth a market check on first run for new yard.

RaceName: Bathshack Maiden
Spotlight: Betrayed inexperience when a 3.25l sixth of 15 in a Curragh maiden on debut in May (1m2f, good); should improve plenty for that run and the choice of Foley but whether this drop back in trip will suit is debateable and drawn wide.

RaceName: Bathshack Maiden
Spotlight: Has displayed winning potential when fourth in maidens at Dundalk in December (7f) and at Gowran (1m, soft) in April; off 114 days but clearly has ability, is well drawn and market can guide.

RaceName: Bathshack Maiden
Spotlight: Rated 74; promise in maidens last year (including here over 7f on soft) and in first two runs this term at Leopardstown; no impact behind Gliondar in 1m Curragh maiden on good latest; could do better back on softer ground in first-time blinkers.

RaceName: Bathshack Maiden
Spotlight: Caught the eye when a 6.25l third of 16 on debut at Gowran; had excuses when sixth on latest at Naas (scoped dirty); tricky draw here and Foley prefers Royal Bones.

RaceName: Bathshack Maiden
Spotlight: 33-1 and beaten 20l on debut in fillies' maiden at Gowran; may need more time.

RaceName: Bathshack Maiden
Spotlight: Minor promise over 7f at Fairyhouse on debut and built on that when a 1l third of 7 upped to 10.5f (good) at Down Royal at 80-1; place claims dropped back in trip.

RaceName: Bathshack Maiden
Spotlight: Well beaten in barrier trial; modest efforts in maidens at Navan and Gowran; will get a handicap mark after this.

RaceName: Bathshack Maiden
OwnerName: Sheikh Khalid Bin Ali Al Khalifa
Spotlight: Make Believe gelding; brother to 1m AW winner Suspicion (RPR 85); dam unraced half-sister to winners Ninjago (6f Listed) and Florestans Match (6f), out of French 7.5f Listed winner; likely best watched on debut.

RaceName: Bathshack Maiden
Spotlight: Huge odds for all three starts and slowly away in two of them; hard to make a case for on form.

RaceName: Bathshack Maiden
Spotlight: 80-1 and failed to beat a rival on debut at Gowran; hard to fancy

RaceName: Bathshack Maiden
Spotlight: Modest maiden rated just 30; impossible to fancy in a race of this nature.

RaceName: Ardilaun Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Gained second career win off just 1lb higher at Down Royal in May (7f, good); lost form since and was soundly beaten behind a couple of these rivals over 8.5f here on Tuesday; would prefer a sounder surface.

RaceName: Ardilaun Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: British raider seeking a hat-trick after back to back fast ground wins over 7.5f at Beverley; has gone up 8lb for those two victories; clearly in fine fettle and nicely drawn but may need quicker ground.

RaceName: Ardilaun Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Had been running well before a below par effort at the Curragh last time over an inadequate 5f; runner up over C&D last year off 8lb higher; could bounce back.

RaceName: Ardilaun Hotel Handicap
Ardilaun Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Goes well at this venue and was only reeled in close to home over 8.5f here on Tuesday; runs off the same mark now and nicely drawn so can't discount dropped back in trip; obvious chance.

RaceName: Ardilaun Hotel Handicap
Ardilaun Hotel Handicap
Ardilaun Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Two wins when trained in France over 6f and 1m1f; no impact in first two runs for this stable; mark sliding but drawn wide and others make more appeal.

RaceName: Ardilaun Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time winner but no joy since July 2023; mark sliding but hasn't looked like taking advantage in recent starts; beaten 10.5l when down the field at the Curragh on latest.

RaceName: Ardilaun Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Has failed to add to his Gowran maiden win in April 2024 (7f, good); not a bad effort when a close fourth behind Minaun View in a Bellewstown claimer latest (Gloriously Glam second); handicap form unconvincing; new headgear combination tried.

RaceName: Ardilaun Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice last year and is now 2lb below his last success but heavy defeats both starts this term; blinkers go back on but they didn't do much for him when he wore them before.

RaceName: Ardilaun Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Four-time winner claimed out of Ado McGuinness' yard for E10,000 after finishing a 0.5l second behind in form Minaun View in Bellewstown claimer; 8lb below last handicap win but difficult draw on first start for new stable.

RaceName: Ardilaun Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Won this race last year off 4lb lower for Mick Mulvany; has run well on all three previous visits to this venue and should be sharper for her seasonal reappearance and stable debut at Ballinrobe 40 days ago; visor added to tongue tie; could go well.

RaceName: McDonogh Capital Investments Handicap
Spotlight: Gained second turf win at Roscommon in May (10.5f, yielding) off 4lb lower; has come up short twice since off revised mark but ran well off 1lb higher at this meeting last year over 8.5f so not dismissed stepped up in trip in first-time blinkers.

RaceName: McDonogh Capital Investments Handicap
Spotlight: Four-time winner landed this race last season off 72; was running off that mark when winning at Roscommon on latest (10.5f, good); 6lb rise makes things tougher but she's got a nice low draw, ground is fine and should be in the mix again.

RaceName: McDonogh Capital Investments Handicap
Spotlight: Dual 1m winner in Britain, both on good ground; no show last year for this stable but both runs this year encouraging, only beaten 2.25l when fifth at Ayr latest (1m2f, good); not well drawn here, however, and may need quicker ground; visored.

RaceName: McDonogh Capital Investments Handicap
Spotlight: 5-26 on turf; just 2lb higher than when winning at Leopardstown in October (1m2f, heavy); beaten 3.75l into fifth in this race last season off this mark but hard to fancy on this season's efforts and others look better treated.

RaceName: McDonogh Capital Investments Handicap
Spotlight: Seven-time turf winner on a hat-trick after back to back wins at Navan (1m2f, good) and Killarney (11.5f, good); has gone up 11lb for those wins but she has won off higher marks in the past; however, was unplaced in the 5.40 here on Thursday.

RaceName: McDonogh Capital Investments Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden showed more than enough for Charlie Fellowes last season to suggest he could win races; below best when last seen at Newmarket in October; worth a market check on debut for Gordon Elliott.

RaceName: McDonogh Capital Investments Handicap
Spotlight: Ex-French performer 4-12 on the AW but just 1-11 on turf for former yard; yet to show much since joining this stable but drops in grade and shrewd yard won nice pot here earlier this week; check the market.

RaceName: McDonogh Capital Investments Handicap
Spotlight: Both Flat wins at this trip, a Curragh maiden on good in July 2024 and a Roscommon handicap (soft) off 6lb lower last October; has failed to fire on previous runs at this venue, including when beaten 19l over 16.5f here on Wednesday.

RaceName: McDonogh Capital Investments Handicap
Spotlight: Both turf wins came over 1m but proved stamina for 1m4f when scoring at Dundalk in February; nice prep run for this at Navan over 1m2f and the step back up to this trip is a plus but he's got a tricky draw to overcome.

RaceName: McDonogh Capital Investments Handicap
Spotlight: Enjoyed a purple patch in 2023, winning five times on the Flat (and once over hurdles) for Mick Mulvany; solid run over hurdles here on Wednesday; won over 8.5f at this meeting in 2023, this trip is within her range and she's 4lb below her last success; player.

RaceName: McDonogh Capital Investments Handicap
Spotlight: British raider; won twice on the Flat when trained by Dermot Weld (1-9 on turf); ran well in a Market Rasen maiden hurdle on penultimate; out of depth in Listed hurdle here earlier this week; this more realistic but difficult draw.

RaceName: McDonogh Capital Investments Handicap
Spotlight: Up 6lb for breakthrough Flat win at Roscommon in May (1m4f, yielding), beating subsequent winner Obscenity by 2.75l; soundly beaten in Punchestown maiden hurdle latest but has to be considered back on the level from low draw.

RaceName: McDonogh Capital Investments Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't won on the Flat since scoring over C&D at this meeting in 2023; went close at Navan in April (1m5f, gd-yld) off 2lb lower; hasn't backed that up since but did run a nice race over hurdles here on Wednesday.

RaceName: McDonogh Capital Investments Handicap
Spotlight: Best on AW (6-12) but just 1-20 on turf; scored at Dundalk in March but soundly beaten back on turf the last twice (7l behind Thatwilldoso on penultimate); drawn wide; others more convincing.

RaceName: McDonogh Capital Investments Handicap
Spotlight: Two-time 1m AW winner for former yard; went close on debut for this stable on last Flat start at Dundalk (10.5f); no impact over hurdles last thrice and 0-7 record on turf on the Flat doesn't inspire confidence; drawn wide.

RaceName: McDonogh Capital Investments Handicap
Spotlight: French recruit; placed twice for former yard in 2025; 50-1 and never figured on return from 407 days off on stable debut at Ballinrobe 12 days ago; drawn wide and probably best watched for now.

RaceName: Highclere Castle Gin Summer Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 0-6 in handicaps, with regular progress/promise but not when favourite last time at Royal Ascot where he raced freely early on and ran out of steam after challenging over 2f out (finished 8l sixth of 17); it's much too early to forget his reappearance promise (also 1m4f on good to firm) but that latest run also casts some doubt on the suitability of this new trip.

RaceName: Highclere Castle Gin Summer Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 1m4f festival wins off much lower marks at Chester and Epsom last July when trained by the Moores; returned to Flat with an eye-catching effort at Royal Ascot (2m4f, good to firm; 12-1) last month, turning for home towards rear but running on into sixth of 20; back down in trip but one to note.

RaceName: Highclere Castle Gin Summer Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Close third in this last year and a creditable, running-on fourth of 16 at Royal Ascot (1m6f, good to firm) latest start; strong each-way chance.

RaceName: Highclere Castle Gin Summer Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: The future looked bright when he won the Melrose at York (1m6f, good to firm) last August but he's not built on that significantly; well held back in Britain for two Group races this May when last seen; off 12lb higher than in the Melrose, this return to a handicap may also be tough.

RaceName: Highclere Castle Gin Summer Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Stepped up to 1m6f with cheekpieces enlisted for last two starts and won them both, doing it smoothly at this track (good) and having to battle when prevailing by a neck in valuable race at Newmarket (good to firm); raised another 3lb but looks a serious contender once again.

RaceName: Highclere Castle Gin Summer Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Upset in the stalls when a disappointing favourite at this meeting last year (subsequently gelded); had a 1m6f win next time and solid performances when beaten about 3l on all three starts this season, sixth of 16 when back up to 1m6f at Royal Ascot latest; others saw it out better that day but he should have serious each-way claims.

RaceName: Highclere Castle Gin Summer Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won this race in 2024 before embarking on a long losing run; he's broken that with two 2m wins on the AW this year, most notably in the Northumberland Plate at Newcastle last time; second in valuable race at Newmarket (1m6f, good to firm) in May was followed by a blip here; back up another 4lb since Newcastle but not entirely ruled out.

RaceName: Highclere Castle Gin Summer Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Not a prolific winner, with his waiting tactics, but he was fourth in the Ebor at York (1m6f, good to firm) last August off a 2lb higher mark; ran creditably on reappearance, before neither start since panned out favourably; only ninth in this last year on his only run at Goodwood.

RaceName: Highclere Castle Gin Summer Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: J William Rowley & S P C Woods
Spotlight: Won five-runner race here (upped to 2m, good) in May and made most when fifth of 20 in the Northumberland Plate at Newcastle (2m, AW); no room over 1f out at Newbury two weeks ago but the speed with which he dropped out when jockey gave up was still rather disconcerting; place chance if bouncing back.

RaceName: Highclere Castle Gin Summer Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 2-5 in France and also scored in December in Bahrain for new connections; fourth of eight at Ascot (1m4f, good to firm) three weeks ago was probably his best form but better is needed and he didn't settle well enough behind horses that day, so is seemingly not crying out for this longer trip.

RaceName: Highclere Castle Gin Summer Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 2023 Royal Ascot winner who has also tasted the high life in top hurdle races; his attentions have been turned back to the Flat this year and he hasn't been in peak form; falling in the weights but still needs a revival; good 5lb claimer is enlisted.

RaceName: Highclere Castle Gin Summer Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Contested three Group races last summer; it's been 1m4f handicaps (good to firm) this season, registering his highest rating when fourth of eight at Newmarket in May but two disappointing shows at Ascot have followed; blinkered latest; stays at least 1m5f (unraced over this far) and he's 6lb lower than at Newmarket, but some caution is advised at present.

RaceName: Highclere Castle Gin Summer Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Two big runs over 1m4f here, including when third of nine in Listed race in May; not quite so good in two Ascot handicaps (1m6f/1m4f) since and there's a bit more to prove at this trip but that Listed run reads well.

RaceName: Coral Glorious Stakes (Group 3)
OwnerName: T & Mrs L Standish & Mrs A Spence
Spotlight: He's run well on both visits to Goodwood, latest a close third in 1m2f Listed race here (good) in May after an absence, and the late headway he made when eighth in the Listed Wolferton at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm) suggests this step up in trip could be a good move; each-way chance.

RaceName: Coral Glorious Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who won at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm) in May on his second start since being gelded and followed up in the Duke Of Edinburgh Handicap at Royal Ascot (1m4f, good to firm); he's by Frankel out of a Group 1 winner and could take this rise in grade in his stride; key player.

RaceName: Coral Glorious Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: 9yo who has won the last two runnings of this race (good to firm/good to soft) and has run well on both starts this season, most recently posting a cosy Listed win at Beverley (1m4f, good to firm); leading claims.

RaceName: Coral Glorious Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: He was returning from a year off when down the field in the Wolferton at Royal Ascot in June, and may have needed that first run for Kevin Philippart De Foy; classy performer for Clive Cox prior to £2,000,000 sale, making the frame in several Group 1s, and can have a big say if back to his best.

RaceName: Coral Glorious Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Late headway once in the clear in the Listed Wolferton Stakes at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm) in June, finishing seventh of 16, and outclassed in the Eclipse since (well beaten at 100-1); drops back in grade and the step back up in trip is worth a go, but he's 0-13 in Group/Listed races since winning the London Gold Cup in May 2024 and may again find a few too good.

RaceName: Coral Glorious Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Didn't really take to hurdling but she relished the step up in trip in this code when easily winning a 13-runner handicap at the Curragh (1m4f, good) in June; she has to prove that brilliance was no one-off but it was certainly an impressive performance and she could have a part to play today.

RaceName: Coral Glorious Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Ex-French 4yo who won Group 3 at Saint-Cloud (10.5f, good) last May; respectable Listed efforts on last two starts (including C&D) but hasn't shown enough on those outings to suggest he'll be making an impact today.

RaceName: Coral Glorious Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Won Meydan handicap (9.5f, good) in March and ran well in defeat in Listed races on next two starts (including here over 1m2f); however, no match for Al Aasy in Listed race at Beverley (1m4f, good to firm) four weeks ago and others have more substance to their claims.

RaceName: Qatar Lillie Langtry Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: 5l third to Waardah in this last year, before career best when second in the Melbourne Cup (2m); back to best European form when second in Group 3 at Fairyhouse (1m6f, good; unraced on firmer) this month but will probably have to settle for a place here if others show their best.

RaceName: Qatar Lillie Langtry Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Duelled with Consent over 1m6f last year; progressive ways continued in May with a win at Newmarket (substandard 1m4f Group 2, good to firm) and close second in Group 1 at Longchamp (near 2m, soft); the Hardwicke back over 1m4f at Royal Ascot six weeks ago was a stiff task and she hung right in first-time cheekpieces on her way to a heavy defeat; much more interesting today with no headgear and back up in trip.

RaceName: Qatar Lillie Langtry Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Won twice here (soft/good to soft) last summer, latterly when leading over 2f out in this race and seeing off Danielle's challenge by three-quarters of a length; ran moderately on final 3yo start but reappearance this May was positive when second to a class act in Group 3 at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm); big player if back to her peak.

RaceName: Qatar Lillie Langtry Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Pipped by Santorini Star in Group 2 at Doncaster (14.5f, good to soft) in September but turned the tables on her in fine style in Group 1 at Longchamp (1m6f, soft) in October; cut out tamely in the final 2f of another French Group 1 (near 2m, soft) on return but ten weeks have passed; never having raced on firmer than good asks quite a question but tough to beat if back to her best.

RaceName: Qatar Lillie Langtry Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies & Mares)
OwnerName: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith
Spotlight: Reappeared with 2l win in the Listed Cheshire Oaks at Chester (11.3f, good); soundly beaten when favourite for the Oaks itself on testing ground at Epsom and put firmly in her place when fifth in Irish Oaks at the Curragh (1m4f, good to firm; 5-1); wore a hood and blinkers on first two starts this season, just cheekpieces on latest; some limitations have seemingly been exposed and others saw the race out better in her two Oaks bids.

RaceName: Qatar Lillie Langtry Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Second to Waardah in this last year and fourth to Santorini Star and Consent in Group 2 at Doncaster (14.5f, good to soft) last September; routed her rivals in Listed event (1m2f, heavy) in November and reappeared with Group 3 win at York (1m6f, good; made most at 1-2) ten weeks ago; unraced on good to firm since 2024 (comfortably held); serious player if the ground is okay.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Chased home Far Above Dream, beaten a neck with the pair clear, in a C&D handicap in May; again finished behind that rival in the Wokingham six weeks ago (cheekpieces first time) and needs more to win but that is not out of the question.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Looked one to follow when bolting up at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in December; had numerous excuses for a series of subsequent defeats but things finally clicked again at York (6f, good to firm) last week, gamely repelling 20 rivals; 2lb wrong under his penalty but he has Group-race aspirations and shouldn't be passed over lightly.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: He hasn't had a great deal of racing since July 2024 but, two wind surgeries and a gelding operation later, he has shown he retains a good chunk of his former ability (Group 2 winner at best) this year, in a tongue-tie on last two starts; finished just behind Soldier's Tree when fifth in the Wokingham (6f, good to firm) but was in front of that rival in a Group 3 at Newbury two weeks ago; 3lb well in and has the ability to feature but his tendency to forfeit ground at the start isn't ideal in a race of this depth.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Finished eighth behind Two Tribes in this race 12 months ago when 4lb lower; he is a better horse now, as emphasised by two 6f AW wins in January and a fine second in the Wokingham (cheekpieces first time) but he finished behind Two Tribes at Ascot last week and others look more appealing for win purposes.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
OwnerName: L Bond & Sheikh Aymen Jawad Al Hamandi
Spotlight: Has a history of running well at this meeting and Tuesday's fourth (5f, good) was another solid effort; this looks a much stiffer test though.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Another success story for James Owen, progressing well in 2025 and continuing the good work this time around with wins over C&D and at Newbury (both good ground); another step forward when fourth in the Wokingham, an effort that can be upgraded, and he races off the same mark today; 3-3 over C&D and sure to be popular.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Climbed the ranks as a 4yo, ending that campaign with placed efforts in the Ayr Silver Cup and at Ascot; down the field on seasonal return but he hasn't looked back since, winning at Epsom (6f, soft) on Derby day for the second year in succession, doing best of the low numbers in the Wokingham (the others in his group have done well since) and then seeing off 19 rivals at the Curragh (6.3f, good to firm) two weeks ago; showed a fantastic attitude on that latest occasion and his 6lb penalty shouldn't prevent another big performance.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Impressed at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in June; had an excuse at Ascot next time and spent the first half of the race in the unfavoured stands' side group when down the field there last week; this looks too demanding all the same.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Still has low mileage and is proven over C&D but he has come up well short in deep races since winning here last August; hood left off this time; others look safer.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Would have finished closer than tenth in the Wokingham at Royal Ascot (6f) granted a clear run; scaled new heights when beating his 14 rivals there (5f, also good to firm) three weeks ago, finishing his race off strongly; 3lb wrong under his penalty today and while he has more good races in him, this one might prove too demanding.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Having edged down the weights he offered a good deal more when third to Tuco Salamanca at Newcastle (6f, AW) in June; finished with a flourish when seventh behind Dubai Bling at Ascot (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago, a run that confirmed he was still in good order; returning to 6f will help and he can't be dismissed, for all that he has been well beaten in this race twice before (2022 and 2025).

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: He didn't make his debut until December but this 5yo is quickly making up for lost time, finishing third in a Listed race at Salisbury (6f, good) on his stable debut and then running a huge race in the Wokingham at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm), beaten just over one length into third off a 1lb lower mark; again raced freely when third in a Group 3 at Newbury (6f, good to firm) two weeks ago; still has potential after just six starts.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Beat his 21 rivals at York in May and added a handicap at Chester (6f, good) last month; ran a fine race behind Sondad at the Curragh two weeks ago and is 7lb better off for half a length this time; officially the best handicapped horse in the race (5lb ahead of his mark) and another big run should be forthcoming.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Blessed with a potent turn of foot and he has been impressive in winning 6f AW handicaps at Kempton and Newcastle this year; a 3lb rise for the latter success five weeks ago doesn't handicap him out of things and he ran well in his one visit to Goodwood; one to be interested in.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Finished fourth behind stablemate Two Tribes in this race 12 months ago when 8lb lower and enjoyed his finest hour when making most to win the Ayr Gold Cup (6f, soft) last September; successful in Dubai early in the year and although his results have been mixed since returning to Britain, he retains plenty of ability; down the field over 5f here on Tuesday when a change of tactics failed to bear fruit; better can be expected today.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Profile is hit and miss but conditions won't faze him; he looked good at Carlisle (6f, good to firm; cheekpieces first time) in May and brings relatively low mileage but he was only midfield in the Wokingham and is 1lb higher today, so needs a big personal best.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Made all up the stands' rail when springing a 40-1 surprise in this race in 2024; added another major handicap when dominating last year's Wokingham; failed to beat a rival in his next three starts though (including in this race) and he has been absent for 314 days; his draw gives him the chance to repeat the heroics of 2024 but this looks a tough assignment on his return.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Three front-running AW wins in the spring saw him soar up the handicap; he didn't run badly off his revised mark at Epsom on Derby day but it would be a surprise if he were up to a task of this magnitude.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Quickly established himself as a smart sprinter, winning Group 2 and Group 3 prizes at Meydan (both 5f; good to firm and good) in early 2025; the addition of cheekpieces saw him return to his best when second in a 5f Group 3 on Dundalk AW last October; not quite at his best in two runs in Dubai in January and absent since; new blinkers need to have a positive effect.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Won five of his ten starts for Richard Fahey, notably a local Group 3 in Qatar in November 2024; absent for 593 days and gelded prior to his stable debut at Pontefract (6f, good) last month, a race in which he was caught out wide but plugged on for second behind the thriving easy winner; clearly retains ability but this will demand much more.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: On the up in 2025, completing a hat-trick before fine runs at Royal Ascot and in the Ayr Gold Cup (beaten favourite in this race in between); had a wind operation prior to reappearance but he has finished down the field in both starts since, the Wokingham on latest; down in the weights but a full revival is essential; tongue-tie experiment last time is quickly aborted.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Two wins in Dubai early in the year before coming up short in Group 1 company in March and June; back on the up with a 7f Listed win at Chester three weeks ago; this looks a tough task under 6lb penalty though.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
OwnerName: Berkshire Parts & Panels Ltd No1 Fanclub
Spotlight: He has done all his winning on AW but his fourth at Leicester (6f, good to firm) in April is a comparable standard; can win races on the grass but perhaps not this one.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: 6f winner at Thirsk (good) in May and back at a similar level when a keeping-on third behind Dubai Bling at Ascot (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago; should run his race but others are perhaps better treated.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Best known for his AW exploits but he is fine on turf and has a lower mark in this sphere; went desperately close at Hamilton (6f, good to firm) 15 days ago, a race in which the first two pulled clear in the closing stages from a subsequent winner; 2lb ahead of the handicapper and he was successful on his only visit to Goodwood; interesting.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: His impressive Newmarket success last May saw him hit hard by the handicapper and he hasn't added to it; chasing home Sondad at Epsom (6f, soft) in June represented his best run of the year but he failed to build on it at Windsor last time; others look safer.

RaceName: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Surged to the front 1f out when dominant in this race (good to soft) 12 months ago; 7lb higher this time around but he was better than ever when second in a hot handicap at Ascot last week (7f, good to firm) when coming from further back than ideal; 2lb ahead of the handicapper and he has a fine chance of becoming the fifth horse to win back-to-back Stewards' Cups (Commanche Falls in 2021 and 2022 was the latest).

RaceName: Phase Eight Handicap
Spotlight: Campaigned over shorter this term, posting a useful AW win on reappearance and not disgraced at Newmarket most recently; showed respectable 7f form as a 2yo, including a good effort in the maiden on this card and a success at Chester; still fairly unexposed over this distance; interesting.

RaceName: Phase Eight Handicap
Spotlight: Versatile sort who held on narrowly from Proud Nation over 7f at Newmarket (good to firm) most recently, adding to his 2yo sprint wins and taking record to 3-7; ran creditably over C&D in May; solid chance.

RaceName: Phase Eight Handicap
Spotlight: Gelded since finishing last when favourite for the Britannia at Royal Ascot (1m); had progressive 7f form previously and recorded a wide-margin success at Newmarket (good) the time before, taking record over this trip to 2211; may still have more to offer and remains of interest.

RaceName: Phase Eight Handicap
Spotlight: Won on the nod at Doncaster (good to firm) last time, looking suited by the step up to 7f and surging back to form; unexposed over this trip and may remain competitive, provided he takes to first-time cheekpieces (faced difficult task when once in blinkers).

RaceName: Phase Eight Handicap
Spotlight: Prevailed narrowly in small field when upped to 7f at Newmarket (good to firm) last time, taking record to 2-4; goes into deeper waters but remains unexposed, particularly at this distance; wears first-time headgear.

RaceName: Phase Eight Handicap
Spotlight: Has form figures of 114, all at Chester (6f and around 7f), since being gelded (maiden previously); not disgraced last time but has something to prove off the same mark switched to a different venue and upped in grade.

RaceName: Phase Eight Handicap
Spotlight: Took a while to hit the target but he had some notable maiden form, including at this meeting last year, and now bids for a hat-trick after wins under Jack Nicholls at Pontefract (6f maiden, good to soft) and Catterick (7f handicap; good to firm); further improvement is possible; respected.

RaceName: Phase Eight Handicap
Spotlight: Broadly progressive gelding who has form figures of 11127 in turf handicaps, the latest effort best forgiven (met trouble); ran well in a competitive field over C&D the time before; still 9lb above last winning mark but Harry Vigors takes off a useful 5lb; in the mix.

RaceName: Phase Eight Handicap
Spotlight: Commenced career with a record of 221 on AW; far from solid on his Listed/Group form on turf since (peak effort may not be reliable) and has something to prove off his mark; gelded since last run.

RaceName: Phase Eight Handicap
Spotlight: The class angle in this field and has earned top weight on handicap debut, having ended his progressive 2yo season with good efforts in a Newmarket Group 2 (7f, good to firm) and Canadian Grade 1 (1m, firm); a likely danger provided he's back in similar form with Listed reappearance under his belt.

RaceName: Phase Eight Handicap
Spotlight: Low-mileage colt who registered his 2yo success in a York maiden and posted two sound efforts since handicapping, beaten narrowly by Ironwill at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) latest; may do better still; not ruled out.

RaceName: Phase Eight Handicap
Spotlight: Appears to have his limitations, being 2-2 in Class 5 but 0-5 in higher grades; gained the latest success at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) last week; opposed from 6lb out of the weights in this markedly better race.

RaceName: Phase Eight Handicap
Spotlight: Back in his comfort zone at Epsom (7f, good) last time, taking Class 4 record to 3-3; sold out of George Boughey's yard for 28,000gns since; returns to deeper waters off a demanding mark; new headgear.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (Colts And Geldings Only)
Spotlight: Thrice-raced colt who is moving steadily in the right direction, third at Newbury (7f, good to firm) most recently; however, likely needs further progress to open his account in this field and he's the stable second string on jockey arrangements.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (Colts And Geldings Only)
Spotlight: 450,000gns breeze-up 2yo purchase who appeared to run well, despite being hampered and racing in the unfavoured group, in the Windsor Castle at Royal Ascot (finished tenth of 25 overall, fourth of nine on the far side) in latest 6f start; one of the form players, upped in trip.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (Colts And Geldings Only)
Spotlight: Blue Point colt; sibling to two winners, notably Wolf Of Badenoch (Group-placed 7f 2yo/1m3f; RPR 101); dam 12.4f AW/1m5f turf scorer (89), half-sister to Irish Oaks winner Even So; probably one of the better types among the newcomers.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (Colts And Geldings Only)
Spotlight: Zoustar half-brother to 12 winners, notably James Garfield (6f/7f including 2yo Group 2; RPR 119); dam 6f/7f 2yo scorer (103); from a family that his connections know well; the betting may offer further guidance.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (Colts And Geldings Only)
Spotlight: 450,000euros breeze-up 2yo buy who holds two Group entries; hindered his chance with an awkward start and some greenness en route to finishing third of nine (as 4-5 favourite) over 6f at Windsor; recorded a modest RPR but should do better with the experience under his belt.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (Colts And Geldings Only)
Spotlight: Holds a Group 1 entry; has two pieces of experience, namely fourth-place finishes in Naas barrier trial and Leopardstown event (7f, good); shaped particularly well on latter occasion, finishing nicely once seeing daylight; brings potential and adds great interest.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (Colts And Geldings Only)
Spotlight: 30,000euros yearling; Awtaad half-brother to two winners, notably Endless Power (1m/9.4f AW; RPR 95); dam unraced half-sister to Oaks winner Qualify; pitched into a warm maiden on debut; likely best watched.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (Colts And Geldings Only)
Spotlight: Green and in rear throughout at Newmarket, finishing almost 5l behind Al Wathba; may do better with the experience under his belt but has work to do to reverse placings with that rival.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (Colts And Geldings Only)
Spotlight: 38,000euros foal, 70,000gns yearling; Phoenix Of Spain half-brother to Listed-placed 5f/6f 2yo winner Rush Queen (RPR 88); dam unraced, out of maiden half-sister to Group-placed 1m 2yo winner Yaseer; begins career in rather deep waters.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (Colts And Geldings Only)
Spotlight: 45,000gns yearling; by Australia; dam placed at 1m2f/1m3f in Germany, sibling to a few very useful German winners, notably Elle Shadow (triple 1m2f Group 3); probably one to look out for over longer trips later on.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (Colts And Geldings Only)
Spotlight: Has shown ability in 6f contests, finishing fourth both times and earning a mark of 77 which is 3lb below the one allotted to stablemate Rafe's Da Man but this is the first string on jockey arrangements and still open to progress with this new trip a plus on breeding.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (Colts And Geldings Only)
Spotlight: Showed promise with second-place finish in 6f event at Chester while shaping as if today's extra furlong will suit; this is a stronger race but he's open to progress and could go well.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (Colts And Geldings Only)
OwnerName: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg
Spotlight: Ballydoyle colt who holds several Group entries; unable to quicken in steadily run maiden at the Curragh (7f, good to firm) but stuck on for fourth of six and should be capable of improvement, especially if getting a stronger pace kept to this distance; shortlisted.

RaceName: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap
Spotlight: Third to Blue Courvoisier in the Silver Bowl at Carlisle (1m, good to firm) in May and bounced back from Royal Ascot defeat (drawn on the wrong side) for clear second at Ascot (1m, good to firm), when a nose behind Ciarrai Abu who followed up here on Thursday; he should stay this far, and this progressive 3yo could be on an advantageous mark up 4lb since last time.

RaceName: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap
Spotlight: Fifth of 16 in this last year in a race that favoured those ridden more prominently and he's been in career-best form at Sandown on his last two starts, posting a win (1m, good) and a very creditable third of 12 (1m2f, good); could be involved.

RaceName: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap
Spotlight: Built upon previous promise to win the Silver Bowl at Carlisle (1m, good to firm) in May on his third handicap start; mid-division in the Britannia at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) since when fifth of 15 on the unfavoured far side; this 3yo remains of interest and is firmly in calculations.

RaceName: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap
Spotlight: 4yo who was making his seventh start when winning at Epsom (8.5f, good) in April; two lesser runs have followed but it wasn't a bad effort at Sandown last time and the fact he excelled at Epsom bodes well for today's first visit to Goodwood, which has similarities; wears a first-time tongue-tie.

RaceName: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap
Spotlight: Inconsistent and his losing sequence is up to 11 races; however, he was a close third off this reduced mark at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) last time and is an each-way contender if backing up that performance.

RaceName: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap
Spotlight: 5yo who won last year on first two starts before good second on handicap debut at Haydock where he was 7lb higher; however, his form has gone the wrong way since and there was no revival on last month's stable debut.

RaceName: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap
Spotlight: Close third at Newmarket (good) in June on his first crack at 1m and second start for this yard, and he made good headway before his run petered out in the John Smith's Cup at York (10.2f, good to firm), finishing sixth of 22; has won here and today's drop back in trip/grade could prove ideal.

RaceName: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap
Spotlight: Third of 15 for Richard Hughes in the Golden Mile here last August when 5lb higher; hasn't hit the same heights since, most recently fifth of nine at Redcar when the 6-4 favourite; however, he's on a dangerous mark and is not written off; interesting to see if he's again strong in the betting.

RaceName: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap
Spotlight: Kept on for second at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) in April and he's run well in fourth on both starts since (1m2f/1m4f, good to soft/good to firm); he's never raced over a trip this short and it isn't an obvious plus, but on the flip-side a well-run race in this big field should play to his strengths.

RaceName: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap
Spotlight: Two-time French winner who could improve from his British debut at Kempton (1m4f, AW) last month, when fifth of seven; dropped 2lb but there's a suspicion he remains on a tough mark; wears first-time cheekpieces.

RaceName: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap
Spotlight: 9yo who won two in a row at Lingfield (1m2f/1m1f, good to firm) and maybe went off too hard when well beaten at Sandown (1m2f, good) last time; has won here twice and he might not be far away if bouncing back.

RaceName: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap
Spotlight: Course winner who won two in a row last May (1m, good) and is 4lb below his last winning mark; showed some spark at Meydan in January but hasn't shone in Britain on his two runs since and needs to turn things around.

RaceName: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap
Spotlight: Extremely well handicapped on his old form; it appeared to bode very well for this campaign when he was runner-up at Sandown in May on his second stable start, but he's failed to kick on and has something to prove.

RaceName: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap
Spotlight: Seven-time winner in France; this front-runner was runner-up in twice in a row for Tom Dascombe last July/September but things didn't go to plan on his final two runs for that yard (Flat/hurdles) and he was well beaten on his stable and seasonal debut at Chepstow in May.

RaceName: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap
