Spotlight: Ex-Ballydoyle 4yo who has been running for Norwegian yard this year; won in Norway in May but struggled in handicaps at Meydan early this year and was well beaten in the Buckingham Palace at Royal Ascot in June (third of six in far-side group); others are preferred.

RaceName: Scullion Law 'Law Firm For Life' EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Runner-up in fast-ground maidens at Brighton (5.5f) and Yarmouth (5f) on last two starts; sets a fair standard and shapes as if 6f could suit.

RaceName: Scullion Law 'Law Firm For Life' EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Harry Angel colt who was sent off at 33-1 and finished well held on his Ascot debut three weeks ago.

RaceName: Scullion Law 'Law Firm For Life' EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 140,000gns breeze-up purchase who never threatened when sixth of ten on Newbury debut (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago, but looked to be getting the hang of things late and improvement is very much on cards; Tuesday's Goodwood maiden winner Agrippa was second so it was probably a decent race.

RaceName: Scullion Law 'Law Firm For Life' EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 200,000euros breeze-up purchase out of a mare who failed to win herself but is from a good family; betting informative for stable which enjoys plenty of first-time-out 2yo success.

RaceName: Scullion Law 'Law Firm For Life' EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Space Blues half-brother to 6f/7f AW 2yo winner Ghisa (RPR 77); dam unraced half-sister to some useful sorts; yard had an easy 2yo winner here (although not first time up) in June so a market move would be interesting.

RaceName: Strathmore Hotels Ltd Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Form has been up and down, but one of his better efforts when beaten a neck in a Pontefract maiden (1m2f, good) last month; solid claims granted a similar effort.

RaceName: Strathmore Hotels Ltd Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Overcame greenness when narrowly making a winning debut at Leicester (1m2f, good to soft) last September, but although only beating one home in a Listed contest at Goodwood (1m4f, good) in May, she did meet trouble; respected if resuming her progress.

RaceName: Strathmore Hotels Ltd Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Runner-up in all three starts this year, the latest behind a nice sort (just beaten in a Goodwood handicap on Wednesday) at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm; first start since being gelded) last month; big shout, especially if the cheekpieces have a positive effect.

RaceName: Strathmore Hotels Ltd Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Not disgraced when fourth of five in a Chester maiden (1m2f, good; 150-1) in May, but he still has a bit to find and looks one for handicaps after this.

RaceName: Strathmore Hotels Ltd Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Half-sister to winners Earn Your Stripes (5f/6f; RPR 59) and Willy Il Coyote (Italian 6.7f-1m); dam 1m4f AW winner (58), half-sister to US 8.5f stakes winner Lilbourne Eliza and Listed-placed 1m/1m2f winner Terre Neuve; hooded on debut and wouldn't be an obvious winner first time out; refused to enter the stalls for her intended debut at Carlisle in June.

RaceName: PDM Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Hot To Trot Racing 1 And Mrs David Egan
Spotlight: Out of her depth in Listed company at Pontefract (1m4f, good) 15 days ago, but suggested she retains ability after returning from another lengthy absence in March; return to a longer trip may suit and respected down in grade.

RaceName: PDM Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 2-5 since joining this yard, winning at Pontefract (2m2f, good; first-time visor) in June and over hurdles at Cartmel a fortnight ago; clearly in good heart, but this may not be far enough for him now.

RaceName: PDM Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Lightly raced 7yo who won at Musselburgh (2m, good) in May and Ayr (1m7f, soft) in June; however, he seemed to find the trip too sharp over C&D (good) in between and ran poorly over 2m when favourite at Musselburgh on Friday.

RaceName: PDM Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Made a successful stable debut/reappearance at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) in April, but a 5lb rise seemed to find her out at York (1m4f, good) the following month; bred to stay this far, but she needs to bounce back after 79 days off.

RaceName: PDM Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Six of his eight wins have come over 1m3f/1m4f here and is 6lb lower than for the most recent, but yet to click since returning in May; dual-handed stable won this in 2022 and 2023.

RaceName: PDM Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 0-8; finished fourth of 15 on her third start for the yard at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm; 50-1) last time, but was still 15l behind the winner; another 2lb drop not enough to tempt.

RaceName: PDM Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Hambleton Racing Ltd XXXV & E Burke
Spotlight: Edging back down the weights and now 3lb higher than for the latest of two wins over 1m6f last September; wore cheekpieces in a void race last month, but this is effectively his first start in them; shortlisted.

RaceName: PDM Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Three-time winner over 1m3f/1m4f on a soft surface in France, but he hasn't beaten many in five starts for this yard; down another 3lb, but hard to fancy.

RaceName: PDM Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Beaten upwards of 10l in three maidens over 7f-1m4f; from a highly successful staying family and worth a market check on handicap debut.

RaceName: PDM Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Made all on his final start for Ross Burdon at Yarmouth (11.5f, soft) in June, since when he changed hands for 19,000gns; 4lb rise fair enough, but he could do with some rain; one of two runners for yard that took this in 2024.

RaceName: Cube Glass 'Soba' Handicap
Spotlight: Won 5f handicaps at Haydock (good) and here (soft) on his first two runs for Ed Bethell last September; has recorded even better form in defeat this year, notably his close second of 14 in the Gosforth Park Cup (5f) five weeks ago; won't be inconvenienced should any of the forecast showers arrive; gets the vote.

RaceName: Cube Glass 'Soba' Handicap
Spotlight: Won last season's Portland handicap at Doncaster (good) off a 2lb higher mark; looked on the way back when runner-up back at Doncaster early last month but two lesser runs have followed.

RaceName: Cube Glass 'Soba' Handicap
Spotlight: Largely progressive form; ran a cracker on what was effectively her seasonal return (unseated her rider soon after start on reappearance) when fourth of 15 in 5f Ayr Listed race (soft) in June; travelled strongly close to the pace in 6f York Group 3 (good to firm) since and the return to 5f could suit back in handicap company; part of a strong hand for Ed Bethell.

RaceName: Cube Glass 'Soba' Handicap
OwnerName: M McHale, J Munroe, M Guy & D Walshe
Spotlight: Four wins last season, including C&D on good; 0-6 in 2026 but latest Southwell third creditable and he's back on a winning mark.

RaceName: Cube Glass 'Soba' Handicap
Spotlight: Back in form since fitted with blinkers, scoring over C&D (good) in May; has reached the frame on all three outings since, although latest fourth of seven at Pontefract was no more than respectable.

RaceName: Cube Glass 'Soba' Handicap
Spotlight: He is a better horse on AW than turf; a much lower mark in this sphere reflects that but his 1-28 record on the grass doesn't mark him down as the likely winner of this.

RaceName: Cube Glass 'Soba' Handicap
Spotlight: Landed a 5f Bahrain handicap in January but has struggled since; the handicapper is starting to relent but others are still preferred.

RaceName: Cube Glass 'Soba' Handicap
Spotlight: He hasn't won since a Listed success at York (6f, soft) in October 2023, but he's started for Robert Cowell with a trio of creditable efforts in competitive handicaps; could click for this yard at some point.

RaceName: Cube Glass 'Soba' Handicap
Spotlight: Below par in three AW outings this year and a return to turf and first-time blinkers failed to spark a revival at Beverley in April; absent since (has had wind surgery for a second time).

RaceName: Cube Glass 'Soba' Handicap
Spotlight: Running well this year, including close third to Vantheman over C&D in May, and he posted a deserved win in a big field at Ayr (6f, good) 26 days ago; raised 5lb but he was very competitive off similar marks in 2024.

RaceName: Cube Glass 'Soba' Handicap
Spotlight: Made it 3-5 since joining Mick Appleby when seeing off 19 rivals in the Epsom Dash (5f, good to soft) eight weeks ago; had the advantage of racing against the near rail but most of his 6lb rise is offset by the promising Conor Whiteley's claim.

RaceName: Blitz Cleaning Commercial Cleaning Handicap
OwnerName: N Irving, F Steele & I Jardine
Spotlight: Made it 3-10 on the AW when successful at Newcastle last month; up 5lb and 1-13 on turf, but a stiff 5f seems to suit her well; looks the pick of the stable's trio.

RaceName: Blitz Cleaning Commercial Cleaning Handicap
Spotlight: Another who has a better strike-rate on AW (7-19) than on turf (1-17); patchy form so far this year, but has dropped 3lb below his last winning mark and this is a drop in class; stable also runs Thunderstorm Katie.

RaceName: Blitz Cleaning Commercial Cleaning Handicap
Spotlight: Has been consistent since his successful reappearance at Southwell (6f, AW) in January and was only beaten 2l into fourth of eight in a 0-85 at Beverley last month; suited by a stiff 5f and much respected down in class.

RaceName: Blitz Cleaning Commercial Cleaning Handicap
Spotlight: Back off the same mark as when winning at Carlisle (5f, good) in May, but not very consistent so not quite sure what to expect.

RaceName: Blitz Cleaning Commercial Cleaning Handicap
Spotlight: Has a better strike-rate on the AW (4-26) than on turf (3-39); 4lb below his last winning mark, but has to put a modest effort at Ayr (5f, good to firm) last month behind him.

RaceName: Blitz Cleaning Commercial Cleaning Handicap
Spotlight: 1lb below his last winning mark but usually misses the break and has finished out of the frame in all five starts this year; rain would help.

RaceName: Blitz Cleaning Commercial Cleaning Handicap
Spotlight: Losing run up to 16, but has won twice over C&D and ran better than it looked when sixth of 11 at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) 11 days ago; 20lb below his last winning mark and could go well at a price.

RaceName: Blitz Cleaning Commercial Cleaning Handicap
Spotlight: 1lb below his last winning mark, but is another who would have made more appeal on the AW (5-10) than turf (1-40).

RaceName: Blitz Cleaning Commercial Cleaning Handicap
Spotlight: One of five wins in the second half of last season was over C&D in August; four seconds (including over 5f/6f here) from the back in her last five starts this term, back to form at Musselburgh last night; each-way claims.

RaceName: Blitz Cleaning Commercial Cleaning Handicap
Spotlight: Holds her form really well despite being kept busy, winning three times here since mid-June and making it 12 course wins overall; the return here is a big plus, but all 14 career wins have come over 6f so she does have something to prove on a rare attempt at 5f; stable also runs Harb.

RaceName: Blitz Cleaning Commercial Cleaning Handicap
Spotlight: 2-5 over C&D, the latest win coming in first-time cheekpieces in June (good to firm, has won on soft); still just 2lb higher, but not the most consistent; first-time blinkers.

RaceName: GSS Contracts Handicap
OwnerName: Middleham Park Racing Lxvi And P Demilow
Spotlight: Low-mileage 3yo whose form since handicapping features a reappearance win at Redcar (1m) in April and keeping-on second at Carlisle (1m1f, good to soft) in June; beaten by more than lack of stamina over 1m2f at Pontefract since, though.

RaceName: GSS Contracts Handicap
OwnerName: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
Spotlight: Progressive 4yo who scored over C&D (good to soft) in June before making it five wins in his last seven starts when overcoming interference to shade a close finish at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) four weeks ago; he and the second were clear of the rest on Town Moor so a 4lb rise may not stop him.

RaceName: GSS Contracts Handicap
Spotlight: Hold-up performer who is thrown in on his 2025 form but has yet to really get going this time round, including beaten 5l when third of six at Ayr (7f) 12 days ago; Paul Mulrennan, who has been on board for eight of his ten wins, is on Sanafi Zabeel this time.

RaceName: GSS Contracts Handicap
Spotlight: Ex-German 1m1f winner; gained a first win for current yard over C&D (good to firm) in May and has matched that form when third here on his last two starts; likely to be on the premises again.

RaceName: GSS Contracts Handicap
Spotlight: Had been bubbling under prior to winning easily at Redcar (1m, good to firm) last month; keeping on (although still had a fair bit of ground to make up) when clipping heels and coming down 1f out at York last Saturday; 9lb higher than at Redcar but still a potential class act at this level if that nasty experience last weekend hasn't left a mark.

RaceName: GSS Contracts Handicap
OwnerName: David Orr & Miss L A Perratt
Spotlight: Course winner who added to his tally at Ayr (1m, good to firm) in May; good runner-up efforts there in recent weeks and has to enter calculations.

RaceName: GSS Contracts Handicap
Spotlight: Cost 550,000euros as a 2yo but has yet to make a significant impact, including last of six on 7.5f Beverley handicap debut (good) 39 days ago; much too soon to write him off for leading stable but first-time cheekpieces need to give him a lift.

RaceName: GSS Contracts Handicap
OwnerName: Future Champions Racing Syn & Ben Haslam
Spotlight: Won his final start in Ireland (1m, heavy); hasn't been in the same form for new stable but worth a second look in the betting back from a two-month break.

RaceName: GSS Contracts Handicap
Spotlight: Good and bad in six runs for this yard, failing to build on a decent run at Newcastle when seventh of eight at Doncaster last time.

RaceName: GSS Contracts Handicap
Spotlight: Landed 6f Ascot novice (soft) for Hugo Palmer last September; little to shout about since but his mark has tumbled as a result and Adam Nicol does well with new recruits (same owners); one to keep an eye on in the betting.

RaceName: Wellman Cars Hamilton Handicap
Spotlight: Bids for a hat-trick after two wins on good to firm ground at Redcar, the latest in an apprentice handicap over 1m under Conor Whiteley on Wednesday; can race off 1lb lower and shouldn't have an issue with stepping back up trip, while rain would also be no problem; major claims.

RaceName: Wellman Cars Hamilton Handicap
Spotlight: All four wins have come on the AW at Chelmsford (7f-1m2f) and is 0-11 on turf; plenty to prove on his return from ten months off with cheekpieces given a go.

RaceName: Wellman Cars Hamilton Handicap
Spotlight: Has twice made the frame over 6f this year, but 0-13 and has plenty to prove on this first attempt beyond 7f.

RaceName: Wellman Cars Hamilton Handicap
Spotlight: Mainly campaigned over shorter but does stay this far; 399 days off before this season; never-never fourth of seven at Musselburgh (7f) last night was probably his most positive display since; back on his last winning mark.

RaceName: Wellman Cars Hamilton Handicap
Spotlight: Dual winner over the extended 1m here; losing run up to 13, but 16lb below her last winning mark and looked unlucky not to finish closer when fourth of six here (1m, good) three weeks ago; stays this far and could go well.

RaceName: Wellman Cars Hamilton Handicap
Spotlight: Back off the same mark as for his successful Nottingham reappearance (1m, good) in April, but his form has regressed since; enough to prove.

RaceName: Wellman Cars Hamilton Handicap
Spotlight: 5-37 on the AW but 0-24 on turf; hasn't looked like exploiting his declining mark of late; visor returns.

RaceName: Wellman Cars Hamilton Handicap
Spotlight: Made it 15th-time lucky at Newcastle (1m, AW) a week ago; now needs to show he can do it back on turf from 4lb higher and also still has stamina to prove.

RaceName: Professional Horse Racing Tips At chracingclub.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Well-bred filly who won small-field C&D (good) maiden in May, her second start, and was creditable second on handicap debut at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) last month; still has more improvement to come; good chance.

RaceName: Professional Horse Racing Tips At chracingclub.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won off today's mark on Polytrack here (1m2f) in April; not quite at same level on turf since but was persistently denied clear run when fourth of six at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm; behind Percival) nine days ago and has possibilities if his luck improves.

RaceName: Professional Horse Racing Tips At chracingclub.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Yet to add to his Group 3 win at Glorious Goodwood three years ago but placed several times this year, losing out only by a neck at Epsom (1m4f, good to firm) on latest outing 16 days ago; remains on a workable mark and will be fine over today's shorter trip; probably on the premises again.

RaceName: Professional Horse Racing Tips At chracingclub.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Lightly raced since heavy-ground win on debut in France in November 2024 but bettered low-key stable debut when respectable third at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm; hood removed) nine days ago, despite racing too freely; any further progress here will make him a serious player.

RaceName: Professional Horse Racing Tips At chracingclub.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 2-3 as a 2yo; not much has gone to plan on his two starts this year but he had soft ground as a plausible excuse for 56l defeat at Epsom (1m2f) on Derby Derby, and his down-the-field finish at Ascot (1m; first-time hood) last month came in a warm 3yo handicap; this race is easier and it would be dangerous to write him off at this stage.

RaceName: Happy 50th Birthday Joanne Baker Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 0-16 but made brave bold from the front before weakening into third at Epsom (1m4f, good) last month and faced impossible task when second of four behind well-handicapped rival here (1m6f, good to firm) a week ago; ought to be suited by this drop back in trip; dangerous if allowed to dominate.

RaceName: Happy 50th Birthday Joanne Baker Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 13-race maiden; placed in two AW handicaps in early part of this year (1m/9.4f) but beaten about 16l when fourth of five on turf return at Windsor (1m, good to firm) in June; must do better here.

RaceName: Happy 50th Birthday Joanne Baker Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Kept on for third in AW handicap here (1m2f) in March but was well down the field on both subsequent starts (1m4f/1m2f) and is now 0-9; eased in grade but needs three-month break to have done her good.

RaceName: Happy 50th Birthday Joanne Baker Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Lightly raced after only five starts and wasn't disgraced when fifth of seven in this grade at Yarmouth (11.5f, good to firm) last month but needs to take another step forward.

RaceName: Happy 50th Birthday Joanne Baker Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Below form in 1m2f Yarmouth handicap last month (no headgear) but returned to the Flat with win in refitted cheekpieces (back on today) over that C&D (good to firm) in June and has strong claims if back at that level.

RaceName: Happy 50th Birthday Joanne Baker Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Yet to show any worthwhile form after six starts, the penultimate over C&D in this grade; significant improvement required.

RaceName: Pilgrims Sales & Lettings Handicap
Spotlight: Much improved since hiked up in trip and switched to handicaps this season, and bids to complete a hat-trick after small-field success in first-time cheekpieces at Newbury (2m, good to firm) nine days ago; has an ungainly head carriage but is probably still well treated after latest 4lb rise.

RaceName: Pilgrims Sales & Lettings Handicap
Spotlight: Clear second to fast-improving rival over C&D (good) on latest Flat start in June and also ran well over hurdles last month; may not have much margin for error off current mark but can make his presence felt.

RaceName: Pilgrims Sales & Lettings Handicap
Spotlight: Won three in a row in a visor this spring (1m6f-2m1f, good to firm/good) but recent efforts suggest the handicapper may have her measure now; tried in blinkers here; needs to kick on again.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Maiden Stakes (For horses In Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Out of a Listed-placed German winner; showed inexperience in early stages but ran on well for clear second of five (no threat to winner) on last month's debut at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm); ought to be more streetwise here; leading contender.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Maiden Stakes (For horses In Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Out of a half-sister to Group-placed 6f/7f 2yo winner Gavota; made quite promising debut when keeping-on third of ten at Kempton (6f, AW) in December; gelded during subsequent eight-month break and has tongue-tie fitted for turf debut; shortlisted.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Maiden Stakes (For horses In Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Displayed promise on first three starts, most notably when third over C&D (good) in May; has a bit to find on the figures with a couple of these but can collect another minor prize; hooded for first time.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Maiden Stakes (For horses In Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Struggled (albeit on soft ground) on debut here (7.6f) in June and didn't achieve much when last of five at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) last month; difficult to enthuse over.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Maiden Stakes (For horses In Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beaten over 15l when last of five on last month's debut at Ripon (1m, good); not the most obvious answer here.

RaceName: Drainex Group Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Built upon encouraging debut when third of ten in Newbury novice (6f, good to firm) last month, despite racing too freely, and should have more improvement to come in nurseries; must be considered.

RaceName: Drainex Group Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Creditable third behind two useful rivals in valuable C&D (good) novice in June and had excuse when well beaten on latest outing (struck into); needs to be taken very seriously on nursery debut.

RaceName: Drainex Group Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Safely held when sixth of seven on last month's nursery debut at Nottingham but subsequent seventh of 24 in Newbury's Super Sprint (also 5f, good to firm; first-time hood) was commendable, particularly as she was first of seven home in the far-side group; can feature if suited by this new trip.

RaceName: Drainex Group Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Won here when dropped back to 5f (good to firm) for recent nursery debut; could quite plausibly have more to offer back at 6f but is 5lb higher in a higher-grade race today.

RaceName: Drainex Group Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Scored over C&D (good to firm) on nursery debut 17 days ago, beating the warm favourite; could still be well treated after recent 3lb rise; obvious contender.

RaceName: Drainex Group Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Behind Seed Ya Later when tenth of 24 in Newbury's Super Sprint (5f, good to firm) a fortnight ago and has now been unplaced all four starts; needs combination of new trip and first-time cheekpieces to unlock improvement on this nursery debut.

RaceName: Drainex Group Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Only beaten about 2l when fifth of six on recent nursery debut at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) and is 2lb lower here but others have stronger claims.

RaceName: Core Group Handicap
Spotlight: Close second twice on good to firm turf last month before winning in first-time cheekpieces on Tapeta (also 7f) 11 days ago; 5lb higher here but commands respect in current form; usual tongue-tie (left off last time) is refitted.

RaceName: Core Group Handicap
Spotlight: Came good at 11th attempt, with clearcut win from off the pace in C&D (good to firm) classified ten days ago; has more on her plate in this handicap but further progress is possible.

RaceName: Core Group Handicap
Spotlight: Has modest 2-39 strike-rate, with both wins gained on AW, and tends to race too freely but the form of his never-dangerous fourth at Brighton (7f, good to firm) at end of June has worked out well; worth a second look.

RaceName: Core Group Handicap
Spotlight: Led close home for narrow AW win here in January but that's his only success from 21 starts and he posed no threat on turf at Brighton last month; others have more pressing claims.

RaceName: Core Group Handicap
Spotlight: Soundly beaten on all three turf starts, most recently in soft-ground C&D contest won by Beau Jardine in early June, but now 1lb lower than when winning on Polytrack here in December and has possibilities if this fast ground suits.

RaceName: Core Group Handicap
Spotlight: Ended long losing run with soft-ground C&D win in June and gave another good account when fourth at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) 11 days ago; probably won't be far away.

RaceName: Core Group Handicap
Spotlight: Still unexposed after only five starts but raced too freely and was soundly beaten on handicap debut at Kempton (7f, AW) in February; returns from five-month break.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Began season with two decent efforts over 1m before justifying skinny odds in tactical, four-runner contest at Ffos Las (7.3f, good) on Tuesday; effectively only 4lb higher under 5lb penalty here, and evidently in good nick.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Kept on well to score at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) last month and is now 2-7; still unexposed on turf and promises to be suited by today's slightly longer trip; ought to be right in the thick of things.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Useful 2yo who needed significant help from the handicapper before her narrow win in first-time visor here (7f, good to firm; made all) ten days ago; went back up only 2lb for that, though; respected.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Chalice Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won her first two races; disappointing when favourite for Lingfield Oaks Trial in the spring but firmly back on track when second in French Listed event (1m4f, good; collared late on after being clear over 1f out) six weeks ago; still has untapped potential.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Chalice Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Useful on her day; highly tried and not at best so far this year, but she ran respectably when never-nearer fourth of eight in Irish Group 3 (1m2f, good to firm) two weeks ago; moves into unknown territory trip-wise but her pedigree gives hope that she'll stay and this is a drop in grade.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Chalice Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: From a family that has served these connections well; 0-10 since her debut success but she finished close behind Orionis when fifth in C&D Listed race (7-4 favourite) last time; previous two efforts read even better and she's a major player with a visor replacing cheekpieces.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Chalice Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Sea The Stars half-sister to the same connections' Oaks winner Soul Sister; arrives on an upward curve after easy novice win at Lingfield and unlucky second in handicap at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm; stayed on well after being short of room); plenty to find on bare form in this higher grade but she should be well suited by this step up in trip and cannot be discounted.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Chalice Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Reliable type whose wins have come in 1m2f and 1m6f handicaps; good fourth on her only attempts at Listed company but she'll need a personal best if she's to make a winning reappearance after ten months off.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Chalice Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Best effort when winning Goodwood handicap (1m4f, good) in May; respectable third in C&D Listed race two weeks ago, racing freely and finding no extra; may not have reached her ceiling just yet and she's high on the list.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Chalice Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Listed winner and Group 3 runner-up for the Gosdens last year; has shown she retains all her ability, fourth in Group 2 over C&D (good to firm; wore tongue-strap) last month; this is easier and she should be thereabouts in a first-time hood.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Chalice Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has improved with each run this year, winning maiden at Ripon (1m3f, good) and handicap at Salisbury (1m4f, good to firm; dug deep to see off main challenger by a neck), both in small fields; this is a sterner assignment but she's still unexposed and in good hands.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Green on debut but hasn't looked back since and she forced a dead-heat in C&D Listed race (good to firm; 100-30) last time; may have more in the tank and she's high on the list once more.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Highly tried since debut win at Bath (5.7f, firm) in May; seemed to show improvement when sixth of eight in C&D Group 2 three weeks ago, although 50-1 and no threat; that run hasn't been missed by the handicapper.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Like Rollthedicebaby, she finished in mid-division in the Super Sprint (80-1) last time, but she had no excuses on account of the draw; up against it here from 4lb out of the handicap.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Down the field in the Group 2 Queen Mary at Royal Ascot, but she'd previously come from the rear to win the Listed Marygate at York (5f, good); should be just as effective over 6f and may still have untapped potential.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Gained deserved win after three second places in maiden at Lingfield (6f, good to firm) 17 days ago, no more than workmanlike in landing the odds; in deeper here and 3lb out of weights but she may not be fully exposed.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Could finish only in midfield in the Super Sprint at Newbury (4-1) last month but she was done no favours by the draw; better judged on a clearcut maiden win at Goodwood (6f, soft) the time before; remains open to improvement and may well get back on track here.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Improving with each run and won going away from two rivals in nursery at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) 11 days ago; raised 5lb but should be well suited by this return to 6f and may well complete a hat-trick.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has taken off for front-running tactics and cheekpieces on her last two starts, winning nurseries at Catterick and Thirsk (both 6f, good to firm); up 11lb in total but keeps improving and should make another bold bid.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Got up late on to win maiden at Chester (5.5f, good) in May but ran poorly when upped to 7f for nursery there two months later; perhaps this intermediate trip will suit but she's on a retrieval mission.

RaceName: Lodge At The National Stud EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: By Kingman; sister to winners Calyx (6f including 2yo Group 2; RPR 118), Coppice (7f/1m including 2yo/Listed; 117) and Stanage (7f; 92); dam 6f-1m 2yo winner (including Group 3; 112), sister to 6f Group 1 winner African Rose; has an excellent Juddmonte pedigree and her stable's 2yos are just beginning to fire; big player on paper.

RaceName: Lodge At The National Stud EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Quite stoutly bred and predictably improved for the step up to 7f when third here (good to firm; 33-1) two weeks ago; the type to progress with racing and should be involved in the shake-up once more.

RaceName: Lodge At The National Stud EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 380,000gns yearling; by Dark Angel; dam 5f/5.5f winner (including 2yo/Listed; RPR 99), half-sister to 5f-6f winner Marching Mac, out of 1m winning half-sister to 7f Group 3 winner Muthabara; expensive purchase with a useful pedigree and representing a leading local yard.

RaceName: Lodge At The National Stud EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: By Frankel; sister to 1m3f/2m2f Flat (RPR 84) and 2m/2m1f hurdle winner Secret Force, half-sister to 7f winner Cerro Blanco (103); dam 7f/1m winner (including 2yo/Listed; 107), out of Group-placed 7f 2yo winner; stable won this race in 2017, 2020 and 2024 and has a strike-rate of over 40% with its 2yos this season.

RaceName: Lodge At The National Stud EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 200,000euros yearling; Coulsty half-sister to winners Pierre Bonnard (1m/1m2f 2yo including Group 1; RPR 119), Crepe Suzette (Group-placed 9.4f; 110) and Diavolo (7f; 91); dam 1m2f-1m4f winner (including Group 1 Nassau Stakes; 116); has a classy pedigree; stable's 2yos operating at 19% this season.

RaceName: Lodge At The National Stud EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: By Stradivarius; dam placed 7f 2yo (RPR 70), half-sister to useful winners Not Never (1m1f 2yo/1m4f Flat and 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase) and Final Watch (7f); may be of more interest in the longer term.

RaceName: Lodge At The National Stud EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Slowly away and always behind both starts; may benefit from today's step up in distance but needs a giant leap forward.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Campaigned over as far as 10.3f but proved well suited by the drop back to 7f when winning in clearcut style at Yarmouth (good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) last month; now that connections have found the key, she's open to further improvement; leading contender.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Likeable 7f specialist (all four wins at this trip); just edged out by Sierra Sands over C&D three weeks ago; holding his form really well and should be in the thick of things again.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Unlucky over this trip at Sandown two outings ago from just 1lb lower, but was disappointing when only fourth there next time; hasn't had much racing and may get back on the up.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Thriving on this course this summer, and beat Lion Of Mali a neck over C&D three weeks ago; edging up the weights only slowly and should give another good account of himself.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Sprang a 25-1 upset on debut at Newbury (6f) last summer, but unplaced all outings since, including over 1m4f last time; plummeting in the weights but hard to fancy.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Narrowly beaten on three of his four starts since being gelded, going down on the nod at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) on latest; should go close again off an unchanged mark, especially if first-time headgear has a positive effect.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Gained his most recent win here (1m6f) last August off 2lb lower in first-time blinkers; with creditable shows in two of his three starts this season, he is firmly in calculations.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has done well over 1m4f-1m6f on turf this term, winning three times from six starts; latest win came easily at this track (1m6f, good to firm) in June and he's 7lb higher today; tailing off so badly at Southwell four weeks ago may be offputting but he came last in 2025 in his only other AW race, so perhaps can spring back to life with today's return to turf.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Ten-time AW winner who is 5lb lower than when winning at Southwell (1m4f, AW) last November; however, this is his first run since January and he was well beaten at Ascot in May 2024 on his last encounter with turf; 0-5 on grass and others have less to prove.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Often ridden by claimer Alexandra Egan, including when he won a four-runner C&D race (good to firm) last July off the same mark as today; creditable second on last two outings (C&D latest) suggest he will be bang there.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 5yo now who won for Sean Woods on belated debut last July; no joy in his seven races since, three for this yard, but he kept on well for a good third of 12 in a slowly run race at Ayr (upped markedly to 1m5f, soft) in June and may well have been stretched by 1m6f when performing respectably at Ascot (good to firm; made most) three weeks ago; firmly in the mix.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: He's had a long career but never been better than this season, winning on AW at Wolverhampton (9.4f) and Lingfield (1m4f); they were in March/April but he returned from a break with creditable third of six here (1m2f, good to firm) 15 days ago, again under Olivia Tubb; probably not far away.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Both wins (from nine races) have been in small fields, including from off the pace at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) on reappearance ten days ago; going back up 4lb demands more but there's a fair chance that he'll turn out to be an improved performer this term; up 2f, which he's not sure to stay, but he has to be on the shortlist.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: S Mizon, H McAlpine & Winner Racing Ltd
Spotlight: Has some back-class but now 0-11 for this yard and the form he showed in initial outings last summer has not been repeated; accelerating down the weights, which gives him a chance on this year's form even, but others are more convincing.

RaceName: National Stud Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 280,000gns purchase as a yearling; hasn't gone on as anticipated from a promising debut, fading and beating only one home in maiden at Yarmouth (1m2f, good to firm) three weeks ago; still early days but she has something to prove.

RaceName: National Stud Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: HM The King & HM The Queen
Spotlight: Has taken a while to get the hang of things, but improved form last two starts, winning novice in small field at Nottingham and pulling clear with the winner when second in handicap at Salisbury (both 1m2f, good to firm); tactically versatile and looks the one to beat.

RaceName: National Stud Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 6f winner last autumn; has been running respectably in 7f/1m handicaps without looking ahead of her mark; now moves up in distance (sister won up to 1m2f); should be thereabouts.

RaceName: National Stud Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Two wins from ten outings, both over the extended 1m at Nottingham; faded on first attempt at 1m2f when fifth at Windsor last time; beginning to look exposed.

RaceName: British Racing School Handicap
Spotlight: Tough 5f performer, holding his form well; close third under regular rider Chloe Lyons at Windsor on Monday; should give it his best shot again.

RaceName: British Racing School Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced 3yo; sole win came over this trip at Southwell last winter, and she shaped nicely after six months off on turf debut at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) two weeks ago; now fitted with a tongue-strap; big player if building on her last run.

RaceName: British Racing School Handicap
Spotlight: 0-7 on the AW between September and April, but he has won his last five races on turf; patiently ridden as usual and led late at Brighton (5f, good to firm) six weeks ago; edging up the weights only slowly and in the mix once more.

RaceName: British Racing School Handicap
Spotlight: Missed 2025 but is making up for lost time and completed a hat-trick of 5f handicaps at Salisbury (good to firm) 11 days ago; thriving and may not have reached her limit just yet.

RaceName: British Racing School Handicap
Spotlight: 0-7; never dangerous when sixth of 11 on stable debut at Windsor (5f, good to firm) on Monday, finishing three places behind Merrimack; however, she did meet trouble that day and can't be ruled out entirely.

RaceName: British Racing School Handicap
Spotlight: Started well for this yard but seems to have gone off the boil, safely held when fourth over C&D two weeks ago; needs a revival.

RaceName: John & Paula 25th Wedding Anniversary EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Never looked like getting to Palm Reader when second at Beverley (5f, good to firm) four weeks ago; no improvement for stepping up to 6f at Hamilton two weeks ago; 7lb turnaround in the weights may be insufficient to turn the tables.

RaceName: John & Paula 25th Wedding Anniversary EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 92,000gns yearling; second foal; half-brother to 7f AW winner Espona Bay (RPR 71); dam 5f 2yo winner (89), half-sister to 7f winners Bendy Spirit and The Toff; stable operating at a healthy strike-rate with 2yos this season; betting useful.

RaceName: John & Paula 25th Wedding Anniversary EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Never in the hunt in a 5f novice at Newcastle five weeks ago (18-1); should do much better at some point.

RaceName: John & Paula 25th Wedding Anniversary EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Unique Retreats, P Morrall & J Blackburn
Spotlight: Cost 160,000euros at the breeze-ups in May; justified favouritism with a front-running success at Beverley (5f, good to firm; Battle Fever second) four weeks ago; more to come and he's the one to beat.

RaceName: John & Paula 25th Wedding Anniversary EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 150-1 when finishing down the field on last week's Newcastle debut (6f, AW); needs a big step forward.

RaceName: John & Paula 25th Wedding Anniversary EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
Spotlight: 33-1 and always in rear on his debut at Beverley (5f, good to firm) 12 days ago; best watched.

RaceName: John & Paula 25th Wedding Anniversary EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Modest form in two 5f maidens 98 days apart (gelded after debut); improvement essential.

RaceName: John & Paula 25th Wedding Anniversary EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Down the field in two 5f runs last month; minor nurseries beckon.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Formerly smart but is currently out of sorts, as several duck eggs next to his name reflect, and hasn't scored on turf for nearly three years (gained last two wins on Newcastle AW); opposed.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Formerly a miler but has gained last three wins over 1m2f, the most recent in Bahrain; well held in major handicap returned to home soil last time; bit to prove off current mark back down in trip; Lexie Clarkson claims 7lb but has limited experience.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Nosed ahead in the final strides at York (7f) last time, ending a two-year losing spell and showing he retains plenty of ability aged eight; back up just 2lb he remains well treated on historical data; won the Thirsk Hunt Cup over C&D in 2023; should remain competitive.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Sole 3yo in this field; maiden last term; gelded prior to posting form figures of 131 (over 7f-1m) this season, the wins on sharp, left-handed tracks, namely Catterick (good) and Chester (good to soft); open to further improvement, should take well to Thirsk and receives weight all round; respected.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Commenced career with two wins, including Listed; 0-6 and patchy form-wise since but proved resurgent in York handicap (1m; debut for new stable) most recently and is interesting off current mark assuming he builds on that effort.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Record of 3-11 in France for Henri-Francois Devin, most recently prevailing narrowly in big-field handicap at Longchamp in May; sold for 80,000euros since; likely faces a stiffer task off opening British mark but market support should be heeded.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Campaigned mostly at the Newmarket tracks this term, winning in May and respectable third last time; has shown versatility in the past but looks weighted to the hilt off current mark and this step back up in class adds to the difficulty.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Scored twice in 2024 and three times in 2025; gradually back to form this season, creditable second in useful handicap at York (1m) most recently; appears to be on his way to regaining the winning thread and looks a must for the shortlist.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Useful on his day and has a record of 2-3 over C&D, notably a success off current mark in this year's Thirsk Hunt Cup; not particularly solid on form elsewhere since but the return to this scenario may have a positive effect; not dismissed.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Generally in good form, mostly on AW, for current stable and latest effort is best forgiven (race didn't pan out favourably); not disgraced in most recent turf attempt but is still seeking a first success in this sphere and is somewhat hostage to fortune the way he races.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Front-running tactics backfired at the Newmarket July festival last time when bidding for a 1m hat-trick after Class 4 wins at Carlisle; remains on career-high mark and is upped further in grade, so needs to resume his improvement.

RaceName: Theakston Great Yorkshire Pint EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Has shown promise in both starts, even when last of three at Chester (1m2f, good) last month (runner-up has won since); shortlisted for stable that took this in 2022 and 2023.

RaceName: Theakston Great Yorkshire Pint EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 450,000gns yearling; disappointing when sent off favourite for his Salisbury debut (7f, soft) in June, but with a tongue-tie fitted he showed his true colours when winning a Kempton novice (7f, AW) last month; has a 7lb penalty to carry, but bred to be smart so could easily step forward again.

RaceName: Theakston Great Yorkshire Pint EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Huge prices and failed to beat a rival in his first two starts (7f/1m2f) eight months apart; handicaps beckon.

RaceName: Theakston Great Yorkshire Pint EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Offered promise when fourth of ten in a Doncaster maiden (1m, soft) on his debut September, but well held on his Hamilton return (1m, good to firm) 16 days ago; looks one for handicaps.

RaceName: Theakston Great Yorkshire Pint EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Sent off 100-1 when beaten miles into last of 13 on his Southwell debut (7f, AW) nine days ago; stable runs three.

RaceName: Jordan Foy Memorial Handicap
OwnerName: Miss K Padgett And Mrs S D Pearson
Spotlight: Well handicapped on this winter's AW form but he has gone off the boil more recently; given a chance by the handicapper as a consequence and he needs a market check starting out for Ruth Carr (sold out of David Loughnane's stable for 22,000gns last month).

RaceName: Jordan Foy Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Successful off this mark at Wolverhampton in March; solid efforts on his last three starts and he should make a bold bid to win this race for the second season in succession.

RaceName: Jordan Foy Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Won a 5f handicap off this mark at Newmarket (good to firm) last August; she has run some fair races this year but her latest effort (tried in cheekpieces, usual visor back on today) wasn't one of them; no surprise to see her bounce back quickly.

RaceName: Jordan Foy Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Prominent racer; thriving this season, winning three of his last five starts with the latest a cosy success at Hamilton (5f, good to firm) two weeks ago; up 4lb but he needs serious consideration; stable also runs American Bay.

RaceName: Jordan Foy Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner; below par in a big field at York (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago but plenty of form this season that makes him of interest; Jack Callan's claim a bonus; one to consider back at 5f.

RaceName: Jordan Foy Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: 5f AW win in April; ran well at Ripon (5f, good) later that month but he has struggled twice since; has a C&D win on his record but others bring more pressing claims.

RaceName: Jordan Foy Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Two 5f wins this year and she ran her best race so far when third of 12 at York (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago; races off the same mark here and should make another bold bid.

RaceName: Jordan Foy Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Three wins in 5f handicaps this year, the latest off 6lb lower last month; another good effort when second over 6f here last week; likely vulnerable in Class 4.

RaceName: Jordan Foy Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Wasn't winning out of turn when taking a 5f handicap at Wolverhampton in May; didn't get the clearest run at Chester three weeks ago but that took his turf record to 0-11; others are more appealing.

RaceName: Jordan Foy Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Didn't run badly at Windsor in May but that run is sandwiched by two lesser turf runs; connections now turn to a tongue tie and cheekpieces.

RaceName: Jordan Foy Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Has a couple of C&D wins on his record; not found his best form this year and he has too much to prove for comfort, for all he is tumbling down the weights.

RaceName: Jordan Foy Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Talented veteran but has temperament to match his ability; no turf win since 2021 and when second at Nottingham 11 days ago there were only four runners; more minor money perhaps his best hope.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
Spotlight: Impressive on 2yo debut in 2024 (6f, good) then absent until last month, when going very close at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) before easy win at 1-50 at Lingfield (6f, good to firm); could be on a good mark for this first handicap.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
Spotlight: Won at Lingfield (1m, AW) in April and achieved his best result of this turf season when close fourth of 17 at York (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; he might not be far away.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
Spotlight: Well handicapped on his form up to June 2023 but he was then absent until this season and hasn't been the force of old on his three runs in 2026.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
Spotlight: Without a win since August 2024 but he's been in good form since this visor went on, bumping into an unexposed 3yo when second of four at Catterick (7f, good to firm) and again finishing runner-up at Chester (7.5f, good) last time; in each-way calculations once more.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
Spotlight: Ran really well when runner-up in two big-field handicaps at York (7f/1m, good) in June; not at the same level when mid-division there (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago in first-time cheekpieces (retained) but can be in the shake-up if swiftly rediscovering his previous form.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
Spotlight: Won over C&D (good) in May and close second at Chester (7f, good) a fortnight later; respectable sixth of 19 at York (7f, good) next time and perhaps unsuited by return to AW most recently; each-way possibilities.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
Spotlight: Well beaten on final outing last season and same story on reappearance at Epsom on Oaks day (pulled hard); he has something to prove but that latest outing may have got the freshness out of him and he's on a handy mark on last season's best efforts; not written off.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
Spotlight: Four-time AW winner, the latest at Newcastle (7f) in May, and good second at Chester (7f, good to soft) in June; however, only fifth of ten at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last time and has to leave that run behind if he's to get off the mark on turf at the seventh attempt.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
Spotlight: 8yo who was knocking on the door prior to making all in fine style at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm) 12 days ago; had just three rivals to beat last time and he's 4lb higher in a tougher race today, but is clearly in good heart and is a two-time winner at Thirsk; could go well.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
Spotlight: She's dropped below her last winning mark and has run some reasonable races on turf this summer, but without suggesting a win is imminent; she's just 1-20 on grass as opposed to 6-43 on AW.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
Spotlight: Reappeared at York (7f, good) in June following a wind op and he beat 19 rivals to win; very much of interest based on that performance but he was well beaten back at York (7f, good to firm) last time; cheekpieces go on.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
Spotlight: Won at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm) in May and has run well in defeat at Carlisle (1m, good to firm) and Beverley (7.4f, good to firm) on his last two starts; he's in with an each-way chance.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
OwnerName: Ursa Major Racing Ltd & Julie Camacho
Spotlight: Won in fields of a similar size to today's at York (7f, good) last July and Wetherby (7f, good to firm) in June; outside of those wins his form figures since last June read 000089055 and he's a type who needs everything to drop right, but it's possible that will happen off an expected good pace today.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
Spotlight: Very lightly raced since winning two 2yo novice races in autumn 2024 (7f, AW); returned from another absence at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) in April, having been gelded, and ran well in second of six; could have part to play.

RaceName: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
Spotlight: Won four times in 2024; just two runs last year and reappeared this April with close third at Redcar; down to a dangerous mark but he hasn't really shone on his last four starts and has to turn things around.

RaceName: Vision PVC Carlton Miniott Thirsk Handicap
Spotlight: Improved form the last twice, finishing first past the post at Goodwood (1m4f; demoted to second for causing interference) then beaten only a neck at Newbury (1m5f); respected.

RaceName: Vision PVC Carlton Miniott Thirsk Handicap
Spotlight: Novice win last October; has come up well short in Class 4 handicaps this term (modest fourth last time; gelded since) but may fare better off a reduced mark at this lower level.

RaceName: Vision PVC Carlton Miniott Thirsk Handicap
Spotlight: Five-race maiden who has two standout pieces of form, including creditable effort with cheekpieces fitted at Doncaster (1m4f) last time; could go well in the retained headgear.

RaceName: Vision PVC Carlton Miniott Thirsk Handicap
Spotlight: Exposed 6yo who concedes weight to 3yo rivals but brings positives, being the only C&D scorer in the field and a winner off 2lb higher in most recent attempt in this grade.

RaceName: John Joseph Robson Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Not beaten far on a few occasions in the spring, but now 0-12 and cheekpieces made no difference last time; needs the addition of a tongue-tie to make a difference.

RaceName: John Joseph Robson Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Very disappointing at Ascot (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago which needs forgiving, but his Chepstow success (7f, good to firm) in May was the only occasion he has dropped into Class 6 company in more than two years; worth a second look.

RaceName: John Joseph Robson Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Narrowly bounced back to winning form under Jonathan England at Carlisle (6f, good to firm) last month, but met traffic when fifth of ten at Beverley (5f, good to firm) 11 days later; a player granted better luck.

RaceName: John Joseph Robson Memorial Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs K S Pratt & M Dods
Spotlight: Handy sort whose three turf wins have all come over C&D; not firing of late, but has become dangerously well handicapped having dropped 14lb below his last winning mark.

RaceName: John Joseph Robson Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: 2-6 over C&D; ended a 17-race losing run at Chester (7f, good) last month and only beaten just over 2l into fourth of eight at Catterick (7f, good to firm) ten days ago; shouldn't have an issue with the return to this trip and shortlisted.

RaceName: John Joseph Robson Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Winner of eight races including one over C&D, but losing run up to 12 despite a slipping mark; not disgraced when fourth of 11 behind Great at Carlisle (6f, good to firm) last month, but he could really do with the ground easing.

RaceName: John Joseph Robson Memorial Handicap
OwnerName: P C J Dalby & R D Schuster
Spotlight: Both wins came on the AW last autumn; 1lb lower than for the latest, but he has beaten just one rival in four starts on turf; blinkers removed after one use and are replaced by cheekpieces.

RaceName: John Joseph Robson Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: 0-9; 33-1 when second of 11 at Redcar (7f, good to firm; first-time tongue-tie) in May, but ran poorly over the same C&D the following month; has questions to answer back in trip; stable also runs Lord Abama.

RaceName: John Joseph Robson Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Well handicapped on old form, but has shown little in two starts since returning from a long absence in May; just 1-36 on turf and hard to fancy.

Arlington Million Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Progressive turf performer, thriving at present and still not fully exposed; completed hat-trick in Listed race at Churchill Downs (1m3f) last time, beating smart Chapman's Peak (who received 5lb) by a neck, pair clear; previously wide-margin winner over 1m4f of Grade 2 at Keeneland and Grade 3 at Churchill Downs; the coming force in this division and can prove himself at top level today.

RaceName: Arlington Million Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: Epic Horses LLC, WSS Racing Et Al
Spotlight: Chilean Grade 1 winner in 2025; very useful form to complete hat-trick outside graded events in USA (one at Santa Anita, two at Gulfstream); on latest start (second for current trainer) he justified favouritism by just over 1l in handicap at Gulfstream (8.5f) from stablemate Nemo; progressive and in excellent hands but needs to rediscover peak from former country if he's to contend.

RaceName: Arlington Million Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Smart and consistent type who has won three Grade 3s on Tapeta at Woodbine, including Autumn Stakes (1m1f) last November; showed himself just as good on turf (won allowance in May) when about 1l third to Lagynos in Grade 2 Wise Dan at Churchill Downs (8.5f) last time; best form at about 1m.

RaceName: Arlington Million Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Grade 3 winner at Gulfstream Park (1m4f; good ride by David Egan) in January; better of two efforts since when fourth in Grade 3 on penultimate start but overall form leaves him plenty to find.

RaceName: Arlington Million Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Last year's winner when he came off fast pace to beat Grand Sonata by half a length, with Integration close third; has struggled to reproduce that form, though did win Grade 3 Dinner Party Stakes (1m1f) at Laurel in May; respectable effort latest and maybe this track suits him, but on balance he looks opposable.

RaceName: Arlington Million Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Benefited from excellent ride from Manny Franco when winning Grade 1 Pegasus World Cup Turf Invitational at Gulfstream in January (1m1f, firm) by a neck; back to form when beaten half a length by Deterministic in Grade 1 Manhattan Stakes (9.5f) at Saratoga; best form at shorter than 1m2f but should get the trip.

RaceName: Arlington Million Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: West Point Thoroughbreds & Woodford Racing LLC
Spotlight: Six wins from 18 starts include Grade 2s in 2023 and 2024; largely consistent since (close third in this last year) and beaten just under 2l by Deterministic when fifth in Grade 1 Manhattan Stakes (9.5f) at Saratoga on last start; looks poised to make a bold bid.

RaceName: Aurie's Star Handicap (Group 3) (Handicap) (Turf)
OwnerName: Wessel Thoroughbreds, R H Morrison Et Al
Spotlight: Let-up (42-days). Performance just fair in the Eye Liner at Ipswich when went around $10. Since trialled at Caulfield Heath 16 Jul. Each way claims.

RaceName: Aurie's Star Handicap (Group 3) (Handicap) (Turf)
Spotlight: Just missed in a crackerjack finish in the (Bm88) at Flemington over this trip. Can play a role.

RaceName: Aurie's Star Handicap (Group 3) (Handicap) (Turf)
OwnerName: Ms J McAlpine, Philippa Duncan Bloodstock Et Al
Spotlight: First-up (18-weeks). Last prep was highlighted by a G1 placing. Proven fresh performer. Has form this track and distance and a nice weight drop. Worth a look.

RaceName: Aurie's Star Handicap (Group 3) (Handicap) (Turf)
OwnerName: Lindsay Park Bloodstock Pty Ltd, P B Devitt Et Al
Spotlight: Turned on the speed and fended off challengers to narrowly prevail this course 4 Jul. Unbeaten at track and distance. Well placed for a repeat performance.

RaceName: Aurie's Star Handicap (Group 3) (Handicap) (Turf)
OwnerName: Seymour Bloodstock, B W James Et Al
Spotlight: Freshened. Not disgraced in soft going at Sunshine Coast. Switching to 1200m. Can challenge.

RaceName: Aurie's Star Handicap (Group 3) (Handicap) (Turf)
OwnerName: J P M Ma, A K Y Leung & Mrs J R McGrath
Spotlight: Resuming (39-weeks). Very speedy type. Nabbed on the wire in Open company first-up last campaign while warmed up with a synthetic trial & winning a recent Cranbourne jump-out. Watch closely.

RaceName: Aurie's Star Handicap (Group 3) (Handicap) (Turf)
Spotlight: Great run at Swan Hill 5 Jun. Made the running but soon off the bit and weakened noticeably this course last time. Drops back in trip now. Could run into the exotics.

RaceName: Aurie's Star Handicap (Group 3) (Handicap) (Turf)
OwnerName: Mailbag Windstorm, C C F C Group Et Al
Spotlight: Now 5 weeks between runs. Well back and never sighted at Caulfield at first run for new trainer at long odds. Usually gets back. Keener on others here.

RaceName: Jim Dandy Stakes Presented By Mohegan Sun (Grade 2) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Won the Grade 1 Florida Derby four months ago and producing consistent form; was on the premises in the Belmont Stakes (second, beaten just over 1l) two months ago; this is a step down in class; should not be far away.

RaceName: Jim Dandy Stakes Presented By Mohegan Sun (Grade 2) (Dirt)
Spotlight: On target twice in his last six outings; running consistently; solid effort in the Arkansas Derby, beaten 4l to finish runner-up behind Renegade (Oaklawn Park) in March; down in class; returns from a layoff here; competitive shout.

RaceName: Jim Dandy Stakes Presented By Mohegan Sun (Grade 2) (Dirt)
OwnerName: Leland Ackerley Racing LLC, James Sherwood et al
Spotlight: Narrow winner of a Grade 3 at Thistledown six weeks ago; successful three times in his last seven starts.

RaceName: Jim Dandy Stakes Presented By Mohegan Sun (Grade 2) (Dirt)

Spotlight: Although yet to hit the target, he has shown ability; held in seventh over 1m here (maiden claimer) last month; this line-up contains some strong opposition so others more likely.
