RaceName: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual-purpose maiden; extended hurdles record to 0-8 at Tramore 11 days ago but it wasn't a bad run in third; was still beaten over 7l, however, so needs more off the same mark here with cheekpieces added.

RaceName: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Gained eighth career win (fifth over fences) at Wexford when last seen in May; has won around here before and looks to exploit 20lb lower hurdles' mark; can't be discounted for local yard.

RaceName: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services Handicap Hurdle

RaceName: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services Handicap Hurdle

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
OwnerName: Scott Sterling & Darragh Cuffe & Conor Keohane
Spotlight: Some mild promise in AW maidens, but no obvious signs she's ready strike off this mark in three handicap runs so far; blinkers go on down in trip.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner three years ago; two positive runs when fourth over 6f earlier in the summer and not beaten far at Fairyhouse over same trip 33 days ago; drop back to 5f unsure to suit though, and  well held over C&D twice in the last year.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Produced a positive third in small field over 5f in Dundalk maiden in December; little to recommend since in three starts, including on turf at Sligo last time.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Placed three times in maidens in Britain two years ago; never figured in two handicap starts over 5f and 7f for this stable, so hard to fancy.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Proving consistent in handicaps this year; handled drop back to 5f at Down Royal 17 days ago, coming home well to grab third behind Dandy Land; shaped well that day from a less than ideal position, so capable of turning the tables.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win in 13 starts came in 6f Sligo handicap a year ago, scoring cosily by 2.5l; positive third on AW in September but below par on turf return 23 days ago; needs to come on for that dropped back in trip.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Back-to-back wins on good ground over 5f at Navan and Down Royal in summer of 2024; not been close to that form over last two years and continues to slide in the weights.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Improved when fourth behind Dandy Land and Hot To Foxtrot at Down Royal last time on first start for this yard; should improve for that, but needs to reverse the form.

RaceName: Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Good third in a nursery in September; saddle slipped at Cork, but back on track with fifth at Limerick; only gave way late on when 1.75l second at Killarney over a mile 20 days ago; drop in trip should suit and claims again.

RaceName: Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't finished out of the first four in last four starts in handicaps from 7f to 1m on varying ground; beaten favourite last time at Leopardstown, 3l behind Ardadslosttheplot, doing well to make the frame having lost position early; should be thereabouts.

RaceName: Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: 0-17 but has looked like her turn is near, placing the last four times over a range of trips from 5f to 1m; good 0.5l second to Gloriously Glam on last try over this trip in May, so shouldn't be far away back in a handicap.

RaceName: Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Six-time AW winner in Britain; first turf success at Ballinrobe (9.5f, good) in May, quickening well to score by 2.5l; not in the same form the last twice and drop in trip needs to spark a bounce-back.

RaceName: Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Landed back-to-back handicaps at Leopardstown last year; placed twice over 1m subsequently; below best first two runs this year, but step in right direction with staying-on sixth at Fairyhouse 33 days ago; definite each-way chance.

RaceName: Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: 1-25 on turf; two solid thirds over 1m on AW earlier this year, but below that form on turf last twice; needs more down in trip.

RaceName: Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Ran respectably in three decent maidens over a mile last year; best run when beaten 3.5l into fifth by Ice Dancer on heavy at Gowran; off 301 days and opening mark looks fair.

RaceName: Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Consistent on turf from 6f to 1m this year; clung on by a head to land fifth win at Gowran Park (7f, good) nine days ago when well placed; should be in the mix off 5lb higher.

RaceName: Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win came in Navan maiden (6f, yielding) in October and ran a decent race on stable debut this year when fifth at Leopardstown; not in same form in three runs since, but has slid in the weights if he can put his best foot forward in a tongue-tie.

RaceName: Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: 1-31 but has finished second seven times, including over 6f at the Curragh in June in 20-runner handicap; didn't feature from wide draw at Leopardstown, but back on track when beaten 3l into fifth at Navan last time; shouldn't rule out back up in trip.

RaceName: Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap
Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Went close at Fairyhouse over 7f (good) and went one better to notch fifth win 23 days ago when beating El Fontenaro by 0.75l over 6.5f at Limerick; the pair pulled well clear and the runner-up won next time out, so has obvious claims off 9lb higher.

RaceName: Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Kept on reasonably well to finish midfield in two turf maidens; steps up in trip on handicap debut and one to monitor in market.

RaceName: Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win in ten starts came on AW in maiden over 7f in October; well held in handicaps since, keeping on one pace over 6f at Navan 23 days ago; needs more up in trip.

RaceName: Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark at Ayr in May when landing 1m1f handicap off 2lb higher; some decent runs since, most notably when beaten 1l into third in claimer over 1m at Bellewstown; drop in trip unsure to suit.

RaceName: Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win in 22 starts came at Bath in April when she bolted up by 4.5l over 1m on good; finished second off revised mark twice since, including at Nottingham 39 days ago; form has worked out; interesting on stable debut dropped in trip.

RaceName: Watch All Racing Live At Matchbook Handicap
OwnerName: Bronsan Racing & H Redknapp & John Breslin
Spotlight: AW maiden winner narrowly landed 1m2f Leopardstown handicap in May; held since, but that means she's only 2lb higher; in front of My Girl Grace at Killarney last month, but not hard to see that form being turned around.

RaceName: Watch All Racing Live At Matchbook Handicap
OwnerName: Mark E Phelan & Paul W Phelan
Spotlight: Latest win was just under a year ago over 1m1f at Leopardstown, although twice went close on AW over the winter (at this trip and 1m4f); well held in two starts at Leopardstown this summer, although it was a hot race last time and this is more his level.

RaceName: Watch All Racing Live At Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Just 1m4f AW maiden win to his name and best over farther; had the run of the race when pipped over 1m6f at Fairyhouse, and readily opposed over this trip.

RaceName: Watch All Racing Live At Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Mare has been around the houses and is now on trainer number five, but not had a pile of racing for her age; won over this trip off 70 last summer; was gambled-on second on first run of the year at Navan, where she finished well over 1m2f but couldn't peg back another one that was punted; had Genoah over 3l behind that day; big chance if she's gone the right way since.

RaceName: Watch All Racing Live At Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Solid and consistent, but has plenty of weight; 1m1f Leopardstown win came on soft, but his latest third back there over 1m2f was on good and he ran his race; has his chance, but Keane's preference for stablemate wouldn't encourage support.

RaceName: Watch All Racing Live At Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Four wins at Dundalk, but winless on the grass; Curragh second suggested he might put that right, but laboured enough effort when favourite at Navan; looks held by Letiza on that running.

RaceName: Watch All Racing Live At Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Winning debut over 1m2f on soft ground at Leopardstown (third won at Galway); trainer felt she wanted farther after that, but couldn't land a blow when favourite for 11.5f handicap at Killarney; no pace that day and best to draw a line through it.

RaceName: Watch All Racing Live At Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Ordinary form in Britain, just sole 1m AW win to his name; seasonal/stable debut fourth over 1m4f at the Curragh, in this grade, was very good (travelled well and stuck on well) and quite likely he 'bounced' eight days later at Carlisle; has tried different headgear and visor now goes; trainer seems adept at improving recruits.

RaceName: Watch All Racing Live At Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Okay run in AW maiden, but was beaten around 20l in Ulster Oaks when 33s on handicap debut; in fairness, soft ground was probably to blame.

RaceName: Watch All Racing Live At Matchbook Handicap
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Useful soft-ground form at two; Leopardstown fourth in first-time headgear has worked out well; was keeping on well then, but still has stamina to prove.

RaceName: Watch All Racing Live At Matchbook Handicap
Spotlight: Bumper winner at four and fairly ordinary maiden hurdler; lapped in his last two maidens but that 10l sixth to Enceladus (Royal Ascot handicap winner who followed up in Gordon Stakes last week) catches the eye; maybe it flatters him, but the market will be interesting.

RaceName: Irish EBF Ballyhane Stakes (Median Sires Series)
Spotlight: Third to subsequent Pattern winners on first two starts; made all over 6f at Fairyhouse, second won by a street next time and third ran well at Galway; gets 11lb from the top pair which is handy.

RaceName: Irish EBF Ballyhane Stakes (Median Sires Series)
Spotlight: Dubawi Legend filly cost 50,000euroS as a yearling; half-sister to three winners including 7f Listed winner Bellosa and fair sprinter Salah Belle who won twice for this yard; dam 6f winner, out of French 7f 2yo Listed winner.

RaceName: Irish EBF Ballyhane Stakes (Median Sires Series)
OwnerName: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg
Spotlight: Good fourth in the Chesham (7f, form working out) on second start, but sluggish from the gates and turned over at odds-on over 1m at Killarney (probably not bad form either); 6f is hardly ideal, but a leading player all the same.

RaceName: Irish EBF Ballyhane Stakes (Median Sires Series)
Spotlight: Both runs over this trip; promising third at Salisbury and then won by two short-heads at Newmarket; form of his runs has, by and large, worked out and has potential for more; yard won this in 2023.

RaceName: Irish EBF Ballyhane Stakes (Median Sires Series)
Spotlight: All runs over this trip; odds-on for winning debut on AW; decent form when second in conditions contest at Epsom; was on wrong side in Windsor Castle, but that hardly excuses his dismal showing; gelded since and headgear goes on; races prominently.

RaceName: Irish EBF Ballyhane Stakes (Median Sires Series)
Spotlight: Starman newcomer cost 38,000euros as a yearling; third foal; dam unplaced over 5f, closely related to French 1m/1m4f winner Bolt Of Thunder, half-sister to 5f-7f winner Classy Clarets, out of 6f winner.

RaceName: Irish EBF Ballyhane Stakes (Median Sires Series)
Spotlight: All runs over 5f; debut win at the Curragh was followed by an odds-on defeat here and made no impact in the Norfolk; did things right and was giving weight to the two who beat him at Cork last time, where he finished off quite well; might well get the extra furlong here.

RaceName: Irish EBF Ballyhane Stakes (Median Sires Series)
Spotlight: Both runs over 6f; Fairyhouse debut was fine, but being hampered at the start doesn't explain a lacklustre effort here; Livenka is the one for the yard, and he'll be just trying to nick a bit of prize money.

RaceName: Irish EBF Ballyhane Stakes (Median Sires Series)
Spotlight: Second in valuable 6f novice at York in May (only okay form), but was thrown out for whip misuse; too keen and weakened to finish in rear in 1m Listed contest here a month ago; gelded and visored; opposable

RaceName: Irish EBF Ballyhane Stakes (Median Sires Series)
Spotlight: 22s, showed a bit of speed but ultimately well beaten over 6.5f at Leopardstown.

RaceName: Irish EBF Ballyhane Stakes (Median Sires Series)
Spotlight: Showed up well in a barrier trial here and was fancied for first of two 7f runs at Leoaprdstown, but was too keen even in a hood; no show last time.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Philip Antonacci & Mrs Paul Shanahan & Mrs John Magnier
Spotlight: Improved from debut, stepped up in trip after a break when fourth at the Curragh (7f, good-to-firm) 16 days ago, 1.25l behind Nautic Star; should appreciate this extra furlong on that evidence.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan
Spotlight: Made the frame in all five starts, beaten 2.5l into third off 75 in 1m handicap at the Curragh before running to a similar level when filling the same spot at the Curragh 16 days ago over 7f; consistent and experienced; should go close back up in trip.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Some promise amid greenness when beaten 10l into sixth on debut at Naas 30 days ago; tongue-tie on; more of a long-term project.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Sea The Stars filly; half-sister to winners Starford (9.4f-1m3f inc Group 3; RPR 114) and Jack Sparowe (1m-1m3f inc AW; 80); dam 7f-1m4f winner (inc 2yo/Listed; 98), half-sister to useful 1m winner Laelaps, out of 1m3f-1m6f Flat and useful 2m hurdle winner; makes debut for in-form yard; second string on jockey bookings.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Blue Point filly; closely related to 1m winner Embiran (RPR 94), half-sister to winners Elamaz (French/Australian 1m/1m2f inc Listed; 113), Emaniya (Group-placed 1m 2yo; 103) and Ediyva (7f AW; 74); dam 7f winner (inc Group 3/AW; 106); well-bred type from good Aga Khan family; market support would be interesting.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: 100,000euros foal (50,000euros vendor Y); second foal; half-sister to 1m4f winner Ledecky (RPR 86); dam 1m AW winner (Group-placed 1m4f; 99), closely related to Italian 1m7f Listed winner Fortunino, out of unraced close relation to 1m4f/1m6f Group 3 winner; yard 2-26 in maidens this year.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith
Spotlight: Best run at two came when beaten 4.5l into fifth by Diamond Necklace in Ingabelle Stakes (7f, good), albeit flattered by proximity to winner; beaten 6.25l into third in maiden at Galway in October on soft ground; used as pacemaker in Group 1 company last twice; obviously far calmer waters here, and her two-year-old form makes her the one to beat.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Well beaten on debut 63 days ago; unlikely to figure.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: 4,000euros foal; Ribchester filly; half-sister to winners Starlight Dream (1m2f; RPR 93), Areana (10.5f; 72), Amethistos (Greek 6f/1m) and Abella (Slovakian 8.5f/1m6f); dam Italian Listed-placed 1m-1m2f winner.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: 13,000euros yearling by Bungle Inthejungle; dam placed 7f/1m AW (RPR 65), half-sister to French winners Harmless (7f 2yo/1m2f Listed), Ghabnah (1m) and Samuraj (6f-1m), is granddaughter of German 1m Listed winner.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Very modest sort based on 13 runs; can't make a case for.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Well-bred filly, half-sister to yard's Grade 1 winner Aspen Grove; green when well held on debut over 7f on soft ground at Cork 121 days ago; likely improver up in trip but needs to.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Well held on first two starts on the AW; off 248 days; looks more one for handicaps.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Faded tamely on debut 52 days ago; drops in trip.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Huge odds and ran accordingly on debut nine days ago; hard to recommend.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: No indication she can win a maiden based on first three runs.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: John G Hennessy & C Acheson & Mrs John Harrington
Spotlight: Well-held on debut at Down Royal 66 days ago; likely to improve for that but needs far more in cheekpieces.

RaceName: Weatherbys Digital Solutions Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: She's run to a similar level all four starts, often pulling hard, including in the first-time hood (retained) back up to 1m last time; leading claims if she settles but it's now hard to be bullish on that front.

RaceName: Weatherbys Digital Solutions Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Again inclined to pull hard in a C&D fillies' novice last time and no surprise to see a first-time hood fitted today; looking exposed now and will again be vulnerable to an improver, even if proving more amenable.

RaceName: Weatherbys Digital Solutions Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Solid debut behind a couple of useful fillies last autumn but then wasn't seen again until a fortnight ago, when easy to back (1m2f); again finished third to a couple of useful fillies at Newbury and holds decent claims with that under her belt.

RaceName: Weatherbys Digital Solutions Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Second foal of a 7f 2yo winner for the Gosden yard (first offspring a winner in France and Spain); trainer gets the odd big-priced winning newcomer but she's likely one for handicaps down the line.

RaceName: Weatherbys Digital Solutions Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 50-1 when well held on her 6f Polytrack debut for Ed Walker last September; yard's Flat wins in recent times have all come with older horses and it would be a surprise to see her take this.

RaceName: Weatherbys Global Stallions App EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Stable in flying form of late, albeit mainly with older horses; this filly needed the experience on her Salisbury debut a fortnight ago, when well off the front pair; entitled to improve but needs to.

RaceName: Weatherbys Global Stallions App EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 290,000euros yearling whose French-trained dam won on her 6f 2yo debut; trainer, who also saddles Harlequin Gift, has enjoyed a decent season with juveniles and she's an interesting newcomer.

RaceName: Weatherbys Global Stallions App EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Well held after a slow start on her 6f debut, and again last time, when pulling hard in front over 7f and not seeing it out; nurseries may be her time to shine in due course.

RaceName: Weatherbys Global Stallions App EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 75,000euros 2yo (Irish breeze-ups) who's a sister to Irish 2yo winner Ex Animo and a half-sister to Serenity Prayer (won on 3yo debut); the market will be the best guide.

RaceName: Weatherbys Global Stallions App EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Big prices and well held in three runs to date (5f-7f), missing the break a couple of times; this is more realistic in a first-time tongue-tie but she again looks vulnerable.

RaceName: Weatherbys Global Stallions App EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: May-foaled 55,000euros 2yo (Irish breeze-ups) who has stamina on the dam's side of her pedigree and is likely to be suited by more of a test in due course; stable had a big-priced 2yo newcomer win last week; watch the market.

RaceName: Weatherbys Global Stallions App EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: April-foaled 30,000gns yearling who's a half-sister to a useful sprint winner (turf) in the US; trainer enjoying a fine summer with 2yos and the market is usually a reliable guide with his newcomers.

RaceName: Weatherbys VAT Services Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Last of six on his first two starts before never involved in a first-time hood (off here) a month ago; for all that, he's shown enough to be considered now handicapping having since been gelded for a yard among the winners.

RaceName: Weatherbys VAT Services Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Three defeats at short prices in the spring, including in a seller, before out of her depth in the Super Sprint last time; this is more realistic on her nursery debut but she needs to find more.

RaceName: Weatherbys VAT Services Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Better with each start, culminating in a neck defeat in a match at Ayr two weeks ago, having been gelded; hard to know the worth of that, with his sole rival a newcomer, but he may have more to offer under Marco Ghiani, who's 2-4 for the yard.

RaceName: Weatherbys VAT Services Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: K Shenton, N Bradley 6 & D Cunha
Spotlight: Gelded after hanging badly right on firm ground at Bath early last month; better effort in a Tapeta novice in which the leaders didn't come back 11 days ago and that gave something to build on.

RaceName: Weatherbys VAT Services Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Backed at prices ahead of her debut, for a yard not noted for 2yo newcomers, and showed the right attitude when off the mark at Chepstow ten days ago (both for Ashley Lewis, who's enjoying a purple patch); shortlisted on her nursery debut.

RaceName: Weatherbys VAT Services Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Didn't see out a stiff 7.4f following her 6f maiden win, but then appeared to have no excuses on her nursery debut last time (first-time tongue-tie; retained); looking exposed now.

RaceName: Weatherbys VAT Services Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Pontefract win hasn't worked out and, having been out of his depth at Royal Ascot, he ran well below market expectations on his nursery debut a few weeks ago (buzzed up after getting crowded early); needs to settle better.

RaceName: weatherbysshop.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: A win and a near-miss to his name in two runs here; now 7lb lower than when winning last spring but he's struggled this season, including without the trademark cheekpieces last time; needs a revival but the drop back from 6f should help.

RaceName: weatherbysshop.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: Prolific winner down the years, including over C&D last summer, who's regressed sharply in recent times; a few years since she ran at this low a level and that should help, but it will largely hinge on how she responds to wearing headgear for the first time.

RaceName: weatherbysshop.co.uk Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs A L Lofts & Mrs Nicky Scott Knight
Spotlight: Sharply regressive for Tom Ward this season, coming a stone down the weights; goes in first-time headgear for her new yard, back from a short break, and is worth tracking in the market.

RaceName: weatherbysshop.co.uk Handicap
OwnerName: Grange Park Racing VIII & Mrs R Carr
Spotlight: Three-time Wolverhampton winner who finally broke his duck on turf off 3lb lower a month ago (went close over C&D previously); things didn't pan out his way at Catterick last time and he's one to consider.

RaceName: weatherbysshop.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: Inconsistent filly who's tried in first-time headgear back from two months off; excuses for two Wolverhampton defeats since her maiden win there in the spring (made all for Rossa Ryan) but she's achieved little in three runs on turf.

RaceName: Weatherbys Bettrends Handicap
Spotlight: Expensive to follow this season before being found a weak handicap over C&D last time, when always in control from the front; has only been nudged up 1lb for that and has a decent chance of following up.

RaceName: Weatherbys Bettrends Handicap
Spotlight: Dam won over this trip and the step up from 1m seems sure to suit on the evidence of three runs to date; looks to start handicap life on a workable mark and should have some improvement left in her.

RaceName: Weatherbys Bettrends Handicap
Spotlight: Not as good now and has his share of off days; back on a winning mark, though, has a C&D win to his name and this is less competitive than he's used to returning from ten weeks off.

RaceName: Weatherbys Bettrends Handicap
Spotlight: Poor effort on her comeback in June and another one off 3lb higher on her handicap debut last time, when a remote last of four; first-time headgear will need to make a difference.

RaceName: Weatherbys Racing Bank Handicap
Spotlight: Gelded after three ordinary efforts in maidens in the spring; solid effort in the first-time tongue-tie off this mark at Southwell last Monday, when a clear second, and his claims are obvious off the same mark.

RaceName: Weatherbys Racing Bank Handicap
OwnerName: Dr M Voikhansky & Mrs S Voikhanskaya
Spotlight: Dual winner for the Frost yard this time last year, latterly off 3lb lower, but has been absent since pulling away her chances over C&D in the spring; needs a revival.

RaceName: Weatherbys Racing Bank Handicap
Spotlight: Serial slow starter who ended a losing run off a 4lb lower mark at Doncaster 11 days ago before bumping into a well-handicapped winner over C&D last Thursday; holds claims, especially if he can get away on terms for a change.

RaceName: Weatherbys Racing Bank Handicap
Spotlight: Inconsistent maiden who has missed the start and/or pulled hard; no problem with 9.5f on Tapeta last time, when turning in his best effort since handicapping (made most), but history suggests he's no good thing to build on it.

RaceName: Weatherbys Racing Bank Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time Tapeta winner who's been expensive to follow in recent times; ridden more prominently than usual when below par last time but there have been too many near-misses for comfort.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Made an encouraging debut when third of seven in a similar contest over C&D (good to firm) last Monday; can be expected to show improvement which is more than likely required here.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: A 200,000gns breeze-up buy, he ran a stormer when beaten a nose on his debut at Pontefract (5f, good to firm) eight days ago, looking a winner-in-waiting; steps up in trip and should be hard to beat.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Solid form when placed in his two runs so far; first-time blinkers replace cheekpieces and he should be suited by stepping back up to 6f; looks the main danger.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Has shown just a modest level of ability in his two runs so far and has his work cut out here; his best chance of success in the immediate future probably lies in nurseries.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Her dam was a 5f/6f winner for the yard (RPR 77) and it's very early days, but she was soundly beaten at big prices last autumn on her first two starts (6f/5f, AW) and this is her first outing since; improvement needed.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Signs of promise on debut at Southwell last month (7f, AW; slowly away) and likewise when 4l third of seven at Redcar (7f, good to firm) last Wednesday; her useful pedigree hints that this drop in trip could be a positive, and she's firmly in calculations.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Went very close at 50-1 on debut at Leicester (6f, good to firm) in May; failed to back that up at Bath (5.7f, good) but she lost a shoe and has had a break since; remains of interest.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 11-race maiden who has finished second six times; needs to prove she can get the job done and it's possible that 5f is her optimum trip, but she has the best form in the field and this could be a good opportunity.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 4yo who has achieved very little across her 17 winless starts and others are preferred.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: One to watch in the betting in first-time cheekpieces but she's been beaten a long way on all five starts, for this stable on her last two runs.

RaceName: Weatherbys Bloodstock Pro Fillies' Handicap
OwnerName: Grange Park Racing Xviii And Ruth Carr
Spotlight: She'd run some good races in defeat this year for the Newland/Insole yard prior to being sold for 12,000gns last month, and she exploited a reduced mark on her stable debut at Thirsk (5f, good to firm); she had just a neck to spare and is back up 4lb but could have more to offer for the yard.

RaceName: Weatherbys Bloodstock Pro Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Won over C&D (good) in May and perhaps the return to Ripon will be a positive; however, she's been unplaced on her three starts since, most recently fourth to Zoustar Dreams at Nottingham, and she needs something extra.

RaceName: Weatherbys Bloodstock Pro Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Made all in a novice at Yarmouth (6f, soft) in May in first-time blinkers; merely seventh subsequently in her first two handicaps (7f/6f, good to firm) but she showed plenty of pace over 6f at Carlisle on the second occasion and could relish this first crack at 5f; cheekpieces replace blinkers.

RaceName: Weatherbys Bloodstock Pro Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive since these cheekpieces went on, winning two in a row (6f/5f, good to firm/soft) before fading into fourth at Newmarket (6f, good to firm), and she appreciated the return to 5f when winning at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) last time; did it nicely and a 5lb rise may not stop her.

RaceName: Weatherbys Bloodstock Pro Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Won Newcastle maiden (5f, AW) last November on final 2yo start; close fifth on reappearance at Catterick (6f, good) in May before heavy defeat here later that month (6f, good; failed to settle); the drop back to 5f could help and she's not written off, but others arrive with less to prove.

RaceName: Wilmot-Smith Memorial Handicap
OwnerName: N Skinner D Jenkins J Glover
Spotlight: Won in a big field at York (6f, good) in May and he's continued in good form, finishing second at Ayr (6f, good to firm) last time; key player.

RaceName: Wilmot-Smith Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Stumbled/unseated in first-time visor (retained since) at Carlisle in May but posted a career-best when winning by 2l over C&D (good) in June, and he was denied a clear run when third of six at Pontefract (6f, good) subsequently; high on the list.

RaceName: Wilmot-Smith Memorial Handicap
OwnerName: Doug Graham, Ian Davison, Alan Drysdale
Spotlight: Runner-up twice in a row in Bahrain (6f, good/good to firm) in January; this 9yo hasn't shone on his three starts since and his losing sequence goes back to September 2023, but perhaps the drop back in grade will trigger a revival for this C&D winner; not ruled out.

RaceName: Wilmot-Smith Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner who won two in a row at Newcastle (AW) at the start of the year and was a close third over C&D (good) in May; he's dropped back down to a handy mark but has finished down the field on his last three outings.

RaceName: Wilmot-Smith Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Inconsistent and winless this year and well beaten at York (6f, good to firm) recently; however, that was more competitive than this and two starts ago he ran well when third of 17 at Ayr (6f, good); may have a chance.

RaceName: Wilmot-Smith Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Having dropped down the weights he was a good second on his seasonal and stable debut at Ascot (6f, good) in May; however, two lesser runs have followed and this 8yo remains without a win since June 2023.

RaceName: Wilmot-Smith Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: 2yo Listed runner-up last October; fourth of seven on stable debut at Chester (6f, good) nine days ago, which was a step back in the right direction, but he needs another today if he's to pose a serious threat.

RaceName: North Yorkshire Ice Cream Championship 2026 Handicap
Spotlight: 11yo who is a three-time C&D winner, the latest last month (good), and he followed up at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) last Thursday in a novice amateur riders' race, for which he carries a 4lb penalty here; third in the last three runnings of this race and could better that position today.

RaceName: North Yorkshire Ice Cream Championship 2026 Handicap
Spotlight: Close second of five at Ayr (1m2f, good to firm) last month before getting off the mark at the 16th attempt at Pontefract (1m, good to firm) eight days ago; had something to spare and she's respected under a penalty.

RaceName: North Yorkshire Ice Cream Championship 2026 Handicap
Spotlight: Won for Ian Williams at Newbury (1m2f, good to firm) last July and runner-up three times subsequently; sold for 20,000gns last October and absent since (wind op in interim); may be best watched on stable debut.

RaceName: North Yorkshire Ice Cream Championship 2026 Handicap
Spotlight: Placed twice in a row before winning by 2l at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) last month; he holds solid claims up 6lb for last time.

RaceName: North Yorkshire Ice Cream Championship 2026 Handicap
Spotlight: Won at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) in May and second of five there (1m2f, good to firm) last month, but he was beaten 4l and has finished down the field either side of that penultimate start; others have more pressing claims.

RaceName: Queen Ethelburga's Collegiate Handicap
Spotlight: Has shown improvement since joining current yard and stepping up to around 1m in two runs, getting off the mark at Hamilton (good) last month when making all; she should give another good account off 3lb higher.

RaceName: Queen Ethelburga's Collegiate Handicap
Spotlight: Nine-race maiden but has made the frame five times, although his best efforts have been when second twice over 7f; holds place claims.

RaceName: Queen Ethelburga's Collegiate Handicap
Spotlight: Improved for the fitting of cheekpieces and the step up to 1m when scoring over C&D (good) in May; after two lesser efforts, she showed her liking for this track when landing her second C&D win (good) 16 days ago; handicapper has whacked her up 8lb but she cannot be dismissed around here.

RaceName: Queen Ethelburga's Collegiate Handicap
Spotlight: Ex-French; has shown just modest form in three runs for this yard over 7f; steps back up to 1m and improvement required.

RaceName: Queen Ethelburga's Collegiate Handicap
Spotlight: Big prices and well beaten in three handicaps this year; dropping down the weights but hard to recommend.

RaceName: Queen Ethelburga's Collegiate Handicap
Spotlight: Fair third for Jamie Osborne on debut at Southwell last September; subsequently sold for 7,000gns; beaten 23l on stable debut at Wetherby (7f, good to firm) in June, and 24l at Wolverhampton (7f) last month; steps up in trip in first-time tongue-tie but she doesn't look ready to win.

RaceName: Queen Ethelburga's Collegiate Handicap
Spotlight: Promising third on his debut at Lingfield (7f, AW) in March when trained by Richard Hughes, but has run well below that level since; has finished last on two most recent runs for current trainer; hard to fancy.

RaceName: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Bumper/AW handicap winner; second of 13 here (1m2f, good to firm) in May under Georgia King and has since twice made the frame under the same rider, the latest when third of seven at Epsom (1m4f, good to firm) last month; still unexposed on turf and respected back down in grade.

RaceName: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Has run well on good to firm but looks best on a softer surface; either way a record of 2-49 sounds a note of caution; out of the weights.

RaceName: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: 1-21; has been placed a few times on turf but his best form has come on the AW, albeit he was well held at Wolverhampton (1m4f) on Friday; others stronger.

RaceName: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Latest defeat when sent off favourite here (1m2f, good to firm) a fortnight ago wasn't quite as bad as it looks, but his losing run is now up to 20 and his best form has come over shorter.

RaceName: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Versatile sort having won on turf, AW and over hurdles; 2lb lower than for his last Flat success but this trip looks sharp enough; Ruby Criscuolo rode a winner for the stable at Wolverhampton last month; yard also runs Wrist Art.

RaceName: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Patchy form since joining this yard and well behind I'd Go Maniac on his return from five months off at Epsom (1m4f, good to firm) 18 days ago, but is 9lb lower than when winning at Newbury (1m4f, good to firm) for Ian Williams a year ago; first-time tongue-tie.

RaceName: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Third start for new yard when winning at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) under Grace Littmoden in May; 4lb rise fair enough and the return to turf shouldn't be a problem back from a short break; shortlisted.

RaceName: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Ran with some credit on his return from 100 days off when fourth of 11 at Chepstow (1m2f, good to soft) seven weeks ago, but now 0-27 and is well out of the weights.

RaceName: Wasdell Group Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Stamina in her pedigree; never involved after a slow start on her 5f debut for Richard Hughes here seven weeks ago; prominent in the market that day, though, and interesting to see how she goes in the betting for her new yard (0-44 with 2yos here all told).

RaceName: Wasdell Group Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Inclined to hang on her first two runs and continued the steady progression when having Decem Carolinae behind at Yarmouth five weeks ago; a lot of years since her trainer had a 2yo win on turf but she sets the standard the newcomers are gunning for.

RaceName: Wasdell Group Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 50,000gns yearling who's the first foal of a French 7f winner and holds a few sales race entries; trainer enjoyed a good spell with 2yos of late and she's interesting under Oisin Murphy (18-98 for the yard).

RaceName: Wasdell Group Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 60,000euros foal, 70,000euros yearling who's the first offspring of a French 6f-7f winner; trainer's strike-rate with 2yos is up a touch this season and he's 26% with them here; she's a likely looking newcomer.

RaceName: Wasdell Group Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 1,000gns foal who's the first offspring of an unraced sister to two winners over hurdles; trainer has a 7% strike-rate with 2yos here; would want to see good support on debut before considering her.

RaceName: Wasdell Group Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Slowly away when finishing a remote last on her Tapeta debut 11 days ago; will need to leave that well behind for a trainer who's 2-23 with 2yos here.

RaceName: Wasdell Group EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Sent off 40-1 for her Leicester debut (6f, good to firm) ten weeks ago, but ran well to be beaten less than 2l into fourth of ten (winner has gone in again since); absence is a slight concern, but she still makes more appeal than most.

RaceName: Wasdell Group EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Twice runner-up on the AW at Lingfield (5f/6f), but failed to beat a rival back on turf there (6f, good to firm) nine days ago; however, the return to the minimum trip does look a positive so she may be worth chancing.

RaceName: Wasdell Group EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Was finishing fourth for the third consecutive time when filling that position on handicap debut at Kempton (6f, AW) last month; doesn't shape as though the drop to 5f is a positive, but her form still makes her a major player in this field; tongue-tie given a go.

RaceName: Wasdell Group EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Had major issues at the start in his first two outings and achieved little when beaten 10l into second of three at Lingfield (6f, good to firm; first-time blinkers) 12 days ago; bred to be better than that, but best watched for now.

RaceName: Wasdell Group EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Well beaten in two starts on the AW (5f/6f) more than 15 months apart (debut was for Mark Usher); best watched for now.

RaceName: Wasdell Group EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Huge prices when tailed off at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) and here (1m2f, good to firm) last month; drops dramatically in trip and makes no appeal.

RaceName: Happy Birthday Tyne Patterson Fillies' Handicap
OwnerName: Nick Bradley Racing 16 And Jmr Partners
Spotlight: Made the most of her declining mark when regaining winning form off 2lb lower at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) last month; lost her race at the start at Bath a fortnight later and a major player if breaking on terms this time.

RaceName: Happy Birthday Tyne Patterson Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Seven-race maiden who showed ability in her early starts last year, but seems to have lost her way including in both outings since returning in June; Oisin Murphy regains the ride but the filly still needs a resurgence.

RaceName: Happy Birthday Tyne Patterson Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time course winner (5f/6f) whose form has been mixed since returning to turf in May, but this front-runner may enjoy the run of the race and she remains on a favourable mark; goes especially well on good to firm ground; much respected.

RaceName: Happy Birthday Tyne Patterson Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-time winner in Ireland but all over 7f/1m, and three starts over 6f/7f for this yard have yielded little; takes another drop in class but best watched for now.

RaceName: Happy Birthday Tyne Patterson Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Won a maiden over C&D (good) for the Kublers a year ago and only just beaten on her reappearance/stable debut at Goodwood (6f, soft) in June, but well beaten at Leicester (6f, good to firm) last month; may not want the ground this quick, but still a player if bouncing back in first-time cheekpieces.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 0-16 but looked unlucky not to finish closer when third of nine in a 0-70 handicap at Epsom (8.5f, good to firm) last time; not certain to back that up but would be a player if he can.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Running well in this headgear lately, winning a 0-60 handicap at Bath (1m, good) in June and keeping on to finish a close third in a similar contest to this at Lingfield (1m, AW) three weeks ago; didn't stay 1m4f in one attempt but should be fine at this trip; player.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Successfully dropped to this level when off the mark at the 17th attempt at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) on Saturday; major player if turning out again.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 0-5 but not disgraced in a couple of 0-55 handicaps; still unexposed and shortlisted with a first-time tongue-tie added to the usual hood.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: First and second in two nurseries at Bath (1m, soft) last October, but not much otherwise including in both starts since returning in June; drop in grade the one positive.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Ex-Irish gelding who ran with a bit of credit when fourth of ten in a similar contest at Ffos Las (1m2f, good) last time, but has yet to be placed in 12 starts; hood will need to make a difference.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Seven-race maiden who hinted at ability in a couple of maidens but hasn't built on it in handicaps, including when fitted with a hood last time; makes limited appeal despite the drop in grade.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 0-9; may have been flattered when third of six in a 0-55 handicap at Leicester (1m, good to firm) 12 days ago; drops in grade but others are more convincing.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Landed a similar contest at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) in January, but that her only success in her last 25 starts; could go well but others preferred for the win.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 0-11; has run with credit in a couple of fast-ground handicaps over this trip in recent months, but still looks up against it on these terms.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: On a losing run of 18 but does know how to win and drops below 0-60 level for the first time; each-way claims; stable also runs Maryland Star.

RaceName: Talk Sport Radio Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins have been on AW; raced too freely on return to action when sixth of seven over C&D (good to firm) two weeks ago and needs to settle better to give himself a chance.

RaceName: Talk Sport Radio Handicap
Spotlight: Sole success came in a Nottingham maiden in 2024 when trained by David Evans; switched yards this year and best run since when runner-up at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) 11 days ago; Billy Loughnane rides for the first time and he should be thereabouts.

RaceName: Talk Sport Radio Handicap
Spotlight: Confirmed the promise of recent runs when scoring for the second time at Bath (1m, firm) last month; 5lb rise makes this tougher but holds place claims at least.

RaceName: Talk Sport Radio Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins have been over 7f on AW; looks in need of a drop in the weights and a drop back in trip on AW.

RaceName: Talk Sport Radio Handicap
Spotlight: All five wins have been for previous trainers over 6f/7f; his two runs over 1m have not proved his stamina for the distance, but this does represent a class drop so all is not lost.

RaceName: Talk Sport Radio Handicap
Spotlight: 0-11 but has performed with credit on all four starts this year for current trainer; back on the same mark as when beaten a neck at Bath (1m, good to soft) in April; first-time cheekpieces are now applied and she should run well.

RaceName: Talk Sport Radio Handicap
Spotlight: Placed on his first two runs this year but last two runs not so good; three of his four turf wins have been at Bath, and may be best to wait until he returns to that venue.

RaceName: Army Benevolent Fund/EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: He was behind two experienced rivals, including a longer-priced stablemate, when 3l third of 12 at 15-8 on debut at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) last month; this 175,000euros breeze-up buy is a likeable prospect; high on the list.

RaceName: Army Benevolent Fund/EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 10-1, beaten about 9l when sixth of eight on last month's debut at Ascot (7f, good to firm); however, this 72,000gns breeze-up buy represents a top Newmarket trainer who is 7-15 (47%) here in the last five seasons; could take a big step forward and play a major role.

RaceName: Army Benevolent Fund/EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Third foal; Dark Angel half-brother to 9.4f/1m2f AW winner Siam Ruby (RPR 78); dam placed 7f AW 2yo (67), closely related to 7f 2yo winner Jacqueline Quest (relegated to second in 1,000 Guineas); likely to improve for this debut outing but is one to watch in the betting; has been gelded.

RaceName: Army Benevolent Fund/EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: First foal; dam French 11.5f/1m4f winner (RPR 74), sister to US 2m Grade 2 winner Siskany; Newmarket trainer has 4-19 (21%) record at Catterick; this Dark Angel newcomer could have a part to play.

RaceName: Army Benevolent Fund/EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: First foal of connections' 1m4f Arc winner Alpinista; it's possible this Dubawi newcomer will need more time and distance but her dam won over 7f on her 2yo debut; Newmarket stable 5-17 (29%) here in the past five seasons; intriguing contender, all the more so if strong in the betting.

RaceName: Army Benevolent Fund/EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 5,000gns foal; towards the rear throughout when 33-1 for last month's debut at Doncaster (7f, good to firm); lots of improvement is needed.

RaceName: Hugh James Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Following a two-month break he returned to form and landed a gamble in reapplied cheekpieces (retained) at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) last Thursday; he's never finished better than seventh on turf and the surface switch is a concern, but he'll be tough to beat if reproducing anything like his latest form.

RaceName: Hugh James Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Two-time course winner who showed some spark when third over C&D in May; however, this 7yo has struggled on her four starts since and hopes are pinned on the first-time visor (replacing cheekpieces) prompting a revival.

RaceName: Hugh James Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 9yo who has been beaten on his last 13 starts and hasn't really shone elsewhere on his last two outings; however, this four-time course winner was second in this last year and a respectable fourth over C&D three starts ago; could have a part to play now back here.

RaceName: Hugh James Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Remains a maiden after 14 starts but she's returned from a break in good form this summer, finishing in the first three on her last three starts (6f/7f, good/good to firm; including here); could be thereabouts.

RaceName: Hugh James Classified Stakes
Spotlight: A couple of respectable efforts in May/June but she's been well beaten on her last two starts and has won just one of her 24 races.

RaceName: Hugh James Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 13-race maiden who is unraced beyond 6f; after a promising third on stable debut here (6f, good to firm) in June he took a backward step when fifth at Beverley (5f, good to firm) latest, but this 3yo is not ruled out.

RaceName: Hugh James Classified Stakes
Spotlight: She's run some respectable races this season but over shorter; 0-23 and hasn't been shaping as though a first win is imminent.

RaceName: Jacky Rylance 60th Birthday Celebration Handicap
Spotlight: Well beaten on his first two starts for this stable (1m4f/1m6f) and he didn't see his race out when fourth of six at Nottingham (1m6f, good to firm) last month; down another 3lb but has stamina to prove for this far.

RaceName: Jacky Rylance 60th Birthday Celebration Handicap
Spotlight: 1-21, with the win coming in a classified event at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW; first-time blinkers) last February, but he has been runner-up on three occasions; below his best in recent starts and was last of four at Nottingham in June.

RaceName: Jacky Rylance 60th Birthday Celebration Handicap
OwnerName: Mr & Mrs G F Hall Racing
Spotlight: Both wins came on the AW in 2023 (8.5f/1m2f); bounced back from a lesser effort at Ayr (1m7f, soft) when a 3l fourth at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm) last time but she is yet to fully prove she's effective at this trip; visor goes on.

RaceName: Jacky Rylance 60th Birthday Celebration Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win from 33 starts came on the AW at Wolverhampton (around 2m) in October; well-held third on her last two starts, including over C&D in May, but cheekpieces may be able to help; each-way chance.

RaceName: Jacky Rylance 60th Birthday Celebration Handicap
Spotlight: 16-race maiden (Flat/hurdles) but he was runner-up on the Flat at Yarmouth (1m4f, good; first-time cheekpieces) last October; has made the frame over hurdles in recent starts but others look stronger.

RaceName: Jacky Rylance 60th Birthday Celebration Handicap
Spotlight: Dual C&D winner last May, the most recent coming off a 7lb higher mark than today's; failed to beat a rival home here in May and he was pulled up over hurdles when last seen 52 days ago; bit to prove after those efforts.

RaceName: Jacky Rylance 60th Birthday Celebration Handicap
Spotlight: In good form over hurdles, getting off the mark when winning at Market Rasen (2m7f) and just held on by a head to follow up at Stratford (2m6f) 36 days ago; ran respectably over this C&D for her previous stable and has claims returned to the Flat.

RaceName: Jacky Rylance 60th Birthday Celebration Handicap
Spotlight: Dual AW winner in France (1m/9.5f); beaten 13l when second of five over this C&D (good to firm) last month and was well beaten at Newcastle (2m, AW) four days ago; others have stronger claims.

RaceName: Jacky Rylance 60th Birthday Celebration Handicap
Spotlight: Dual winner over hurdles (2024/2025) when trained by Fergal O'Brien; tailed off here over 1m4f on her stable debut and she was an 11l fifth at Beverley (1m4f) a week ago; step back up in trip needs to help.

RaceName: Hannah Blanchard 21st Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Often front-runner; course winner over 7f last June and gained her fifth success when winning at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) five starts ago; behind Barmyblade when third over this C&D before a lesser effort at Thirsk 11 days ago; could bounce back in this lower grade.

RaceName: Hannah Blanchard 21st Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Ran well on his stable debut at Wetherby (5.5f, good to firm) in June and built on that when winning at Thirsk (7f; fifth and sixth have won since) 19 days ago; this drop back in trip won't be an issue and he has good claims off a 4lb higher mark.

RaceName: Hannah Blanchard 21st Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark at the tenth attempt when getting up to win by a head over C&D in June; didn't get home over 7.5f at Beverley next time but ran well when third at Pontefract (6f) nine days ago; solid claims.

RaceName: Hannah Blanchard 21st Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Made all at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) last month and bounced back from a disappointing effort when winning over this C&D two weeks ago (again made all); can't be dismissed off this 3lb higher mark at a track which suits.

RaceName: Hannah Blanchard 21st Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: 3-29 on the AW compared to 1-23 on turf, the last two successes coming at Southwell in January (6f/7f); went close at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) two weeks ago and will have no issue with the drop back in trip; respected.

RaceName: Hannah Blanchard 21st Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Six-race maiden; refused to settle and built up a clear lead at Beverley (7.5f, good to firm) three weeks ago, but was caught inside the final furlong and finished third of eight; there was plenty of encouragement to be taken from that effort and he should be suited by the drop back in trip.

RaceName: Hannah Blanchard 21st Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Seven of his eight wins have been on the AW, the most recent coming at Newcastle (6f; first-time tongue-tie) in February; well beaten on his last three starts but he did have an excuse here two weeks ago (blindfold was removed late).

RaceName: Hannah Blanchard 21st Birthday Handicap
OwnerName: John Kelly, John McNeill & Kevin Mowatt
Spotlight: Sole win from 21 starts came in a 5f handicap here in April off the same mark as today's but he's mostly struggled since; has failed to beat a rival on his last two outings and the headgear is now removed.

RaceName: racingtv.com Handicap
Spotlight: Well held in each of her three previous starts on the AW at around 1m in May and June; the hood worn for those outings is now removed, and it would be no surprise to see an improved performance now stepping up in trip on her turf/handicap debut (dam 1m3f-1m4f winner).

RaceName: racingtv.com Handicap
Spotlight: Went close when upped to 1m4f on his handicap debut at Ripon before winning a classified at Pontefract by 8l next time (made all); posted another good effort back in handicap company at Southwell (1m3f, AW) 12 days ago but is 5lb higher; makes the shortlist.

RaceName: racingtv.com Handicap
Spotlight: 27-race maiden but he has been running well, including when a 8l second of seven behind Hansteen at Pontefract (1m4f, good to firm) 18 days ago; has a bit to find to reverse placings with that rival but holds each-way claims back into a handicap.

RaceName: racingtv.com Handicap
Spotlight: 1-27 on Flat turf, the win coming on soft ground over 1m at Redcar in May 2024 (first-time hood); gave it a good go from the front when runner-up over this C&D last month but she failed to beat a rival home at Ayr (1m2f) two weeks ago; needs to bounce back.

RaceName: racingtv.com Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden whose best effort came when runner-up at Newcastle (1m2f) in April; well held when third of seven (beaten around 11l) over this C&D on her turf debut 13 days ago and others have stronger claims.

RaceName: racingtv.com Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo who was well beaten in his qualifying runs and it's been the same story in two handicaps, including at Southwell (1m3f, AW) last time after a 61-day break; others are more persuasive.

RaceName: racingtv.com Handicap
OwnerName: The Tokyo Bay Syndicate And P Kirby
Spotlight: Well beaten at triple-figure odds in three novice/maiden events at up to 1m and she did no better over C&D on her handicap/turf debut 13 days ago; better needed.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Gained five of his 11 wins at this track; not at best in three handicaps since returned to turf in June but was only beaten about 2l when fifth of seven at Windsor (1m, good to firm) last time and is strong interest in this lower grade and with cheekpieces refitted.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Yet fully to convince stamina-wise over 1m but came second in this grade at Lingfield (7.6f/7f, good to firm) on her last two outings and features prominently in calculations.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Narrow winner of C&D (good to firm) handicap in September and went close in this grade here (7f, good) in June; safely held on AW at Lingfield since but was poorly positioned on outside of the field there and can do better here.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Won in this grade at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) in March and is also suited by this track but her recent handicap form has been disappointing; tried in a visor on latest outing; cheekpieces are refitted today.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 0-9 when trained by Jack Channon; placed in Pontefract handicap (1m2f, good to soft) in September but absent since heavy defeat on AW in October; usual tongue-tie left off for this seasonal/stable debut.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 20-race maiden who returned from a break with two disappointing runs this summer (1m/7f), the latter in this grade in refitted cheekpieces; not yet proven over 1m; others have much stronger claims.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Unplaced all seven starts; ran quite well when sixth of 13 in Bath handicap (1m2f, good; first-time cheekpieces) in June but was soundly beaten in 7f classified here (good to firm) later that month; needs to find extra.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Dual AW winner (8.4f/1m) in this grade at start of this year; ran as though something was amiss when back on turf last month but has possibilities if back on song.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Six-time AW winner for Alice Haynes; well below best form for new stable this year but his two recent turf runs in this grade (1m/7f, good to firm) were fairly respectable, and he might be boosted by the refitted blinkers here.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
Spotlight: Dual 7f winner this season; looked as good as ever when clear second to progressive rival at Sandown (1m, good to firm) 12 days ago but recent 4lb rise demands a bit more from him here.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
Spotlight: Belatedly came good with clearcut Ascot win (7f, good to firm) last month, his 12th start, and was not discredited when ninth in big-field sprint at Glorious Goodwood a week ago; will be suited by this return to 1m and may still have a bit more to offer.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
Spotlight: Won 7f AW novice in January; returned from break with three poor handicap runs in the spring but, having been gelded, his keeping-on fifth at Epsom (7f, good) last month was much more encouraging; still unexposed over 1m; interesting.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
OwnerName: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum
Spotlight: Managed only ninth of 11 on last month's handicap debut at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) but was placed in two of his three qualifying races (7f/7.4f) and could still have significant potential.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
Spotlight: Showed career-best form when leading close home at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) last month and has now won under Oliver Carmichael on two of his last three outings; ought to cope with the undulations here and can make his presence felt again.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
Spotlight: Scored over C&D (good to firm) in September and was also on target at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) in April; recent efforts have been respectable and he holds each-way claims at least.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
Spotlight: Three-time AW winner who has made the frame four times on turf this summer (6f-7.6f); disappointed on latest outing, having been restless in the stalls, but his current mark is workable and he'll be fine over today's trip.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
Spotlight: Ex-French filly who was safely held on both British starts this spring (7f/1m) and needs subsequent wind surgery to have made a big difference.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
OwnerName: P And Mrs L Rowe And John Turner
Spotlight: Largely consistent 4yo who came from off the pace to score over C&D (good) in June; below form at Epsom since, though, and probably doesn't have much margin for error off current mark.

RaceName: Monty Bennetts 18th Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Slightly disappointing on both starts since emphatic success at Hamilton (1m1f, good to soft) in June and still needs to prove he's effective on fast ground but his current mark is workable and he can't be ruled out.

RaceName: Monty Bennetts 18th Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Far too inconsistent to rely upon heavily but just did enough to cause 22-1 surprise on recent seasonal debut at Salisbury (1m, good to firm; front pair clear), and could be seen to even better effect now back up in trip.

RaceName: Monty Bennetts 18th Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Took form to new level when scoring at Leicester (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago, her second success this season; 6lb higher here but could have untapped potential over this new trip; must be considered.

RaceName: Monty Bennetts 18th Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Benefited from combination of step up in trip and first-time cheekpieces when making all over C&D (good to firm) in June, her seventh start; open to further progress but needs to bounce back from a disappointing effort at Leicester last month.

RaceName: Monty Bennetts 18th Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Long in the tooth now and not firing on all cylinders this season but, from a reduced mark, ran well in defeat over C&D (good to firm) in June; had excuse (lame) when below form here last month; big player if all goes to plan this time.

RaceName: Monty Bennetts 18th Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Unexposed after only five runs (one in a bumper) but was unable to land a significant blow when well-held third of four over C&D (good to firm) on handicap debut in June; improvement required.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden; seemed to respond well to first-time visor when third of six at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) last month and should be fine over this extra furlong; now tries cheekpieces; enters calculations.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Eight-time winner; lurks on a dangerous mark and might be perked up by first-time cheekpieces but has looked out of sorts on all three starts since returning from a layoff in April; leap of faith required to support her.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Returned to turf with two decent efforts (both 7f, good) this spring, and his keeping-on fifth at Lingfield (7f, AW) last month was perfectly respectable; would appeal more on ground slower than good but still considered each-way.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Came good at Southwell (1m, AW) in October, his second handicap, but has gone the wrong way since; in rear throughout at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) last month, after a break, and needs to have taken significant benefit from that outing.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Placed twice on Polytrack this year (1m/7f); safely held on both starts since returned to turf but this is easier than the Sandown race she contested last month, and she's now 2lb lower than for last summer's C&D win; worth a second look.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Three-time course winner who has finished second four consecutive (twice over C&D on good to firm) since swapping cheekpieces for blinkers in May; likely to be right in the thick of things again.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Raced far too freely in the lead before dropping out tamely on recent handicap debut at Sandown (7f, good to firm); remains unexposed after only four starts and is open to significant improvement if/when he learns to settle but comes with obvious risk attached.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Close third in classified race here (5.2f, good; first-time cheekpieces) in June but was just a respectable fourth at Wolverhampton (5f, AW; first-time blinkers) last month and is now 0-26; needs to find something extra on this first venture beyond 6f.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Well beaten at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago and has now been unplaced all 14 starts; usual tongue-tie left off here; difficult to enthuse over.

RaceName: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Returned to form with narrow win at Chepstow (5f, good to firm) in June; remains on workable mark after 3lb rise and is very well suited by this track (four-time C&D winner) but managed only fifth of six at Bath (5f, firm) three weeks ago and has become unreliable.

RaceName: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Three wins this year, the latest by a nose over C&D (good to firm) in May; still in good form, albeit he was behind Faustus when third over C&D (good to firm; winner did it easily) last month; probably won't be far away.

RaceName: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Unplaced all seven starts; outran 50-1 odds when respectable fifth of 14 in Bath handicap (5f, good) in June and was denied clear run when filling same position in Chepstow classified (5f, good to firm) last month but others appeal more all the same.

RaceName: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Placed twice here this year (5.2f/6f) but ran poorly at Bath last month and it's now exactly two years since her last win; difficult to enthuse over.

RaceName: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Placed three times from seven starts since returned to turf in May; no match for easy winner when second over C&D (good to firm) last month and remains well below the best of last year's form but still has possibilities; often wears cheekpieces but goes in refitted blinkers today.

RaceName: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Three-time C&D winner, most recently last May; absent since two disappointing runs here last August, though, and would appeal more on good or slower ground.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Five-race maiden who has inconsistent form and seems to be more exposed than most of today's rivals; failed to improve for visor last time; headgear retained.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has shown ability over 5f while twice leaving the impression he'll be well suited by today's extra furlong; made late gains, without landing a blow, in the Super Sprint last time; one to consider.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Showed promise on debut; has failed to beat a rival at Royal Ascot and Yarmouth for new yard since but this switch to nursery level may prompt a turnaround.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Similar type to Nascent Star, having shown some promise over 5f while looking as if she'll benefit from this step up to 6f; not disgraced when favourite on nursery debut last time; still of interest.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has made the frame under 7lb claimer in sprint maidens at Windsor and Nottingham, doing enough to think he can make his mark in ordinary nurseries; Colin Keane is booked for this first attempt; interesting.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has shown ability with fourth-place finishes at Windsor and Goodwood; may be capable of progress in nurseries and yard keeps it in the family with Toby Moore taking off 7lb; one to bear in mind.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: E Kelly, J Woods, N Gallagher & Partner
Spotlight: Thrice-raced colt who looks the type to benefit from stepping out of novice level but doesn't appear to have a generous opening mark; not well treated on bare figures.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Faced stiff task on penultimate start; has some AW winners in her pedigree and ran well (2l second) in 6f novice event at Southwell switched to this sphere last time; may build on that effort; possibilities.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has shown steady progress on turf; won at Ffos Las (5f; nursery debut) most recently, leaving the impression this return to 6f will suit; half-sister to a smart performer who is 2-2 on AW; respected.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Raced only on turf; has failed to back up the form of her spring win at Ripon; chance depends on the effects of new surface and another change of headgear.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
OwnerName: B Dickson, P Cook & R Rexton
Spotlight: 150,000gns yearling; didn't enjoy the clearest of runs when sixth of ten on his Newbury debut (6f, good to firm) last month (fifth has won since); shortlisted with the experience on his side.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: March foal by Dark Angel; 450,000gns yearling; brother to winners Charyn (6f/1m including 2yo/Group 1; RPR 127) and Wings Of War (6f including 2yo Group 2; 110); dam Listed-placed 5f winner (including AW; 99), out of 5f 2yo winning sister to 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Galeota; in-form stable gets plenty of 2yo winners first time out and his pedigree makes a market check crucial.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
OwnerName: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar
Spotlight: February foal by U S Navy Flag; 25,000gns yearling; half-brother to five winners including Interlocuter (1m-10.5f including AW/France/Australia; RPR 104), Spellwork (1m; 104) and Aslan (UAE 1m1f-1m3f; 93); dam UAE 1,000 Guineas/UAE Oaks winner (109), sister to Middle Park winner Lujain; plenty to like on breeding, but stable has few 2yos go in first time.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: March foal by St Mark's Basilica; 110,000euros yearling; half-brother to 1m1f 2yo/1m2f winner South Island (RPR 101); dam 1m2f-1m3f winner (including French Listed; 100), half-sister to winners Acadius (7.5f Listed), Aconito (7f/1m4f), Andraxt (9.5f) and A Kind Of Magic (1m3f); stable has a fine record with 2yo newcomers and plenty to like on pedigree; entered in the Goffs Million.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Well beaten in three starts over 6f/7f on turf/AW; gelded since last seen and it will need to have made a dramatic difference; low-grade handicaps may be more his thing; stable also runs Off The Peg.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: March foal by Minzaal; 52,000gns foal, 58,000gns yearling, 95,000gns breeze-up 2yo; half-brother to 5f 2yo winner Vishaka (RPR 71); dam 8.6f AW winner (56), half-sister to winners Dancing King (1m6f Group 3) and Starstruck (US 1m1f Grade 3), out of smart 5f/6f winner; tongue tied on debut and others appeal a bit more on breeding, but his stable's fine record with 2yo newcomers makes him worth a market check.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: March foal by Minzaal; 42,000gns foal, 58,000gns yearling; half-brother to winners Another Investment (6f/7f including 2yo; RPR 95), Shrara (6f 2yo; 71) and Ibn Alwaleed (KSA 1m 2yo); dam US 5f 2yo/6f dirt winner, half-sister to 7f Listed winner Council Member; stable gets its share of 2yo winners first time and worth monitoring in the market.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: February foal by Sioux Nation; 45,000gns foal, 55,000gns yearling; half-brother to six winners including Orchid (6f AW including 2yo; RPR 88), True Wisdom (1m 2yo; 85), Light Beam (UAE 1m1f; 81) and Clear White Light (1m4f Flat, 72; 2m-2m4f hurdle); dam 7f/1m winner (including Listed; 100); stable has the occasional 2yo winner first time, but probably only of interest if backed.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Friendless in the betting but showed some promise, amid greenness, in 7f event at Newbury where he kept on for seventh of 12; the form received a boost at Glorious Goodwood last week; the pick of the runners with experience.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 90,000euros foal; by Invincible Spirit and first foal of 6f/7f winner (including 2yo/Listed; RPR 109); major stable; possibilities.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 48,000gns foal, 105,000gns yearling; by Intello and first foal of French 7f turf/7.5f AW scorer (RPR 86) who is half-sister to three Group winners and daughter of 5f 2yo Group 3 winner; likely type, based on sales information and pedigree.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 24,000euros then £10,000 yearling, 20,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; Sioux Nation half-brother to Italian 5f 2yo winner Many Kisses, out of 1m winner (including 2yo; RPR 75); others are more interesting.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 16,000euros foal, £62,000 yearling; Persian Force half-brother to 7.5f 2yo winner Leblon Queen (RPR 62), out of unraced half-sister to Swedish 1m3f scorer Sel Sea; Amo/Hannon newcomer who is one to bear in mind.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Always behind and finished last of ten, beaten about 11l, in 6f contest at Newbury having been easy to back; however, may fare better upped to 7f with that experience under his belt.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Sole filly in this field; similar type to Sayid Harry Angel having been beaten about 11l in Newbury event (6.5f) on debut, finishing sixth of seven; may improve with that outing under her belt.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 70,000gns yearling; Saxon Warrior half-brother to two winners, notably Albula (Group-placed 1m 2yo; RPR 98); dam Australian 7.7f/1m scorer (including Group 3; 103); represents in-form major yard; respected newcomer.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Brother to winners Logician (1m2f-14.5f including St Leger; RPR 121) and Collide (1m1f-1m6f including AW; 112), half-brother to six winners including Okeechobee (1m-1m2f including AW/Group 3; 117); dam 1m winner (103), half-sister to 1m1f Group 1 winner Cityscape; stable doesn't have many winners first time out, but he's still worth a market check given his classy pedigree.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
