Spotlight: Doubled her tally when winning a classified event at Ayr (7f, soft) in June before a good second there in a handicap next time; did too much too soon and didn't get home over 1m at Leicester two weeks ago, and this free-going sort could go well now dropping back to 6f.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
OwnerName: Ursa Major & Mark Walford Racing Club
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden who was sixth of nine on her stable debut and first start for 306 days at Ripon (6f, good) last month; seemed to find the drop back to 5f against her when seventh here two weeks ago and now steps back up in trip off a career-low mark.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
OwnerName: In For A Penny Partnership & Partner
Spotlight: Sole win from 11 starts came over 7f at Redcar in May off a mark 10lb lower than today's, but he posted his best effort when going close at Leicester (6f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) last time; can go well.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
Spotlight: Gelded prior to winning at Newcastle (6f, AW; first start for 82 days) in March and his next two efforts were solid (6f/1m); however, he was well held at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) last time after another 82-day break and needs to take a step forward from that.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
Spotlight: Placed in one of his seven outings and finished midfield over this C&D in June; disappointed in first-time cheekpieces (now removed) at Ayr (7f, soft) in June and now returns to 6f having been dropped another 3lb.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
OwnerName: D Jenkins J Glover R O'Donnell J Short
Spotlight: Won on his handicap debut at Redcar (6f, good to soft) in September and bounced back from two lesser efforts when third at Ripon (6f, good); below that level having raced freely over 7f last time but should be happier back down in trip.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
OwnerName: Matt Broughton & Hold My Beer Syndicate
Spotlight: Runner-up on her first three starts but she's been well held in three handicaps, including at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) in June on her final start for Dylan Cunha; watch the betting on her stable debut.

RaceName: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
Spotlight: Five-race maiden who has beaten only one rival home in two handicaps (6f/5f; good to firm/AW); this unexposed gelding now steps back up in trip but others have stronger claims.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Decent third in sole completed point start; it was a weak maiden hurdle that he took second in at Sligo (2m2f, good) last time on his third run under rules but it was a positive effort nonetheless; may get involved with claimer now taking off 7lb.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual Flat winner was a good second of 15 on hurdles bow at Downpatrick in September (2m2f, yielding) and would have made the winner work for it if not unseating his rider at the last at Tramore in April (2m, soft); of concern is that the worst of his three hurdle runs came over C&D in October when a 21l sixth of 13 but could go well; well beaten on Flat when last seen.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-11 over hurdles; ran to a decent level last year, placing in three maiden hurdles over a range of trips on good ground; similar level when fourth at Listowel in May and shaped better than the bare result at Kilbeggan last month; okay C&D fourth last time; he's solid but vulnerable to improvers.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Didn't trouble the judge in either bumper start; took fourth of 17 on hurdles debut at Clonmel (2m4f, good to yielding) in May; another decent effort over 2m4f here last time when a distant third; thereabouts again.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Never counted in a good-class Leopardstown bumper on debut; well beaten in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last time; unlikely.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Weak in the market when down the field at Galway on bumper debut last September; much better at Killarney (2m1f, yielding) the following month when fourth of ten over hurdles; more needed all the same and absence to overcome too.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-6 in point-to-points and heavy defeat in sole start over hurdles at Cork a year ago; similar story likely.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Half-brother to five winners including the useful Farceur Du Large; started the 5-2 favourite and was running respectably on point debut when falling last year; likely best watched unless market speaks.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Improved over his debut when making late gains to be beaten 17l into fourth at Ballinrobe in May (2m, good); didn't build on that over C&D last time when tailed off; a few questions arise after that performance.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: J J Leckey & Donal P Keane & P J Rothwell
Spotlight: No impact in either point-to-point and beaten 29l on rules debut at Downpatrick; hard to fancy.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Kingston Hill half-brother to winners Decision Time (1m4f/1m5f Flat, RPR 86; bumper/2m hurdle), Sergeant Wilson (bumper/2m hurdle) and Stucker Hill (2m5f/2m6f hurdle); dam 7f winner (92); market best guide on debut.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Three-time AW winner is rated 54 on that surface; 0-19 on turf on Flat; makes hurdling bow with a good rider aboard but others more likely.

RaceName: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Seven-time AW winner in Britain has struggled for new yard; has pulled up in all three runs over hurdles at huge odds; he would be a shock winner.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Best hurdling effort came over C&D early last month when a 4.5l fifth (good), keeping on late in the game; a bit below that in a similar contest last time when a 10.5l fourth (3.25l behind Avandra); improvement required.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Longstanding maiden yet to show anything for current yard (formerly Gordon Elliott); tailed off over C&D back from a break last time; hard to fancy.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-21 but some reasons for hope in her runs this season; was a 2l second at Tramore in May (2m, good) and okay efforts at Cork (2m2f, good) when fifth of 23 and when third of ten over C&D last time (good); more needed to win but definite place possibilities.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Course specialist has bagged all three wins here (two over hurdles), including in this race last year off 2lb higher (good to yielding); fairly moderate form after that, but she has returned to form here over fences recently, winning a handicap chase (2m, good) and finishing second last time (2m, good); leading player.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Little impact in maidens and far too keen when tried in cheekpieces in last month's handicap debut at this track over 3m in cheekpieces (retained); declared for 6.20 at Sligo on Thursday.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Decent handicap form for new yard; second on stable debut at Sligo in May (2m6f, good), fading late; fourth at Downpatrick (2m6f, good to yielding) later that month; okay fourth at Sligo last time (2m5f, good); drops in trip now but more needed to get home in front.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Fair form without winning, in bumpers and maiden hurdles; three handicaps have been less encouraging; tailed off at Clonmel in October; unseated at the first on C&D seasonal return here and tailed off at Kilbeggan last time (2m3f, good); others more likely.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Best form has been at Tipperary, where she won a bumper and placed on her handicap debut in October; entitled to come on for recent comeback run at Cork.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Placed just once in seven bumpers; tailed off in all six starts over hurdles, the latest two in handicaps; tongue tie goes on.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Ran one of her best races on stable debut/second handicap start back from a break at Cork (2m4f, good) when keeping on steadily for fourth; always in rear when pulled up at Kilbeggan last time; tongue tie goes on after that disappointment and not ruled out if it has a positive effect.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Two wins on the Flat but 0-16 over hurdles; good effort when third of 24 at Navan in November (2m, heavy); pulled up next time at Fairyhouse; fell and tailed off in two runs this term so others have more persuasive recent form; declared for 6.20 at Sligo on Thursday.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Outran 80-1 odds at Down Royal (2m2f, good) on handicap debut in May when fourth of 20; a bit below that next time at Listowel (2m5f, good to yielding); midfield finish at Sligo last time (2m5f, good); cheekpieces go on now; place chance.

RaceName: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Showed next to nothing in maidens; beaten a long way in both handicaps as well; hard to make a case for her.

RaceName: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has lost her way until comfortably landing an eight-runner Tramore handicap in May (2m, good); given an easy lead that day and couldn't back it up at Galway when tailed off (2m1f, good); needs things to go her way.

RaceName: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Four-time Flat winner is 1-4 hurdling, with the victory coming in a Galway maiden hurdle in 2024; 9.25l fourth of eight over C&D (soft) when last seen over hurdles in March and hasn't been at his best in three Flat runs since then; others preferred.

RaceName: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: P Haughey & P M Haughey & John Ball
Spotlight: Won a Cork novice hurdle (2m2f, good) and a Wexford beginners' (2m, good) last summer; a fall over fences at Wexford is sandwiched between two okay efforts on the Flat this season; a tongue tie goes on for her handicap hurdle debut and she's race-fit but she's on a tough mark.

RaceName: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Back to form with a good third in a 1m4f Killarney Flat handicap last month but unable to back that up at Ballinrobe five days later; 2-6 hurdling although poor debut handicap effort at Cork when last seen in this discipline.

RaceName: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Back-to-back winner at Ballinrobe in August last year at 2m1f/2m3f on good ground, the second of those by 14l; ran respectably in the Lartigue at Listowel (2m, good to yielding) off 1lb higher when last seen in September; appealing but this is his seasonal return.

RaceName: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: French bumper winner has never raced on better than yielding to soft; made the breakthrough for his current stable when taking a six-runner Fairyhouse contest by 12l on handicap debut; came up short off revised mark in Listed handicaps at Fairyhouse and Punchestown towards end of last season; ground a concern for return.

RaceName: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Ready winner of a 2m Cork maiden hurdle in the summer of 2024 (good) but has been absent since well held in a Galway novice a month later; mammoth absence is a major blight on his prospects.

RaceName: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a Killarney maiden hurdle by 10l last August (2m1f, good); made all in a 1m1f Flat maiden last month in first-time cheekpieces at Ballinrobe in June; made her handicap hurdle debut at Galway last time (2m1f, good) when posting a disappointing performance; down 1lb but must bounce back.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Little to shout about in maidens but ran better race switched to handicaps at Kilbeggan when a 10.5l seventh over this trip; midfield finish at Ballinrobe last time (2m6f, good); down 2lb more and place chance with 7lb claimer back aboard.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 11yo is 1-27 over hurdles, the win coming at Sligo in August last year off 4lb higher (3m2f, good); okay fifth on seasonal return at Kilbeggan in June (3m1f, good to yielding) but was tailed off at Sligo last time (3m2f, good); others preferred.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-9 over hurdles but chased home a 15l winner in a maiden over 2m4f here in May and faded into third after the last in a 2m5f Bellewstown handicap last month; got to within 4.25l of a 113-rated rival in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last time; mark is up 3lb for that, but he's consistent.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 14-race maiden over hurdles; well beaten at Clonmel on seasonal return (2m1f, yielding); some improvement over 2m1f here (good) when a 5.25l eighth of 13; back up to 3m now.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: One of his better efforts came over 2m4f (good) here two weeks ago when a 10l seventh of 14; back up in trip now and down 2lb.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Took a big step forward when second of 18 over an extended 2m6f at Limerick early last month (good); proved that was no fluke when winning over C&D last time (Gerrys Wish 2.25l behind in second); up 6lb but she's of obvious interest.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: No impact in six maiden hurdles and ran poorly on handicap debut at Bellewstown (2m5f, good); unseated at the first over C&D last time; hard to make a case for.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won back-to-back handicaps in 2024, the first of them was this race off 10lb higher (good) and at Tramore off 17lb higher (2m5f, good to yielding); lost her way badly following that but there were positive signs in her 3l third of 14 over C&D last time, staying on strongly; well handicapped if backing it up.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Pulled off a shock success at Bellewstown early last month (2m5f, good, 50-1) having pulled up in his previous four starts; moderate effort off 6lb higher over C&D last time.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a Ballinrobe handicap by 8l off 10lb lower last July; well beaten in three runs since so best watched for now.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Point winner has raced just four times over hurdles with little success; won a novice handicap chase for Ruth Jefferson at Newcastle in March last year (3m, good); made a positive stable debut over fences at Killarney last time when a 5l second of 15 over fences (2m7f, good to yielding); must bring that form to this sphere off a higher mark.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-13 over hurdles but placed six times in maidens; no impact in initial handicap runs but fared better following the application of blinkers in his last two outings; 8l fourth at Limerick (2m7f, good) and 7.5l behind Set The Tone over C&D last time when keeping on well after getting squeezed for room at the third last; not ruled out.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: An unknown quantity after three unplaced efforts in 4yo maidens this summer; respected yard, worth a market check on handicap debut in a very winnable contest.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Had a long period on the sidelines but put in a couple of respectable efforts this summer in handicap hurdles at Punchestown and Downpatrick; trip is probably okay for him and good each-way claims.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Straight into handicap hurdles after a short spell in points; runner-up over this trip in a class 5 at Perth being her best effort; might have had a little too much use made of her at Downpatrick last time; headgear used that day left on here.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Showed initial promise in maiden hurdles for Gordon Elliott in 2025; not totally disgraced in the first-time tongue-tie over C&D last month but more needed even in this company.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Poor effort on his handicap debut at Cork in April but much more like it in a pair of 2m1f handicap hurdles here in May; step up in trip is a slight question mark but looks a leading contender.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Fairly lightly raced overall; in very good form this year, winning a handicap hurdle at Clonmel in May and solid efforts since including over 3m here last time; drop back in trip is fine; handicapper has not been harsh on her and the jockey of the moment is booked to ride; ticks a lot of boxes

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Maiden and handicap form does not stack up to very much and easily passed over here.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Failed to complete twice since an okay run after a break at Clonmel in May; needs a step forward here.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Has run to a similar level in three maiden hurdles from 2m to 3m on good ground; handicap mark probably fair enough on his handicap debut; best watched.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Three-time Flat winner and improving over hurdles. culminating in a decent second in a 2m3f Kilbeggan contest two weeks ago; trip is suitable and unlikely to be too far away.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Some promise in a Roscommon maiden hurdle a year ago; pulled up on his second start in a handicap at Limerick in October and not seen since; others much more likely.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Had a subsequent triple winner behind her when a remore third in a Downpatrick maiden hurdle in May; cut no ice however on her handicap debut at the same venue the following month and may need to come down a little in the handicap.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Nothing obvious in three maiden hurdle runs last year; beaten out of sight after more than nine months off on her handicap debut at Kilbeggan last month; cheekpieces fitted here but very difficult to give a chance to.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Won a handicap at Fakenham last October over this trip but hasn't been near that level since including on debut for this yard; has to get back to his best but certainly not dismissed.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Has done most of his winning on the Flat in Britain, and has found a new lease of life over hurdles at his local track last month, following up a good second in a 2m1f handicap hurdle in early July by getting up on the line to land a similar handicap over the same trip three weeks later; up 6lb for those two efforts is far from excessive and he can be thereabouts once more with the step up in trip unlikely to be an issue.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
OwnerName: Anthony Vaughan & Mark Phillips & D P Gaffney
Spotlight: The step up to this trip on good ground might have been the key to a much improved effort when he was runner-up in a Sligo handicap last month; headgear is left on here and could well be on the upgrade.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Has shown a reasonable level of form in three maiden hurdle outings; might not be much wiggle room in her handicap mark but interesting on her debut in this sphere.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Landed back-to-back successes over thid trip at Limerick and Sligo before anchored by weight increase at Sligo last month; early to write off and the trainer has decided to claim off her here.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: 11-race maiden over hurdles with her best finish being second iver 3m at Punchestown in May off 79;  below par since and drops back in trip here; can certainly get involved at her best.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Ordinary form until a much improved effort in a strongly run contest at Kilbeggan two weeks ago; could be a little more to come from him and rider bookings suggest he is the stable first-string.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: 17-race maiden over hurdles; her Sligo third from last July off 3lb higher would give her a squeak, but well below that level since returning from a break, including over fences; more needed although the rider booking is a positive.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Showed a little in a maiden hurdle at Fairyhouse in April but well beaten on her handicap debut at Kilbeggan later that month; would not appear well-handicapped on current evidence.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Reluctant to race here last month and way too keen on his return here three weeks later; looks far from straightforward and not exactly a betting proposition on what we know so far.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Seven race maiden but has taken very well to handicaps and acts on most ground; good second on his handicap debut here in March, and another fine effort over this trip with today's headgear when runner-up in a similar contest at Sligo last month; up 2lb for that effort and has plenty of weight but sets a standard that could see him home here.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Maiden pointer soundly beaten at huge odds in three maiden hurdles; best watched in first handicap unless money comes for him.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Big odds and ran accordingly in three maidens and handicap hurdle; no obvious chance.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Off the track for two years and caught the eye somewhat when fourth in a 2m1f Ballinrobe handicap hurdle last month; back up in trip here and interesting to see what the market makes of him.

RaceName: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Showed little in maidens or on her handicap debut at Cork; easy to pass over here.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Very green on debut at Thurles in October, jumping the road twice and almost coming down; not seen since but sure to be more streetwise this time and is the likely favourite.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Decent effort when a fading third in a C&D bumper last month; likely to improve again but this looks somewhat tougher.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Reappeared from a six month absence when pulled up after racing too keenly in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle two weeks ago; hard to fancy on her return to a bumper.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Third foal; half-sister to useful 2m/2m1f hurdle winner Beckett Rock; dam bumper/2m hurdle winner, sister to useful bumper/2m4f hurdle winner Column Of Fire, half-sister to useful 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase winner Tully East; fine pedigree and the in-form yard had a debut bumper winner on Tuesday; regular stable amateur riding something else is worth pointing out however.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Promise when an admittedly remote second on her debut at Listowel in May; failed to match that when hanging to her left at Cork last month; likely to appreciate going left-handed here but might find a couple too good in a strong-looking race.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Third foal; half-sister to useful 2m-2m7f hurdle/chase winner Kings Hill; dam unraced half-sister to winners Stick With Bill (useful 2m4f hurdle) and Conceroe (2m4f hurdle/2m5f chase), out of unraced half-sister to smart 2m-2m4f jump winner; stoutly bred daughter of Vadamos; likely to improve for time and a longer trip.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to winners Torquay Road (2m1f/2m2f hurdle) and Omaha Wish (2m chase); dam French 1m-1m4f winner (inc 2yo), half-sister to French 2m5f Listed hurdle winner El Gringo, out of French 1m5f/13.5f winner; useful pedigree; stable does not provide many debut bumper winners but worth watching for future reference; half-sister to today's rival Fully Functional.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Shorter trip and much better ground let to a much improved display from this mare when run out of it late in a Killarney bumper last month; tongue-tie tried here and should acquit herself well on a track that should suit.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Clearly fancied on debut at Roscommon last month when having a lot of ground to make up; interesting that John Gleeson takes the mount on her rather than the Knockeen newcomer; big player potentially.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Stoutly-bred daughter of Wings Of Eagles; no show in a Kilbeggan bumper in June and hard to give a chance to here.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Half-sister to today's rival Vartry Diamond; completed on the second of two point-to-points; best watched.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
Spotlight: First foal; dam showed little Flat (RPR 35)/points, closely related to useful French winners Disclose (1m), World Ruler (7f/1m) and Grand Vista (5.5f/6f 2yo); Flat pedigree; hood being applied for her debut not really a positive sign; best watched.

Al Nujaifi Racing Series Fillies & Mares Conditions Stakes
Spotlight: Was runner up three times in France before bolting up on the dirt on her UAE debut; as only hit the frame once there since on both surfaces mainly over distances further than this; been off since March so others have a fitness edge but will find this a bit easier than some of the races she ran in earlier in the year; market will tell us more. (R17 W1 P5) (OR 75)

RaceName: Al Nujaifi Racing Series Fillies & Mares Conditions Stakes
Spotlight: Dual Listed winner who made all to win at Windsor on her seasonal debut beating three of these; should improve fitness wise for that run and despite carrying a penalty is clear on the ratings for this; if she runs to form, she'll be very difficult to beat. (R15 W5 P5) (OR 87)

RaceName: Al Nujaifi Racing Series Fillies & Mares Conditions Stakes
Spotlight: Has shaped with promise in her three runs to date including when not far behind Victoria over further last time out; was trying to give that rival 18lbs that day so gets a big pull in the weights here, for all the drop down in trip might not be ideal; wears blinkers for the first time. (R3 W0 P3) (OR 60)

RaceName: Al Nujaifi Racing Series Fillies & Mares Conditions Stakes
Spotlight: Likeable and consistent Mare who's bounced back to form after a rare poor run at Windsor in Listed company when she was behind three of these; her latest win at Chepstow means she has a penalty to carry and is very badly in at the weights with a few of these but is likely to run her race. (R22 W3 P12) (OR 59)

RaceName: Al Nujaifi Racing Series Fillies & Mares Conditions Stakes
Spotlight: Seems at her best when leading; put up a big personal best when finishing to Fareedhat El Izz at Windsor; didn't back that run up in a lesser grade at Lingfield nine days later although that run might have come soon enough; better expected here but has a lot to do at the weights.  (R11 W0 P3) (OR 54)

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
Spotlight: Progressive last year and he has continued the good work in 2026, winning 6f handicaps at Kempton and Newcastle either side of lesser turf efforts, albeit in hot handicaps; has run well at Ascot in the past and although he has yet to race over 5f, he is a strong traveller who could prove suited to it; interesting.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
Spotlight: Three front-running AW wins in the spring saw him soar up the handicap; he didn't run badly off his revised mark at Epsom on Derby day and last week's Stewards' Cup was always going to be a tough assignment; this is more suitable but others look better treated.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
Spotlight: Ran on well when third in a C&D handicap last month; not in the same form when down the field in the Stewards' Cup last week; not discounted in these slightly calmer waters.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
Spotlight: Made good progress last season and he has improved again this year, finishing third of 17 over C&D on his reappearance and winning at Ffos Las (5f, good) and C&D (good to firm) on his last two starts; up another 5lb but foolish to think he has reached his ceiling.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
Spotlight: His three good runs this year have all come at Ascot, winning in May (6f, good) and doing best of those in the stands' side group when sixth behind All Ways Glamorous here two weeks ago (cheekpieces on for the first time; first 5f run since 2024); can get it wrong at the start but he has races in him off this mark.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
OwnerName: Miss Kate McGivern & Thomas Hore & Shane M Power
Spotlight: Ended 2025 with a win in a handicap in Bahrain (5f, good); he has raised his game on turf this summer, winning a Listed race at Cork (5f, good; cheekpieces first time) in June; the cheekpieces were absent when he was a fine third in a Cork handicap two weeks ago, doing best of the far-side group, and another big run seems likely.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
OwnerName: Hambleton Racing Ltd XXXI And Partner
Spotlight: Had a fine year in 2025, winning four times including in Listed and Group 3 company; not in comparable form so far in 2026 but the handicapper is easing his burden.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
Spotlight: Began the season with two dominant 5f wins on AW; well short of his best on last two starts (6f, good and AW); returning to 5f won't hurt and the return of cheekpieces could perk him up; can't discount.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
Spotlight: Fine strike-rate; hit hard for her runaway win at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) in May and she has finished down the field in two runs since; others look more persuasive.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
Spotlight: Looked good when making a successful British debut for Marco Botti at Southwell (5f) in March; no progress since and he was sold for 40,000gns last month; best watched on stable debut despite being back to his winning mark.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Third in a 1m4f handicap at this meeting two years ago and his run over the same trip here 15 days ago was a step back in the right direction; has some appealing form to his name at 2m, so very much in the mix.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won the 17-runner Chester Plate (2m2f, good) in May on return to turf and went in again last time at Newbury (2m, good to firm), where it was hard work in the end but he travelled strongly deep into the race; only 3lb higher and hasn't had a lot of racing.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: A winner off this mark on the AW just over two years ago when trained by David Simcock; returned from a long absence in the spring and back to his best best when coming from a long way off the pace to win well at Thirsk (2m, good) 69 days ago; back from a break with his yard going well; considered off 4lb higher.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: A lightly raced gelding who won over 1m4f and 2m when trained in France; only his third run for Ian Williams when fourth of 20 in the consolation race for the Northumberland Plate; whether he'll build on that now encountering fast ground for the first time is questionable, especially as he was withdrawn on account of such conditions earlier in the year.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum
Spotlight: The initial positive reaction to a visor soon wore thin and he beat only one home at Newmarket last time (1m6f) with no headgear (as today); has dropped to a dangerous mark but with some major questions to answer.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 2-11 for the Gosdens, scoring for the first time on turf when leading late on at Sandown a month ago (1m6f, good; in regular cheekpieces); later bought for 77,000gns; tackles a new trip here and might well have more to offer; good to firm seems fine.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Only eighth of ten in a 1m6f handicap at Newmarket a month ago in which he was second in 2024 and won in 2025 (on good to firm); that was yet another below-par effort and hopes rest on the tongue-tie making a difference.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Useful 1m4f performer and pretty good on his day over hurdles; however, hasn't found his best form this season at 2m/2m4f and has yet to convince as a stayer in this discipline; tried a visor last time at Royal Ascot and cheekpieces return.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Hurdle/Flat winner; ran in snatches when a 5l fifth in a 2m fast-ground handicap at the Curragh on what proved to be his final start for Donnacha O'Brien; that last run was his first on ground quicker than good and he does like the mud.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Never involved when defending his crown in the Northumberland Plate but two of his three previous runs this season had been creditable; only 1lb higher than for his last win at Chester (September) and he was a close fourth in this two years ago; would have been tempting but for concerns about him these days on fast ground (only fifth last year on good to firm).

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Seen mostly at up to 1m4f so perhaps unwise to read all that much into last two defeats over 2m and 1m6f; not impossibly treated on his solid 1m4f form earlier this season, and last year's efforts included a 2l defeat in this (not seen to best effect) and a victory over Insanity at York (1m4f, good to firm); in the mix.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: His 1m4f win on good to firm at Newmarket in July reads well but has finished behind Castle Stuart in their recent clashes and beat only one home in the John Smith's Cup four weeks ago; probably vulnerable off this mark.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won 1m4f/2m handicaps on the AW early this year; only 3-38 on turf but quite encouraging runs in hot 1m3f/1m6f handicaps before finishing tailed off at Newmarket after starting slowly (1m4f); it wouldn't be a bolt from the blue should he run well but others are safer.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Useful at her best in South Africa; steady progress in three runs for William Haggas, last time going close in a Class 2 1m3f handicap on the AW in December; couldn't put it past her trainer having her cherry ripe after a break for this, a race he won four years ago; stays this far but fast ground would be a first.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Had three of these behind when winning this last year off 11lb lower (good to firm); looks even better now, probably not seen to best effect behind Sportingsilvermine at Newmarket before a sterling effort at Glorious Goodwood over an inadequate 1m2f; likes it here and he's hard to knock.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has history in this race, having won it two seasons ago and only a length behind Night Breeze last year (good to firm; could have done with a truer gallop); just 2lb higher than 12 months ago and perhaps unwise to come down too harshly on his defeat at Royal Ascot, especially when his comeback run was so encouraging; shortlisted.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Veteran with ten wins to his name; behind some of these on two visits to York this summer but wasn't disgraced in a C&D handicap 15 days ago on a rare foray over this far; could have some part to play.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Dropped into a Class 3 when making all at Windsor (extended 1m3f, good to firm) and well beaten off this 5lb higher mark at Newmarket; he can be up and down, and could finish only eighth in this last year.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Can race freely and hooded for his last two races at York, in the latest finishing a highly respectable third (promoted from fourth) in the John Smith's Cup (extended 1m2f; good to firm) for which he was 4lb well in; now 3lb higher and surprisingly goes without any headgear, but he's got some momentum behind him.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Looked as though he needed further than 1m when a rallying fourth at Newmarket in June and he duly obliged returned to 1m2f at Sandown; didn't have a lot in hand that day but only went up 2lb and he could approve for going even further this afternoon.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: Thriving since dropped to 6f, winning at Ripon and Hamilton in May and then performing with great credit in hot sprint handicaps on his last three starts; no obvious reason why he wouldn't be bang there once again.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: Easy win in a 6f maiden at Kempton on his reappearance in May; made light of his opening mark when seeing off 21 rivals in a 6f handicap at York (good) in June; unable to justify favouritism in a hot Newmarket handicap last month but the ground was the fastest he has faced and he didn't look entirely at ease, doing well to take third as things panned out; that form looks strong and he remains with serious potential; of obvious interest if the going is deemed suitable.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: Unplaced in his two attempts at sprinting this summer but he hasn't run badly on either occasion; could have a bigger effort brewing.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: Made a winning seasonal/handicap debut at Pontefract (6f, good) in April; flopped behind Thunder Call at York eight weeks ago; that run casts a shadow but he still has low mileage and could well rebound.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: Suited by the drop to 6f, winning a Ripon maiden in June and following up on his handicap debut at Chester in July (both good ground); only fifth of seven off this mark back at Chester two weeks ago; further progress essential.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: 6f novice win as a 2yo; better form when fourth in a Listed race at Chantilly (6.5f, AW) in March but less good twice since; 7f and heavy ground are valid excuses for the last two runs and he is not yet fully exposed.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: Just one win to her name from her nine starts but that doesn't do her ability justice as she has regularly acquitted herself well in the face of stiff tasks, most recently finishing close up in a Group 3 at York (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; interesting on this belated handicap debut.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: Useful 2yo, winning the Windsor Castle over 5f here last June and running creditably in Group 2 company on a couple of occasions; he has offered more than enough this year to think he had trained on and his mark is slowly dropping; gelded since latest start and one to consider back up to 6f; cheekpieces worn on last two starts are now discarded.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
Spotlight: Two wins as a 2yo, notably a sales race at Newmarket (7f, good); not so good in 2026 but his mark is easing; hooded for this first run for Stuart Williams (sold out of Oliver Cole's yard for 65,000gns last month).

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: An improver this season, with his only blip coming on heavy ground in the Italian Derby; got messed about when fourth of the six runners in a 1m2f handicap at Newmarket a month ago (good to firm); not yet exposed and Ryan Moore rides.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: This year's wins at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) and Thirsk (1m4f, good) were from the front; last two defeats suggest his progress may have levelled out, for all that he was tried over 1m6f both times; probably needs his best yet.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Competitive in both his handicaps (1m4f) for George Boughey and left that yard for £170,000; likely to win races for Ian Williams, but he was pulled up after never going at Goodwood only ten days ago (1m4f, good to firm; 25-1) and headgear is soon turned to.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Stable has captured two of the last four renewals, and this filly is on a roll after completing a hat-trick over C&D a month ago; that was by the skin of her teeth but the second was an improver and the pair were clear; she probably won that day in spite of the steady gallop; strong contender under Saffie Osborne.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Races prominently; 0-5 but bounced back from heavy defeat in Royal Ascot handicap (80-1) to go close over C&D last month (good to firm); raised 2lb for that but ceiling of his ability wouldn't be known just yet.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 1m2f AW novice winner last year; probably needed his comeback run and ran appreciably better at Chester last week (1m4f, good) when he conceded a head start to an in-form filly; stable has a good record at this meeting; respected.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: His nursery win (sole success) was on soft but conditions were good to firm when second to Last Verse in a small field at Chepstow (1m4f), since when he's finished tailed off here after suffering early interference; needs his best form yet even if putting best foot forward.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Irish stable won this two years ago; placed in both his handicaps, the latest when headed late on in the Ulster Derby at Down Royal (1m5f, soft); suffered another narrow defeat when the standard-setter in a 1m4f maiden at the Curragh (good to firm); hard to call him progressive, but trainer always respected on her forays here and cheekpieces are a first.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Bought for 20,000gns out of Andrew Balding's yard after winning off 5lb lower at Chepstow (1m4f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces); ran okay at Sandown but no more than that in a small field over 1m6f; his new rider will have to navigate from the widest stall.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
Spotlight: Came from behind for clearcut win at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) but couldn't get past the leader when attempting the same trick at Salisbury; that was under a very capable 5lb claimer off this mark, so has more on her plate now promoted from a Class 5.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: He has returned from the Middle East with fine efforts at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) and over 1m on the straight course here (good to firm) in July; should remain competitive under these conditions.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Strong handicap form last summer, runner-up in both Ascot runs (1m, straight course) before landing a valuable prize at York's Ebor meeting; only 1lb higher today after a couple of low-key runs in May; interesting with cheekpieces now given a go.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Useful form in Europe prior to joining Ian Williams; he has some uninspiring form figures but they don't tell the whole story as he ran well in the Royal Hunt Cup and had a torrid passage in the Golden Mile at Goodwood eight days ago; edging down the weights and has the assistance of Ryan Moore in the saddle; could go well.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Defied a 5lb lower mark in the corresponding race 12 months ago; many good runs in defeat since then, including his fourth in the Royal Hunt Cup, and he is unlikely to be too far away.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Won a valuable 7f handicap here last summer before bolting up in the Stewards' Cup one week later; another fine course run here last month when second of 16 and he was heavily supported for a Stewards' Cup repeat, only to stumble leaving the stalls; that run is easily excused but he is back up 2lb today and his stamina for 1m has to be taken on trust.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Solid fourth-place finishes in good handicaps at Epsom and Sandown on his last two starts; suspicion he will prove vulnerable for win purposes.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Won handicaps at Newmarket and Epsom this summer before finishing down the field in the Royal Hunt Cup; only 14th of 18 at Goodwood (1m, good to firm) eight days ago but that doesn't tell the story of his run as he was travelling well but with nowhere to go for most of the home straight; he will need a career best to win but it is not out of the question.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Four runs for Mike Murphy have yielded three heavy defeats and a shock 1m2f win at Windsor in May; opposable on balance of form.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Finished second behind Ebt's Guard in this race 12 months ago when rated 14lb lower; he has earned his lofty rating since then, winning twice at Goodwood last autumn and recording a career-best RPR when second of 18 in the Golden Mile at Goodwood eight days ago; another big run anticipated.

RaceName: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)
Spotlight: Progressive 3yo last year; gelded prior to finishing down the field in the Buckingham Palace Stakes here (7f, good to firm) at the Royal meeting, a run that is easily excused given his draw; now tongue tied; not fully exposed at 1m and he is one to consider.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Connections declining nurseries after four defeats and her 6f form is up there in this company; should have a say.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Has probably performed to a similar level in both his races, Class 5 maidens at 6f; beaten under 2l at Chepstow in the latest and this isn't a strong race.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
Spotlight: Minor form in both his runs, the latest last week at Thirsk; steps up from 5f.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: May have his quirks as he carried his head awkwardly when a front-running third at Newcastle (7f, AW) and then dropped away when fitted with cheekpieces at Nottingham (6f); might be about to become frustrating.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Showed good speed when second at Thirsk (6f) in July but he disappointed when one of the favourites at Catterick since; might be the yard's second string here.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Mrs T Burns And Rjh Ltd
Spotlight: Slow to break and never involved when kicking off over 7f at Musselburgh (13-2) last week.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Ursa Major Racing, J Craggs & Partner
Spotlight: Went off at 6-4 when only sixth on debut at Beverley where he was getting the hang of things late on, but then finished last of six at Newcastle (again over 5f); steps up in trip with a hood added and might be one for nurseries later.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Played her part in a strong gallop when a fading fourth on nursery debut at Pontefract (6f, good) and that wasn't too bad a run on reflection; could feature.

RaceName: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: £16,000 breeze-up buy; sixth foal; closely related to 6f AW 2yo winner River Blackwater (RPR 64), half-brother to 1m winner Ravishing Beauty (73); dam 5f/6f 2yo winner (105); already gelded and would need to see some confidence behind him in the betting.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
OwnerName: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
Spotlight: Thrown in on last summer's best form and there were clear signs of a revival with her third of six at Musselburgh (5f, good) eight days ago; Ethan Tindall takes off a handy 5lb and she is one to be interested in.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Down the field on her seasonal/stable debut in May but she has run well in defeat since, including when a close second over C&D 12 days ago; runs off the same mark today and she won't need much improvement for the addition of blinkers to play a leading role.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden but placed in 5f handicaps on his last three starts and he remains open to further progress; one to take seriously.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Seven-race maiden who hasn't matched her Irish forrm in four handicap runs for new stable; tumbling down the weights and could yet come good.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: 3lb lower than for his win in the corresponding event 12 months ago; he has won two 5f handicaps (AW and good) this year and wasn't beaten far in a Class 5 at Hamilton last week; considered.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: 0-11 but she has run well at this track, including when second over 6f last month; not quite so good back at 5f 12 days ago; vulnerable for win purposes once again.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: 0-10; pulled hard and didn't see things out when favourite for a 6f handicap here last month; now 5lb lower than for his C&D second in May so he is one to take seriously back down in distance; cheekpieces are the headgear of choice today.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Without a win since his 2yo days; he has run some sound races in Class 6 handicaps this year but needs to pull out more for the win; stable also runs Keep The Gold.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Low-level novice/maiden form but she left that behind when delivering a strong finish to lead late on her handicap debut at Musselburgh (5f, good) 47 days ago; up 2lb but she still has potential and this stiffer test at the trip should suit.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Scrambled home in a 5f handicap at Hamilton in May and has finished third in two of his three starts since, the latest over C&D last month; this is his first Class 6 run since the Hamilton win and he needs taking seriously.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner; yet to strike in 2026 but he has slipped down the weights and his latest C&D fifth was encouraging, just beginning to launch a challenge when forced to switch; each-way shout.

RaceName: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
OwnerName: Adam Mills And Jonnie Delta Racing
Spotlight: Should be making a big impact off this mark and although he has been a shade underwhelming on turf this summer he has too much ability to leave out of calculations at this level.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: Dual C&D winner in 2024; run down late in refitted cheekpieces at Pontefract (1m2f) in June, and finished third (one place behind Mr Lincoln) over C&D next time; fast ground a plausible excuse for a lesser effort latest; runner-up in this last year.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: Continued his progress when drawing clear at Chester (10.5f, good) last Sunday; this is more competitive under a 5lb penalty but Ryan Kavanagh claims 3lb and this one has an obvious chance of following up.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: Produced a career best when winning in added cheekpieces at Wolverhampton (9.5f, AW) six weeks ago; that form perhaps isn't the strongest on offer but he's open to further improvement off a 2lb higher mark.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: Consistent since winning by a nose over 1m (good to firm; off 5lb lower) in May but lacked the pace to figure when third to a progressive winner over C&D 12 days ago; others appear better handicapped.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: 1-12; fair third over 1m1f at Hamilton three starts back but lesser efforts at York (1m6f and 1m) since; still 3lb above his winning mark and best form is at up to 1m1f; others more appealing.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: Hung left but took form to a new level when off the mark at Carlisle (1m1f, good to soft) in June; patience has been needed in pursuit of similar ground but considered from 5lb higher; trainer won this last year.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
OwnerName: J D Wright & Mrs S Wright
Spotlight: Left Harry Charlton for 18,000gns; made a striking winning stable debut over C&D (good to firm) 19 days ago; hit with a 10lb rise but that form has been boosted twice since; massively respected.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: Did well to finish third after stumbling at the start at Carlisle (1m1f, good) last month and has since run well over hurdles; no issue with track, trip or ground conditions and has possibilities for a trainer who has won this three times since 2021.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: 0-10; runner-up in two of his last three races, failing to get a clear run when a close second at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) two months ago; on a positive trajectory but with more required from 4lb higher.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: Game win at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) in June, in first-time cheekpieces; not in the same form since though and stamina not conclusive over 1m2f; better candidates to be found elsewhere.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: AW winner (8.5f) for David Loughnane; creditable third to Unchartedterritory at Carlisle (1m1f; blinkers replaced cheekpieces) in June but he found little at Hamilton (1m3f) subsequently; stablemate Mr Lincoln looks to have a better chance.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice for David O'Meara on Newcastle AW (1m2f) in 2024 but 0-12 on turf; out of sorts last year, and has failed to beat a rival in last two appearances, at Newcastle and Redcar; mark is in freefall but plenty to prove.

RaceName: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs K Oliver And Miss K Scott
Spotlight: Modicum of promise in 1m4f maiden at Fairyhouse last month; left Willie McCreery for 8,000gns and makes handicap debut in change of headgear (blinkers) for new yard; worth a market check.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: Well handicapped on his best form and some of that has been here, although not on his latest visit in July when only eighth; however, he's one of a few in here who would appreciate softening ground and firmly enters the reckoning.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: Likeably consistent dual winner who won't mind what the weather does, with recent seconds at about 1m coming on soft and good to firm; pretty solid, other than this is a step up in class.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: Gave it a good go from the front at Southwell (7f; fine at 1m) recently but he's been found wanting a few times since his last win, off 7lb lower on the AW last August; rain is forecast and he's unraced on ground slower than good.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: Kept on well for a seventh career success over C&D 19 days ago but he's gone back up 5lb and has never won anything better than a Class 5; others preferred.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
OwnerName: Rise One Racing And W A Bethell
Spotlight: Ran moderately on most recent outing 50 days ago but mostly consistent for current yard and any rain would be much welcomed.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: All four wins have been at 7f but he hasn't had many chances at this trip, over which he ran third on his penultimate start at Carlisle; had a break since a bad run in June and has possibilities.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: On a perfectly good mark, he won't mind rain and he ran surprisingly well to be fifth in last week's Golden Mile at Glorious Goodwood; lots to like.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: Successful in France and Ireland; impossible to make a case on his five runs for Ian Williams but he'll probably come good again at some point and any rain wouldn't harm his cause.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: Did well to come from so far back and win at Carlisle (1m, good) last month and the race wasn't run to suit at Hamilton since; this could be a better fit for her and she's back in good form.

RaceName: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
Spotlight: Made all on his final start for Ross Burdon at Yarmouth (11.5f, soft) in June, after which he changed hands for 19,000gns; rain would be a bonus but he did trail home last at Hamilton only last week (1m5f) and has a good bit to prove at 1m.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: All five wins between July and October last year, at 6f and 5f, including this race (good); runner-up four times this year and her latest Hamilton run can be consigned to history as she'd run the day before; respected, although serious rain wouldn't be ideal.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Not yet off the mark and was vulnerable in her early handicaps but she made a good fist of it when third on the wing over C&D (good to firm) in July; not so good here since but that was her third run in two weeks and will perhaps be all the better for more of a break this time.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: All turf runs on good or quicker ground; has had a busy year with some mixed results but he's taken a healthy drop in the weights and nearly nicked a Carlisle race in July; returned to that level when imposing himself on a C&D race 12 days ago and, back up 4lb, should have a big say.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark in 6f handicap at Cork (yielding) last September; has been placed in big-field handicaps at 6f and 7f for this yard in 2026 and although below best when last seen in June she shouldn't be out of this, especially if the ground deteriorates.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Signed off 2yo season with 6f win on Newcastle AW; thereabouts in all three 6f races this year and there's little between her and Mr Cool on recent C&D form; however, she was struggling to keep up from some way out before coming home strongly and this test may again be on the sharp side.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: 0-8; involved in some hard-fought finishes over 6f on AW but he probably needs a bit more than a close fifth of five in his first turf handicap, at Catterick in May; ran better than the bare result back on AW last week but still needs to show he's as effective on grass, especially with rain about.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Suited by Hamilton and was winning for the second time there two starts ago (both 6f; good to soft and good to firm); found little returned to 5f on this track since and the yard's other two runners look more likely.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Winless since 7f success here in May 2024 and has yet to find his true form this year (beaten favourite three times; behind Mr Cool here last time) but he ran well on occasions in better 6f races than this in 2025 and won't mind what the weather does; quite well treated now and a revival could be imminent.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Best form of the year when persevering well to win at Thirsk (6f, good) in June but disappointingly failed to do herself justice at Hamilton next time, a track where she won and went close (in a higher grade than this) last autumn; has had a short break since and may well revive.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Eight wins, all on good to soft or slower, include one over C&D; ran a cracker when fourth of 17 on Doncaster reappearance in March but he's kept his distance since, even when ground conditions looked suitable, but the more rain the better.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Close up in 7f events as a 3yo but she hasn't been her old self at 7f and 6f this year, in different headgear in two of her last three starts (none today); looks unlikely for now.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Ought to be open to some improvement at this level but he again failed to conserve his energy on handicap debut at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) in July and his challenge was very short-lived; reservations.

RaceName: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
Spotlight: Minor promise when qualifying but she was 22-1 when beaten a long way on her handicap/AW debut at Newcastle (7f) in June; too far behind there to consider seriously back on turf but at least the return to 6f should suit.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Has led but not dependent on tactics; slowly away and never threatened at Chester latest but a first win shouldn't be far away on earlier narrow defeats, at Musselburgh and Carlisle (both 7f; good and good to firm), closely matched with Black Storm on the latter occasion; thereabouts.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Handles all surfaces; many good runs on turf over the last year, making all in first-time blinkers here (1m, good to firm) in July and two solid efforts since; headgear left off now tackling 7f for the first time since 2yo days in Ireland but has another good run in him.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win in 7f AW maiden at Dundalk as 3yo; slightly frustrating for this yard as he's been involved in some tight finishes for them, including in this race last year and when just behind Supreme Clarets at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) in July, but fitting blinkers could help; solid chance, if so.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Capable of better than he's shown on his last two starts at York, unsuccessfully tried over 1m then visored (left off today) in a higher grade; has possibilities on his close second to Circle Of Trust over C&D (soft) in June, albeit the latter pulled out extra when challenged; not ruled out.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: First British win when making all at Hamilton (about 1m, good to firm) in May; has remained in form there since without looking ahead of his mark but this first attempt at 7f looks worth investigating for last year's winning trainer.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Won 1m2f Bath novice as 2yo but just middling form from the front here of late, over 1m2f, 7f and 6f; dropping down the weights but this is competitive and the other two from the yard look more interesting.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Often leads; narrow Chester winner (7f, good to firm) last August on handicap debut and he ran much better back there in June than he had the time before at York; another bold show is on the cards.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Talented and well treated; multiple wins include two over C&D; nearly all his wins under Paul Mulrennan, who prefers Sanafi Zabeel, but he's also gone well for Lauren Young and ran creditably for her at Hamilton last week; the likely strong pace will suit and he's capable of a big run.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden; one of his best efforts came over C&D (good to soft) last summer and yard has won two of the last five runnings but this one needs to improve on his handicap form so far, most recently when bleeding from the nose in June; now hooded.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs R G Hillen And Partner
Spotlight: Nearly made a successful switch to handicaps at Yarmouth (7f, good to soft) last September, just held by one who won three of his next five starts; had a quiet start to 2026 but did better when prominently ridden and having a little in hand against Milford Grange over C&D (soft) in June; up 3lb; capable of better.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Three of four wins have been at 7f, including over C&D (good) last August; back on his latest winning mark after failing to find his form this year and has plenty to prove following a 14l defeat at Doncaster in June.

RaceName: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Took a step forward when winning 6f novice on Newcastle AW last December but she's had two crushing defeats in handicaps this year for new yard; can only watch.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Irish raider; ran far better than finishing position suggests (pecked badly at second-last) over hurdles at Kilbeggan (2m3f) a fortnight ago; cosy Flat winner at Limerick (1m4f, yielding) in April and needs respecting at this basement level.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 0-5; better since joining this trainer, twice placed over 1m here (Class 6); run style wouldn't suggest he's the most obvious candidate for 1m2f, but pedigree does offer hope; still open to improvement; isn't discounted.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 1-25; keeping reasonable form over further until a low-key effort at Musselburgh (1m5f, good) last week; dropping back to 1m2f is helpful (was third in this last year) but others still make more appeal.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Well backed and returned to form when winning classified event at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) last week; that was steadily run but he was an emphatic winner; every chance if able to reproduce equivalent level on turf (0-9); stablemate of Sassy Glory.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
OwnerName: Ursa Major & Mark Walford Racing Club
Spotlight: Runner-up (beaten over 4l) in this last year, but yet to win on turf (0-17); gamely fended off the frustrating Little Ted at Newcastle (1m; 11-2) on penultimate start, but reportedly ran flat back there on latest; stable have more obvious chance with Wicklow Way.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 12-race maiden; placed over this trip at Beverley (beaten 3l) in June but disappointing since, beaten nearly 50l (last of seven) over 1m4f at Pontefract latest; focus elsewhere.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Veteran (5-81) stablemate of Zebra Star; respectable third over 1m here (good to firm) in July, but could make only minimal inroads over C&D (fifth; 22-1) latest; this is a slightly easier task.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 1-18, that win in a newly applied visor here (1m, good to soft; 16-1) last July; finished sixth behind Golden Valour on return from six-month break over C&D latest; could strip fitter.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Dual course winner, the most recent over this trip (Class 6, good to soft) over a year ago; no obvious excuses (form figures 9549) in 2026, but does have a capable 5lb claimer aboard, and further rain could assist; stablemate of Golden Valour.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Failed to win for William Knight (0-7), beaten at odds-on at Yarmouth (1m2f classified) on final start for that trainer; visor (worn twice) has yielded some improvement; wise to monitor this 7,000gns purchase on stable debut.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Ten-race maiden; fourth (not far behind Falaise Blanc) at Musselburgh (12.5f; 33-1) in June, but weakened over C&D (raced keenly) subsequently; level of competition suitable, but others are easier to recommend.

RaceName: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Yet to win (0-8) and not many positives to take from latest C&D effort; Mulrennan takes the ride aboard this stablemate of Storm On Jura; opposable.

RaceName: Betway Leigh Handicap
Spotlight: 0-7; some improvement when third at Ripon (1m2f, good to firm; 100-1) 12 days ago, but she's up against it here from 4lb out of the weights; usual hood left off today.

RaceName: Betway Leigh Handicap
Spotlight: 0-7 but last month's close second at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) was a fine try; nudged up only 1lb; has a sound chance of going one better.

RaceName: Betway Leigh Handicap
Spotlight: Improved efforts of late, brushing aside two rivals at Yarmouth (11.4f, good to firm) last Sunday; should make another bold bid under a 6lb penalty.

RaceName: Betway Leigh Handicap
Spotlight: Won 7f Thirsk maiden last July but her form has plateaued in handicaps; last of four at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) on latest outing; dropped 4lb since but will still need a personal best.

RaceName: Betway Leigh Handicap
Spotlight: Steady improvement first four starts, winning Lingfield maiden (1m2f, soft) in June; didn't give his running when last of eight on handicap debut at Chester six weeks ago, but he's in good hands and may well bounce back.

RaceName: Betway Rose Of Lancaster Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Superbly bred gelding whose form has hit new heights this season; runaway winner of handicap at Epsom (1m2f, good to soft) on Oaks day and followed up cosily in Listed race at Sandown (1m2f, good) five weeks ago; thriving and looks the one to beat.

RaceName: Betway Rose Of Lancaster Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Showed he can go well fresh when winning 1m2f Listed event at Epsom last spring; mostly creditable efforts in defeat afterwards (subsequently gelded) but will probably need a career best to make a winning return after ten months off.

RaceName: Betway Rose Of Lancaster Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Rapidly developed into a smart performer last year, winning Listed Glasgow Stakes at Hamilton (1m3f, good); raced too freely when only ninth in Wolferton at Royal Ascot (joint-favourite) on reappearance; still has untapped potential and the last run may have blown away the cobwebs.

RaceName: Betway Rose Of Lancaster Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Successful five times from ten attempts, including in Group 3 at Newbury (1m4f, good) in April, but soundly beaten twice since; now on a retrieval mission and has to concede weight all round.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Beaten only once in four outings as a 2yo, crowning the campaign with a gutsy success in Group 3 at Newmarket (7f, good); should have no problem getting 1m; still has untapped potential and she's an interesting candidate if ready to roll after ten months off.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Progressive 2yo campaign culminated in fine second in the Breeders' Cup Juvenile Fillies Turf; below par in Listed race at York (possibly needed run) and Group 3 at Epsom (ground possibly softer than ideal) this term; some questions to answer but she's a leading player if back to her best.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Won three 1m Group 1s last year on good or good to yielding ground; well below form on final 4yo start and she folded tamely when last of four in Group 2 Middleton Fillies' Stakes at York (1m2f, good) on reappearance, when lack of stamina was possibly a factor; takes a significant drop in grade and she's the one to beat if back to her best.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Progressive type who followed an unlucky fifth to Alobayyah in handicap at Royal Ascot with a narrow win in similar event at Goodwood (1m, good) 11 days ago; this is a sterner assignment but it's unlikely she's reached her ceiling just yet.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Won Musselburgh handicap (1m1f, good) in good style in April but has since come up short in Listed race here and Group 2 at Ascot (1m, good to firm; last of 15); will need a career best but she's relatively low mileage.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Reliable 3yo; creditable second in French Listed race (1m, good to soft) two weeks ago, but this looks a much more competitive affair and she has plenty to find on the figures.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Very lightly raced for her age; posted a personal best when justifying strong support in 24-runner Kensington Palace Handicap at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm), leading late on; still unexposed and well worth her place in this higher grade.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: 0-9 on turf; ran as well as she's ever done on grass when beaten neck in six-runner handicap at Leopardstown (1m, good) three weeks ago, but that still leaves her with a fair bit to find on these terms.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
OwnerName: J Fyffe, A Edmondson & L McGurty
Spotlight: Regularly makes the frame and she ran up to her best when third in Listed race at Pontefract (1m, good to firm) two weeks ago; this is tougher but she still has each-way possibilities.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Ran as well as could have been expected when 80-1 for the 1,000 Guineas in May; still rather green but stuck to her task well when second in Listed race at Sandown (1m, good to firm; 11-1) five weeks ago; needs more progress but she's going the right way.

RaceName: Betway Ashton Heath Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time 7f turf winner who was close to career-best form when second of 17 at York (7f, good to firm) last month but he weakened to finish well adrift of Crimson Spirit at Goodwood last week.

RaceName: Betway Ashton Heath Handicap
Spotlight: Better than ever when landing a second 7f Goodwood success of the year in 20-runner event at last week's Glorious meeting (good to firm), with the reopposing Pellitory well behind; a further 4lb rise seems unlikely to prevent another prominent showing from this thriving 5yo.

RaceName: Betway Ashton Heath Handicap
Spotlight: Mixed form this season but last two efforts creditable and the way his challenge petered out late on over 1m at Ascot a fortnight ago suggests this return to 7f could prove ideal.

RaceName: Betway Ashton Heath Handicap
Spotlight: Prominent racer; now 1lb lower than for last August's win at Chester (7.6f, good to firm) but his two York efforts this summer have been underwhelming.

RaceName: Betway Ashton Heath Handicap
Spotlight: Reappeared with close third at Redcar in April but hasn't built on it, including last of 15 at Thirsk last weekend; hopes are pinned on a first-time visor having a revitalising effect with Oisin Murphy taking the reins.

RaceName: Betway Ashton Heath Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins over 6f at Kempton, latterly a handicap 59 days ago, but she was second in a C&D maiden on good last August; hit with a 7lb rise for that latest success but she's a lightly raced filly from a yard in fine form so further progress wouldn't surprise.

RaceName: Betway Tanners Bridge Handicap
Spotlight: Thriving since joining Charlie Clover, justifying favouritism at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm; Napolian fourth) 11 days ago; may have more in the tank, although this is warmer and he's 5lb higher.

RaceName: Betway Tanners Bridge Handicap
Spotlight: Revived with the help of cheekpieces to win at Leicester (6f, good to firm) last month, and the way she kept on suggests this return to 7f will be fine; leading contender if the headgear works a second time.

RaceName: Betway Tanners Bridge Handicap
