RaceName: Racing Again 28th August Fillies INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Feel Like Dancing filly; dam point winner, half-sister to bumper/2m hurdle winner On The Wild Side, out of useful 2m hurdle winner; yard 3-11 in bumpers this season and their runners always command respect; market clues can help; yard won this last year.

RaceName: Racing Again 28th August Fillies INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Maxios filly; unraced dam closely related to bumper winner Dramalarma Lucy, out of unraced sister to Grade 1 bumper winner Lovethehigherlaw; a pedigree which appeals to this sphere for trainer who does well with small string.

RaceName: Racing Again 28th August Fillies INH Flat Race
OwnerName: Miss Ciara McGee & Ms Denise McCourt
Spotlight: Sister to 1m4f winner Celtic Druid (inc AW; RPR 73), half-sister to 7f/1m winner Lady Scathach (86); dam well beaten 5f-1m2f (33), half-sister to 6f winner Charley's Aunt, out of 7f winning half-sister to 6f 2yo Listed winner Miss Beabea; bred to have a chance on the Flat; probably a big ask.

RaceName: Racing Again 28th August Fillies INH Flat Race
Spotlight: 2,000euro 3yo; half-sister to useful 2m4f-2m7f hurdle/chase winner Lord Of Thunder; dam unraced sister to 2m4f-2m6f hurdle/chase winner The Caddy Rose, out of unraced half-sister to Cheltenham Gold Cup third Harbour Pilot; pulled up on sole point-to-point start; big ask.

RaceName: Racing Again 28th August Fillies INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Nathaniel filly out of unraced half-sister to top-class staying hurdler Big Buck's; shaped with plenty of promise when a 1.25l second to Hilly Filly at Cork on debut 29 days ago, hitting the front a furlong and a half out before being worn down; signs of greenness that day and bound to step forward; big chance.

RaceName: Racing Again 28th August Fillies INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Sister to smart 1m4f winner Highland Bling; will improve for experience on debut 29 days ago, beaten 25l into eighth at Cork; well-held by Honey Bucks on that form.

RaceName: Prix de Reux (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Unbeaten son of Frankel, who only made his debut at the beginning of May; improvement with every start, the last two over 1m4f on good ground, the most recent being a Listed event; almost certainly capable of better on this next step up the ladder, and needs to on the figures, but the owner's retained rider Maxime Guyon is booked to ride Oracle.

RaceName: Prix de Reux (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Qatar Racing Ltd, Ecurie Skymarc Farm & Ecurie Des Monceaux
Spotlight: Won a 1m4f good-ground Listed contest at Clairefontaine last year in a solid season and has run three smart races following a gelding operation in 2026, beating Presage Nocturne two runs ago (1m4f, good) before narrowly denied by Sons And Lovers upped to 1m6f; seems adaptable with regard to trip and should place a part.

RaceName: Prix de Reux (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Unraced as a 2yo and went on quite the winning streak last year when a tongue-tie was applied, progressing from an opening mark of 81 to 100 when he was second in the Group 3 Cumberland Lodge Stakes (1m4f, soft) by October; bagged a career best on his seasonal return but didn't need to repeat that when beating popular stablemate Hamish two months ago; seems to handle most ground, so leading claims.

RaceName: Prix de Reux (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Paolo Zambelli, Carlo Pellegatti Et Al
Spotlight: Notably went off favourite for last year's Melbourne Cup, albeit he finished down the field, following a solid season, and has been steadily improving in 2026, most recently landing a 1m4f good-ground Listed race at Lyon Parilly a month and a half ago under this rider by 4l; beaten a nose by Parachutiste on the same terms prior to that, so hard to dismiss.

RaceName: Prix de Reux (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: No wins since his debut but produced plenty of decent efforts in Group company and he comes into this having recorded a career best behind Goliath in a 1m4f Group 2 on good ground when last seen in late May; player if the 69-day absence hasn't left him a little rusty; seems choice of the owner's retained rider.

RaceName: Prix de Reux (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Capable sort at his best as he showed when landing a 1m2f Listed race on heavy last summer at Compiegne (where he has a good record) before a respectable run in the Group 3 Prix du Prince d'Orange; didn't start this campaign strongly but did better last time and could find improvement for a first try over this distance (dam stayed this sort of trip).

OwnerName: D L Hewitt & Ms J C Preston
Spotlight: Pure speed merchant. Great effort in the Sir John Monash Stakes Caulfield two back. Brave after showing speed this venue. Sticky gate but has early pace. Must consider.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Clarken Bloodstock, M K Jennings Et Al
Spotlight: Not far off them in the small field this track. Has form in wet. All the better and not out of this.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: HK Import returning for second Australian campaign (56-weeks). Proven fresh performer. Has early speed. Keep safe.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Resuming (13-weeks). Right amongst it in top company. Not beaten far Benchmark 72 company first-up last preparation. Finds a harder setup.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: B H Perks, Ms A M Clough Et Al
Spotlight: First-up (21-weeks). Tends to race well first-up without winning. Prefers better than heavy. Best viewed as a rough place hope fresh in this line-up.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: G G Tully, T K Thompson Et Al
Spotlight: Great effort in the Santa Ana Lane Sprint Final Flemington two back. Just got there in the 4yo+ Hcp this track in rain affected going. Relishes the sting out of the ground. Fit from racing and right in the mix again.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Ms J Heaney, R M Warnock Et Al
Spotlight: Freshened. Really good run in testing conditions coming from the back in (Bm76) at Morphettville Parks over longer assignment. Drops to shorter trip. Could get into the placings.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Fair performance without threatening on a soft deck at Sandown-Hillside at $5.50. Dual winner this trip. Capable of making an impact.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: A Bain, Seymour Bloodstock Et Al
Spotlight: First-up (37-weeks). Latest trial work was solid. One for multiples fresh in this affair.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: R Jolly, J Bechara Et Al
Spotlight: Caulfield (Bm84) placegetter 27 Jun. Not disgraced on a soft deck at Flemington over this journey at $12. Wet tracks certainly don't pose a problem. Worth a look.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: T J Doudle, S D Bland Et Al
Spotlight: Now 4 weeks between runs. Just missed at Rosehill 27 Jun. Prominent, showed plenty of ticker in heavy ground to just go under at Randwick. Respecting.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Kept fresh. Ridden back, battled home without threatening at Flemington. One for your exotics.

RaceName: Sportsbet Behemoth Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: B J Bowman, G R Nilsson Et Al
Spotlight: Resuming after a (69-weeks) spell. Seasoned galloper best over longer these days. A the bottom of his win range here. Tough ask fresh off the long lay-off.

RaceName: Kia Ora Stud Missile Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: MyRacehorse No 1, Fairway Thoroughbreds Et Al
Spotlight: First-up (22-weeks). Won twice in black type company last prep and warmed up with two solid trials here. 1200m is the query but handles wet ground and right in this.

RaceName: Kia Ora Stud Missile Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Let-up (70-days). Raced in back half and was never in a position to mount a serious challenge at Eagle Farm. Genuine 1200m horse who has trialled well and Grp 1 placed. Must respect.

RaceName: Kia Ora Stud Missile Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Resuming (16-weeks). Right amongst it in top company. Reliable first-up performer while brought on by 2 trials. McDonald rides and drawn to perfection. Hard to beat.

RaceName: Kia Ora Stud Missile Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: S G Darby, D Foote Et Al
Spotlight: Hauled them in effortlessly at Rosehill at $3.20. Relishes the sting out of the ground. Ticks the track and distance win box. In outstanding form and stays under strong notice for this.

RaceName: Kia Ora Stud Missile Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Ordinary performance in small field in sloppy conditions at Rosehill for new trainer. First time around Randwick and others with more to offer at this level.

RaceName: Kia Ora Stud Missile Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: A E Koundouris & Mrs G Koundouris
Spotlight: Resuming (17-weeks). Smart mare who was consistently around the mark last prep. Excellent first up record while cruising through a winning trial at Randwick. Gets the gun run. Major player.

RaceName: Kia Ora Stud Missile Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: M J Zammit, M Zammit Et Al
Spotlight: Compounded after leading in heavy ground at Rosehill. Adverse barrier tests. Could get into the placings.

Test Stakes Presented By Ticketmaster (Fillies) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: Michael E Pegram, Karl Watson & Paul Weitman
Spotlight: Scored narrowly in an allowance listed (Churchill Downs) when back to this distance two months ago; has chalked up four wins from her last seven; the Bob Baffert operation is running hot currently; leading claims.

RaceName: Test Stakes Presented By Ticketmaster (Fillies) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Ran a bit below expectations (sent off 11-10) when fifth in a black type (Churchill Downs) two months ago; could have a say if replicating the best of her form and she goes well fresh.

RaceName: Test Stakes Presented By Ticketmaster (Fillies) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Just denied over 6 1/2f here (allowance Grade 3) behind Sippin Pretty last month; track has proven suitable before; has made an impressive start to her career with three wins from six starts; has to be respected.

RaceName: Test Stakes Presented By Ticketmaster (Fillies) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: Randall L Bloch, Six Column Stables LLC Et Al
Spotlight: Had a couple of these behind when springing a 28-1 surprise four weeks ago in an allowance Grade 3; has won three of her five career starts.

RaceName: Test Stakes Presented By Ticketmaster (Fillies) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Successful four times in her last seven starts; favourite and only narrowly beaten in an allowance listed (Churchill Downs) behind Explora two months ago; competitive shout.

RaceName: Test Stakes Presented By Ticketmaster (Fillies) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Goes for a hat-trick today and has a nice pedigree (by Speightstown); ran out a ready winner over 6 1/2f at Churchill Downs (allowance optional claimer) 45 days ago; despite that Churchill Downs success, one to tread carefully with.

RaceName: Test Stakes Presented By Ticketmaster (Fillies) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: Legion Racing, MHM Stables LLC Et Al
Spotlight: Beaten 9l into fifth last month in an allowance Grade 3; has winning form at this track; successful twice in her last five starts; easy to oppose.

RaceName: Test Stakes Presented By Ticketmaster (Fillies) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Attempts to land a hat-trick and two from three in her career so far; won an allowance optional claimer by just over 5l at Churchill Downs in May; despite that Churchill Downs success, may have to settle for supporting role at best.

RaceName: Fourstardave Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: St Elias Stable, Ken Langone Et Al
Spotlight: In the form of his life at present, continuing his winning spree when beating Test Score by half a length in Grade 1 Manhattan Stakes here (9.5f) last time, pressing leader and battling on with great tenacity in the straight; has now won three Grade 1s (including this race in 2025) and looks sure to make a concerted defence of his title.

RaceName: Fourstardave Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Smart form on last two starts here, winning black type event in June (8.5f; easily by 4l) then dead-heating with Zulu Kingdom in Grade 3 Kelso (1m); progressive, but does need to improve again to threaten the best here.

RaceName: Fourstardave Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: Madaket Stables LLC, Michael Dubb Et Al
Spotlight: Clearly best effort to win Grade 1 Maker's Mark Mile at Keeneland in April by around 1l from One Stripe, dictating steady pace before kicked into clear lead and holding on; creditable efforts on balance of smart form since, dead-heating with Mi Bago (same terms) in Grade 3 Kelso over C&D; faces pressure for lead and opposed on balance.

RaceName: Fourstardave Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: Gary Barber, Cheyenne Stable LLC & Wachtel Stable
Spotlight: High-class miler (fourth in latest Breeders' Cup Mile) and better than ever in 2026; improved form to win Grade 1 Turf Classic at Churchill Downs (1m1f) in May by 3l from Make Me King, making all; upset in stalls, unable to dominate when around 1l fourth to Deterministic in Manhattan Stakes (9.5f) here afterwards; not seen to best advantage last time and rates as the one to beat.

RaceName: Fourstardave Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: HRH Prince Sultan Bin Mishal Al Saud
Spotlight: Has racked up ten wins from 28 starts under shrewd placement from Steve Asmussen; completed five-timer in 2026 with Grade 3 Arlington and Grade 2 Wise Dan Stakes wins, both over 8.5f at Churchill Downs; has only tried Grade 1 company once, when only seventh in this last year; maybe in a shade too deep.

RaceName: Fourstardave Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Has plenty to prove to better this type of rival on all known form, including 3l fourth of ten to dead-heaters Zulu Kingdom and Mi Bago in Grade 3 Kelso over course and distance latest; opposed.

RaceName: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Very useful form when third over 1m2f this season in Group 3 Hampton Court Stakes at Royal Ascot (about 1l behind Generic) and in Listed Gala Stakes at Sandown (beaten 2l by Sallaal), accelerating well from rear both times but no extra close home; fits in terms of class and first-time cheekpieces could really help.

RaceName: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Progressive form in five starts, scoring in maiden at Keeneland in April, allowance at Churchill Downs in May and Grade 3 Pennine Ridge here (8.5f) in June; shaped like best horse, set plenty to do and finishing best, when eye-catching close second to Title Role again here (1m1f) in Grade 1 Belmont Derby; outside draw makes things difficult.

RaceName: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Has thrived in 2026, winning Listed race at Meydan (1m) in February, Group 2 German 2,000 Guineas at Cologne (1m) in May and Grade 1 Belmont Derby here (1m1f; beat West End Kid and Remember Mamba in close finish, better placed turning in than either); slightly longer trip does not favour him.

RaceName: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Unbeaten in first three, including Grade 3 Transylvania at Keeneland in April; placed in Grade 1 American Turf at Churchill Downs (8.5f; second to Stark Contrast) and Belmont Derby here (1m1f; close third to Title Role); must go well again.

RaceName: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: Reeves Thoroughbred Racing, Tony Weintraub & Brandon Dalinka
Spotlight: Looked a bright prospect on Tapeta as a juvenile, winning maiden at Presque Isle Downs (1m) and Grade 3 Grey Stakes at Woodbine (8.5f; beat smart Silent Tactic by under 1l); huge task on turf debut and on first start for nine months; blinkers retained.

RaceName: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: Magic Carpet Racing, Catherine W Coyle & Blue Bison Stable
Spotlight: Under 6l fifth to Gstaad in Grade 1 Breeders' Cup Juvenile Turf at Del Mar (1m) last November; 15-1, roughly same level of form when winning Listed race over 8.5f here (8.5f) by neck from Blinging It Back; should be suited by today's longer trip but needs a lot more to contend in this grade.

RaceName: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: West Paces Racing/Rainbow's End Racing/Michael P Lyden
Spotlight: Useful form when in frame over 8.5f here in Grade 3 Pennine Ridge Stakes (under 2l fourth to West End Kid) and Listed Saranac Stakes (under 1l third to Heeere's Johnny); pitched in deep here and will need a perfect game to reach a place.

RaceName: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Won two of his first four starts on turf, include allowance race at Keeneland in April over this trip (beat Noble Dynasty by a neck); improved effort on dirt debut at Delaware (sloppy going; scored by two and a half lengths) last time; should be just as effective back on grass but lots to find.

RaceName: Whitney Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: US Horse of the Year in 2025; won Kentucky Derby at Churchill Downs and three times at Saratoga afterwards, notably Grade 1 Belmont Stakes and Grade 1 Travers (by 10l); well below best this season, second to White Abarrio in Grade 2 at Oaklawn on reappearance, then really disappointing third to Magnitude in Grade 1 Stephen Foster at Churchill Downs, weakening tamely stretch; brilliant at best and goes really well here but optimism for return to form rests on news of encouraging workouts, rather than anything seen on track.

RaceName: Whitney Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Top-class filly, surely the best of her sex around two turns on dirt; deeply impressive in 13l win over Bless The Broken in Grade 1 Ogden Phipps over C&D on latest start, still going strongly with field in trouble turning in, changing gears and soon a long way clear (outstanding time); much stiffer task against males but coming off a performance of rare standing.

RaceName: Whitney Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Career-best effort last August in trouble-affected Grade 1 Jockey Club Gold Cup here (1m2f); well below that form in three of four starts since, except when winning Grade 3 Westchester Stakes at Aqueduct (1m) by 6l from Bishops Bay; very smart on his day but finds this type of rival tough.

RaceName: Whitney Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: C R K Stable LLC & Grandview Equine
Spotlight: Smart horse on his day who beat Magnitude by just over 2l in Grade 1 Pennsylvania Derby (1m1f) last September; creditable efforts this year, around 1l second to same rival in Grade 1 Stephen Foster at Churchill Downs last time, running on; not far behind these on balance and could take a hand if the early pace is too strong.

RaceName: Whitney Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: Winchell Thoroughbreds LLC, Derrick Smith Et Al
Spotlight: Nowhere near this class yet; won allowance race at Churchill Downs in May before moderate third to Phileas Fogg in Grade 2 Suburban Stakes here (1m2f) last month.

RaceName: Whitney Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Has improved into top-class colt as 4yo, winning Grade 3 Razorback Handicap at Oaklawn (8.5f; by 4l) in February, Grade 1 Dubai World Cup at Meydan (1m2f) in March and Grade 1 Stephen Foster Stakes at Churchill Downs in June (1m1f; broke out of stalls beforehand, again made all and beat Baeza by a length and a quarter); owns deep stamina and courage and deserves to be regarded as the division's leading male performer.

RaceName: Whitney Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: C2 Racing Stable LLC, Gary Barber & La Milagrosa Stable LLC
Spotlight: High-class form at best, winning four Grade 1s including 2023 Breeders' Cup Classic at Santa Anita and 2025 Pegasus World Cup (1m1f) at Gulfstream Park; returned to form when winning Grade 2 Oaklawn Handicap in April (by 2l from Sovereignty) but moderate fourth of five behind Magnitude last time; difficult to predict.

RaceName: Happy 100th Birthday Chepstow Racecourse "Training Series" Apprentice Handicap (RE Series)
Spotlight: Has won only once, over 7f, during 25-race career; does have form at 6f but hasn't offered much in two runs after wind surgery.

RaceName: Happy 100th Birthday Chepstow Racecourse "Training Series" Apprentice Handicap (RE Series)
Spotlight: Always prominent when belatedly off the mark over C&D in June and probably performed to a similar level when beaten 2l off this figure at Leicester; after steering clear of 6f for so much of her career, it's now looking a good fit.

RaceName: Happy 100th Birthday Chepstow Racecourse "Training Series" Apprentice Handicap (RE Series)
OwnerName: Mrs S M Maine & Roger Gould & Partner
Spotlight: Be An Angel didn't get the best of runs when this gelding was hot on her heels here last month; found wanting in a classified race since then; looks vulnerable.

RaceName: Happy 100th Birthday Chepstow Racecourse "Training Series" Apprentice Handicap (RE Series)
Spotlight: 0-14 but has competitive form off higher marks and was runner-up over 5f here two weeks ago; won't be hindered by returning to 6f and blinkers might give him a lift.

RaceName: Happy 100th Birthday Chepstow Racecourse "Training Series" Apprentice Handicap (RE Series)
Spotlight: Nutted on the line when backed at Ffos Las 12 days ago (6f, good) and gets in off the same mark, which is very favourable on peak form.

RaceName: Happy 100th Birthday Chepstow Racecourse "Training Series" Apprentice Handicap (RE Series)
Spotlight: Back in form, following her Salisbury win (6f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) with an unlucky second here and she wasn't beaten far despite finishing sixth last time; mark hasn't really gone anywhere so should be on the scene once more.

RaceName: Happy 100th Birthday Chepstow Racecourse "Training Series" Apprentice Handicap (RE Series)
OwnerName: Giddy Up You Good Thing Racing Syndicate
Spotlight: Has only won a Chelmsford 5f novice in 28 starts but well handicapped on best form and he was only 2l away over this trip at Nottingham a month ago (good to firm); has new handling this afternoon but should run well.

RaceName: Coral Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Held on narrowly, having dictated the pace, in similar event at Chepstow (6f, good to firm; nursery debut) last time; likely to be as effective back at 5f; open to further progress at this level; respected up just 2lb.

RaceName: Coral Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Five-race maiden who is moving gradually in the right direction; good second at Thirsk (6f, good to firm; nursery debut) most recently; possibilities provided she copes with the drop in distance.

RaceName: Coral Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Nursery debutant whose form figures of 543 reflect that he's steadily getting the hang of things; ran well over C&D (good to firm) most recently; interesting with another step forward plausible.

RaceName: Coral Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Five-race maiden who came up short (finished last of three) in Class 4 event most recently; creditable second in Class 6 at Ffos Las (5f) the time before; the return to this grade looks a positive.

RaceName: Coral Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who posted clear best effort, namely 50-1 second at Ffos Las, in sole attempt over 5f and only start in cheekpieces; could go well with those two factors back in play.

RaceName: Coral Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Only one place behind Our Fella at Ffos Las (5f) last time, showing some improvement for the combination of first-time tongue-tie and switch to nursery level; may build on that effort.

RaceName: Coral Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Four-race maiden who is proving rather a weak finisher; not disgraced in Lingfield nursery (dropped back to 5f) most recently but still needs to prove he can see things out to the line.

RaceName: Coral Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has started at 28-1 in his novice races, best effort when fifth over C&D; ties in with Chianti on that form and goes handicapping with a more realistic chance than previously; one to bear in mind.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Irish filly who showed ability with running-on fifth at Bellewstown, then understandably never figured when facing a much stiffer task in Listed grade at Naas; possibilities back down in class and upped to 6f.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Placed in two novice contests at Newbury and respectable fifth, belying her 50-1 odds, in competitive nursery at Glorious Goodwood since upped to 6f; leading form contender in an ordinary maiden.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Showed some promise with fourth of 11, just over 4l behind Global Success, in 6f event at Newbury; has frame possibilities as things stand and an even better chance if plausible improvement materialises.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Ran according to market expectations (rank outsider of five) in 6f contest at Salisbury; drops to a slightly lower level but is perhaps one for handicaps later on.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Flashes her tail but has broadly consistent form; creditable second in nurseries at Chepstow (6f) and Lingfield (5f) on last two starts, doing well having started slowly latest; returns to this C&D with solid claims.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Sister to 6f AW winner Nursia (RPR 74), out of unraced sibling to UAE 1m4f Group 2 winner Bold Act and two 2yo scorers (6f/7f); sole newcomer in the field and starts off at an ordinary level; interesting.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Folded tamely and well beaten in big-field maiden at Naas (6f) won by a Ballydoyle colt who followed up in the Richmond; may do better at this lesser level and is one of two Irish raiders who add interest.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Ducked left at the start and always behind in 6f maiden at Newbury; may post a bigger effort at this easier-looking level with the experience under her belt; check the market signals for positive signs.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Last of five in both starts, achieving very little.

RaceName: Floyds Turfcar Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Holds a fighting chance on peak form, namely success off just 1lb lower in first-time cheekpieces at Lingfield (6f, good) in May; drops back in trip after attempting 7f last time.

RaceName: Floyds Turfcar Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Campaigned over 5f since switched to handicaps, dead-heating at Chepstow the first attempt; most efforts since suggest this return to 6f is well worth exploring; major player.

RaceName: Floyds Turfcar Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Proved markedly resurgent with 28-1 win at Pontefract (6f, good to firm) last time, ending a poor spell; still well treated on best 2yo figures; respected assuming he remains in form.

RaceName: Floyds Turfcar Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Six-race maiden who has inconsistent form; posted one of his better efforts at Bath (5.7f) most recently but finished last of the five runners; not particularly solid.

RaceName: Floyds Turfcar Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Still a maiden on turf but is in a consistent vein of form, close fourth at Bath (5.7f) kept to classified level last time; gained his AW handicap success off current mark; solid chance.

RaceName: Floyds Turfcar Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Poor maiden over longer trips in Ireland for Tommy Dowling; chance partly depends on whether the switch to sprinting prompts improvement; declared 8.10 Lingfield Saturday.

RaceName: Floyds Turfcar Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Far-from-solid maiden whose chance depends on whether she's capable of backing up latest effort, namely close fourth at Carlisle (6f, soft); has weak claims on previous form.

RaceName: Floyds Turfcar Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Eye-catcher on 2yo debut but has failed to build on that effort; trailed home last of ten, having pulled hard, at Salisbury (6f) on handicap/seasonal debut; something to prove.

RaceName: DragonBet Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Good 2yo form; remains a maiden after 20 starts but he's fallen a long way in the weights and, at odds of 4-1, was a clear second over C&D 55 days ago; considered.

RaceName: DragonBet Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
