Spotlight: Showed ability on his first three starts (7f/1m) but he failed to beat a rival home on his handicap debut at Wolverhampton (9.5f, AW; reported to have lost his action) in June; has since left Roger Varian having been bought for 12,000gns and has the hood removed for his yard debut.

RaceName: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to six winners including See The Fire (7f-1m2f including 2yo/Group 2; RPR 121), Venetian Prince (7f 2yo/1m3f Group 2 Italian Derby; 105) and Spirit Mixer (1m4f-2m including AW; 104); dam 5f-1m2f winner (including 2yo/Group 1; 116); striking pedigree, although likely for further, and stable have won this race in two of the last four seasons (both winners had previous experience).

RaceName: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Comfortably held in two starts at Kempton (6f, Polytrack); pedigree suggests handicaps over much further may suit in due course.

RaceName: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Promise amidst inexperience on his debut at Yarmouth (6f, good) in May; thrown in the deep end in the Group 2 Coventry Stakes eight weeks ago and finished well beaten, albeit his track position wasn't ideal; capable of further progress.

RaceName: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Yet to land a blow in two novice runs this summer, the latest at Ffos Las (7.4f, good) last week; others bring more pressing claims.

RaceName: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Modest RPRs in two starts this summer (6f, good and good to firm), in need of the experience on each occasion; may need more time.

RaceName: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: He has run to a modest level in two novice runs this summer, both over 6f (good/good to firm); bred to stay further and nurseries over 7f+ may see him in a better light.

RaceName: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: No better than midfield in two 6f novices (soft and good to firm) this summer; latest effort was better but another good step forward will be required to win.

RaceName: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Recorded RPRs in the low 40s in his two runs last month (both 6f on good to firm); the addition of a hood isn't enough to tempt.

RaceName: Frazier Jones Wine Merchants Handicap
Spotlight: Won a Class 5 over C&D (soft) in June and followed that with three runner-up finishes; beaten favourite at Goodwood a fortnight ago but he was racing away from the main action and shaped as though still in top form; Oisin Murphy retains the ride; solid claims.

RaceName: Frazier Jones Wine Merchants Handicap
Spotlight: Landed 6f novices at Kempton and Ripon before posting an excellent fourth in York's Lowther Stakes last August; down the field on her return but fared much better when fourth at Windsor (6f, good to firm) 16 days ago; yard going well and the fitting of a tongue-tie may help; key player.

RaceName: Frazier Jones Wine Merchants Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive 2yo/3yo; he has faced some stiff tasks for his new yard this year and has come up short; his sights are lowered here, however, and 6f on fast ground won't faze him; respected now down into a 0-90 with headgear dispensed with.

RaceName: Frazier Jones Wine Merchants Handicap
Spotlight: Turned over at long odds-on at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) on his return from a year on the sidelines; finished just in front of Dandana when third at Windsor on last month's handicap debut; still has time to deliver a bigger performance.

RaceName: Frazier Jones Wine Merchants Handicap
Spotlight: Two wins as a 3yo, the latter a C&D handicap off 1lb lower last October; good runs in defeat on his last two starts (7f, soft and good to firm); should make another bold bid.

RaceName: Frazier Jones Wine Merchants Handicap
Spotlight: Had some solid form as a 2yo and he belatedly shed his maiden tag with a C&D (good ground) win in May; only eighth in a big-field handicap at York 60 days ago; eased in grade but needs to raise his game to win.

RaceName: Frazier Jones Wine Merchants Handicap
Spotlight: More exposed than most but he is down in the weights and his latest Windsor fourth can be upgraded as he had to wait for a gap to appear; this is a higher grade though.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Stonehenge Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Rallied to win on debut at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last month and followed up in Sandown novice (7f, good to firm); both wins have been pretty tight but he has a good attitude and this Sea The Stars colt could relish today's extra furlong, with his dam a 1m 2yo Listed winner.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Stonehenge Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Runner-up on first three starts before winning a fillies' maiden at 2-1 at Newmarket's July meeting (7f, good to firm); the Newmarket runner-up has since finished third in a Listed race and she's in good hands to continue to progress; not discounted.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Stonehenge Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Belied his 22-1 odds and a slow start to win a six-runner novice on his debut at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; it was a performance in keeping with his useful pedigree and he could have plenty more to offer, especially now up to 1m; possible contender.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Stonehenge Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Third on debut at Newmarket's July meeting (7f, good to firm) and won at Chester (7f, good) subsequently; this is a tougher test of his credentials but his trainer has a useful 2yo team and he may be suited by 1m; chance.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Stonehenge Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Chepstow debut winner (6f, good to soft) who rallied for a good third in Sandown novice (7f, good) last month; suffered interference when mid-division on recent nursery debut at Glorious Goodwood (7f, good to firm) but nevertheless looks up against it in today's company.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Stonehenge Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: 11-1 winner on debut at Kempton (6f, AW) in June and beaten just over 3l when fifth of ten at 40-1 in Listed race at Ascot (7f, good to firm) last month; he's closely matched with the Ascot third Dandyman Dan and there's stamina in his pedigree; not ruled out now tackling 1m.

RaceName: Molson Coors Pembroke Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Made debut in June and he showed ability when fourth on his first two starts (6f/7f, good to firm/soft), the latest here; gelded since and this half-brother to Italian Group 3 winner Rainbow Royal is open to improvement.

RaceName: Molson Coors Pembroke Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Soundly beaten on all three starts and improvement is necessary if she's to be a force this afternoon.

RaceName: Molson Coors Pembroke Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Finished first past the post in a maiden at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago but was demoted due to interference; she has her limitations but nevertheless holds leading claims in this field.

RaceName: Molson Coors Pembroke Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: She's shown some ability across her four starts and could be suited by this step back up to 6f; however, low-grade handicaps are likely to be a better pathway to success.

RaceName: Molson Coors Pembroke Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Mrs Wendy Jarrett & J S Moore
Spotlight: Fifth of seven on last month's debut at Ffos Las (5f, good) and second of six at Bath (5.7f, firm) subsequently; however, this looks a better race than last time and he needs another step forward.

RaceName: Molson Coors Pembroke Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Well beaten for James Tate on sole 2yo start and not disgraced when fourth of six on recent stable and seasonal debut at Bath (5.7f, firm); however, others have much stronger form.

RaceName: Molson Coors Pembroke Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 15,000euros foal, 40,000gns yearling; third foal; Sioux Nation sister to 5f/6f winner Shagraan (including Listed); dam 7f/1m winner (RPR 97); trainer also saddles Bold Shout, who has shown promise previously, and the betting could be informative on debut.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Upavon Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Close Listed third at Goodwood (1m2f, good) in May and that form has worked out extremely well; tailed off in the Oaks at Epsom (1m4f, good to soft) next time and behind Regal Charm when fourth of five in Listed race at York (1m2f, good to firm) last time; not written off but has to raise her game.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Upavon Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Won at Leicester (7f, good to soft) last September on sole 2yo start; both runs this season have been in novice races at Newbury, reappearing with a close second (1m1f, good to soft) and winning last time (1m2f, good to firm); this unexposed 3yo goes up in grade today but is a half-sister to two Listed winners and is in top hands, and could play a leading role.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Upavon Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Won her first two starts (1m/1m2f, AW/good) then finished second to subsequent Oaks runner-up Legacy Link in the Group 3 Musidora at York (1m2f, good); soundly beaten in the Group 1 Prix de Diane at Chantilly (1m2f, good to firm) last time but is in with a big shout now back down in grade.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Upavon Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: She's 0-8 in Group 3 and Listed races but has finished runner-up in Listed contests in France on her last two starts (10.5f/1m4f, good/soft); there is every chance that she will be in the mix.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Upavon Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Won three handicaps in a row (1m/7f, good/good to firm) prior to respectable sixth of 14 in handicap at Glorious Goodwood (1m, good) a fortnight ago; further improvement is necessary up in grade but this 3yo's pedigree suggests the step up in trip could be a plus and she's not discounted.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Upavon Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who reappeared with easy win in C&D handicap (soft) last month; no match for the 1-2 winner when Listed second of five at York recently (1m2f, good to firm) but that performance entitles her to respect.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Upavon Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Won 1m3f maiden at Dieppe last July; respectable fifth in Listed race at Pontefract (1m, good) last month; well beaten either side of that (1m/7f); goes back up in trip today but looks opposable.

RaceName: Champagne Joseph Perrier Handicap
Spotlight: Hard to predict and has record of 1-15 but she bounced back with a good third in a Class 4 at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) last month; has possibilities if she can back that up and she's still lightly raced on turf.

RaceName: Champagne Joseph Perrier Handicap
Spotlight: Returned after a gelding operation with a win at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) last month and he had an excuse when upped to 1m4f at Newmarket (took strong hold) next time; still looks feasibly treated on his penultimate form and he's an interesting contender back in trip.

RaceName: Champagne Joseph Perrier Handicap
Spotlight: Dual Polytrack winner last summer; returned after 279 days off with a fair effort at Kempton (1m4f) in May but he was disappointing on his return visit the following month; has bit to prove after that but he still has low mileage and his first win was on turf (1m2f, good).

RaceName: Champagne Joseph Perrier Handicap
Spotlight: Triple AW winner who is 0-24 on turf but he ran well to finish second behind an unexposed improver at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) 11 days ago; on same mark here and he's a big player if he can repeat that form.

RaceName: Champagne Joseph Perrier Handicap
Spotlight: Two creditable efforts at Epsom (8.5f/1m4f) from his three runs this season; could go well again back at his optimum trip but his last win was 13 months ago and he's ideally suited by good or slower ground.

RaceName: Champagne Joseph Perrier Handicap
OwnerName: Middleham Park Racing I and Partner
Spotlight: Both wins have been on AW but he's run well on turf this season including when runner-up at Carlisle (1m) in May and when third over this trip at Windsor (good to firm) last time; continues to edge down the weights and he's in the mix with cheekpieces added.

RaceName: Racing TV Club Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: No Nay Never filly who made a winning start to her career over 5f at Sandown (good to firm) three weeks ago; the third from that race has won since; 7lb penalty but almost certainly has more to offer for top stable.

RaceName: Racing TV Club Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 100,000euros daughter of No Nay Never; stable has had a first-time-out 2yo winner here in the Jaber Abdullah silks this season; would need considering if the betting speaks in her favour.

RaceName: Racing TV Club Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Showed ability in maidens at Pontefract (6f, good) and Hamilton (5f, good to firm) in June without achieving a great deal; capable of better at some point.

RaceName: Racing TV Club Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Promise in three 5f runs in Ireland in the spring; well beaten in the Albany at Royal Ascot on yard debut but bounced back when fourth of eight in 6f Newmarket Listed race (good to firm) seven weeks ago, no extra late on and shaping as if this return to a stiff 5f may be ideal; sets a good standard for the rest to aim at.

RaceName: Racing TV Club Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Advertise filly and the second foal of a fair 6f AW winner; the mount of David Allan from the yard's two debutantes but the market is likely the best guide to expectations

RaceName: Racing TV Club Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Starspangledbanner half-sister to 6f winner The Untamed (RPR 80); dam 6f 2yo winner (95); David Allan is on the yard's other newcomer but she's bred to have a future and is worth a second look in the betting.

RaceName: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Bumped into useful types when runner-up in maidens Hamilton (5f, good to soft) and over C&D (good to firm) in June/July and made a good start to his nursery career when beaten only a neck in a 0-75 at Carlisle (5f, good) on Tuesday; pulled just over 3l clear of the third at Carlisle and is the one to beat if turned out again quickly.

RaceName: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Her mark appears about right based on her two nursery efforts last month but she now returns to the scene of her fast-ground claiming success in May; also has a handy draw so there are reasons to be hopeful.

RaceName: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has reached the frame on two of her three starts; looked suited by the drop to 6f (led for long way) when third in Lingfield maiden and it could be that the minimum trip sees her in an even better light on nursery debut.

RaceName: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Had two runs in nurseries last month, beaten just over 2l when third of seven over 5f at Lingfield (good to firm) latterly; being eased another 2lb can only help but it's not enough to tempt.

RaceName: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Made a sound start to his nursery career when fourth to stablemate Lady Dublin over 6f at Thirsk (good to firm) three weeks ago, albeit not obviously shaping as if crying out for a drop back to 5f; wears first-time cheekpieces; has shown a tendency to start slowly.

RaceName: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't built on his 5f debut in two subsequent 6f outings but more realistic chance now handicapping at a low level; has shown speed so the return to 5f could help, as may first-time blinkers.

RaceName: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap

Spotlight: 16,000gns yearling; built on promising debut when justifying good support with convincing win at Doncaster (6.5f, good to firm) 12 days ago; 7lb penalty is largely wiped out by her allowance and she holds strong claims.

RaceName: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai British EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (B/C/D) (Qual) (GBB/IRE Inc)
Spotlight: 8,500gns foal, £55,000 yearling; missed the break and looked green on her debut when sixth of eight at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month; yard's juveniles often take a good step forward from their introduction so no surprise to see her more competitive this time.

RaceName: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai British EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (B/C/D) (Qual) (GBB/IRE Inc)
Spotlight: Improved on her very moderate debut when beaten 7l at Lingfield (7f, AW) nine days ago; that still leaves her someway adrift of the required standard.

RaceName: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai British EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (B/C/D) (Qual) (GBB/IRE Inc)
Spotlight: 66-1 when she finished ninth of 11 on her introduction at Newbury (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; will need a firm step forward.

RaceName: Colin Hinton & Mitch Hinton Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: M Blencowe & & Mrs R M Gorell
Spotlight: 130,000gns yearling; already-gelded son of No Nay Never; half-brother to winners Maybe Not (7f-1m including AW; RPR 95) and Glencalvie (1m including AW; 78); dam 7f/8.6f AW winner (91), half-sister to smart winners English Oak (7f/1m) and Forest Of Dean (1m2f Group 3); faces just one rival on his introduction and he's in good hands; market should prove telling.

RaceName: Colin Hinton & Mitch Hinton Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Confirmed the promise of her November debut (good to soft) when taking Kempton novice (also 7f, AW) one month later; half-sister to connections' Group 1 winners Bluestocking and Qirat whose trainer hoped could progress into a Pattern performer in a spring stable tour; has been found a cracking opportunity to start out on that journey.

RaceName: Tattersalls £40,000 EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 600,000euros breeze-up buy who did best of those coming from off the pace when fourth of 13 at Goodwood (7f, good to firm; Clarity fifth, Orchard Hatches eighth) on her introduction a fortnight ago; holds Pattern-race entries and connections took this with a future Group 2 winner in 2024; a mile will suit on breeding and she's probably the one to beat.

RaceName: Tattersalls £40,000 EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Similar form when beaten around 4l in Kempton novice (6f, AW) last month and valuable Goodwood maiden (7f, good to firm; Siena Storm 2l ahead, Orchard Hatches behind) three weeks later; goes up in trip again and she's probably still getting the hang of things; can be expected to do better.

RaceName: Tattersalls £40,000 EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 125-1 when she did quite a bit wrong before finshing eighth of 13 at Goodwood (7f, good to firm; Siena Storm fourth, Clarity fifth) a fortnight ago; looks sure to prove better than that at some point, but might be one for further down the line.

RaceName: Tattersalls £40,000 EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Showed signs of inexperience before finishing fourth of ten at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) on her debut four weeks ago; that initial effort already gives her solid claims and runner-up Flooding (declared for 6:04 on this card) may give the form a boost; pedigree suggests this new trip may suit and she's a player.

RaceName: British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: In-form filly who scraped home at Hamilton (1m3f, good to firm) in June before going fairly close at Newcastle (12.5f, AW) one month later; goes up in grade again but she's getting better and needs respecting.

RaceName: British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Tends to lead; won twice last summer and she also went close here (again 1m2f, good) in October; yet to match latter form in two starts this term and now tries a new trip.

RaceName: British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Lady Bamford , Mrs Collins & Bv Sangster
Spotlight: Prominent racer who is only a neck away from being on a five-timer, with two wins at Ffos Las supplemented by success at Leicester (1m4f, good to firm) three weeks ago; those wins came in small fields and this is a hike in grade but she's still a player; one of two for a yard that's ticking along nicely.

RaceName: British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Rampant since joining Rod Millman and she was 7lb well in when completing a July hat-trick at Newbury (13.5f, good to firm) four weeks ago; runs off her revised rating this time but this drop back in trip should be no bother and she needs to be taken very seriously.

RaceName: British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Steadily progressive filly who made the running when taking 1m2f handicaps (good to firm) at Doncaster and Beverley this year; didn't get the breaks at Pontefract last time and this return to 1m4f is no reason to rule her out.

RaceName: British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Bar a soft-ground blip she's been in good form since switched to handicaps and she made the breakthrough over C&D (good to firm) 19 days ago; like stablemate Liveinthelight she goes up in grade but similarly has her best days ahead of her and warrants consideration.

RaceName: British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Unexposed filly who won Thirsk novice (good) in June and made a winning handicap debut at Newmarket (also 1m4f, good to firm) one month later; looked better the further she went last time and a 4lb rise shouldn't stop her being very competitive in the hat-trick bid.

RaceName: Venture Security Handicap
Spotlight: After an encouraging debut she made good strides in three subsequent starts, winning a maiden (1m, AW), Bath novice and Nottingham handicap (also 1m2f, good to firm); handicapper couldn't go overboard after that latter success a fortnight ago; leading contender in bid for the four-timer.

RaceName: Venture Security Handicap
Spotlight: Sauntered home in a June juvenile hurdle and, after getting turned over in similar event at Stratford six days later, he got up late to land four-runner handicap over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; first-time cheekpieces worn that day are retained and he's respected up 3lb.

RaceName: Venture Security Handicap
Spotlight: Looked good when winning twice on AW (1m/7f) in the spring but his form on turf doesn't bear comparison, albeit his last start on grass came in a warm handicap; proved underwhelming on AW last time and he now tackles a new trip with a question to answer.

RaceName: Venture Security Handicap
Spotlight: Unexposed filly who won Doncaster novice (1m2f, good to firm) in June and it was a solid handicap debut when fairly close fourth at Chester (10.5f, good) three weeks ago; unraced at two and it will be disappointing if we've already seen the best of her.

RaceName: Bar 1 Betting Rated Novice Chase
Spotlight: Has hit top form recently; followed up an easy win in a weak Downpatrick maiden hurdle (2m2f, good) with success in a Sligo novice contest (2m2f, good); his rating of 120 over hurdles is the best on offer here but he must transfer it to fences on this chasing bow.

RaceName: Bar 1 Betting Rated Novice Chase
Spotlight: Dual-purpose sort; rated 112 over hurdles; was in the process of running a cracker when returning from 745 days off on his chasing debut at Wexford before falling at the last; pulled a long way clear with one other at Roscommon 13 days later when runner-up (2m1f, soft); this is another run relatively quickly but he looks like he has improved for fences.

RaceName: Bar 1 Betting Rated Novice Chase
Spotlight: Bagged back-to-back mares' handicap hurdles in January/March at Down Royal and Leopardstown at 2m1f/2m3f on soft ground; form has dipped in three runs since, including when beaten 18.5l at Galway last time (2m1f, good); cheekpieces return and the tongue tie is new; one of the top rated over hurdles for this chasing bow but needs to bring her best.

RaceName: Bar 1 Betting Rated Novice Chase
Spotlight: Won back-to-back handicaps at Cork (2m1f, good) and Tipperary (2m, good to yielding) in August/October; hasn't hit same heights since; unplaced in points and switch to chasing didn't bring improvement at Killarney last time when beaten 28l.

RaceName: Bar 1 Betting Rated Novice Chase
Spotlight: Dual hurdles winner got off the mark over fences for the first time at the eighth attempt at the Galway festival (2m2f, good); 4lb penalty for that could prove pivotal and his overall form doesn't suggest that a follow-up is guaranteed; trainer won this race last year though.

RaceName: Bar 1 Betting Rated Novice Chase
Spotlight: Flat winner is 1-11 over hurdles, having been successful in a Leopardstown maiden hurdle in March (2m, soft to heavy); good runner-up finish to the smart Switch From Diesel in a Punchestown novice hurdle in June was his best run since (2m1f, good); makes chasing debut now and his hurdles rating of 115 gives him a shout but his recent runs have been a bit below his best.

RaceName: O'Neill's Bar Beginners Chase
OwnerName: Trevor Payne/One In A Million Syndicate
Spotlight: Rated 108 over hurdles; gained a first success at the 12th attempt over hurdles in a weak Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last time (2m3f, good); he's in good form for his chasing debut but others are more appealing.

RaceName: O'Neill's Bar Beginners Chase
OwnerName: John Joseph Flynn & Conor Lannen & Mrs Miriam Queally
Spotlight: Beaten a long way in a bumper and four hurdle starts, the latest on handicap debut; mark of 97 over hurdles is possibly flattering so work to do on chasing bow.

RaceName: O'Neill's Bar Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Point-to-point winner took the runner-up spot at Punchestown (2m3f, good to yielding) and Roscommon (2m5f, good) before running below his best at Galway (2m6f, good); ignoring his last run he's in good form, he has a healthy hurdles rating of 110 and he has a point background, so there's a lot to like.

RaceName: O'Neill's Bar Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Rated 100 after five runs over fences; the latest of those was a positive third in a Roscommon handicap chase in August last year (2m6f, yielding) off 99; made winning stable debut in a Killarney handicap hurdle in May (2m4f, good to yielding); tailed off at Ballinrobe last time; most experienced of these but others probably more talented.

RaceName: O'Neill's Bar Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Placed in a point before falling in his second; 0-9 over hurdles but some okay runs in defeat; runner-up in a Cork handicap hurdle off 105 on stable debut in May; didn't match that in two subsequent outings; could do better over fences; not dismissed.

RaceName: O'Neill's Bar Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Enjoyed a purple patch last summer, winning three handicap hurdles on the bounce at 2m5f-2m7f on good ground; generally struggled since and his latest two runs have been fairly dismal; returns to chasing for the first time since 2024, when he didn't set things alight in three beginners'.

RaceName: O'Neill's Bar Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Lightly raced; took well to fences when just run out of it late in a beginners' at Wexford in June; blinkers stay on and he looks like he will rate higher over fences compared to his hurdles rating of 102; interesting.

RaceName: O'Neill's Bar Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Is 0-16 over hurdles and rated 100 in that sphere; nonetheless, his 9l fifth of nine at Killarney last month was one of his better efforts (2m5f, good); fences need to bring improvement.

RaceName: O'Neill's Bar Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Shaped with promise in maidens but serious jumping issues evident on handicap debut at Clonmel in May (2m4f, good to yielding) and his tailed-off finish at Bellewstown last time (3m1f, good) was concerning; rated 107 over hurdles and this yard does wonders with horses over fences so not ruled out on first try chasing with a tongue tie added.

RaceName: McDonald & Son Builders Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Outran 40-1 odds when a fine second of 17 on debut in a Clonmel maiden hurdle (2m1f, good) despite jumping badly right at second obstacle; proved that was no fluke when winning a 2m Kilbeggan bumper 11 days later; fell at the sixth back over hurdles at Cork last time; must carry a penalty for his bumper win.

RaceName: McDonald & Son Builders Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Is 0-8 on the Flat in Britain; pulled up in three of four starts over hurdles and in the other he was beaten 90l; impossible to fancy.

RaceName: McDonald & Son Builders Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Has looked limited on the Flat, beating few rivals in four starts; tailed off at Limerick last time; hard to fancy.

RaceName: McDonald & Son Builders Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Ran okay in an academy hurdle on testing ground at Naas in December, but better in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle on good ground last month when taking the runner-up spot; entitled to improve on that as it came after a 221-day break and if she does she won't be far away.

RaceName: McDonald & Son Builders Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Yet to trouble the judge in seven Flat runs; well beaten off 93 on his handicap hurdle debut at Kilbeggan last time (2m, good); others preferred.

RaceName: McDonald & Son Builders Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Second in a 1m2f Flat maiden at Ripon last year when trained by owner's son; well beaten in three Flat starts for current yard, but there was promise in his fourth of 15 on hurdling bow at Ballinrobe last time (2m2f, good); in the mix if building on that.

RaceName: McDonald & Son Builders Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: One of two for trainer; well beaten in a bumper at Ballinrobe (2m1f, good); just slight improvement at Sligo when sent over hurdles (2m2f, good); others preferred.

RaceName: McDonald & Son Builders Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Three starts in academy hurdles on softer ground than this; best run when in second place and unseating at the last at Cork on debut; on first run of the year, was tailed off at the same venue last time; trainer also runs Noble Rocco.

RaceName: McDonald & Son Builders Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Gelded son of the German-bred stallion Bathyrhon; first foal; dam French 1m winner, half-sister to German 1m Listed winner; market best guide.

RaceName: McDonald & Son Builders Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Modest Flat maiden was pulled up at 300-1 on his hurdling bow at Cork (2m2f, good); hard to fancy.

RaceName: McDonald & Son Builders Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Order Of St George filly; fifth foal; sister to winners Nitty Gritty (2m4f hurdle) and Sky Grove (2m hurdle), half-sister to bumper winner Lionnar; dam unraced sister to useful bumper/2m3f hurdle winner Level Neverending; hooded for debut but entitled to respect given the trainer.

RaceName: McDonald & Son Builders Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Tailed off at Kilbeggan on debut at 66-1; unlikely.

RaceName: Flynn Hotel Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Downpatrick hurdle winner in 2024 for Paul Flynn; came back from a long absence for this yard with a close second over hurdles at Wexford; got off the mark over fences since at the same track; should go well.

RaceName: Flynn Hotel Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a Kilbeggan handicap hurdle in 2024 for John McConnell; came back to form in first-time blinkers to easily win on the Flat here over 1m4f last time; has to be respected back hurdling assuming the blinkers have the desired effect again.

RaceName: Flynn Hotel Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Kilbeggan maiden hurdle winner two years ago for former yard; has been consistent in defeat lately for this stable at around this trip and should run well again.

RaceName: Flynn Hotel Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner for Joseph O'Brien last year; similar runs in defeat at Killarney and Galway lately so has to find more even dropped 2lb.

RaceName: Flynn Hotel Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: One-time useful dual-purpose sort when trained in UK; however, has been poor on his last three runs (two over hurdles) and others preferred.

RaceName: Flynn Hotel Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Hints of ability in maidens but has to improve plenty from handicap debut at Wexford last time when beaten 24l.

RaceName: WTW Willis Rated Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Got off the mark when winning a 2m Limerick maiden hurdle in May and was a solid second in a Ballinrobe novice last time over 2m1f; stayed this trip in France so has to be considered for a top local yard.

RaceName: WTW Willis Rated Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Sligo bumper winner last year took a Downpatrick maiden hurdle over 2m3f in May; improved from his handicap debut at the same track when runner-up over 3m at Galway last time; can run well again.

RaceName: WTW Willis Rated Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Was a wide-margin winner of a Limerick maiden hurdle over this trip but was poor in a Galway novice since so has to rebound.

RaceName: WTW Willis Rated Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle over 2m6f here in May; a decent run in a Downpatrick novice since but was beaten 32l there last time; has a lot to do in this company on these terms.

RaceName: WTW Willis Rated Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Second runner for yard; won a 2m Clonmel maiden hurdle and added a Perth novice over 2m4f since; this is more competitive but has to be considered.

RaceName: WTW Willis Rated Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a 2m Kilbeggan maiden hurdle and bounced back from two lesser runs over further to take a Market Rasen novice over this trip; this is more competitive but has a chance.

RaceName: WTW Willis Rated Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Was third in a valuable Fairyhouse restricted bumper on debut last year; lesser bumper run in January; belied inexperience to win on hurdles debut at Killarney over this trip; there should be more to come and is a big player.

RaceName: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Was beaten 20l over C&D in April but pulled-up next time at Punchestown; has to find improvement for a new yard.

RaceName: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Third in a Clonmel handicap over this trip on debut for this yard last October; has a shout if she can repeat that after a break.

RaceName: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden showed promise in four bumpers in 2024 and in two maiden hurdles last year; hit and miss this year and has to rebound from two poor runs.

RaceName: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has shown a hint of ability in bumpers and over hurdles but was beaten a long way in a Wexford handicap last time so others preferred.

RaceName: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden was a close third at Cork last month over 2m1f but was below that level since over the same C&D; has to rebound back up in trip.

RaceName: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Point winner on soft ground ran his best race over hurdles when fourth over 3m at Kilbeggan last time; this shorter trip might not suit as well but still one to consider.

RaceName: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle
Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden ran well enough on second handicap start at Wexford last time but was still beaten 16l; needs a fair bit more off 2lb lower.

RaceName: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Was regressive over hurdles over the winter in testing ground; fell on stable/chasing debut last time; others make more appeal.

RaceName: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a Sligo maiden hurdle last summer but has been mostly below that level since; better last time at Wexford in first-time cheekpieces over 3m; this trip suits better and could go well with the headgear retained.

RaceName: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: One of his three chase wins came here; has also claimed two hurdle races plus was runner-up in this race last year off 6lb lower;  pulled-up over fences at Galway last time but can bounce back over hurdles.

RaceName: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Ran her best race over hurdles when fourth in heavy ground here in 2025; not a bad run at Cork last time over 2m1f; a squeak if staying this trip.

RaceName: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Mild promise in bumpers but not much over hurdles and isn't easy to make a case for her.

RaceName: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Best handicap run came when beaten only 9l at Kilbeggan over 15.5f; carried out early at Killarney since; blinkers added today and should stay this trip; a player.

RaceName: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Not a bad run at Kilbeggan over 3m but has to rebound from a poor effort over this trip at Killarney.

RaceName: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Third in a Cork bumper on debut last year but hasn't built on that over hurdles; is still worth a market check on handicap debut after a break with a tongue-tie added.

RaceName: Conor Lannen Country Store (Ladies) Maiden
Spotlight: A 132-rated hurdler has run well in defeat on the Flat several times including when third over 1m4f here on return last month; however, was poor over hurdles at Galway since and has to rebound; the hood worn then is left off.

RaceName: Conor Lannen Country Store (Ladies) Maiden
Spotlight: Made all to win over hurdles here in May and bounced back from a poor Galway run to again make all to win a Wexford handicap hurdle six days ago; goes well here and should be a player but likes to get her own way in front.

RaceName: Conor Lannen Country Store (Ladies) Maiden
Spotlight: Has been in the form of her career this season, winning handicap hurdles at Ballinrobe and Kilbeggan before finishing a close third at Galway; now rated 129 in that sphere so has to be respected on Flat debut over a trip that will suit.

RaceName: Conor Lannen Country Store (Ladies) Maiden
OwnerName: John J Flynn, Pierce Flynn, Conor Lannen
Spotlight: Won a Wexford bumper a year ago and has run some solid races in defeat over hurdles since including at Cork last time; beaten 10l in a Leopardstown maiden on sole Flat start; has a bit to find but can be involved.

RaceName: Conor Lannen Country Store (Ladies) Maiden
Spotlight: Produced a solid effort on debut when a close fourth over 1m4f here last month; with improvement forthcoming she could turn the tables on the placed horses then, Kimy and Dream On Baby; this trip is a question on pedigree, though.

RaceName: Conor Lannen Country Store (Ladies) Maiden
Spotlight: Sole win over hurdles came here in 2024; also ran well on the Flat here when second in a 1m4f maiden when 1.25l ahead of Dream On Baby; well below that level at Galway since so has to rebound.

RaceName: Conor Lannen Country Store (Ladies) Maiden
Spotlight: Bumper and dual hurdle winner up to 2m4f (rated 132); the best of two Flat runs when beaten 11l in a 1m4f maiden at Galway last time; this longer trip will suit better and is a big player.

RaceName: Conor Lannen Country Store (Ladies) Maiden
Spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner stays 2m6f in that sphere and rated 110; beaten a long way on sole Flat start at Ballinrobe on return this year but can do better today.

RaceName: Conor Lannen Country Store (Ladies) Maiden
Spotlight: Maiden in all spheres was tailed-off in a 1m4f Galway maiden on return for a new yard so can't be fancied on that showing.

RaceName: Play The Matchbook Match 6 Handicap
Spotlight: No match for Maid In Devon three runs back but probably his best form yet when beating Solar Invincible over C&D 17 days ago; 4lb rise is fair enough.

RaceName: Play The Matchbook Match 6 Handicap
Spotlight: Bath maiden winner last July (5.5f); lightly raced since and pretty poor in his last two starts.

RaceName: Play The Matchbook Match 6 Handicap
Spotlight: Secured her hat-trick over 6f on soft and fast ground; only 2lb higher than for the last of those wins and it wasn't her fault when losing position quite early last time at Salisbury; needs considering.

RaceName: Play The Matchbook Match 6 Handicap
Spotlight: Best of his three runs was on debut in a 7f novice at Doncaster; subsequent efforts leave him with much to prove on this handicap debut.

RaceName: Play The Matchbook Match 6 Handicap
Spotlight: Won a 6f AW race in Ireland on second career start; close fifth on her handicap debut afterwards when tried in a hood that's been absent since (lost her way); sold in July for 3,000gns; others safer.

RaceName: Play The Matchbook Match 6 Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't looked on that good a mark since winning as a 2yo and ordinary of late, with and without headgear.

RaceName: Play The Matchbook Match 6 Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden who has been disappointing since finishing second in a 6f sales race at Newmarket a year ago and was no match for the winner when second in a small field three weeks back (5f; second run in blinkers); makes handicap debut on ninth career start.

RaceName: Play The Matchbook Match 6 Handicap
Spotlight: Back at 5f when going close in a maiden here recently; didn't really threaten in two handicaps prior to that, even when second at Lingfield; should run well but perhaps vulnerable.

RaceName: Play The Matchbook Match 6 Handicap
Spotlight: 0-5 for Richard Hannon; successful seasonal/stable debut at Bath (5.5f, good to firm) in May but lesser performances have followed.

RaceName: Play The Matchbook Match 6 Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins at 5f on Southwell AW; second at Leicester (6f) before a lesser show here 17 days ago when she got warm before the race; could be given another chance.

RaceName: Play The Matchbook Match 6 Handicap
Spotlight: Dual 5f winner who ran well on his belated return to 6f here 17 days ago, finishing second to Madman despite taking a strong hold; Billy Loughnane has been aboard for both his wins and he now returns.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
Spotlight: Ran three times as a 2yo for Karl Burke before moving to Ireland, where he won a handicap at Dundalk (7f, AW) in March; joined this yard for 6,000gns and finished second at Yarmouth last month (6-5f; 7f); this is a belated first go at 6f but he has shown early speed.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time course winner (5f/6f) who often leads, as was the case when a 4l third of five here ten days ago; that was a bit disappointing.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
Spotlight: All the better for wind/gelding operations, since producing figures of 3212131; it was by a narrow margin last time and the second disappointed at Chepstow earlier this week, but this 4yo only went up 1lb.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
Spotlight: Only 1-15 and recently joined this yard for 5,000gns; didn't get the clearest of runs behind Rianka at Yarmouth but she's unconvincing.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time winner for George Scott; signs of getting back on track off her reduced mark last month only to then run poorly last week at Ffos Las.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
Spotlight: Exploited reduced mark on yard debut over C&D but was beaten at odds-on when escaping a penalty at Ffos Las; that was a missed opportunity as he's now 6lb higher.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
Spotlight: Consistent maiden who was no worse for the hood going on when fourth at Salisbury (6f); she would have been closer with a clearer run.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
Spotlight: 3-23; got going too late when runner-up over Brighton's 6f last week; might again hit a flat spot here and may prefer some give underfoot.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
Spotlight: Out of a Listed winner; contesting only her second handicap (tongue tied for both) when coming from behind to win narrowly at Yarmouth (6f); has to be considered off 3lb higher.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
Spotlight: Has got closer in each of her runs, last time showing good speed before weakening into third over Bath's extended 5f; doesn't look on a strikingly good mark for handicap debut but still early days for this well-bred filly, and Liam Wright takes off 5lb.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
Spotlight: Looked limited in four Irish runs (5f-7f) for Joseph O'Brien and was sold on for 3,500gns; handicap debut.

RaceName: ~matchbook Loves Racing Handicap
Spotlight: 1m2f novice winner in April; rather disappointing afterwards but he was then well backed last time at Ayr (1m2f) and beat all bar an Ed Walker improver; 2lb higher with a tongue-tie added and firmly enters the reckoning; should be fine back at 1m.

RaceName: ~matchbook Loves Racing Handicap
Spotlight: Four-time turf winner; cheekpieces applied for final three races and after two thirds (1m) he got no luck in running at Chester; now having first run for Tom Ward and wouldn't rule out.

RaceName: ~matchbook Loves Racing Handicap
Spotlight: A suspicion that 7f might suit him best but after starting slowly he did keep on over 1m at Newbury last time, albeit some 9l off the winner; the handicapper knows all about him.

RaceName: ~matchbook Loves Racing Handicap
Spotlight: 1m novice winner at two and then gelded; slow starts weren't helping matters this season but raced in touch last time at Lingfield (1m1f) and they all bumped into an improver; could go well.

RaceName: ~matchbook Loves Racing Handicap
Spotlight: Came good at 11th attempt from off the pace over C&D in June (3lb lower) and the steady pace wasn't beneficial when last of the four at Epsom; consistent in the main.

RaceName: ~matchbook Loves Racing Handicap
Spotlight: Won two in a row last May (1m, good) and is 7lb below his last winning mark; however, hasn't produced an effort of note since returning to Britain after a stint at Meydan.

RaceName: ~matchbook Loves Racing Handicap
OwnerName: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum
Spotlight: The season started well but this front-runner has dropped away tamely in his last three races, albeit strong handicaps; this might not be so challenging and could go well if getting any freedom up front.

RaceName: ~matchbook Loves Racing Handicap
Spotlight: 2-5 in France, the wins coming at 1m on slow ground; later sold for 130,000euros and since had wind surgery; Billy Loughnane booked but the ground has to be a worry.

RaceName: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Had plenty of chances now (0-10) but he hasn't always enjoyed the best of luck in showing useful form, as was again the case when third in a competitive 1m3f handicap at Glorious Goodwood (first-time blinkers); he's the standout danger to the regally-bred newcomer Partying.

RaceName: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Frankel filly who cost 4,400,000gns as a yearling; second foal out of a 7f/1m winner (RPR 116), closely related to 1m2f winner Gamrai; bred in accordance with her purchase price and the betting should be highly revealing.

RaceName: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Probably achieved little when a remote fourth over C&D last month (300-1).

RaceName: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 40-1 when completely tailed off at Nottingham last month (1m2f).

RaceName: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Beaten 17l behind none other than Bow Echo on his debut in August and the following month beat one home at Southwell (1m), though did get closer; could be one for handicaps.

RaceName: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Modest form under National Hunt rules and pretty much tailed off in two 7f novice races.

RaceName: RIP Susan Procter Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Both handicap wins have come by narrow margins at Class 3 level and it was a deep Class 2 in which he made no impact last time at Sandown; he's not handicapped out of it if he stays this longer distance (unraced beyond 8.6f).

RaceName: RIP Susan Procter Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Progressed well this year and was doing all his best work late when mid-division in a big field at Glorious Goodwood (1m); stays 1m1f and he'll probably stay this far; has more to offer.

RaceName: RIP Susan Procter Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: This is a classier race than he's accustomed to but he's been in fine form since returning from a break and it was comfortable over C&D a month ago; 6lb rise demands another career best but couldn't put it past him.

RaceName: RIP Susan Procter Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Close third over C&D in May since when he's been up against it in Class 2s won by a Group horse and then the John Smith's Cup, in which he ran perfectly well for a 66-1 chance; very capable of a big show, though the cheekpieces are new and so too is Donagh Murphy claiming 7lb.

RaceName: RIP Susan Procter Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Had gone badly off the boil but back in a Class 4 he came from behind to score narrowly at Chester (extended 1m2f); if he's turned a corner then likely to have some say off 3lb higher.

RaceName: RIP Susan Procter Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Four of his six wins have been at Chester where he nearly won again when last seen 11 months ago; trip/ground fine and on a fair mark, but market confidence would be welcomed after so long out.

RaceName: RIP Susan Procter Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Gina Mangan picked up a 12-day ban when this 4yo was given a lot to do at Ffos Las and he then won by a length under Oisin Murphy here over 1m; has never raced beyond that trip but gives the impression he'll stay this far; up in class off a 5lb higher mark.

RaceName: RIP Susan Procter Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Five turf wins but has done most of his winning on the AW; surprising to see blinkers back on having won in a visor at Chester last month and then beaten only 4l in a Class 2 handicap at Goodwood; if that doesn't backfire then has possibilities.

RaceName: Classic Golden Music Group 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Ex-Irish filly who is 3-5 for current yard, all the wins coming on fast ground at Chepstow (1m2f-1m4f); won as she liked last week so could well make light of the penalty.

RaceName: Classic Golden Music Group 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Gelded ahead of his handicap debut at Sandown where he lacked the pace of the front two over 1m2f; this extra yardage can trigger some improvement.

RaceName: Classic Golden Music Group 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Carries a penalty for the Ffos Las win (1m, good) as he escapes one for winning an apprentice race over 1m2f here on Monday, which was only by a neck but he had to be switched; competes off the same mark and Billy Loughnane is back on; should have no trouble seeing out this longer trip.

RaceName: Classic Golden Music Group 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Exposed but consistent and dug deep to prevail in a close finish over 1m2f here a month ago (they went steady); every chance off 2lb higher; third over this trip the time before.
