Spotlight: 68,000gns yearling; half-brother to four winners, notably Embesto (1m Group 3; RPR 113) and Silent Film (7f-1m; RPR 105); dam French 5f-6.5f Group 3 winner (RPR 108); this Ghaiyyath colt holds a Group 2 Royal Lodge entry so rates an interesting newcomer.

RaceName: Meadowhall X Flannels Beauty Bar EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 9-2, shaped well when fourth of six in novice at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) on his debut 18 days ago, running on late under hand riding; this son of Frankel looks to have a fair bit more to offer; big shout.

RaceName: Meadowhall X Flannels Beauty Bar EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 28-1, never-dangerous fifth of ten in 7f AW novice at Lingfield on his debut last month; this Territories colt can build on it here.

RaceName: Meadowhall X Flannels Beauty Bar EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 10-1 and green when a debut seventh of eight in 7f Kempton novice ten days ago; this Minzaal colt can take a step forward.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
OwnerName: Kevin Frost Racing Club & Mike Humphries
Spotlight: Winless since 2024 but this veteran arrives in decent nick, runner-up at Newbury (7f) in June before a creditable tenth of 17 in 7f Ascot handicap last month; not totally dismissed.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
OwnerName: David Orr & Miss L A Perratt
Spotlight: Ended a losing sequence at Ayr (1m) in May and largely in good nick since, sixth of ten in 1m handicap at Hamilton two weeks ago; no forlorn hope eased 1lb.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Doubled her tally over C&D in June and was right back on song when close second at Lingfield (7f, good to firm) last month but has a point to prove after weakening quickly on AW a fortnight ago.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: A fair 7f scorer for Marco Botti last June; back on song for his current stable when second of 11 over C&D in June; not out of things despite a 2lb weights rise.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
OwnerName: The Good Racing Company Ltd & Partner
Spotlight: Gained a first win over C&D last July but well below that level in five subsequent starts, although he suffered a poor run when tenth of 12 in 1m Ripon handicap in June; cheekpieces go on after a break.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Scored at Newcastle (1m) in June but he has failed to reproduce it in three turf outings since and came in last of 11 at Haydock (7f) eight days ago; others are much preferred.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
OwnerName: Future Champions Racing Syn & Ben Haslam
Spotlight: A two-time scorer (including over C&D) for Michael Appleby last summer; well below par for his present handler this season, however, and he failed to beat a rival in 1m Pontefract handicap last time.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Ended a losing run over C&D in July and quickly followed up with comfortable success in 7f Yarmouth handicap 18 days ago; up another 7lb now but very much one to consider in his hat-trick bid.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Ended 2025 with 7f Newcastle victory and he's back in very good form of late, third of 14 in 1m handicap at Redcar a week ago; a likely player eased 1lb.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Back in fine form this summer since stepped up to 7f and he narrowly completed a hat-trick under a 7lb penalty at Ayr 19 days ago; this strong traveller merits serious consideration despite a further 3lb rise.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Resumed winning ways at Pontefract (6f) in June but below par in big-field 6f handicaps at York on his last two runs; this course scorer needs to bounce back on a rare run over 7f.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Course winner who comes here on the back of a respectable seventh of 12 in 6f Southwell handicap 19 days ago; possibilities from a falling mark.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Low-mileage 6yo who is much improved for his new yard this summer, gaining a second success in his last three runs in 6f handicap at Newmarket last month; up 4lb but that form has been well advertised since so he merits serious consideration.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive sort who notched a third victory of 2026 at Lingfield (5f) in June; went very freely from widest draw and did well in circumstances when fifth of 13 in 6f Windsor handicap last time; a player eased 1lb.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Won three times over 5f in 2025; got back on track in first-time cheekpieces with fourth of ten in 6f Chester handicap in June; no forlorn hope off a 2lb lower mark here with headgear retained.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Scored at Wolverhampton (6f) in January and largely in good nick since, challenging wide when sixth of ten in another 6f handicap there last time; can make his presence felt.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Has progressed really well this season and notched a third success over 6f here in June; posted a good fifth of ten in 6f handicap at Newmarket (form franked) last month so must enter calculations.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Not proving the easiest to catch right since going in at Newcastle (5f) in February but he comes here on the back of a good second of six in 5f Newmarket handicap a week ago; in the mix if on his A-game again.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
OwnerName: Future Champions Racing Syn & Mps Racing
Spotlight: A fair 6f maiden winner at Sligo in May and signed off for Paddy Twomey with very good second in 7f Fairyhouse novice following month; since changed hands for 40,000gns and not out of things on his yard/handicap debut after a break.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Signed off for Richard Newland and Jamie Insole with victory in 6f handicap at Haydock in April; up 6lb and needs to hit the ground running for his new handler after an absence.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Got off the mark at Newcastle (5f) in January but he has failed to build on it and came in last in 5f handicaps at Haydock and Hamilton (hooded) on his last two runs; others are much preferred.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: A fairly useful 5f winner in 2025; yet to hit top form this season though, third of four in 5f Nottingham handicap last month; more is needed despite a tumbling mark.

RaceName: Luxury Looks From The Avenue At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Notched a second success of 2026 at Ripon (1m) in July and followed it with a very good third of seven off an 8lb higher mark in another 1m handicap there 12 days ago; must enter calculations.

RaceName: Luxury Looks From The Avenue At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Gained a first success at Leicester (1m) in June but has failed to kick on since, just seventh of ten in 1m Ayr handicap five days ago; hood is reached for now.

RaceName: Luxury Looks From The Avenue At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Fair 1m maiden for Francis-Henri Graffard; off four months before a never-dangerous seventh of ten for new stable in 9.5f handicap at Wolverhampton in June; more is needed after another break.

RaceName: Luxury Looks From The Avenue At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Fair maiden for William Haggas; has made a bright start for her new handler and gained a breakthrough victory in 1m Windsor handicap 19 days ago; not taken lightly nudged up 2lb.

RaceName: Luxury Looks From The Avenue At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Scored at Wolverhampton (8.5f) in December but he's not proving the easiest to catch right this season, only ninth of 18 at Galway (8.5f) 15 days ago.

RaceName: Luxury Looks From The Avenue At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Son of Ghaiyyath who is on the up since sent handicapping, scoring over C&D and at Yarmouth (1m) last month; up 4lb but another bold showing is on the cards in his hat-trick bid.

RaceName: Luxury Looks From The Avenue At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: A fair 7.5f winner as a 2yo; returned to form after wind surgery with third of seven in 7.5f handicap at Beverley 18 days ago; needs to back it up now.

RaceName: Raceday Ready With Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Winner at Ayr (1m5f) and Musselburgh (1m4f) in June and has run well on all three starts since, runner-up over 1m3f and 2m on last two occasions; latest was quite a rare run in cheekpieces; should be bang there.

RaceName: Raceday Ready With Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Staying-on third over 1m2f on handicap debut and duly built on that when plugging on well to get on top close home at 10-11 in a seven-runner 1m4f race at Catterick (again good to firm) 18 days later; 5lb rise demands more from her but another step up in trip today may well provide it; big chance.

RaceName: Raceday Ready With Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Often a front-runner and the last six of his seven wins were on Southwell AW, with the latest in March; Elle-May Croot knows him especially well and he's back 1lb below his last winning mark but the return to Southwell (from turf) for latest outing did not spark an upturn; best watched at present.

RaceName: Raceday Ready With Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Modest maiden after six races, failing to kick on in handicaps this term; tried blinkers on latest start; now it's cheekpieces and a longer trip.

RaceName: Raceday Ready With Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Fifth of ten in handicap at Southwell (1m3f, AW) on latest start was his closest finish but he still has major work to do; wore cheekpieces that day and connections now turn to blinkers and an extra 3f.

RaceName: Raceday Ready With Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Best of his five efforts when fourth of 11 in 1m Southwell maiden (AW) in January with a first-time hood, which has been kept since; upped in trip again today but the heavy defeats in his two handicaps (last of three in latest) means that caution is advised.

RaceName: Raceday Ready With Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Visored first time (occasionally tried other headgear) when a hampered, running-on second of seven under 7lb claimer over 1m4f at Beverley 18 days ago and that was the best Flat result since his win in January 2024; unraced beyond that latest 1m4f on Flat (second over a sharp 2m1f as hurdler); place chance but, with a 1-30 strike-rate, probably not the percentage call.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
OwnerName: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor
Spotlight: Placings last autumn included over C&D; hasn't improved this year but wasn't beaten far in Curragh handicap; recent Navan maiden fourth was a good bit below best; should be thereabouts but possibly vulnerable.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Sister to Listed-winning sprinter Grand Marques; keen enough on both maiden runs in the spring, second occasion not quite getting home over stiff finish at Navan when third (second won next time and now rated 90); that looks decent form and could well play a major role here.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
OwnerName: N W T Dalzell & Edward Lynam
Spotlight: Three runs here in the spring were ordinary enough when never really competitive; can't rule out on return but looks a more likely one for handicaps.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Experienced filly began the season on a rating of 80, having twice finished second in Curragh 2yo maidens; regressive this season though and needs to bounce back; good draw.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Sister to Group 3-winning sprinter Ostraka and half-sister to 5f/6f winner Charlemont; dam Listed-placed 5f winner, is half-sister to 6f Group 3 winner Osterhase; visored when shaping with definite promise on Cork debut in June, weakening late on when fourth (third won next time); better for that and could play a major role here.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: No impact on sole 2yo run in 7f heavy ground maiden at Listowel and early speed on return at Cork last month, weakening into midfield; drops in trip and tongue-tie tried.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Showed some promise in Britain at two; not beaten too far on yard debut last month in Curragh handicap despite slow start; more needed however back in maiden company.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Ducked right at start when well held in maidens at the Curragh and Navan; headgear combination now fitted and seems best watched.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Half-brother to yard's smart 7f/8f performer Indigo Five; didn't count last month in 6f maidens at Navan and Cork; drop back in trip unlikely to suit and eligible for a mark after this.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: 15,000euros yearling; Mehmas colt; half-brother to winners Geometrical (Group-placed 7.5f/1m) and Slaney Tide (1m2f); dam unraced half-sister to smart 1m/1m2f winner King's Gambit, out of sister to 1m Group 1 winner Sophisticat; trip sharp on pedigree.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Big odds, soundly beaten twice in Curragh maidens in June; back in trip and seems best watched.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Shaped okay on second start last season in Navan maiden, not so good on comeback run at Cork in June; seems the lesser likely of the Stack pair and draw far from ideal.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Blue Point filly has been highly tried the last twice, staying on fifth (beaten 3.5l) in Naas Listed and outclassed in Group 3 Silver Flash at Leopardstown last month (7f); drops in trip for first run in maiden company so has to be respected.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Promising debut in 6f Fairyhouse median sires series race last month when strong-finishing second after meeting trouble in running; week later showed good early speed in much better-class fillies' maiden over same C&D in finishing fourth; one to consider.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Eclipse T'bred Partners/Gaynor Bloodstock LLC/F Gallagher
Spotlight: Second in Naas barrier trial in May before satisfactory debut five days later when third in Listowel maiden; didn't improve on that when beaten favourite in Bellewstown auction maiden (albeit winner won again next time), never really overcoming a slow start over 5f; return to 6f to suit and tongue-tie tried; draw a negative.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Pinatubo filly cost 32,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to winners Arkendale (1m; RPR 89) and Ajdayet (8.6f AW; 83); dam 1m2f-1m4f maiden (71), half-sister to 7f 2yo Group 1 winner Intense Focus; debutante probably best watched unless market speaks.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Inns Of Court half-sister to winners Formidable Force (6f; RPR 86), Amaan (6f/7f inc 2yo/Bahrain; 86) and Karnavaal (7f; 85); dam twice-raced (62) sister to US 1m3f Grade 1 winner Prince Arch; debutante probably all the better for the experience.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Bayside Boy filly a 15,000euros yearling; first foal; dam 9.5f AW winner, is sister to 2yo Group 3 winner/1m Group 1-placed Marie's Diamond; green, never featured but some late headway on last month's Gowran debut (7f); better for that experience but not sure this drop in trip will suit.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 37,000euros yearling; dam 1m2f winner (inc AW; RPR 96), half-sister to 7f/1m Listed winner Shuwari, out of US 1m1f Grade 3 winner, is granddaughter of 1m1f winning half-sister to Champion Hurdle winner Annie Power; seventh of ten in a Naas barrier trial (behind Hip Hop Chrissy) in May.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Recent Sligo fourth (6f, yielding) a step in the right direction but more required here.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Magna Grecia half-sister to winners Catalyse (6f 2yo; RPR 87) and Toosha (German 6f AW); dam placed 6f 2yo (67), closely related to 11.6f Listed winner Kilimanjaro; newcomer best watched.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 100-1, never sighted when towards rear in good-class Curragh fillies contest last Sunday; can only be watched.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Cheaply bought Twilight Sun filly never counted on recent Sligo debut when a 20-1 chance; best watched.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Dandy Man filly cost 3,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to Qatari 6f-1m winner Mister Staple (inc 2yo); dam French 8.5f/1m1f AW winner (RPR 97), out of 7f 2yo/1m winning sister to Cheveley Park winner Magical Romance; headgear combination on for debut.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Starman filly cost 38,000euros as a yearling; third foal; dam unplaced over 5f, closely related to French 1m/1m4f winner Bolt Of Thunder, half-sister to 5f-7f winner Classy Clarets; slow to break, some late headway under considerate handling on debut into midfield in very valuable Ballyhane Stakes at Naas early this month; entitled to improve for that.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Bayside Boy filly a 30,000gns foal; second foal; half-sister to Italian 5.5f/6f winner Invincible Ronaldo (inc 2yo); dam French 6f-1m 2yo winner, out of 6f 2yo Listed winner; market likely best guide on debut.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
OwnerName: J Fairhurst & Damian McCann & Cyril McMullan
Spotlight: Five wins include twice over C&D and valuable Lingfield handicap in the spring; contesting premier turf handicaps of late, notably close third in Rockingham (Curragh), not clear run in the Ahonoora at Galway last time (7f); back to optimum trip now and one to consider.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
OwnerName: Elaine Shevlin & Cormac Farrell & Ms Denise McCourt
Spotlight: Won a 7f maiden here last October but hasn't really gone on from that, much the best effort when third behind Cuban Grey here over 5f in May; soon beaten following month at Fairyhouse; back from a break and tough task from 7lb out of handicap.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
Spotlight: All five wins have come on the AW, including twice over C&D last winter; encouraging turf return at Newmarket in May hasn't been built on, cheekpieces tried last time now ditched; back on favoured surface but races off 15lb higher mark.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
Spotlight: C&D maiden winner in April before adding Cork handicap over 5f; wasn't beaten far over same C&D last month on ground plenty quick; should appreciate return to 6f on this surface; likes to force it and has the ideal draw.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
Spotlight: Admirable sort whose seven wins include twice here over 5f, notably 0.5l defeat of Collective Power in April; arrives here on the back of two good runs over 5f at the Curragh but remains vulnerable at this trip.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time Fairyhouse winner has been running well this season but yet to get his head in front, most recently faring best of those racing stands' side when chasing home a rapid improver at Naas last month; 0-5 on AW but close second over C&D in April when last seen here; definite player with rider's claim a positive.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
OwnerName: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar
Spotlight: Five-time winner at the track at 5f-8f, including 4-runner minor contest last winter; out of form on turf in first half of season and last month's AW return leaves him with a fair bit to find with some of these.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
OwnerName: Exors of the Late Mrs S Power
Spotlight: Six-time course winner (four at this trip) and has gone close a few times this year, including last month when strong-finishing third (beaten 0.75l) to Kerdos over 5f, having had to be switched; big player now at his more favoured trip.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
OwnerName: Michael Scaife/Liam Ferguson/Simon Murphy/H S Khunkhuna
Spotlight: Won four for Clive Cox, including the Group 2 Temple Stakes in 2024; first win since came here last month in 5f handicap (first-time blinkers) coming off strong pace to reel in long-time leader late on (Collective Power, Fox In Flight and Valiant Force behind); 5lb higher now but still on an okay mark.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
Spotlight: Group 2 Richmond Stakes winner in 2024; sparingly raced last year, including third of 5 behind Valiant Force in 5f conditions event here; never sighted on seasonal return in Naas Listed in May and has had time off since (gelded); first-time headgear combination for handicap debut.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
Spotlight: Won a 5f maiden here last December and several good runs in defeat since including Cork second and close fifth to Kerdos here last month (5f); never competitive in valuable Cork handicap latest when 3lb out of handicap; 4lb wrong here.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
Spotlight: Dual C&D winner (from 7 career wins) but relatively lightly raced in recent years without success; absent for a year and starts off with a new trainer off much-reduced mark (3lb wrong).

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
OwnerName: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan
Spotlight: Hasn't finished outside the first four in five maiden starts, notably latest two in 6f maidens, beaten a short-head into third at Navan and ducked badly left in first-time cheekpieces (now discarded) when third at Cork last month; 7f trip an unknown but definite player if staying, despite wide draw.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Blue Point filly closely related to 1m winner Embiran (RPR 94), half-sister to winners Elamaz (French/Australian 1m/1m2f inc Listed; 113), Emaniya (Group-placed 1m 2yo) and Ediyva (7f AW); dam 7f winner (inc Group 3/AW; 106); encouraging recent Naas debut fifth over 1m, having travelled well into the race; drop back in trip and first-time tongue tie could prove a shrewd move.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Good 2yo maiden form at this trip and just denied on seasonal return in valuable Curragh fillies handicap over 1m in May; clipped heels when unseating at Galway latest but on overall form has leading claims here; good draw too.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Owes her high mark to finishing fourth in Group 3 Anglesey Stakes last year; not a bad effort on Fairyhouse comeback in June but later in month keen and lost a shoe when last in Curragh premier fillies' handicap; back from a break and has a bit to prove from outside draw.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Fine debut second at Leopardstown last summer hasn't been built on, although recent Fairyhouse third was a bit more encouraging; more needed.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Cotai Glory half-brother to 1m5f turf/2m AW winner Elle Dorado Rock (RPR 69); dam 1m 2yo winner (71), half-sister to Group-placed 9.4f-11.4f winner Majeed; debutant for whom market best guide (rider has ridden a couple of winners this season).

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Elzaam filly is first foal of a moderate maiden so little to excite on breeding.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Modest effort on debut at Limerick last month when 22-1; may need more time and experience.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Kameko half-sister to winners Space Tracker (6f-1m inc Australia; RPR 102), Qaaddim (1m AW 2yo/1m2f turf; 87) and Notturno Ligure (Italian 7f-1m2f); dam sprint maiden, half-sister to Listed-placed 5f-7.4f winner Colour Of Love; debutante for whom market best guide.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: All four runs have been here earlier in the year, notably narrow defeat in 6f maiden and didn't seem to quite get home over today's trip; absent since below-par run over 5f in April.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Belardo gelding cost 7,000euros at the breeze-ups; brother to 1m winner Bellabel (inc 2yo/US turf Grade 2; RPR 114), half-brother to winners Sumptuary Law (1m-10.3f inc 2yo/AW; 90), Classic Design (9.4f AW; 82) and Key Look (7f/1m inc AW; 70); dam 8.6f AW winner (96); unlikely one to make an immediate impact but worth a market check.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Wings Of Eagles half-brother to six winners inc Sebastian Beach (1m4f/1m6f; RPR 88), Wefait (1m2f AW/11.4f turf; 83) and Dunmore Boy (5f/6f 2yo AW; 68); dam maiden half-sister to French 1,000 Guineas winner Danseuse Du Soir; bred to want further but upwardly mobile yard so don't rule out on debut.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Two maiden runs in the spring were modest enough; likely to be of more interest in handicaps.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Never landed a blow over further in maidens at Down Royal and Leopardstown; eligible for a mark after this.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Gun Runner colt one of three for top yard and preferred by Lordan; looked like he'd improve plenty for his promising debut run over 6f at Naas behind subsequent Group 2 winner Man's Best Friend when not knocked about and this longer trip should suit; leading claims.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Sent off at 50-1 on debut at Galway (7f, yielding) and wasn't disgraced, beaten 8.5l into fourth of 8; open to improvement but a fair bit more likely needed to take this.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
OwnerName: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor
Spotlight: Gun Runner colt; half-brother to 6f 2yo winner Trojan Warrior (RPR 94); dam 7f 2yo Listed winner (104), half-sister to 1m1f Group 3 winner Red Riding Hood; one of three for top yard that has won the last four renewals; market can guide.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
OwnerName: Karl Kirwan & R P Behan & Mrs John Murphy & James Morgan
Spotlight: Blackbeard colt; slowly away and never landed a blow on debut over 5f on heavy at the Curragh in March; attracted market support that day so likely capable of better and has been gelded since; top rider booked and steps up markedly in trip.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: 66-1 and failed to beat a rival on debut at Leopardstown 23 days ago; others make more appeal.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Epicenter colt was an 80,000USD yearling; closely related to US 6f/8.5f dirt winner Howling Time (inc 2yo), half-brother to US winners Air Recruit (5.5f-8.5f turf inc 2yo/stakes) and Basil Flavor (1m turf); dam US 8.3f AW/9.5f turf winner; plenty of appeal on paper.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Dark Angel colt from a good family was sent off at 6-1 on debut at Leopardstown (1m, good) 23 days ago but was beaten 10.5l; major step forward needed.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Starman filly was sent off at 40-1 on debut at the Curragh and ran accordingly; may need a bit more time.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
OwnerName: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith
Spotlight: St Mark's Basilica colt; half-brother to seven winners inc Serpentine (1m2f/1m4f inc Derby; RPR 121), Wedding Vow (1m1f Group 2; 113) and Beacon Rock (1m2f Group 3; 109); dam placed 7f-1m4f (including Oaks; 112); impeccably bred and no surprise to see a big run on debut.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Flightline colt; 950,000USD yearling; half-brother to US Graded stakes-placed 1m dirt winner Blacksmith; dam unraced sister to US 7f Grade 2 winner Cezanne, closely related to US 6f stakes winner Counterforce; one of three for top yard; worth a market check on debut.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Starman filly; unraced dam out of maiden close relative of smart 2m jumper My Mate Mozzie; best watched on debut.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: 200-1 and never figured on debut at the Curragh six days ago; seems safe to rule out on that evidence.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Arizona filly; E3,000 yearling; half-sister to winners Corolla Point (5f inc 2yo; RPR 105) and Mullins Beach (6f; 67); dam unplaced 6f-1m AW (33), closely related to US 1m Grade 2 winner Istanford; likely best watched on debut.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: Recovered from a sluggish start to shed the maiden tag at Gowran (9.5f, gd-fm) three days ago, her first start for this yard; carries a 7lb penalty, drops in trip and her previous runs here have been moderate; slow-starting, fast-finishing second over 1m at Cork on Friday.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: Won a 7f claimer here in December; ran well in C&D handicap on last visit to this venue in April and 1lb lower now; modest turf runs last twice and drawn wide on return to the AW.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: Back from a 429-day absence with a 25-1 win over C&D on stable bow last month (Famous Enough second); 4lb rise for that seems reasonable and can't be discounted but wide draw not ideal.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo filly made all to score by 4.25l at Gowran (7f, good) eight days ago in a first-time visor (retained); has won here over 6f and 7f and wasn't far behind Queen Leila over C&D in January; drawn to attack from stall 1 and a bold bid looks likely.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo filly off the mark at Killarney a month ago (1m, good), staying on well to get up for a 1.75l win (Beau Army third); hiked up 7lb; held behind a couple of these on last AW run over C&D in April but arrives in form and this race could be run to suit; big chance.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
OwnerName: David Daly & Gerard Shevlin & D Battersby
Spotlight: 3yo filly gained breakthrough win here a month ago over 7f when a 33-1 shot; just 3lb higher now and while she's drawn wide, she'll have the assistance of the champion jockey in the plate; however, stamina a query at this longer trip.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
OwnerName: Patrick M O'Brien & Larry Murray & Derek Cummins
Spotlight: Not easy to win with but often runs well in defeat; is 7lb lower than when winning over C&D in March 2025 but he's becoming difficult to predict; only midfield at Leopardstown on latest; others look more solid.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs P McCourt/Whyte's Stamullen Syndicate/S Sweeney
Spotlight: Is 15lb lower than when winning over C&D last summer and took a step in the right direction when beaten 3.5l over C&D on latest; eased 3lb for that run and well-drawn here; could go well at a price.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner has shaped as though turn was near the last twice; beaten a head by Movin And Groovin over C&D on penultimate off 2lb lower and beaten 1.25l when second of 18 at Naas (1m, good) on latest; should be thereabouts again.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo filly 0-6 and yet to show winning potential; well held behind Cause I Like You and Beau Army at Killarney last time; blinkers now tried for AW debut; more needed.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo filly's standout effort came when a close third at Gowran in May but nowhere near that level in three runs since; hard to fancy right now.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo filly had the run of the race when getting a soft lead to score by 1.5l over C&D when last seen in April (Beau Army second); raised 5lb for that and may not get her own way out in front again here.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: Showed ability for Andrew Balding but sold cheaply in October 2024 and hasn't been seen since; best watched on stable debut.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: No sign of winning potential in maidens for Noel Meade and heavy defeat on handicap and stable debut on seasonal return at Roscommon; still relatively early days but others preferred.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Running okay without really threatening to win this season; not terrible efforts the last twice at the Curragh (1m2f, gd-fm) and on latest at Galway (1m4f, yld-sft) but probably needs a bit more help from the handicapper to get his head back in front.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Seven-time turf winner ran a nice race to finish second at Gowran earlier this week (12.5f, gd-fm): rated 4lb higher on this surface and while he's 0-17 on the AW, he's gone close on plenty of occasions off much higher marks; chance, once this doesn't come too soon.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Has come up dry since winning back-to-back races at the Curragh on first two starts for this stable in 2024; positive signs at Roscommon in cheekpieces on latest and now tries a visor for his AW debut; on a dangerous mark if taking to this surface.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Rock solid record of 4-6 on AW including two wins over C&D; is 2lb lower than when last winning here in 2024 and wasn't disgraced when beaten 4.25l in a premier handicap at Leopardstown last month; interesting back at this venue.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Below par in heritage handicap at York on latest but previously ran well in defeat in a premier handicap at the Curragh; AW debutant is bred to act on this surface (half-brother to two AW winners and dam won on AW) so could bounce back.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Two-time C&D winner, most recently last November off 2lb lower; running okay in defeat on turf in recent starts over inadequate trips and this hold up sort could get a nice pace to aim at on return to the AW; not out of this.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Solid AW strike rate of 4-8 including back-to-back wins here in the winter over this trip and 1m4f; is 5lb higher than when scoring over C&D in December and running okay on turf in recent starts; could go well back on his favourite surface.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Consistent 3yo placed in a 1m maiden here in January; yet to run a bad race this term; won at Roscommon in June (10.5f, good); another fine run when a close fourth at Galway over 12.5f latest; 3lb wrong here but should give another good account.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Boasts C&D form figures of 211; roared back to form with a win over 8.5f (yld-sft) at the Galway festival on latest; 7lb rise makes things tougher and this is harder but has to be respected given her fine record at this venue.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Best effort came in a C&D maiden in May when a 0.5l second to an 80 rated rival; ran respectably on handicap bow at Navan (1m2f, good) but struggled upped to 1m5f at Ballinrobe latest; drops back in trip now and the return to the AW is a plus.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Two-time course winner over 1m4f; remains 4lb above her most recent win here in March; shaped well over 1m5f at Down Royal on latest but this trip may be on the sharp side.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Both career wins have come here, the latest in this race last year off 1lb higher; has run well in defeat over much further on turf a couple of times this term and soft ground wouldn't have suited at Galway latest; should be doing his best work at the finish.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Has lost way since winning at Gowran in July of last year; way below best on turf when last seen in April and has been gelded; cheekpieces tried now on first start since rejoining yard; probably best watched unless backed.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: C&D win came in a maiden in 2023; a couple of decent runs this term but reportedly stopped very quickly when down the field at Leopardstown latest; is 2lb below her last turf win but was well held by Iron Fist at the Curragh in May and others more convincing.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Went close at Navan last month (1m2f, good) before tailing off at Ballinrobe over 1m5f on latest; 0-4 on AW but yet to finish out of the first four; place chance if leaving that last run behind.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden ran his best race to date when a 2l fourth of 14 here over 1m last month; didn't shape like he was crying out for further but his dam was placed over 1m4f here so not discounted.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Two-time turf winner below best on grass so far this year and extended AW record to 0-8 when soundly beaten over 1m4f here last month; others arrive in better form.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Won over C&D in March and runs off the same mark here; however, soundly beaten on last three starts on turf so return to the AW needs to revive.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Eighteen race maiden is 0-11 on the AW; soundly beaten on return from 128 days off over 1m here last month and the hood worn that day is left off; not easy to fancy.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Ran okay in a C&D maiden here in January but hasn't built on that; failed to beat a rival on last two starts; cheekpieces now added to tongue tie; questions to answer.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden whose best runs have come over 7f-1m; good second on debut for this yard at Bellewstown (1m, good) but bombed out at Killarney on latest (reportedly clinically abnormal post-race); a hood now goes on; risky.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Three wins here over 7f-1m but does stay this far and has multiple placed efforts over C&D; on a dangerous mark and a recent spin over hurdles at Wexford will have blown away any cobwebs; chance with rider taking off handy 7lb.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Huge odds and no show in maidens and similar story in first two handicaps; 2lb wrong; new hood needs to spark.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: First sign of possible winning potential when a 5.75l fourth of 12 at Navan (1m2f, good) last month; 3yo eased 1lb and can challenge for place money if backing that last run up.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Bolted up at Tipperary last summer but form has nosedived since; slightly better at Gowran on latest but a bit to prove on AW debut.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Fine run on second handicap start at Fairyhouse in June (1m2f, good); tailed off at Down Royal on latest when favourite but soft ground may not have suited; 3yo surely capable of better than that and too soon to write off.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Ran her best race to date when a 7.5l second at Ballinrobe (1m5f, gd-yld) on penultimate but failed to build on that when a well beaten favourite at the Curragh; 0-5 on AW and others look more convincing.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: 4-24 on AW including three wins over C&D; is 4lb lower than when scoring here in September but his form in 2026 has been underwhelming so needs to get back on track.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Came away with an in-form rival when completing the hat-trick at Ffos Las on Wednesday (enjoyed the run of the race; now 2-2 for Millie Wonnacott); maybe won't go up by as much as the 5lb penalty when reassessed but a fair chance of going in again.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Back in form since returned to cheekpieces of late, latterly when beaten a nose by Belle Of Kt at Bath a fortnight ago; 6lb better off with her old rival and her last win came round here off 3lb higher, so there are reasons for optimism.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Two wins for her new yard before finishing last of four in better company seven weeks ago; maybe the good to firm ground did for her that night but she now has to prove this mark (5lb higher than when last successful) within range.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
OwnerName: Mrs E Bickerton And A Streeter
Spotlight: Four-time Polytrack winner who came back to form last time and is 2lb lower than when last successful (turf) last summer; often fluffs the start and is usually held up, so the bigger field won't hurt; one to consider.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Nine-race maiden who has run below market expectations in four starts this year and is evidently felt capable of better; again pulled hard when a beaten-favourite nine days ago (Tapeta) and much will hinge on how he responds to a first-time hood.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Two short-priced wins (0-50 classified, then a 0-55 handicap) before held off his revised mark at this level last time; that was another in-form effort, though, and there's no obvious reason he won't go well once more.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Four AW efforts better than his five turf runs (including three over hurdles), backing up his win early in the year with a second off this mark next time (both Tapeta); needs a bit more again back from five months off.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Dual Kempton winner who was below-par there on Wednesday evening; victories came for headgear coming off, then for going back on, so perhaps the removal will result in a better effort, but she's some way down the pecking order.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Regressive maiden under both codes for four yards (trainer also saddles Tenadaay, who looks his best chance); hard to make a case for her back in the cheekpieces.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 1,000gns yearling, £20,000 breeze-up 2yo who was inclined to pull hard out in daylight on his 5f Windsor debut in early summer; shaped alright in faring best of the newcomers that night but it wasn't much of a novice; has to settle from stall 10 up to 6f.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Related to several winners for his connections; pulled hard when well held on his 5f debut but bettered that last time, upped to this trip, despite hanging left (both turf); yard has a poor record with 2yos on the AW but he's open to more improvement.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Not an awful turf debut in the spring but was beaten a long way on Tapeta recently; low-grade nurseries may well be next on the agenda for a yard also responsible for Premium Seat.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Fair turf debut behind a useful winner in June, for a yard far from noted for 2yos, and ran to a similar level when splitting two subsequent winners on Tapeta last time; wasn't best suited by the way that race panned out and is one to consider.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 30,000gns breeze-up 2yo who was easy to back when well held on her Bath (5.7f) debut for the Newland/Insole yard in the spring; new trainer always to be respected with new recruits and the market will help with this filly, who's tried in a hood.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Sarah Fern, Patricia James And Partner
Spotlight: Found the seventh furlong stretching her on her debut here 11 days ago; entitled to have come on for that but it didn't look much of a maiden (winner exposed as ordinary).

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Dam was happiest on soft/heavy ground and didn't win until she was a 4yo; trainer enjoying a fair season with 2yos but doesn't have a great record with them here down the years.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Third foal of a 7f-1m4f winner; trainer (also runs Postremo) on the board for the season with 2yos in the week, but wouldn't be noted for newcomers these days.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 16,000euros breeze-up 2yo who started 150-1 for his Windsor debut a month ago, when well held having had issues at the start;  will need a lot more from the outside stall for a trainer whose recent successes have all come with older horses.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Half-sister to two winners, who both improved with time; trainer had a quiet year with juveniles thus far (1-23) and the market will show what's expected.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing 415 Handicap
Spotlight: Has rather mixed record this season but was back in good form when dominating from the front over C&D a week ago, and a recent 5lb rise is manageable if he's in the right mood again.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing 415 Handicap
Spotlight: Gained both wins in 5.2f Brighton nurseries last summer; close second of four at Yarmouth (5f, good to firm) last month, his second start this season, but didn't fire at Windsor a fortnight later; needs to respond well to first-time cheekpieces and prove himself on an AW surface.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing 415 Handicap
Spotlight: Placed three times over 5f/6f on turf in the spring but this is his first run for over two months and his record on Polytrack (safely held all three starts) is off-putting.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing 415 Handicap
Spotlight: Came good with two AW wins in April (5f/6f) but seemed quickly to go off the boil in June; further progress is not yet out of the question but he needs a two-month break to have done him good.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap
Spotlight: Started nurseries on an unrealistic mark for Richard Hannon but has found his level again now, narrowly being denied off 1lb lower last time (best of the group that started out racing near side at Nottingham); this half-brother to a C&D winner is shortlisted.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap
Spotlight: Often makes the running, as when winning over C&D off 4lb lower in January; yet to show anything on turf, so his latest Chester flop looks best written off, but there's other pace in here.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap
Spotlight: Keen-going maiden who's been running over further, latterly not seeing out a stiff 7f having again pulled hard; hung left more than once and the emphasis will be on speed this time from the outside stall.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice on Tapeta early in the year and is having his first AW run since, off a mark 3lb lower than when last successful; a poor first effort since being gelded in a tongue-tie (off here) will need ignoring though.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap
Spotlight: Two wins (disqualified from one) and a close fourth to his name from four runs over C&D, his last success coming off 4lb higher in February; not as good or consistent now but unlucky not to go closer last time and the handicapper's given him every chance.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice in Ireland last season before closing out with two lesser efforts in Listed company; struggled for his current yard, coming a stone down the weights, and again didn't achieve much last time when fourth of five on turf here.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap
Spotlight: Front-runner who ran as well as could have been expected in a Tapeta claimer on tough terms last time; that effort confirmed him still in form but there's not much wiggle room off this mark.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap
Spotlight: Didn't look to see out 1m from the front at Goodwood last time but now the question is whether she'll have the toe for 6f round here; effectively 5lb lower today and it will be interesting to see how she goes in the market.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
Spotlight: Won four times (once over C&D) in 2025 and has gradually worked her way back to form this year; persistently denied a clear run when close fourth at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) last month and will be dangerous here if her luck improves.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
Spotlight: In rear throughout when 50-1 for last month's belated seasonal debut at Wolverhampton (7f); still unexposed over this trip but has modest 1-15 strike-rate and needs to leave that recent effort a long way behind.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to add to his two Irish wins in 2023 but has performed well twice this month, finishing second in Windsor handicap (11.4f, good to firm) and fourth in classified race here (1m4f); this drop back in trip ought to suit; probably won't be far away.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
Spotlight: Ended long losing spell when holding on by a nose in C&D classified in January and has made the frame here (1m, AW/1m1f, turf) on his last two appearances; likely contender.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
Spotlight: Not quite at best on last two turf starts but now only 2lb higher than when leading close home at Kempton (1m) in May, and this longer trip won't be a problem; a possible.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
Spotlight: Built upon satisfactory seasonal debut when winning at Southwell (1m) in April; absent since down-the-field turf run (albeit in better race than this) in May, though, and has stamina to prove over 1m2f.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
Spotlight: 20-race maiden who was well beaten in two 1m2f Yarmouth handicaps last month; might be happier back on Polytrack but remains difficult to enthuse over.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
Spotlight: Regressive 8yo who returned from a break with two low-key runs (8.3f/7f) in June/July; should be fine over today's longer trip and is too well handicapped to rule out but needs to up his game.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive 3yo who came from off the pace for emphatic success at Kempton (1m) on Monday and has now won two of his last three; also suited by this track; obvious contender under 6lb penalty.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: Won two Kempton nurseries (1m/7f) in October but has disappointed on all four starts this year; needs huge boost from the new cheekpieces.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to win this season but kept on for third at Salisbury (1m, good) in June and only faded out of contention in closing stages at Wolverhampton (9.4f) last month, having raced wide throughout; on a tempting mark now; might be the answer.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: Returned from short break with two good 7f runs this spring; well handicapped if judged on those but his form has dipped since and he is yet fully to convince stamina-wise over 1m.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: Won off today's mark at Kempton (1m) in January but was soundly beaten after starting slowly in both turf races this summer; others look less risky.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: A maiden after 11 starts but hasn't been with current stable long and comes here after making the frame in two 7f Epsom handicaps last month; looks ready or another crack at 1m and this return to Polytrack won't be a problem; could have a say.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 0-3 in bumpers and 0-7 as a hurdler; however, she's consistent and has each-way claims on peak form; tries cheekpieces.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: The winner of two bumpers and a repeat of the RPR he posted when second in a Southwell maiden this June would see him bang there; he was a disappointing favourite here last time when behind Brosna Town.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: High mileage on the Flat (3-37) and has always plied his trade at a modest level; limited appeal on this belated switch to hurdling.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Dual bumper winner who has been competitive in all four starts over hurdles, from 2m to 2m5f; cheekpieces worn on last two starts are removed; off since October but he's the standard setter.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Dual Flat winner for Dermot Weld; ran twice at the big recent meeting at Galway, predictably struggling in a Listed hurdle but then running okay over 1m4f; 0-5 as a jumper but was runner-up over C&D last month; chance.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Won her only point; hooded for both runs under rules, finishing first then second in bumpers at Newton Abbot; that form is nothing to get excited about but she's a Skelton newcomer to hurdling.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Poor maiden on the Flat and 150-1 when pulled up here two weeks ago.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 0-4 in points and hasn't been that threatening in two bumpers; others preferred.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 1-10 in Irish points and pulled up in all his races over hurdles; first-time cheekpieces.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: No obvious sign of ability in three bumpers at Newcastle.

RaceName: Bet Smarter With Oddschecker+ Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Cherry Knoll Farm, M Ward & D Skelton
Spotlight: Won two uncompetitive events this spring (2m4f/2m) and then finished close second to main market rival over about 2m6f here four weeks ago; rated 5lb above Eternal Angel on BHA ratings but that mark may flatter him.

RaceName: Bet Smarter With Oddschecker+ Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Had four starts for Tom Lacey, winning a pair of 2m hurdle races and perhaps better again when a front-running third in a handicap at Cartmel (second run in cheekpieces); obvious claims with his main rival also doubly penalised.

RaceName: Bet Smarter With Oddschecker+ Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: On his Flat and jumps form he looks outclassed; the hood is new.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: First start for this stable when runner-up over C&D and had the hood back on then; no match for the winner at Newton Abbot but that was behind a Skelton hotpot; respected.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Hasn't lived up to her excellent jumping pedigree and she's now 0-9 after finishing a well-held second at Newton Abbot; can jump to the right so this track should suit better, but she's not overly convincing.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Now in his fourth stable, for which he won a 2m handicap chase at Hexham in June; beaten 8l next time at Cartmel and he has form there; mark just okay but couldn't rule out as this isn't a strong race.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Five-time winner at Sedgefield but he's a dual C&D winner and ran well enough last time at Cartmel to command respect.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Better hurdler than chaser, with him 5-14 in the one discipline and yet 0-7 over fences; his turn should come as it was a fair run last time at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good; beaten 3l off this mark); all his winning form is about this trip.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
OwnerName: The North West National Hunt Racing Club
Spotlight: Just one completion in three runs over fences and beaten 9l on that occasion; fairly well held in his last two races over hurdles as well; he's on a fair mark if everything did come together.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Record of 3-12 over hurdles, the last win off this mark; had a wind operation prior to finishing tailed off on chase debut at Uttoxeter, where she was a weak 14-1 chance in a race won by a stronger-fancied stablemate; needs to better that performance.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Record of 2-18 over hurdles and latest fourth at Uttoxeter wasn't too far off his best form; however, he's Flat bred so what he'll make of fences remains to be seen.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual point winner; came readily clear in a C&D maiden here in June but he disappointed under a penalty at Worcester when easy to back; cheekpieces added for handicap debut but others have greater substance to their claims.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 1lb higher than for the 3m win at Aintree last October (good); hasn't approached that form in his only three races since but this is a drop in grade; should go well.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Six wins divided between Flat and hurdling; has some respectable races during her losing streak but doesn't look on that good a mark.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Made all in a 2m4f maiden and followed that with a second in handicap company over 2m6f; finishing effort was a bit underwhelming at Perth when 5l behind Ballintubber Boy over 3m; that run leaves her with something to prove stamina-wise.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: He was 3lb higher when winning this 12 months ago and didn't arrive here that day in great form; did finish third at Uttoxeter two runs back so could go well, despite a modest last run when the visor was back on (in which he's effective but now removed).

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Below his best form this season but ran better at Perth (3m, good) when only 3l off the winner; unlikely to be far away.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Strong traveller who made it 2-4 over fences with a 3m success here last month but he finished weakly when second at Worcester (2m7f); this drop in trip won't hurt; 8lb higher than for that last win but the ability is there.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Dual course winner but was behind Huckleberry Sting last time and he wants further ideally.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Beat three rivals in a handicap chase at Huntingdon (2m7f, good to firm) in May; however, modest last run and his good days are few and far between.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap Chase
Spotlight: 2m4f winner at Newcastle in April and his following thirds were respectable, at about 3m; however, last two runs (2m4f) not so encouraging and has a lot of weight.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Did well over fences for Harry Derham but nothing to show for four runs since leaving that trainer, latterly tried in a visor.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Sole win in 68 career starts did at least come over fences but he's not in much form and 10lb out of the weights.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Nine-race maiden who hasn't really improved for going into handicaps (2m3f-2m6f; 0-4) and was never remotely threatening last time at Cartmel; mark continues to fall and he's in good hands, so all hope not yet lost.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has won his last two (at about 2m), beating a subsequent winner at Worcester and then nicely on top in the finish here four weeks ago; that was in a small field but they went a good clip and this far will suit; up 4lb for last time.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Left Jedd O'Keeffe for £21,000 in May and given wind surgery; first run since when justifying 5-6 favouritism in 11-runner handicap at Uttoxeter three weeks ago (2m, good); he did that narrowly but he was delivered late, so the 7lb rise could be very manageable.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Quite useful on the Flat and returned from a long absence to win a small-field maiden at Newton Abbot a month ago (2m2f, good to firm); difficult to gauge what he achieved there but brings potential into handicaps off what should be a good mark.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Flat winner but a longstanding maiden over hurdles and arrives here in no form; 4lb out of the weights.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Best recent run was the 9l third at Worcester (2m, good) in a race she'd won twice before; ran no race back there last time and others appeal more.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 2023 was her year but an infrequent winner these days and latest third here over 2m4f was remote; minor honours perhaps her best hope.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Lightly raced mare but only five ran when fourth on handicap debut and was then tailed off at Uttoxeter; much to prove.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 40-1 when pulled up on handicap debut last month; 5lb out of the weights with more new headgear tried; very opposable.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: The booking of Patrick Mullins was a likely factor in him going off 6-4f last time at Hexham where he raced freely and didn't last home over 2m4f; had made steady progress for this yard and, back over shorter with Joshua Thompson taking off 5lb, he should be involved.

RaceName: Highclere Thoroughbred Racing Geoffrey Freer Stakes (Group 3)
OwnerName: Sonny Grebe, Aus Bloodstock, D Gilbert
Spotlight: 3-6 in handicaps, including winning warm events on good to firm at Ascot (1m4f) and Carlisle (1m3f) on first two starts this year; absolutely hacked up in the latter but subsided disappointingly in the closing stages for valuable 1m6f handicap at Newmarket (made most) 16 days later; dam is sister to a 1m5f-2m winner, suggesting he should stay beyond 1m4f; even if back on song, however, this rise in class suggests he will register a place at best.

RaceName: Highclere Thoroughbred Racing Geoffrey Freer Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Won the Melrose Handicap at York in August 2024; 0-10 since but runner-up in six of those races, including at York (1m6f) on last two starts in close finishes also involving Mount Atlas (who now carries a 3lb penalty); the lack of a recent win has become frustrating, particularly as he had the initiative for most of the closing stages last time, losing it in the last three strides; cheekpieces (tried once last term, runner-up) return; second to Dubai Honour in terms of form.

RaceName: Highclere Thoroughbred Racing Geoffrey Freer Stakes (Group 3)
OwnerName: Exors of the late Mohamed Obaida
Spotlight: 8yo with high-class performances around the globe over 1m2f-1m4f but he's never been beyond that; below form in Australia in April when last seen but his performance there the time before was up with his best form; usually runs well after a break; there's a question whether ground firmer than good is ideal but he is very much the class act in this field.

RaceName: Highclere Thoroughbred Racing Geoffrey Freer Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Grabbed a maiden at Kempton (1m, AW) in November and came from last to second in a six-runner Listed race at Epsom (1m2f, good; 33-1) in April; 66-1 but rallied well for sixth of 14 in the Derby at Epsom (1m4f, soft) ten weeks ago, admittedly about 10l behind the winner, so he has a lot to find on ratings, but this St Leger entry probably has untapped potential at 1m4f+.

RaceName: Highclere Thoroughbred Racing Geoffrey Freer Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who has come into his own in a major way; second on good to firm at Newmarket (1m4f) and Royal Ascot (1m6f) in his last two starts; has since changed hands and left the Gosdens; climbing the ladder and although another major step up is required against Dubai Honour on this move out of handicaps, he should be highly competitive against the rest.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Won this 12 months ago off 9lb higher; 0-15 since and a change of headgear (retained) failed to stop the slide at Ascot three weeks ago.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Speedy type who will probably prove best at 5f; having first run after gelding operation and three months off when second to Wheels Of Fire at Sandown; may well improve for that outing and he still has untapped potential.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Dual 6f winner in 2025; regressive in 2026, tenth of 13 at Windsor last time on first run after wind surgery; very best form is over further but he has fallen below his last winning mark and Seamus Cronin's claim is a plus.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Gained three 5f wins in the second half of 2025, but disappointing this year after a promising reappearance; needs to get back on track but drops back in grade after facing a stiff task in York Grade 3 last time.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Has added to his impressive tally with two further 5f wins this season but recent defeats suggest he's gone off the boil somewhat; dropped 2lb since last run but may need some more assistance from the handicapper.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Likeable 8yo mare with a consistent record and ten wins to her name; as good as ever when third of 23 at Glorious Goodwood (5f, good) last month, keeping on gamely; should go well again off 1lb higher.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Both 2026 wins were 5f and he was decisively on top at Sandown (good ground) 17 days ago; that was a personal best and he's in the mix, although significantly worse off at the weights with Sandown runner-up Hypnotised.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Won a 7f novice as a 2yo and he ran over 1m on his reappearance, but his two runs since have been over this distance; went off favourite but met trouble on both occasions, and he has since been gelded; hard to pin down but he's relatively lightly raced and probably has more to offer.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Best effort when getting off the mark on turf at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in June; lost his chance at the start next time and then seemed to find things happening too quickly over Goodwood's sharp 5f; today's stiffer track should be in his favour, and we may not have seen the best of him yet.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: In and out this season but has gained 5f wins at Musselburgh (good) and York (good to firm); not entirely disgraced in big field at Goodwood last time and could make his presence felt.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win over 7f as 2yo for Brian Ellison; never dangerous over 6f on yard debut at Goodwood 17 days ago and now drops back even further in trip.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Won at Goodwood (5f, good) in the spring and has remained in form, second of seven at Lingfield last time; no obvious reason why he won't be thereabouts again but he's fully exposed after 52 starts.

RaceName: TPT Fire Handicap
Spotlight: Has some solid 6f form this year, including when chasing home subsequent Wokingham winner Double Rush at Newmarket; far from disgraced from unfavourable draw at York three weeks ago; big player if seeing out today's extra yardage.

RaceName: TPT Fire Handicap
Spotlight: Often blows the start; everything clicked when she won at Yarmouth (7f, good) in April but she's been more miss than hit otherwise this year; others have less to prove.

RaceName: TPT Fire Handicap
OwnerName: Sir M Arbib,B Arbib,C Budgett & A Kheir
Spotlight: Unplaced all five starts since winning his first two races, but there have been excuses; shaped well after making much of the running in the Royal Hunt Cup, and then used up too much energy from a wide draw in the Golden Mile at Goodwood; dropping back from 1m to 7f is an interesting move and he still has untapped potential.

RaceName: TPT Fire Handicap
Spotlight: 0-8 this season but he's been bubbling under, and he'd have gone close to winning at Haydock (7f, good) last Saturday but for being badly hampered inside the final 1f; dangerous if he's fully recovered from that.

RaceName: TPT Fire Handicap
Spotlight: Reappeared with a convincing C&D win (good ground) but hasn't built on that at all; gelded before finishing down the field at Ascot three weeks ago and now cheekpieces are fitted; needs to get back on track.

RaceName: TPT Fire Handicap
Spotlight: Hard to predict; followed six duck eggs with a last-gasp win at Thirsk (1m, good) two weeks ago, only to run poorly again at Haydock last week; just 2lb higher than for the win but can't be relied on.

RaceName: TPT Fire Handicap
Spotlight: 7f specialist, not beaten far in Ascot's Victoria Cup (good) and Buckingham Palace Stakes (good to firm) in first half of this year; never able to challenge over same C&D last time; this is less competitive and he should be thereabouts.

RaceName: TPT Fire Handicap
Spotlight: Seemed in the doldrums prior to third of ten at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last Saturday; had slipped in the weights and he's well treated on the pick of his 3yo form; not ruled out.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: Has raced only at sprint distances; ran well in the face of a stiff task when fourth of 11 in the Group 1 July Cup at Newmarket (6f, good to firm; 28-1) last month; that makes him one of the leading contenders on form but he does need to prove his stamina for today's longer trip.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: Usually races at 6f nowadays but probably just as effective at 7f; seemed to excel himself in first-time blinkers when sixth of 11 in Group 1 July Cup at Newmarket (good to firm; 80-1) five weeks ago; not ruled out if repeating that form.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: Resurgent when winning 6f Group 3 here (good to firm) last month, leading 2f out and keeping on well; all his successes have come at that distance but under these quick conditions he should be fine back at 7f; unbeaten at Newbury and has to be considered now that he's back in top form.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: Useful handicapper, runner-up in the Bunbury Cup at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) in July; however, well beaten at Ascot since and now faces a much higher calibre of opposition.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: 7f wins include the Group 1 City Of York Stakes last summer; not quite at his best this year, although a sixth in the Sussex Stakes at Goodwood last month (80-1) was no disgrace; back down in grade and returns to his optimum distance so should be thereabouts.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: Ran as well as he's ever done when second in this race 12 months ago, and he was a creditable third in Group 2 at Glorious Goodwood (7f, good) last time; solid credentials and unlikely to be far away.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: Lightly raced 3yo; made it 3-3 when winning a big-field handicap at York (7f, good) in June with plenty in hand; lost his unbeaten record in the International Handicap at Ascot next time but met some trouble and still posted another personal best; seriously unexposed and can take this step up in grade in his stride.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: Back on the up with hard-fought 7f Listed win at Chester (good) in July, before finishing down the field in Stewards' Cup at Goodwood; returning to this trip should suit but he has a fair bit to find on the figures.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: Came from behind to win the Group 3 Fred Darling over C&D (good) on reappearance; tougher assignments over 1m since, racing freely in Ascot Group 3 on latest; this return to 7f is a plus but others have more obvious claims.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Early foal by Cotai Glory; shaped nicely when fourth of 18 over 6f here (good to firm; 28-1) last month, doing best work late on after losing his footing at halfway; should build on that run and stay this extra furlong.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Green throughout but passed a few late on when fourth of nine at Doncaster (7f, good to firm; 33-1) three weeks ago; cost 150,000euros as a yearling and has plenty of potential; could make a big step forward.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: No Nay Never half-brother to winners Arabian Force (Group-placed 1m/1m2f; RPR 112), Sea The Casper (Listed-placed 1m-1m3f; 112) and Golden Story (1m 2yo/1m3f Listed; 103); dam unraced sister to 1m Group 1 winner Rizeena; bred to be smart, and top stable won this race 12 months ago.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 105,000euros yearling; Blackbeard half-brother to winners Juan De Montalban (Group-placed 1m1f-1m4f including 2yo; RPR 109), Pintara (1m 2yo including Listed; 104) and Oxford Comma (1m2f-2m2f; 100); dam Listed-placed 1m3f AW winner (98); has a useful pedigree and holds entries in the Royal Lodge and Dewhurst this autumn; interesting debutant.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 85,000gns yearling; by Gleneagles; dam third at 1m (RPR 74), closely related to 6f 2yo winner Song Of Shadows, out of 1m winning half-sister to 1m2f Grade 1 winner Debussy; yard does well with 2yos; one of the likelier types.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Dean De Zoete Inglett Morris Palmer Rees
Spotlight: Showed some improvement on debut form when fifth of eight at Ascot (7f, good to firm) last month, although still beaten 8l at 100-1; type to keep progressing but probably needs a big leap forward here.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 185,000gns yearling; by New Bay; dam Listed-placed 1m winner (RPR 92), half-sister to winners My Lord And Master (Listed-placed 1m 2yo) and Zain Blue (1m), out of unraced half-sister to 1m2f Group 3 winner Grand Duca; local stable operates at over 20% with its 2yos and this one appeals on pedigree.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 100,000gns yearling; Too Darn Hot half-brother to 1m2f/1m4f winner Lord Melbourne (RPR 107); dam French 1m2f/1m4f winner (92) from family of 1m2f Group 2 winner Loup Breton; bred to be useful and represents a leading stable; makes plenty of appeal on paper.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Coulsty half-brother to winners Capuchinero (6f-1m; RPR 84), Arendelle (1m; 72), Gallagher (Australian 10.5f) and Doune Castle (3m/3m2f hurdle); dam unraced half-sister to 1m2f Listed winner Mashaahed; others preferred.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 10,000euros yearling; by Space Traveller; dam 5.7f 2yo winner (RPR 81), half-sister to 1m-1m4f winner Sheila's Treat; other newcomers are more obvious types.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 55,000gns yearling; Havana Gold half-brother to winners Camelot Tales (1m2f; RPR 93) and Tempted (8.6f AW; 72); dam 7f/1m winner (108), half-sister to 1m2f-14.5f winner Rocktherunway; stable's 2yos yet to start firing (0-3) this season.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: £32,000 yearling; Too Darn Hot half-brother to 5f winner Love Love (RPR 76); dam Listed-placed 6f winner (100), half-sister to French 1m Listed winner Polygreen (dam of 6.5f Group 1 winner Polydream); worth monitoring in the market.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Close second of five at Brighton (6f, good to firm; 3-1) last Friday, sticking on well after running green; should improve and be at least as effective over this longer trip, but there looks to be more strength in depth to this race.
