RaceName: Swings & Smiles Supported By AP&C Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has rather a mixed record (had wind surgery in January) but latest start was a ready win in four-runner race at Catterick (1m4f, good to firm) last month; back up 4lb but has to be considered.

RaceName: Swings & Smiles Supported By AP&C Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won at Salisbury in May and improved again when second since at Goodwood (again 1m4f on good) and Ascot (1m4f, good to firm); versatile tactically and made the running last time; raised another 3lb but looks set for another bold show.

RaceName: Swings & Smiles Supported By AP&C Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Beaten on his last 15 starts but placed over 1m4f/1m2f in three of his five races this term; has the form for another prominent finish and is claimer ridden for the first time.

RaceName: Swings & Smiles Supported By AP&C Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: From a smart French middle-distance/staying family; started career with two wins there early last year and although she's 0-6 since for Jean-Claude Rouget, that's mostly been in Listed races and her penultimate piece of form (1m4f) gives her possibilities on this handicap, stable and seasonal debut; the betting market should give further clues.

RaceName: Swings & Smiles Supported By AP&C Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Peak efforts on AW but he won on good to firm last May and did so again when he first tried cheekpieces in eight-runner race at Ascot (1m4f; by a neck, led over 2f out) five weeks ago; back up 3lb but in the mix in small field.

RaceName: Get Following BetVictor On Instagram Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Started his career with two 1m novice wins on good ground and ran well in defeat next time; 50-1, however, when tongue tied for first time on handicap debut at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) eight weeks ago and faded to be well beaten; this race is far less daunting and his dam was a 1m1f/1m2f winner, so it will again be interesting to gauge his market strength.

RaceName: Get Following BetVictor On Instagram Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won his first four handicaps (1m/7f) and close next time; cheekpieces for both starts since (1m, good to firm) when disappointing at Newmarket and hanging right late on in a respectable ninth at Goodwood; needs to resume progress but stamina in the family makes this new trip look interesting.

RaceName: Get Following BetVictor On Instagram Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: There was market interest in him when the widest draw did not play out to his advantage on handicap debut at Royal Ascot (1m4f, good to firm); rallied gamely when narrow winner of a four-runner race at Ascot (1m2f, good to firm) five weeks ago, for which he dictated the pace and has gone up 3lb since but he should not yet be exposed at 1m2f.

RaceName: Get Following BetVictor On Instagram Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Didn't reproduce reappearance form when having to work hard for his win at 1-4 in a novice at Windsor (1m, good to soft) in June; never dangerous on handicap debut 12 days later, which isn't hard to forgive seeing as that was Royal Ascot (18-1) and the move up to 1m2f that day should have suited him well; gelded since; dropped 3lb and could still bring potential.

RaceName: Betway Boosts EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: By Ghaiyyath; eighth foal; closely related to Group-placed 1m 2yo winner Turgenev (including AW; RPR 113), half-brother to three winners including Manobo (1m2f-1m7f including Group 2; 115) and Tagabawa (8.6f 2yo/1m4f AW; 98); dam 1m-1m2f winner (including 2yo/Group 2; 116); leading yard has a strong hand with its juveniles and this one holds a Royal Lodge entry.

RaceName: Betway Boosts EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 150,000gns breeze-up purchase in April; Frankel second foal; dam 7f/1m winner (including 2yo/AW/Listed; RPR 108), sister to smart 1m-1m4f winner Secret State, half-sister to US Grade 1 BC Juvenile Turf winner Line Of Duty, out of disqualified 1,000 Guineas winner Jacqueline Quest; plenty of appeal on paper and the betting should prove informative.

RaceName: Betway Boosts EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 100,000gns yearling; second foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Queen's Best (1m2f Group 3; dam of 1m2f BC Filly & Mare Turf winner Queen's Trust) and Reverie Solitaire (1m4f Listed), out of 7f Group 3 winner; yard's superstar racehorse Baaeed was off the mark on Wednesday, for the Gosdens, with just his third runner as a sire; this stable will be keen to join the party and market clues invaluable.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: Campaigned mostly over 7f; on a two-year losing spell but he's finished runner-up on his last three outings, including when dropped back to 6f here (good to firm) last Friday; races from the same mark and this previous course winner looks sure to be involved.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: He was 4lb lower when beating Strike to take this race in 2024; could only finish fifth last year but he took advantage of a reduced mark to score at Redcar (6f, good to firm; First Folio fourth) 17 days ago; back up 5lb but he should be thereabouts.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: He had been upset in the stalls when unable to justify favouritism on his stable debut in June but made no mistake when making all under Silvestre De Sousa at Ripon (6f, good) four weeks ago; 8lb rise still leaves him well treated on old form and he's of firm interest.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: Sole start here saw him finish eighth in the 2023 edition of this; picked up a Thirsk handicap last May but no wins since and his last two efforts have been modest, albeit he fluffed the start last time; career-low mark.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: Completed a 6f hat-trick last spring but signed off for William Haggas with last of 13 at Newcastle in November; had been gelded before racing too freely on his stable debut/reappearance 19 days ago; that should have knocked some freshness out of him and he's back on his last winning mark.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
OwnerName: S Emmet And Miss R Emmet
Spotlight: He has contested this race for the last four years, with form figures reading 1626; mostly running with credit this term and he narrowly prevailed at Newbury (6f, good to firm) five weeks ago; 3lb nudge shouldn't stop him being competitive under Billy Loughnane; player.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: Only beaten 1l when fourth in this in 2024; no wins last year and he weakened to finish 5l behind Archduke Ferdinand at Redcar last time; continues to edge down the weights.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to win a turf handicap and he was only ninth of 11 in this race last year; ran well when fifth of 17 at York over 5f last month but surprisingly found it happening too quickly over 6f at Brighton last Friday; others hold more interesting claims.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: 0-7 but he's yet to finish out of the frame; recorded his best effort for this yard when third in 5f Ffos Las maiden (good; first-time visor) one month ago; this return to 6f looks a positive move for his handicap debut.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: Dual turf winner who normally plies her trade in a lower grade and her second of six a fortnight ago came in a classified event; 7lb out of the handicap and will likely find this too tall an order.

RaceName: Betway Bet £10 Get £40 Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: She recorded two AW handicap wins by a neck in the spring; raced freely when well-held second of five over C&D in June but back on track with solid third off this mark at Ascot (1m4f, good to firm) five weeks ago; new hood is probably a good addition as she tackles this trip for a second time.

RaceName: Betway Bet £10 Get £40 Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Very similar form in three 1m4f novices (AW/good) and she bustled up a subsequent handicap winner on the second of them at Thirsk in June; goes up in trip for her handicap debut and she's one to consider.

RaceName: Betway Bet £10 Get £40 Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Relished the step up to this sort of trip when she obliterated three-runner Doncaster handicap seven weeks ago; impossible to accurately assess what she achieved that day but the handicapper came up with a 10lb jolt of improvement; fascinating to see what comes next.

RaceName: Betway Bet £10 Get £40 Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Unraced at two; off the mark on third start when taking 1m2f Pontefract maiden with authority in June; similar form when third on handicap debut at Epsom (1m4f, good) one month later and her latest outing, when she disappointed over this trip at Sandown, came in a messy three-runner affair; cheekpieces go on and she's not one to give up on.

RaceName: Betway Bet £10 Get £40 Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Progressed from a low base last July/September, winning at up to 2m; quiet on her first two starts this summer following wind surgery, but she was back in the groove when second of 13 at York (extended 2m, good to firm; first-time tongue-tie) three weeks ago; tackles a classier event this time but can't be dismissed.

RaceName: Betway Bet The Responsible Way Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: All starts at 5f; Thirsk maiden winner who possibly had excuses when disappointing in Beverley's Hilary Needler next time; that wasn't the case when down the field again in Newbury's Super Sprint four weeks ago; jumps up two furlongs for this handicap debut.

RaceName: Betway Bet The Responsible Way Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Halted a run of seconds when justifying short odds at Lingfield last month; shaped as though 7f would be well worth a go when fifth on her handicap debut here (again 6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; respected.

RaceName: Betway Bet The Responsible Way Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: She opened her account in 7f Epsom maiden last month and took it up a notch with a winning handicap debut over C&D (also good to firm) last Saturday; wasn't done any favours by the runner-up that day and a 5lb rise looks perfectly reasonable; might be the answer.

RaceName: Betway Bet The Responsible Way Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Made good progress in her qualifying runs, including when landing 13-runnner maiden at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) in June; only third of four when favourite for her handicap debut at Chester next time but the pair that beat her have ran well subsequently and her wide stall was no help at Glorious Goodwood last time; could bounce back.

RaceName: Betway Bet The Responsible Way Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Improved when fourth at Newbury (form worked out) on her second start and she went very close at Windsor (also 6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; possibly a little unlucky that day and there's enough in her pedigree to suggest this new trip will suit; player on this handicap debut.

RaceName: Betway Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
Spotlight: Made virtually all when easily landing Ballinrobe claimer (9.5f, yielding; claimed for 15,000euros) for Ken Condon in June; handicapper was evidently watching so interesting to see what she makes of this career-high mark; one of two for Gerard O'Leary.

RaceName: Betway Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
Spotlight: Joined this yard after winning a Dundalk claimer (7f, AW) in November but he's been uncompetitive in three subsequent handicaps, including at Roscommon (10.5f, good) in June; stable looks to have much stronger chances with Femme Beauty but he sports a new headgear combination so watch the market.

RaceName: Betway Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
Spotlight: He is on a hat-trick after making all (odds-on) in small-field handicaps at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm); handicapper hasn't been going overboard and he holds leading claims once again.

RaceName: Betway Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
Spotlight: Showed a bit on her third start at two and, after a quiet handicap debut in June, she was always front rank before being picked off late over C&D (good to firm) four weeks ago; player up 3lb.

RaceName: Betway Free Bet Club Fillies' Handicap
OwnerName: Duaij Al Khalifa & Ahmad Al Qassimi
Spotlight: Unraced at two; six-race maiden but in the frame all starts, including when second of nine at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW) a fortnight ago; 1lb nudge a little gratuitous but she's firmly in calculations.

RaceName: Betway Free Bet Club Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Found a weak maiden when off the mark at long odds-on in May; hasn't quite matched that in two subsequent handicaps (7f) but this return to a longer trip looks a positive; possibilities.

RaceName: Betway Free Bet Club Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Gradual improvement across her five starts culminated with a handicap win over C&D (good to firm) under Alfie Redman last Thursday; now 4lb higher but it's highly likely we've yet to see the best of her; key contender.

RaceName: Betway Free Bet Club Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: 0-5 but she's never been out of the first three and went fairly close when third of 12 in Southwell novice (7f, AW) six weeks ago; shaped that day like the step up to this trip will suit; makes her turf and handicap debut.

RaceName: Betway Free Bet Club Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Versatile sort who was runner-up at Chester (12.3f, good) in May but she's not easy to predict and was tailed off in the Kensington Palace at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) in June; beaten over 12l when 50-1 here (7f) a fortnight ago and younger legs are likely to prevail.

RaceName: Watch Live Racing At Betway Handicap
Spotlight: He was having just his second start on turf when a ready winner at the other Newmarket track (7f, good) in May; finished runner-up on his last three starts, twice over C&D including last time under Chloe Lyons, and now takes a drop in class; has to be considered.

RaceName: Watch Live Racing At Betway Handicap
Spotlight: In cracking form since joining this yard and he was winning his third race from his last four starts when always in command at Haydock (7f, good) last Saturday; goes up another 5lb but he's progressing well.

RaceName: Watch Live Racing At Betway Handicap
Spotlight: It was a fourth AW success when scoring at Lingfield (7f) last Tuesday, but he knows how to get it done on turf too and his previous second of six over C&D (good to firm) was a creditable effort; has won off this mark and Billy Loughnane takes over; player.

RaceName: Watch Live Racing At Betway Handicap
OwnerName: Tim Cottier, Clark, Spence And Fellowes
Spotlight: Fairly bolted up at Epsom (7f, good to firm) last July; that remains his only success but he's generally been running well this term and the handicapper is starting to give him a chance; respected.

RaceName: Watch Live Racing At Betway Handicap
Spotlight: Started out by recording useful form on first three starts for Clive Cox but the wheels came off subsequently; 150-1 for his stable debut when weakening to be beaten 15l over 6f here last Friday; big transformation required just eight days on but slipping mark makes him worth a market check.

RaceName: Watch Live Racing At Betway Handicap
Spotlight: He hasn't been able to replicate his 2yo form in handicaps this year and was beaten a long way when fifth of six over C&D a fortnight ago; very hard to fancy at present.

RaceName: Visit Perth Museum Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Left Emmet Mullins after a disappointing run in May but was back in good nick for new stable last month, going close in similar race to this over C&D (good); will play a major role if in similar form.

RaceName: Visit Perth Museum Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Fair Flat racer who posted the best of his three hurdle runs when second to a fairly useful rival at Huntington (2m, good to firm) in May; not seen since but enters calculations.

RaceName: Visit Perth Museum Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Lost out by only a short head on stable/handicap hurdle debut at Doncaster (2m, good to soft) in March 2025; that form puts him right in the thick of things here but he returned from a long absence with two disappointing AW runs this spring and needs to prove his wellbeing; tongue-tie added.

RaceName: Visit Perth Museum Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Lady Cobham
Spotlight: Very useful on the Flat in his prime and returned from long absence with two encouraging hurdle runs for new stable this season, latterly when close fifth at Uttoxeter (2m, good) three weeks ago; that form already gives him good claims and he could quite plausibly have a bigger run in him.

RaceName: Visit Perth Museum Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Showed only minor promise when 66-1 for hurdling debut over C&D (good to soft) three months ago; probably one for a bit further down the line.

RaceName: Visit Perth Museum Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Regressive maiden on the Flat; outran triple-digit odds when respectable sixth (just behind Biggles) on hurdle debut at Uttoxeter (2m, good) three weeks ago but needs improvement.

RaceName: Visit Perth Museum Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Not beaten that far when sixth of nine in good-ground Worcester bumper in June, his second start, but needs to take a big step forward on this hurdling debut.

RaceName: QuinnBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: In contention when running out at the last at Kilbeggan (2m4f) in June on final start for Joseph O'Brien, before leaving him for 50,000gns; cheekpieces added for this third start over fences (stable debut) and there's no denying that this former pretty useful Flat-racer possesses a fair chunk of ability.

RaceName: QuinnBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Regular winner in France for Joel Boisnard, including over fences at Loudeac (2m5f) and Meral (2m2f); has held his own since moving to the UK, second at Uttoxeter (2m4f; in a reapplied hood) three weeks ago; should prove capable of winning more races, but not necessarily this one.

RaceName: QuinnBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Point winner; maintained unbeaten rules record, landing the odds in a 2m4f novices' hurdle at Sedgefield (good to soft) in February; that form has been boosted by the runner-up (four wins since) who now has a mark of 128, so this one has claims going over fences from his opening mark of 124; likely to be a threat if fully primed.

RaceName: QuinnBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Won twice over hurdles for Stuart Crawford, latterly at Ayr (2m4f) in November 2024; has gone the wrong way and competes from 14lb out of the handicap on this fourth run for current trainer, having had wind surgery since latest; by far the least likely candidate.

RaceName: QuinnBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Switching to fences has reaped benefits, backing up his opening Stratford win with an authoritative display under 5lb claimer at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good; evens favourite); another 5lb higher today; Sean Bowen is back aboard; strong likelihood of better to come, and stable won this last year, so he is the one to beat.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Back in trip, and readily resumed winning ways here (2m, good; 14-1) five weeks ago; that was in a Class 5 (0-105) so he has more on his plate in a 0-120 from this 6lb higher mark; one of two for Mike Smith, with Murray Dodd able to claim his full 5lb allowance this time.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Sole win came in a juvenile hurdle at Down Royal (2m1f) in September 2023; runner-up over 2m here (handicap debut) in July 2024, but all downhill since; soundly beaten when last seen three months ago; needs the added cheekpieces to spark a major revival; focus elsewhere.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Runner-up in this last year, and again chased home Moonbow the following month; close fourth to Lets Mingle over C&D five weeks ago; is 2lb better off with that reopposing rival, and the 10lb claimer Ella McGarry takes over in the saddle; merits respect.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: M Lee, D Lee, C Jolley & Neville
Spotlight: In fine form earlier this year, notching a hurdles hat-trick at Sedgefield (2m1f-2m4f; rising 16lb); reportedly stopped quickly when beaten favourite over 2m here (last of 12, beaten 42l) in June; it's possible that we might see the best version of this 6yo off a ten-week absence.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Said to have drawn benefit from the application of cheekpieces when game C&D winner (16-1; Summergrounds a close fourth) five weeks ago; boasts a solid C&D record (1U31) so a 2lb rise in the handicap could be manageable; one of three for Russell & Scudamore.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual Flat winner for Charlie Johnston (8.5f-12.5f); yet to score over hurdles (0-7) but doesn't have a massive amount to find with Lets Mingle and Summergrounds based on their recent C&D clash; the task isn't an impossible one.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Four course wins (all over 2m); lacked the pace to challenge when third over that trip here (good; 4-1) early last month; finished down the field back on the Flat (1m2f) since; stablemate Follow Charlie has more to recommend.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Infrequent winner (2-40); has plied his trade exclusively over fences since May 2024, lacking for fluency when runner-up to Conquer The Breeze here (2m) last month; monitor only, with Lets Mingle the pick of the Russell & Scudamore trio.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Better over fences than hurdles, notching back-to-back Musselburgh chase wins (2m4f) last November/December; tough task in Carlisle Class 2 (beaten 38l) when last seen 146 days ago; this should bring her on with a return to fences (rated 5lb higher) likely.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Proved her Hexham maiden win (2m4f; 50-1) was no fluke when chasing home the 119-rated Holy Joe over 2m4f here (novice; 15-2) five weeks ago; moves up in trip - stamina isn't totally obvious on pedigree - for handicap debut; low mileage.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Fourth to Newport at Musselburgh (2m, soft; beaten 4l) last November; disappointing since, with no obvious uptick for wind surgery; handicap mark is in freefall and point win came over 3m, so there are some positives.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Pounced late, ending barren spell, in this last year (neck winner off 102); didn't relish the Banks course at Punchestown in May, and nothing spectacular since over hurdles (2m1f-2m2f); returning to 3m is a positive, but he couldn't rate as the confident pick.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Limited; was struggling with over a circuit to go when a remote third over 2m4f (novice; 250-1) five weeks ago; mountain to climb on handicap debut to even threaten to reverse placings with Dolly Dior.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Cosy Ffos Las winner (2m4f, good to soft; from 2lb lower); it isn't easy to quantify that form, but she ran as well (if not slightly better based on RPRs) when runner-up in returning cheekpieces at Uttoxeter latest; back up in trip with Rian Corcoran's services retained; chance.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Promise in bumpers; low key over hurdles until showing fine attitude when scoring at Cartmel (2m6f, good; 14-1) four weeks ago; that breakthrough win came after a year off so there's potentially more to come; 4lb rise seems fair so should be thereabouts.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Thp Racing & D A Harrison Racing
Spotlight: Came from off the pace to make it course win number five last month, brushing off a 6lb rise for his previous C&D win; the handicapper has taken another swipe (further 6lb rise) and this is the highest mark that he has competed from in over three years; a hat-trick is a possibility nevertheless.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden over hurdles (0-21); nothing positive to draw upon since scoring over fences here (3m, soft; 7-2) last October; tailed off post wind surgery here (chase) 44 days ago; a risky proposition.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Six-race maiden; beaten favourite, no match for the winner, at Kelso (2m5f novice) in May 2025, before reportedly running flat on handicap debut at Hexham the following month; off since (for 427 days) so safest to let the market guide.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Ex-Irish; first run for this trainer was respectable but pulled up in the 2m4f 0-120 won by Lets Mingle (runs earlier) here latest; this is an easier option, and he's 5lb lower, but with plenty to prove for the time being, not least stamina.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Pulled up on her first two starts (2m4f mares) and well beaten in a 2m maiden here (250-1) 44 days ago; makes handicap debut from 7lb wrong; younger stablemate of Burgundy Man.

RaceName: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: No match for Filibustering when second at Cartmel (2m1f, good) on stable debut in June and has since been well beaten on the Flat but is well handicapped on some of his form for Alan King and will be suited by today's trip/ground; could have a say.

RaceName: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 2-6 over hurdles, with both wins gained from the front at Market Rasen (2m, good) this season; not sure to get her own way in this higher grade but may still have potential; respected.

RaceName: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Readily drew over 8l clear of Nap Hand to land good prize at Cartmel (2m1f, good) in June and is now 3-3 over hurdles since fitted with a tongue-tie in the spring; another 7lb higher but further progress is possible.

RaceName: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Thp Racing & D A Harrison Racing
Spotlight: C&D winner who was seemingly back in good form when close third in bunch-finish here (2m4f, good) five weeks ago; up in grade today but remains on a good mark; no surprise if she features.

RaceName: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Fair Flat racer who won three of his first four hurdling starts and was creditable third in Summer Hurdle at Market Rasen (2m, good) on latest outing four weeks ago; not yet fully exposed over jumps; must be considered.

RaceName: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
OwnerName: B Hague, Mrs W Duffus & Partner
Spotlight: Won three in a row over C&D (good) in early part of last season and subsequently made the frame in three Graded novice hurdles; absent since pulled up in Kelso Grade 2 in February but will be dangerous if back on song for this Perth return.

RaceName: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Signed off for Micky Hammond with win at Carlisle (2m1f, soft) in November and was placed on both starts for new stable in February (2m1f/2m3f, good to soft); returns from 172-day break on career-high mark but is suited by this C&D and should be fine on the forecast good ground; cheekpieces (worn once on the Flat in 2023) are refitted; contender if fully tuned up.

RaceName: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Off the mark over hurdles at 15th attempt, with hard-fought success in C&D (good) maiden six weeks ago; has more on his plate in this good-quality handicap, though, and needs to kick on again.

RaceName: Brooks Macdonald Handicap Chase
Spotlight: 0-6 over hurdles when trained by Gordon Elliott but finished well from poor position to cause 28-1 surprise here (2m4f, good) on stable/chase debut in six weeks ago; it's probably wise to treat that form with a degree of caution but today's step up in trip ought to suit him.

RaceName: Brooks Macdonald Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Well beaten on last month's stable debut at Newton Abbot (3m2f, good) but made a lot of the running before fading into fourth over that C&D (good to firm) in refitted cheekpieces and a first-time tongue a fortnight later, and it's worth remembering that his only career win came in this race in 2024; goes in just the tongue-tie today; interesting.

RaceName: Brooks Macdonald Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Eight-time hurdle winner; generally disappointing for current stable since last summer but seemed to respond well to first-time visor when respectable fourth of 14 over fences at Uttoxeter (3m, good) three weeks ago; can feature if the new headgear continues to aid.

RaceName: Brooks Macdonald Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Absent for 571 days after winning at Down Royal (2m4f, good to yielding) on Boxing Day 2024 and was probably flattered by his proximity when last of three on last month's reappearance outing at Cartmel (3m1f, good), having set a slow pace for a long way; remains quite tricky to weigh up as a 12yo but that recent run might have brought him on.

RaceName: Brooks Macdonald Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Irish raider; without a win since 2023 and far too inconsistent to rely upon heavily but gave a good account when third off today's mark at Cartmel (3m1f, good) two starts ago and the booking of Sean Bowen catches the eye; reserve (non-runner) in the 5.40 at Tramore on Friday.

RaceName: Brooks Macdonald Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Made all for clearcut success at Worcester (2m7f,) last month and has now won four good-ground chases this year; should also be suited by this right-handed track but latest 6lb rise might leave him vulnerable.

RaceName: Brooks Macdonald Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Dual chase winner last year, latterly off today's mark at Hexham (3m, good to soft) in October; well beaten on last three appearances, though, and returns from five-month break with quite a bit to prove.

RaceName: Scone Palace International Horse Trials National Hunt Flat Race (Conditional/Amateur Jockeys') (GBB)
Spotlight: Made promising debut for Paul Power at Tramore (good; wore a hood) in May, keeping on from the rear for fourth; new stable has excellent 27% strike-rate in British bumpers; leading contender.

RaceName: Scone Palace International Horse Trials National Hunt Flat Race (Conditional/Amateur Jockeys') (GBB)
Spotlight: Former Irish pointer; unable to justify favoritism but didn't really enjoy the run of the race when third of 11 on rules debut at Uttoxeter (good) last month; stable does well in bumpers (23% strike-rate); ought to make his presence felt.

RaceName: Scone Palace International Horse Trials National Hunt Flat Race (Conditional/Amateur Jockeys') (GBB)
Spotlight: Out of a half-sister to a Listed Flat winner; failed to complete his first two Irish points but showed some promise when fourth in May (good to yielding), after which he changed hands for £10,000; market may guide.

RaceName: Scone Palace International Horse Trials National Hunt Flat Race (Conditional/Amateur Jockeys') (GBB)
Spotlight: Out of a bumper/useful jumps winner; with a good stable but weakened into modest fifth of eight on debut at Ludlow (good) in November and needs improvement here.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Confirmed the promise of her Doncaster debut second when pulling well clear at York (7f, good to firm) 22 days ago, with a few of today's rivals behind; 1m will suit and ought to take a bit of stopping if she can get across and obtain a good position from her wide draw.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Completely blew the start when trailing home last on debut; got away on terms and showed ability when fifth of 13 at Redcar (7f, good to firm) since, with the reopposing Tommo's Queen narrowly ahead in fourth.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has reached the frame on all three outings since his debut but his form is little better than modest and latest Chesptow fourth was over 6f so this is a different test; the good form of his stable's juveniles provides hope, though.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Green and never involved on 6f Newbury debut 37 days ago; has stamina in his pedigree, though, so the 2f step up in trip could see him in a better light.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Made an encouraging start when second of 11 over 7f at Carlisle (good to firm) in June; sent off second favourite to Coral Cove at York a month later but weakened quickly (hung right) to finish last of eight; subsequently gelded; needs to recapture the debut form.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 40-1 when well held on 7f Newcastle debut seven weeks ago; can only watch after that.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: More one for low-grade nurseries based on his efforts over 6f/7f last month.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: £32,000 yearling; closely related to 1m-1m2f winner Zarabanda (RPR 102); dam Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner (91); her stable isn't really noted for 2yo winners but reasonable pedigree warrants a betting check.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Left debut behind when third over 7f at York (good to firm) 22 days ago but the reopposing Coral Cove was 7l ahead of him; 1m is bred to suit but even a 6lb swing in the weights with James Owen's filly doesn't look enough.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 33-1, finished a neck behind reopposing stablemate Rule Of The Agency when fourth to Coral Cove on last month's York debut (7f, good to firm); should improve for the experience.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Modest form in two 7f starts, beaten just under 7l when third at Musselburgh in cheekpieces (retained) latterly; improvement needed now stepping up to 1m.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Cracksman filly who was green but displayed promise once she got the hang of things when fourth of 13 on 7f Redcar debut (good to firm) four weeks ago; 1m will suit and she's open to improvement.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: £30,000 half-brother to winners Under The Twilight (6f/7f including AW; RPR 95) and Miss Nightcap (6f turf/7f AW; 92); dam 6f winner (86); the stable has yet to have a 2yo winner but bred to have a future and Danny Tudhope is 2-9 for the stable; has the outside stall but still worth a second look in the betting.

RaceName: Racing For Tamara Ripon Hornblower EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Mehmas filly who got up on the line to make a winning debut at York (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; likely to progress and the one to beat for in-form Ed Bethell.

RaceName: Racing For Tamara Ripon Hornblower EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Promise when sixth of 15 in a warm 6f maiden on Glorious Goodwood debut (good to firm) 18 days ago; likely improver for an in-form stable which won this in 2023.

RaceName: Racing For Tamara Ripon Hornblower EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: From a good family and displayed promise when 4.5l second to a well-touted newcomer from the Crisford stable over C&D (good to firm) 19 days ago; the third has boosted that form by winning since; can be expected to improve.

RaceName: Racing For Tamara Ripon Hornblower EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beaten a long way in two 5f Beverley outings, latterly on Wednesday; outsider.

RaceName: Racing For Tamara Ripon Hornblower EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Minor late headway when seventh of ten on 5f Beverley debut (good to firm) on Wednesday; needs to leave that well behind turned out again quickly.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Better known for his exploits over further but he ran well for second in a C&D handicap last August; several good runs in defeat this year but this looks a competitive race in which to end a two-year drought.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Ten-time course winner; he has done enough this year to think he could add to that tally but this may prove too competitive for the veteran.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Produced a strong finish to win a 6f handicap at York last month; strong in the betting back at York three weeks ago but could manage only seventh after his rider removed his blindfold late; still has handicapping scope.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Won four times in the first half of 2026 but she has come up short in Class 4 events on her last two starts; 2-3 over C&D but perhaps a shade high in the weights for now.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Two C&D wins last year and he is now 5lb lower than for the second of them; needs to bounce back from some modest efforts but that's quite possible under these conditions.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Impressive in this race in 2024 when rated 3lb higher; mixed bag this summer but his two best turf runs have come over C&D and this represents an ease in grade; can't rule out.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Well handicapped on this year's best, including a close fourth over C&D in April; has had the odd excuse since and he ran perfectly well over an inadequate 5f at York three weeks ago (not well drawn); a big run could be on the cards.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs C M Clarke, Foulrice Park Racing Ltd
Spotlight: Took a while to exploit his drop in the weights but he won at Doncaster in July and went in again at Southwell nine days ago; 4lb higher in a better race but he has the rail draw to help.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: On a good mark on his 2yo best; retains ability and he has run with credit on his last two starts; each-way shout.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Scored off this mark at Thirsk in May; has generally run to form since but he hasn't been at his best in two visits to Ripon; new headgear tried this afternoon.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Ended 2025 with a 7f win at Kempton (cheekpieces first time); well beaten at Goodwood 17 days ago on his return from a 175-day break (gelded during the absence); better than that but still not easily recommended.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Low-key stable debut at York last month but she fared much better when third of 21 back there 13 days later; runs off the same mark today and she's not out of it.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Underwent a second wind operation prior to her return to action in May and it appears to have done the trick, as she followed her breakthrough win at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) with a comfortable success at Ayr (5f, good); poorly drawn at York last time (wore cheekpieces); could still have a bigger run in her.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: 4lb lower than when third of 15 in this race last year; yet to strike in 2026 but there have been some good runs along the way, including his last two starts; looks the likeliest to grab the far rail if the field split into two groups; one to consider.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: 5f win here off 2lb higher in May; quiet afterwards until reviving with a second of six at Thirsk last week; has a C&D win on his record but rarely seen over 6f in recent times.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Listed win over C&D (good ground) last August; she hasn't looked ahead of the handicapper this year though and others are more appealing.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Low-key return to turf at York (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; should be well treated but he comes with risks attached.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: In fine form in the second half of 2025, winning five times; ran his best race this season when fourth of six at Windsor (5f, good to soft) when last seen in June; on a winning mark but slower ground would be preferable.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: The addition of a tongue-tie saw him return to winning ways at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in June; the tongue-tie was left off on last month's stable debut and he ran creditably in fifth at Southwell; this may prove too competitive.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: 6-21 on AW as opposed to 0-16 on turf; the handicapper has been in command so far this year but he is edging down the weights and may yet come good on grass; refused to race in last season's Ayr Silver Cup.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Listed winner (6f) on AW; showed himself to be smart on turf too with a 7f handicap win at Newmarket last month; wouldn't judge him harshly on his Bunbury Cup defeat five weeks ago, racing away from the main action and still in front 1f out; 4lb lower today and he looks a big player for last year's winning connections.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Two front-running 5f wins this summer; came up short in his hat-trick bid at Pontefract four weeks ago and this is just the second 6f run of his career; others appeal more.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
OwnerName: N Skinner D Jenkins J Glover
Spotlight: In good form this year, winning a big-field handicap at York (6f, good) in May and adding a C&D handicap 12 days ago (good ground; Dark Cloud Rising second); up 5lb in a stronger race and it could find him out.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Has proved a bargain buy for connections, winning a 6f Doncaster novice on debut and showing progressive form in 7f handicaps this summer; latest York win came in a Class 4 and although he's on the up, he has more on his plate from 4lb out of the handicap.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive handicapper last year; took form to a new level with a Listed win at Doncaster on his seasonal return and performed to a similar level when second in the Group 3 Abernant at Newmarket in April; Group 1 company was too much to handle at Royal Ascot and a mighty performance will be needed to defy his big weight back in a handicap (12lb higher than for his narrow Ascot win last October).

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Positives include a C&D record comprising a win and a second and he arrives in top form; whether he is quite well enough treated for a race of this nature remains to be seen though.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Sprang a 40-1 surprise on his stable debut at York (5f, good) in May and he showed better form in defeat on his next two starts (both at York; 5f and 6f on good ground); messed about at the start when disappointing at York seven weeks ago; still of major interest from a handicapping perspective judged on his run on June 13 and he's unexposed at 6f; contender.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner; runner-up on this card 12 months ago; having a solid campaign but surprising if he was up to winning.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Fared best of the stands' side group when second in this race 12 months ago; races off 3lb higher this time around but he confirmed his liking for the track with a C&D win in April and he was better than ever when beating 16 rivals at York (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago; high on the list.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Gelded prior to his reappearance and he started 2026 with a pair of AW wins; tougher going on turf this summer but he has been in deep races and his latest second at Ascot (6f, good to firm; cheekpieces first time) has worked out well; runs off the same mark and commands respect.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: 7f win at Thirsk in May and ran well over that trip at Chester two weeks later; not quite so good since and the drop to 6f isn't enough to tempt.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice in novice company (7f) for Roger Varian; yet to win a handicap but he has run two sound races (1m and 7f) for his new stable; returns to 6f for the first time since his debut and he should have enough pace to cope.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: His record over C&D reads 121 and he has slipped to a dangerous mark after three low-key runs in 2026; looks the type to revive soon but perhaps when faced with slower ground than he'll encounter today.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: 0-5 at Ripon but he has run well here; back near his best when seeing off 16 rivals at Ayr last month but a subsequent Hamilton run (5f) was underwhelming; still feasibly weighted despite being 1lb wrong but he is another who would make more appeal on a slower surface.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo who was strong in the market when making light of a 560-day absence at Thirsk (7f, good) in May on his first outing for Ed Bethell; won going away in a style which suggests this step up to 1m could unlock more improvement; a further four-month break is of little concern given he goes so well fresh (also won on debut).

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Successful over 1m2f at Newbury (good to firm) off this mark for Ian Williams last summer; creditable start for new yard after nine months off (had wind surgery) when third of five over 1m2f here (good) 12 days ago; entitled to build on that but 9.4f at Wolverhampton is the shortest trip he's tackled prior to this.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Prolific winning veteran, including in this race in 2021 and 2022 (fourth to Capital Guarantee last year); went close to another C&D success last month and fair third at Pontefract (1m, good to firm) since.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Made the frame for the seventh consecutive time, albeit beaten 7l, when second of 14 at Redcar (1m, good to firm) a week ago; holds no secrets from the handicapper but ought to give another good account.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: In-form 4yo who won at Ascot and Pontefract (both 1m, good to firm) in July; another creditable effort when third (Jungle Ruler second) at Sandown (1m, good to firm again) 17 days ago; ought to be competitive again.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Back to winning ways at Thirsk (1m, good to firm) last month; only sixth off this mark at Redcar last Saturday but the fact he won this race off 2lb higher last year provides hope; draw could have been kinder.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Ran really well when runner-up in two big-field handicaps at York (7f/1m, good) in June; back close to that form when fifth of 15 at Thirsk (7f, good) a fortnight ago; has claims but he's often held up (tends to start slowly) and this isn't the easiest course to make ground up.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive since fitted with headgear and switched to handicaps, winning three times and second twice from five attempts; had next-time-out scorers behind in second/third when gaining latest win at Sandown (1m, good to firm) 22 days ago and a further 6lb rise seems unlikely to prevent a bold bid from this improving 3yo.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Back to form from out of the blue in a first-time visor when getting off the mark at the 11th time of asking at Chester (extended 7f, good) five weeks ago; plenty went his way (got a dream run through on the inner after leaders went hard) and wouldn't be an obvious type to follow up.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Made all on his final start for Ross Burdon at Yarmouth (11.5f, soft) in June but has failed to beat a rival in two recent starts for new trainer Iain Jardine; can only be watched at present.

RaceName: Ashley Smith Memorial William Hill Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Usually slowly away but she was able to dictate the pace and battled back well when winning at Hamilton (1m3f, good) last month; evens when creditable second of four at Leicester (1m4f, good to firm) 18 days later, beaten a neck with the front two drawing 15l clear; player off same mark today.

RaceName: Ashley Smith Memorial William Hill Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Four starts, the best of which was her debut in May; while not beaten far on handicap debut at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm; second favourite) last time, she finished only sixth of seven after making most; back to 1m4f (tried it on second start) but others are more alluring.

RaceName: Ashley Smith Memorial William Hill Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Heavy defeats to begin with, including on soft in her only turf race, but closer on handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) and she built on that with a win over the same C&D (16-1); travelled okay but got shuffled back and came wide from last place entering the straight when hitting the front late on in that 12-runner race 16 days ago, which offers the clear chance of better still to offset her 5lb rise.

RaceName: Ashley Smith Memorial William Hill Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Five-race maiden who failed to beat a rival in her two handicaps this term, running below her 2yo form; moves up from 1m2f in first-time headgear.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Promising third at Hamilton (1m1f, good) a fortnight ago and confirmed herself an improved performer with a cosy win at Redcar (1m, good to firm) last week; unextended when following up at Beverley (8.4f, good to firm) on Thursday; 7lb higher today but she should stay and looks to have strong claims of completing her hat-trick.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Won two of her last three starts, both at Ripon over 1m4f and 1m2f; a 4lb rise for her latest win shouldn't be beyond her.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark for the year at Beverley (8.4f, good to firm) in April and he has run several good races in defeat since; he should be in the thick of the action once more.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Has three C&D wins to his name, including this race in 2023; retains ability but threw away a golden opportunity at Leicester last month and a subsequent Newcastle run was below his recent best too; minor money perhaps his best hope.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Course winner (6f); wins at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) and Doncaster (1m, good to soft) this summer but he has come up short on his last three runs; needs more to take this.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner but it has been over four years since she last put her head in front; retained ability last summer but she has been absent for 366 days and others look safer.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice on AW off higher marks over the winter; she has more to prove on turf but a big run wouldn't be a huge surprise.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Poor strike-rate but he arrives after a creditable third at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm) last month; likely one or two will have his measure today.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Finished third in this race 12 months ago (seven ran) before winning over C&D nine days later; unplaced in four runs this year and others look stronger.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Successful at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) last month and that has been followed by two solid runs, the latest at Beverley on Tuesday; one of three runners for Tim Easterby.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Modest form in three turf maidens at up to 8.4f this summer; could improve for the longer trip and switch to low-grade handicaps but this mark isn't an obvious gift on the evidence available.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden; hopes appear to rest on this first crack at 1m2f sparking some progress.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Dropped a long way in the weights since joining Ruth Carr but he retains some ability and this longer trip looks worth exploring; drawn wide but likely to be dropped in; could go well at a price.

RaceName: Newly Weds Sara & Nigel Irish EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Yard won 1m4f maiden a couple of years ago with this one's half-sister Trapalanda, and half-brother Ney is useful dual-purpose performer who has won six races; dam won over 1m.

RaceName: Newly Weds Sara & Nigel Irish EBF Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Mohammed Bin Hamad Khalifa Al Attiyah
Spotlight: Decent debut on rain-softened ground at Leopardstown and then beaten just over 2l by shorter-priced stablemate over this trip at Limerick, sticking to her task; second and fifth both won at Galway.

RaceName: Newly Weds Sara & Nigel Irish EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Promising debut over 1m5f at Leopardstown when finished upsides Phlox; didn't finish off as well when beaten further at Fairyhouse.

RaceName: Newly Weds Sara & Nigel Irish EBF Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Barnane Stud & Hollywood Stud Ireland Limited
Spotlight: Camelot filly is related to Group winnners, and is out of one too; fair fifth over 1m5f at Leopardstown; starting to retreat when hit the rail and became unbalanced at Killarney, which exaggerated the margin of defeat; yard was quiet at the time too, so that run is best ignored.

RaceName: Newly Weds Sara & Nigel Irish EBF Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Carl Anthony Howell & Mrs Pauline Condon
Spotlight: Plugged away on last month's debut over 1m4f at Limerick, but has 10l to find with fourth-placed Mawhibah.

RaceName: Newly Weds Sara & Nigel Irish EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Sea The Stars filly cost 525,000gns as a yearling; dam Group-placed 1m4f-1m6f winner, half-sister to winners Prince Of Arran (1m4f Australian Group 3/Melbourne Cup runner-up) and Souter (useful 1m/8.5f); held an Irish Oaks entry; missed intended debut at Killarney last month.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Third in a Leopardstown bumper in March before winning on hurdling debut at Limerick later that month; both of those runs on soft; well held in Cork novice hurdle on good ground when last seen in May; this is probably a prep for Listowel.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
OwnerName: John P McManus & Mrs John Magnier
Spotlight: By Camelot out of top-class racemare Annie Power; won his first three races last summer, a bumper and two hurdles, but the wheels have come off since; wasn't up to Graded level or smart handicaps in the spring, albeit easy ground was against him several times, and tipped up on chasing debut in May; King will fill him with confidence and has the ability to go close.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Top-class chaser weakend out of contention in the Galway Hurdle; ran in a Curragh 1m4f maiden (without usual cheekpieces) as a prep for that, and a perfectly respectable effort saw him run to a mark of somewhere in the mid-70s, using the runner-up as a guide.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Well beaten in bumpers and rated 103 over hurdles; seemed to run well when plugging away to be fifth in 1m7f amateur riders' maiden at Leopardstown, but they went steady and she's likely flattered by the bare formline.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Frankel filly from a fine Moyglare family; just beaten by a fellow 70-rated rival in an optional claimer at Sligo last week; on pedigree, this longer trip shouldn't be a problem; looking at her action the last day, probably doesn't want it too quick.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Well-bred Wootton Bassett gelding had run in a barrier trial before making his debut last week at Leopardstown; 16s, never a factor over 1m1f; dam is a sister to Irish 1,000 Guineas third So Wonderful, but yet to produce a winner.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Poor form under both codes; no chance here.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Dire form in two runs and no chance here.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Wootton Bassett gelding; half-brother to smart performer Mohawk (7f-1m1f inc 2yo Group 2; RPR 114); dam 6f-1m winner (inc AW 2yo/Group 3;), out of 7f Listed winning half-sister to 7f-1m1f Group 1 winner Bigstone; no star at home if he's coming here for his debut, but the market will tell us more.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Sioux Nation newcomer is half-brother to German winners Fataliste (1m1f) and Fascianata (1m7f); dam German 8.5f winner, out of German 7f Listed winner.

RaceName: Morris DIY Rated Race
Spotlight: Ballinrobe 9.5f winner was no match for Rodeo Blues back there, but is 15lb better off here; well held when second to older rival over C&D last month; usually leads.

RaceName: Morris DIY Rated Race
Spotlight: Saxon Warrior filly has been disappointing since entering handicaps; fair fourth in a Killarney claimer last month; led before backpedalling in the straight at Galway; hasn't raced beyond an extended 1m; dam's half-brother won Group 3 over 1m5f.

RaceName: Morris DIY Rated Race
Spotlight: Bolger-bred Teofilo gelding; good fourth in a hot Curragh maiden last year; okay comeback over 1m at Leopardstown, and soft ground probably the reason for a poor display on handicap debut at same track; gelded since and steps up in trip here.

RaceName: Morris DIY Rated Race
Spotlight: Maiden with solid placed form on last three starts; got this trip okay on handicap debut at Limerick, where he was readily outpaced by a Joseph O'Brien-trained winner; that form took a few hits at Galway, but good chance of being in the three again here.

RaceName: Morris DIY Rated Race
OwnerName: Annus Mirabilis Synd'/Sean O'Driscoll/Middle Cow Unlimited
Spotlight: Went up sharply in the ratings for two wins over shorter, but nothing wrong with her run against older rivals over this trip at Galway; valuable 7lb off and definitely capable of winning more races; went badly left off the home bend at Ballinrobe, but ran straighter at Galway.

RaceName: Morris DIY Rated Race
Spotlight: Front-running fourth over 1m1f at Ballinrobe, but that's not strong from, and was beaten 10l when filling same position over 1m5f at Sligo last week.

RaceName: Morris DIY Rated Race
Spotlight: Not a bad run in a 1m Naas maiden when last seen in June, beaten 14l and still looked very green; sister to 1m6f winner and smart jumper Teddy Blue; could be a different proposition in middle-distance handicaps, so not one to rule out.

RaceName: Morris DIY Rated Race
Spotlight: Fair maiden form and ran respectably on handicap debut in higher-grade contest at the Curragh; outpaced before the straight over 1m1f at Leopardstown last week and going back up in trip should help.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: Winner over this trip at three; won a hurdle and some good placed efforts on the Flat last year; comes here a fresh horse and ran respectably at Ballinrobe last month where met some interference.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: Well-bred filly (grand-daughter of Oaks/Irish Oaks winner Sariska) is sole 3yo in here; yet to be competitive, including when 20-1 for handicap debut at Cork, and slowly away last twice; headgear.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: Recorded his second 10.5f AW win in January and is rated 15lb higher on that surface; fine effort over just shy of this trip at Killarney last month, beaten half a length by in-form mare with Tassarolo a length behind him in third.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: Completed a summer hat-trick in this last year, which was her second C&D win; mid-field run at Leopardstown, after a break, rendered her eligible for repeat bid.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: Dual-purpose 5yo won at Killarney last summer and his third of 15 at that track last month was the closest he's come this term.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark over this trip at Roscommon in May and came home well in 10.5f claimer at Sligo last week; 1lb drop gets her back into this grade.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: Not shamed in four handicaps last year, but yet to place; has come down 10lb from initial mark; been off nearly nine months.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: AW winner at three and dual winner over fences last year; couple of first-fence falls in March and quiet since; okay run at Navan in June; second to Stepdance over C&D last July, off this mark, and now meets her on a whopping 25lb better terms; only second time to wear blinkers.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: Respectable run in a classy Leopardstown maiden on her return, but beaten a long way on handicap debut over 1m1f at same track.

RaceName: Perennial Freight Handicap
Spotlight: Fairly useful hurdler last season, winning a Roscommon maiden; well held in handicaps, however; standout Flat run for Alan King when touched off in 1m6f Sandown handicap two years ago off 3lb higher; didn't appear to stay the extended 2m trip at Galway on his return to this discipline last time; opposable.

RaceName: Perennial Freight Handicap
Spotlight: Up a total of 13lb for back-to-back wins at Ballinrobe (1m5f, yielding) and over C&D (good) when 2.75l ahead of Marmeladova (that rival 3lb better off now); finished last at Gowran last time (1m5f, good to firm), which is not fully explained by her new rating; can do better back here.

RaceName: Perennial Freight Handicap
Spotlight: Bounced back to form when gaining a first Flat win on his third run for this yard over C&D last month in first-time blinkers, successful by 10l; hefty 12lb hike for that but interesting if headgear continues to work; just second over hurdles here on Thursday.

RaceName: Perennial Freight Handicap
OwnerName: D O'Mahony & D McHugh & D J Kelly & G Butler
Spotlight: Yet to win after eight Flat starts but took a Down Royal maiden hurdle in May; solid effort over 1m4f at Galway last month (yielding to soft); two-day break possibly to blame when disappointed over hurdles back there last time; others appeal more.

RaceName: Perennial Freight Handicap
Spotlight: Three wins in Britain in 2023 at up to 1m; regressive in 2024 and 2025 seasons; took advantage of a drop in grade and forceful tactics when winning a claimer over this trip at Limerick and backed that up in a Ballinrobe handicap off 72 (1m2f, yielding); not too bad in two runs at the Galway festival; good claimer takes off weight and this track may suit.

RaceName: Perennial Freight Handicap
Spotlight: Added to her Ballinrobe maiden win over an extended 1m1f trip when landing a 1m2f Leopardstown handicap by a neck off 75 last month; her run at the Curragh last time was too bad to be true when sweating and beaten 21l in last place; finished 2.75l behind Daboya in their C&D meeting in July; needs to bounce back.

RaceName: Perennial Freight Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time Flat winner won off 2lb higher at Ballinrobe last year (1m2f, good) and returned to the same race in May when an okay fourth of nine; something seemingly went wrong when pulled up over hurdles at Clonmel in May; others appeal more.

RaceName: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap
Spotlight: Off since pulling up in a Grade 1 novice hurdle at Naas in January 2025; won a 1m2f Flat maiden at Roscommon in 2022 for Paddy Twomey and a Naas maiden hurdle in 2024; tough task given his absence.

RaceName: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap
Spotlight: Bounced back to form with a close third under a positive ride over 1m7f at Leopardstown last month; form of that race is questionable and she's 4lb out of the weights, but C&D winner last summer and her rider's claim helps; trainer returned to the winners' enclosure at Galway earlier this month.

RaceName: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap
Spotlight: Dual Flat winner in 2022 and added a maiden hurdle last year; just okay Flat handicap runs this season before tailed off effort over hurdles at Ballinrobe; beaten 22l at Fairyhouse last time; others preferred.

RaceName: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap
Spotlight: Fairyhouse maiden winner last season (1m4f, good to yielding); made a cracking return to action in May when fourth in a big-field handicap at the Curragh (1m6f, good); has disappointed as favourite in two runs since at the Curragh (2m1f, good to firm) and at Leopardstown in a five-runner conditions event (1m7f, good, 4-6); capable of more.

RaceName: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap
Spotlight: Modest jumper (rated 99) is 0-3 on Flat and has been well beaten in all those outings; makes his Flat handicap bow, now upped to 2m, from a reasonable initial mark and good claimer aboard.

RaceName: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap
Spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle at Sligo for Willie Mullins in August 2024; failed to win on the Flat for that stable (no Flat win since 2022); ran respectably over 1m4f on stable debut here in a claimer; not disgraced in a valuable Galway Flat handicap last time (2m1f, yielding) when wearing this headgear for the first time; dropped 3lb for that.

RaceName: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap
Spotlight: Six-time winner is 6lb above his last winning mark at Roscommon in September (1m4f, soft); good second on seasonal return at Leopardstown in June (1m1f, soft) but below his best at the Curragh and Galway (2m1f, yielding) since then; slowly away and stumbled in that latest outing, which was a first try at a 2m+ trip; best form on softer.

RaceName: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap
Spotlight: Dual hurdles winner has scored twice on the Flat, including over C&D; latest win was in the valuable amateur riders' handicap at the Galway festival last year (2m1f, yielding) off 5lb lower; disappointed on seasonal return in that race last time; must take a big step forward from that first run, but he has tended to do so in past seasons.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Back-to-back winner on AW at 1m4f/2m earlier this year and didn't run badly back there when last seen in February (2m); 1-13 on turf and rated 21lb lower on this surface; second off 1lb higher at Tipperary in August last year, but poor at Down Royal next time when last seen on turf.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Dual AW winner at 1m6f/2m1f last year; 0-15 on the Flat on turf; moderate run at Down Royal over this trip when last seen on the Flat and poor over hurdles in his last two runs; others more likely.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Won back-to-back handicap hurdles at Downpatrick and Down Royal over 2m6f/3m last August; 0-9 on Flat and first go in this discipline since 2024; disappointed over hurdles at Wexford last time.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Versatile mare gained a first Flat win over C&D at the 22nd attempt last month (Lariat 1.25l behind); ran to her mark over fences at Wexford last time; returns to the scene of her victory 4lb higher and could go well.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Won a Cork 3yo handicap last summer off 1lb lower for Joe Murphy (1m4f, good); pushed wide off the bend when a keeping-on fourth here on seasonal return (1m4f, good), Highway Sixty One 4.5l ahead; close fourth at Killarney next time and raised 3lb for her head defeat at Gowran eight days ago (1m5f, good), shaping like this trip was worth a try; new cheekpieces on.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Was in better form last year when winning at Limerick over hurdles and on the Flat (1m5f, good, rated 73); largely struggled in both codes since, although ran to his mark at Killarney last month when sixth (1m4f, good); took second in a Sligo claiming hurdle last time when well treated; others make more appeal.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Dual Flat winner but nothing since 2022; yet to score from 28 runs over hurdles; ran well over C&D in July when runner-up off this mark; pulled up over hurdles next time; he's better in this sphere, but long losing run drastically reduces his appeal.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden gelding by Frankel; has shown potential for a belated breakthrough in his three Flat runs this term, the latest when sixth over C&D (4-1 fav), where today's rider was banned for stopping riding late on (4.5l behind Lariat); others more appealing.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Now winless from 17 Flat starts but has posted some solid runs this season, including when chasing home an easy winner over 1m4f here on penultimate; hampered at Killarney last time when beaten 7l; tries this trip on the Flat for the first time in his career; tongue-tie added.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Modest form so far; well beaten in opening two handicaps on AW and was tailed off at Ballinrobe last month on his first try on turf; new headgear goes on.

RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Impressive debut at Flemington 14 Feb. Raced keenly & gave up the ghost quickly first-up. Look for improvement here & warrants attention.

RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: D Rogers, Mrs K Rogers Et Al
Spotlight: Short odds and duly saluted at Sale on debut. Can fill the minors here.

RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Back for second campaign (25-weeks). More developed now. In the market all runs. Placed at Rosehill on debut last campaign while showing enough in recent trials. Hope for exotics.

RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Makybe Racing & Breeding Pty Ltd, Cavalluccio Et Al
Spotlight: Second campaign (22-weeks). Further matured. Nice win of the VOBIS Showdown last prep. 2nds at recent jump-outs at Pakenham Syn. Watch closely.

RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Fronting up for second campaign (21-weeks). Placed in Blue Diamond before compounding after racing on pace in Golden Slipper. 3rd & 2nd at recent Flemington jump-outs. Looks a major player.

RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Kicks off second campaign (19-weeks). Stakes-placed colt. Given two trials. Lone victory was over this trip. Place preferred.

RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Bennett Racing P/L, Rosemont Stud P/L Et Al
Spotlight: Kicks off second campaign (19-weeks). Won the Maribyrnong Plate in his maiden campaign. 3rd & 1st at latest Warwick Farm trials. Can play a role fresh.

RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: K W Breese, Mrs J R Breese Et Al
Spotlight: Waltzed in at Echuca at second outing. in the slosh. Has claims for a repeat.

RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Mrs K Flaherty, Baxter Lodge Racing No 1 Et Al
Spotlight: Responded well from back half to get the prize at Flemington at second outing. Could give some cheek at odds.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Kildalton Park Racing, N B Smith Et Al
Spotlight: Kicks off second campaign (12-weeks). Smart debut at Caulfield 9 May & then went on to run 2nd at Gold Coast. Looks very promising. 2nd & 1st at latest jump-outs. Right in this.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Terrific winning the 2yo Hcp over 1100m at Randwick at $7.50. Drawn to effect. Soft proven, heavy unknown. Capable of figuring again.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Miss J Banks, Mrs C L Lovatt, Mrs S Cusack & M Hooton
Spotlight: Kept fresh. Gritty on pace victory 2yo F Mdn at Warwick Farm for new stable. Has an adverse draw. Prefer others.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: 5 weeks since last run. Game effort this track in choppy conditions second-up. More a minor money chance here.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Made an immediate impact with a convincing win in soft going at Flemington. Can win again.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Resolute Racing, C Massie Et Al
Spotlight: Let-up (63-days). Off the speed, picked up soundly and wasn't beaten far at Eagle Farm. Since trialled at Warwick Farm 4 Aug. Others with greater appeal.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Kurrinda Bloodstock, Mrs Y Smith Et Al
Spotlight: Kicks off second campaign (21-weeks). Won the 2yo F Swp in her maiden campaign. Did a terrific job in her first campaign. Has a tricky draw and rising in weight. Place looks best.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: M Hymet, R Griffiths Et Al
Spotlight: Kicks off second campaign (20-weeks). Stakes-placed in first prep., Strikes a stronger field.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Back for second campaign (23-weeks).Undefeated mare having her first run across the ditch. Latest run was a G1 win at Ellerslie. Michael Dee stays on board. Major player.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Australian T'bred B'stock Pty Ltd, J E J Ciurlionis Et Al
Spotlight: Had all before her at turn and went home tamely at Flemington for new stable. Untried in the wet. Hard to make a case.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
TrainerName: Peter G Moody & Katherine Coleman right
Spotlight: Excellent debut performance when just nabbed at Flemington at $21. Worth a look again.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Lindsay Park Bloodstock, Needham Racing Et Al
Spotlight: Let-up (42-days). Just got there in the 2yo (Open) at Flemington in rain affected going last start. Soft tick, heavy query. Could repeat without surprise.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
TrainerName: Leon & Troy Corstens & Will Larkin right

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Kept fresh since resuming. Reserved midfield and picked up intently in choppy conditions at Rosehill off spell. Since trialled at Warwick Farm 4 Aug. One for your exotics.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Great effort in the The Gold Rush Ascot two back. Stationed mid and sustained a strong run this course for his new stable. Has an excellent second-up record & Pikey comes for the ride. Hard to beat.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: Proven Thoroughbreds, P Yates Et Al
Spotlight: Let-up (63-days). Grand camapigner who loves a first-up run. Only got the wobbles late in the Stradbroke after leading them up last time. Must be considered.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: Mystery Downs, Mrs C M Cook Et Al
Spotlight: Resuming (19-weeks). Placed in elite company last prep and has had a 2nd & 1st at recent jump-outs. Barrier hurts but possesses early toe. Can definitely play a role.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: E Jusufovic, P J Fulton Et Al
Spotlight: Kept fresh following return when got home super behind Coeur Volante here. Can run a race at odds.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: Sutton Racing Pty Ltd, S Chappell Et Al
Spotlight: First-up (20-weeks). Has run well fresh. Soft tick, heavy query. Not out of this fresh in this company.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
TrainerName: Peter G Moody & Katherine Coleman right
Spotlight: Let-up (63-days). Finished well held in heavy ground at Eagle Farm over today's trip. Has won multiple times in wet. Can make his presence felt fresh in this line-up.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: Widden Stud Pty Ltd & Bangaloe Stud
Spotlight: Caulfield winner two back. Not far off them at Flemington in a leader dominataed race. Each way claims.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: C J Waller, Go Bloodstock Australia Et Al
Spotlight: First-up (18-weeks). Better suited to longer assignments these days. Others more persuasive.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: Halo Racing Services Pty Ltd, Ms D M Suss Et Al
Spotlight: First-up (27-weeks). Long time since last saluted. Trial & jump-out were pleasing. Rough exotics hope.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: N A Greenhalgh, Mrs M T Greenhalgh et al
Spotlight: First-up (17-weeks). Sound win at Mornington last time. Meets a stronger bunch here .

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Fronting up for second campaign (18-weeks). Ex New Zealander. Steps out for third Aust start. Australian Oaks winner at Randwick last start back in April. Big watch.

RaceName: JRA Prix Alec Head (Prix de Pomone) (Group 2) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Group 1-placed last year and ran to best when beating last weekend's German Group 1 winner Tiffany over 1m4f on fast ground at Chantilly in June (below-par Indalimos back in seventh); the one to beat on that evidence.

RaceName: JRA Prix Alec Head (Prix de Pomone) (Group 2) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
